rows.original: When you and your elven [silly|cumrags|comrades] ascend from the crypt, you find the palace guard waiting for you[party.som| with [companion.name]| with your companions close behind]. "Lady Regent!" the captain salutes, raising her spear. "Are you alright? We heard-" "A lot of things best forgotten, I'm sure," Hethia says, taking her bow from her back and stretching. "Consider the matter resolved. There will be no further threat from the dead." Elthara nods her agreement, handing her war-scythe off to one of the guardsmen. "Goddess be praised, and may the Wyld be sated." Ryn gives you a little smile and takes your hand. "Stand the guard down, captain. Our Champion's saved the palace once more." The armored elf-woman nods solemnly and marches her company back up the stairs, followed by the priestly pair. Once they're all gone, Ryn turns to you and [etheryn.lnhConfidence|just buries her cheek into your [pc.chest]. "Th-th-thank you for saving us again, [pc.name]. I'd be so, so lost without you. Thank you...|takes your other hand too. "Thank you, [pc.name]. You really have saved the day again. I don't know what I'd do without you. I mean it.|brings you in for a hug. "Thanks again, [pc.name]. Not just for saving the day, but for... well, being there for me. Like usual, right? Someday I'll be strong enough to handle these things myself, but until then... thank you for being my savior. Always.]" You give Ryn a little squeeze and tell her that you'll be here for her as long as she needs. [var0|Infused with sunlight, Etheryn's bow now has a permanent +10 Holy damage bonus[var1| and she has +10 Crit Chance regardless of set].]
rows.translation: 当你和你的精灵伙伴们一起 [silly|cumrags|同志们] 从地窖中出来后，你会发现宫廷卫兵正在那里等着你。[party.som| 与……一起 [companion.name]| 你的同伴紧随其后]摄政夫人！”队长敬礼道，同时举起了长矛。“您没事吧？我们听说……” “很多事情最好被遗忘，我相信这一点，”赫希娅说着，从背后取下弓，伸了伸腰。“就把这件事当作已经解决了吧。 死者不会再构成任何威胁了。” 埃尔萨拉点了点头表示同意，然后将她的战镰交给了其中一名卫兵。“愿女神受到赞美，也愿荒野得到满足。” 瑞恩对你微微一笑，然后握住了你的手。 队长，可以解散卫兵了。我们的冠军又一次拯救了这座宫殿。” 这位身着铠甲的精灵女性严肃地点了点头，然后带领她的部队重新走上楼梯，那对牧师也跟在后面。等他们全都离开后，瑞恩转向你说道 [etheryn.lnhConfidence|只是将脸颊贴在你的身上 [pc.chest]太、太感谢你又一次救了我们 [pc.name]没有你，我会感到无比迷茫。谢谢你……|也握住了你的另一只手。“谢谢你， [pc.name]你真的又一次拯救了局面。没有你，我真的不知道该怎么办。我是认真的。|这会让你情不自禁地想要拥抱对方。“再次感谢， [pc.name]不仅仅是为了拯救危难，更是为了……嗯，就是为了陪伴在我身边。就像往常一样，对吧？总有一天，我会变得足够强大，能够独自面对这些困难，但在那之前……感谢你一直成为我的救星。永远感谢你。]你轻轻捏了捏Ryn的手，告诉她，在她需要的任何时候，你都会在她身边。 [var0|沐浴在阳光的照耀下，艾瑟琳的弓现在获得了永久性的+10神圣伤害加成。[var1| 而且无论使用何种装备，她的暴击几率都会增加10%。].]

rows.original: There is no point in descending the stairs again.
rows.translation: 再下楼梯也没有任何意义了。
rows.raw: "There is no point in descending the stairs again."

rows.original: Return to the harem's chambers. Maybe there's still something you forgot...?
rows.translation: 回到后宫的房间吧。也许还有些什么你忘记了……？
rows.raw: "Return to the harem's chambers. Maybe there's still something you forgot...?"

rows.original: Descend their stairs of this deep pit-grave. Gods only know what you'll find down there...
rows.translation: 走下这座深邃的墓穴中的阶梯吧。只有神明才知道下面会有什么……
rows.raw: "Descend their stairs of this deep pit-grave. Gods only know what you'll find down there..."

rows.original:
"Synneva!" you shout, glancing around. "We need you."
    
            A cold hand touches your shoulder, and the near-naked ghosts brushes past you. "I am already here. And eager to see my... my beloved again. Hold, now. Let me pierce her barrier."
            
            The halfsex elf draws from behind her garterbelt a blade of pure, glistening ice and drives it into the spectral barrier blocking your path. There's another of those ear-piercing wails, as if she'd just stuck a living being — but Synneva presses into it, slicing the ice blade down all the way to the floor. It leaves in its wake a gaping gash that even your smaller elves are able to pull apart, creating an opening that Elthara's able to pass through. 
            
            Once one of your party has passed the barrier, it seems to [silly|give up the ghost, fading|fade] into nothing. Whisps of smoke and mist drift away, leaving the archway clear — as if it had never been there at all. 
            
            Beyond the arch, you can see a raised chamber dominated by sarcophagi. And inside it, a woman's kneeling, cloaked by a pair of ashen wings from her back.
            
            "There she is!" Synneva breathes, putting a hand to her chest. "Etheryn, behold. Your grandmother."
            
            "G-grandmother..." Ryn murmurs at your side, looking between you and the ghost of the Consort. "Please. Let's help her move on."
rows.translation:
辛内瓦！”你喊道，同时环顾四周，“我们需要你。”

一只冰冷的手触碰了你的肩膀，那些几乎赤裸的幽灵从你身边掠过。“我已经在这里了。而且非常渴望再次见到我的……我亲爱的……抓紧吧。 让我突破她的屏障吧。”

这个半性别的精灵从自己的袜带后方抽出一把由纯净冰晶构成的利刃，将其刺入了阻挡你前进的那道幽灵屏障之中。又是一声刺耳的哀嚎——仿佛她刚刚刺中了一个活生生的生物……但辛内瓦依然用力将那把冰刃刺了下去，直到它彻底刺入地面。 它会在身后留下一道巨大的裂口，就连你们那些体型较小的精灵也能将其撕开，从而形成一条让艾尔塔拉能够通过的通道。 

一旦你们队伍中的某个人通过了这道屏障，似乎 [silly|死了，彻底消失了|渐隐] 一切又恢复了原状。缕缕烟雾渐渐消散，拱门重新显现出来——仿佛它从来就不存在过一样。

穿过拱门，你会看到一个高高的房间，那里摆满了石棺。而在房间的里面，有位女子正跪着，她的背后长着一对灰白色的翅膀。
            
            她就在那儿！”辛内瓦激动地说道，双手按在胸口。“伊瑟琳，看吧，你的祖母。”

“曾祖母……”莱恩在你身旁轻声说道，目光在你们和那位女皇的幽灵之间来回移动。“求你了…… 让我们帮助她继续前进吧。

rows.original: Call the spirit of Synneva to pierce the veil and lead you to her queen.
rows.translation: 召唤辛妮瓦的灵魂，揭开面纱，引领你前往她的王后身边。
rows.raw: "Call the spirit of Synneva to pierce the veil and lead you to her queen."

rows.original:
You draw the dagger-like shard of ice, gritting your teeth at the agonizing cold of it. It was so precious to Synneva, though, that surely... 

            Taking a deep breath, you reverse grip the blade and drive it into the ghostly barrier. There's another of those ear-piercing wails, as if you've just stuck a living being — but you press into it, slicing the ice blade down all the way to the floor. It leaves in its wake a gaping gash that even your smaller elves are able to pull apart, creating an opening that Elthara's able to pass through. 
            
            Once one of your party has passed the barrier, it seems to [silly|give up the ghost, fading|fade] into nothing. Whisps of smoke and mist drift away, leaving the archway clear — as if it had never been there at all. 
            
            Beyond the arch, you can see a raised chamber dominated by sarcophagi. And inside it, a woman's kneeling, cloaked by a pair of ashen wings from her back.
            
            "A- a blessed valkyrie!" Elthara gasps, bowing her head.
            
            Etheryn glances at you. "That must be... Queen Atheldred. Grandmother."
            
            If you've dispatched one of the estranged lovers, it's clearly time to deal with the other.
rows.translation:
你抽出那把形如匕首的冰片，牙齿因刺骨的寒意而紧咬着。然而，这对辛内瓦来说却是如此珍贵……所以，肯定……

深吸一口气，你改变握刀方式，将冰片刺入了那道幽灵般的屏障之中。 又是一声刺耳的哀嚎，仿佛你刚刚伤害了一个活生生的生物……但你继续用力，将冰刃切向地面，最终在冰面上留下了一道巨大的裂口。就连那些体型较小的精灵也能把这道裂口撑开，从而让埃尔萨拉能够从其中穿过。 
            
            一旦你们队伍中的某个人通过了那道障碍，似乎 [silly|死了，彻底消失了|渐隐] 一切又恢复了原状。缕缕烟雾渐渐消散，拱门重新显现出来——仿佛它从来就不存在过一样。

穿过拱门，你会看到一个高高的房间，那里摆满了石棺。而在房间的里面，有一个女人正跪在那里，她的背后长着一对灰白色的翅膀。
            
            啊——一位神圣的瓦尔基里！”埃尔萨拉惊呼着，低下了头。

艾瑟琳瞥了你一眼：“那一定是……阿瑟德雷德女王。我的祖母。”

如果你已经处理掉了其中一个疏远的恋人，那么现在显然该去处理另一个了。

rows.original: Perhaps this shard of dagger-like ice can cleave through the spectral barrier?
rows.translation: 或许这块匕首般的冰块能够穿透那道幽灵屏障呢？
rows.raw: "Perhaps this shard of dagger-like ice can cleave through the spectral barrier?"

rows.original: Before the elves can lead off, you take a knee beside the queen's sarcophagus. It's been wrenched open somewhat during your confrontation, and now that the valkyrie's light has gone out, you could swear you still see something glowing down there. "[pc.name]!" Elthara gasps, watching you push the covering slab open. "How dare you!" Ryn puts a hand on the priestess's shoulder. "No, it's... look!" There absolutely is something glowing down there, you're sure of it now! You push the tomb open to reveal... a distinct lack of a buried body. All that's inside is a circlet of carved ice, in which glows an unmistakable radiance, like pure sunlight held within. [flags.CAT_SYN_RES 1 2|And beside you, lying on the ground, is the shard of ice Synneva used to pierce the queen's ghastly veil.|You draw the shard of ice you took from Synneva's tomb and hold it up to the circlet.] If you put the two of them together, you're sure you'd have the same crown that Atheldred wore! You give it a try, placing the narrow 'grip' of the blade against a small indentation in the top of the circlet — one that's the perfect size and shape to accept it. Eureka! "The crown!" Etheryn gasps as you hold it aloft, letting the captured sunlight shine throughout the crypt. "Oh, [pc.name], it's-" The crown falls apart in your hands. The ice shard tumbles free of its seating, jamming itself into the floor between your feet. Shit. You stick the two halves of the crown into your pack. You'll need a talented craftsman to put these together, it seems.
rows.translation: 在精灵们开始行动之前，你跪在了女王的石棺旁。在之前的冲突中，石棺已经被强行打开过，而现在，随着女武神的轻型芒熄灭，你仿佛还能看到下面有什么东西在发轻型。[pc.name]啊！”艾尔塔拉惊呼道，看着你推开了那块覆盖物。“你竟敢这样！” 瑞恩把手部放在女祭司的肩上：“不，其实是……看那边！” 那里确实 是 下面有什么东西在发轻型，你现在可以确定了！你推开墓穴，却发现……里面根本没有被埋葬的尸体。里面只有一圈雕刻过的冰，而那冰块上散发出的轻型芒无比清晰，就像被封存在内的纯净阳轻型一样。 [flags.CAT_SYN_RES 1 2|而在你身旁，躺在地面上的是那块冰块——正是辛内娃用它刺穿了女王那可怕的面纱。|你取出从辛内瓦的墓穴中获取的那块冰碎片，将其举到那个圆环面前。] 如果你把这两部分组合在一起，肯定就能得到和阿塞尔德雷德戴过的那一顶王冠一模一样的东西！ 你试着把剑刃那狭窄的部分对准戒指顶部的一个凹槽——那个凹槽的尺寸和形状正好适合容纳剑刃。耶！成功了！ “王冠！”当你将王冠举到高处，让阳轻型照射进地窖时，伊瑟琳惊呼道：“哦，太神奇了 [pc.name]它……” 王冠在你手部中散成了碎片。那块冰块也从原来的位置脱落，掉在了你足部边的地上。糟了。 你把王冠的这两半塞进了背包里。 你需要一位技艺高超的工匠来将这些部件组装起来。看来是这样。

rows.original: Check the sarcophagi for secrets yet undiscovered.
rows.translation: 在这些石棺中，或许还隐藏着尚未被发现的秘密。
rows.raw: "Check the sarcophagi for secrets yet undiscovered."

rows.original: Striding up the front steps of the boreal palace, an involuntary shudder wracks you; something feels off here, the same sense you've gotten countless times just before danger struck. Your hand slips to your [pc.weapon] on instinct, drawing the eye of the palace's remaining guards — just before an unearthly howl tears through the vaulted door, a shriek so horrific that your heart skips a beat in your chest. Gods, what a wail! The guards follow you inside, drawing swords and readying spears to face whatever monster — for it is surely inhuman — that could make such a cry. Hethia and Elthara both meet you in the foyer, [party.has etheryn|earning a grateful smile from their regent at your side|followed shortly by their regent, descending from the throne room]. "Praise Lumia you've come!" Elthara says, sighing with relief as you [party.som|and the guards|and [companion.name]|and your party] arrive. Hethia scowls. "I could hear the screaming all the way from the gardens! What in the Wyld's name was that?" You don't know, but it didn't sound human. Or elven, for that matter. "Whatever it was, it caused the flames in the chapel to gutter out. Some servants were injured by falling ice; the sound cracked the walls and ceiling throughout the eastern wing. I hate to think what-" The howling wail tears through the glacial palace once again, so loud now that you have to cover your [pc.ears] to keep from collapsing from pain. The elves all around you aren't so lucky, filling the hall with cries of agony. Several of the guards double over, dropping their weapons and clutching their long ears; the two priestly elves that greeted you clench their teeth and groan in pain, and poor Ryn's nearly brought to tears. [party.has arona|"Fuck that's loud! Argh!" Arona bellows, punching a wall.] When the cacophony ends, Ryn turns to you with wild eyes full of fear. "That... that sounded like it came from the c-crypt. D-downstairs!" "From the crypt?" Elthara glances from you to the east wing's entrance. "Between the wine cellar and the vaults; the royal family's honored dead are buried down there, including the Lady Regent's parents. But they're sealed, nobody should be down there." Clearly something is. Hethia sighs. "We won't find out by loitering here. And I for one am not content to see what work I've accomplished here be pissed away when this whole place collapses on itself. Which it will do, if those ear-piercing screams keep cracking the ice." A quick glance around the great hall shows that's true enough. Maybe the whole 'build your palace in a glacier' is about to finally come back and bite the elves. Best to deal with this if you don't want all the work you did to liberate this place to be for naught. "We'll meet you downstairs," Elthara nods. "Come as soon as you can. Our Champion of Frost is sure to see us through any danger." Hethia grumbles something like an agreement and follows the Lumian towards the crypt.
rows.translation: 当你踏上那座北方宫殿的前阶时，不由自主地会感到一阵战栗——某种不祥的预感油然而生 关闭 在这里，你会再次感受到那种在危险即将降临之前总会出现的预感。你的手会不自觉地伸向 [pc.weapon] 出于本能，你的举动吸引了宫殿里剩下的守卫们的注意——就在这时，一声超越人声极限的哀嚎从拱形门后传来，那声尖叫如此恐怖，以至于让你的心脏都在胸口怦怦直跳。天啊，这声音简直太可怕了！ 守卫们跟在你后面冲了进去，拔出剑来，准备用长矛来对付任何可能发出这种叫声的怪物——因为这种声音绝对不可能是人类所能发出的。赫希娅和埃尔萨拉都在门厅里迎接了你。 [party.has etheryn|让你身旁的摄政王露出感激的微笑|不久之后，他们的摄政王也从王座厅走了下来。]赞美卢米亚，你终于来了！”埃尔萨拉松了一口气，说道。 [party.som|还有那些守卫们|以及 [companion.name]|还有你的队友们] 到了。 赫希娅皱起了眉头：“我从花园里就听到了那些尖叫声！那到底是什么东西？” 你不知道，但那声音根本不像是人类的，甚至也不像是精灵的。 “不管那是什么，它肯定让小教堂里的火焰熄灭了。 一些仆人被掉落的冰块砸伤了；那种震耳欲聋的声音震得整个东翼的墙壁和天花板都在震动。我真不敢想象还会发生什么……” 那凄厉的哀嚎声再次在冰冷的宫殿中回荡，此刻声音已经大到让人不得不捂住耳朵。 [pc.ears] 为了不因疼痛而昏厥，你周围的精灵们就没有这么幸运了——大厅里充满了他们的痛苦哀嚎。有几名守卫弯下腰来，扔掉武器，双手紧紧抓住自己的长耳朵；当初迎接你的那两名牧师精灵也咬紧牙关，痛苦地呻吟着，而可怜的瑞恩几乎要哭出来了。 [party.has arona|靠，太吵了！啊！”阿罗娜怒吼着，一拳砸在墙上。] 当那嘈杂声结束后，瑞恩用充满恐惧的双眼看着你：“那……那声音好像是从地窖里传来的。在楼下！” “从地窖里？” 艾尔塔拉将目光从你身上转向东翼的入口：“就在酒窖和金库之间；王室的尊贵逝者都被安葬在那里，包括摄政夫人的父母。但是那些地方已经被封住了，根本不应该有人下去。” 显然 某个东西 赫希娅叹了口气：“在这里闲逛是永远无法找到答案的。而且，我绝对不愿意看到自己在这里付出的一切努力，因为这个地方的彻底崩溃而付诸东流。 会 要是那些刺耳的尖叫声继续把冰层震裂的话，可就麻烦了。” 快速扫视了一下大厅，发现情况确实如此。也许“在冰川上建造宫殿”这个想法最终会反过来给精灵们带来麻烦。 如果你不希望自己为解放这个地方所做的一切白费力气，最好尽快处理这件事。 “我们会在楼下等你，”埃尔萨拉点了点头，“尽快过来吧。我们的冰霜勇士一定能帮助我们度过任何危险。赫希娅嘟囔着什么，似乎表示同意，然后跟着卢米安朝着地窖走去。
rows.raw: " Striding up the front steps of the boreal palace, an involuntary shudder wracks you; something feels off here, the same sense you've gotten countless times just before danger struck. Your hand slips to your [pc.weapon] on instinct, drawing the eye of the palace's remaining guards — just before an unearthly howl tears through the vaulted door, a shriek so horrific that your heart skips a beat in your chest. Gods, what a wail! The guards follow you inside, drawing swords and readying spears to face whatever monster — for it is surely inhuman — that could make such a cry. Hethia and Elthara both meet you in the foyer, [party.has etheryn|earning a grateful smile from their regent at your side|followed shortly by their regent, descending from the throne room]. "Praise Lumia you've come!" Elthara says, sighing with relief as you [party.som|and the guards|and [companion.name]|and your party] arrive. Hethia scowls. "I could hear the screaming all the way from the gardens! What in the Wyld's name was that?" You don't know, but it didn't sound human. Or elven, for that matter. "Whatever it was, it caused the flames in the chapel to gutter out. Some servants were injured by falling ice; the sound cracked the walls and ceiling throughout the eastern wing. I hate to think what-" The howling wail tears through the glacial palace once again, so loud now that you have to cover your [pc.ears] to keep from collapsing from pain. The elves all around you aren't so lucky, filling the hall with cries of agony. Several of the guards double over, dropping their weapons and clutching their long ears; the two priestly elves that greeted you clench their teeth and groan in pain, and poor Ryn's nearly brought to tears. [party.has arona|"Fuck that's loud! Argh!" Arona bellows, punching a wall.] When the cacophony ends, Ryn turns to you with wild eyes full of fear. "That... that sounded like it came from the c-crypt. D-downstairs!" "From the crypt?" Elthara glances from you to the east wing's entrance. "Between the wine cellar and the vaults; the royal family's honored dead are buried down there, including the Lady Regent's parents. But they're sealed, nobody should be down there." Clearly something is. Hethia sighs. "We won't find out by loitering here. And I for one am not content to see what work I've accomplished here be pissed away when this whole place collapses on itself. Which it will do, if those ear-piercing screams keep cracking the ice." A quick glance around the great hall shows that's true enough. Maybe the whole 'build your palace in a glacier' is about to finally come back and bite the elves. Best to deal with this if you don't want all the work you did to liberate this place to be for naught. "We'll meet you downstairs," Elthara nods. "Come as soon as you can. Our Champion of Frost is sure to see us through any danger." Hethia grumbles something like an agreement and follows the Lumian towards the crypt."

rows.original:
You join the[pc.ra elf| other] elves at the bottom of the stairs, facing a pair of large sarcophagi. Elthara has turned her attention to prayer, head bowed to the royal graves, while Hethia tests the string on her bow. 
    
    "Finally!" the druidess sighs. "Let's get going already, before-"
    
    "Quiet!" Elthara snaps, cutting her eyes over. "I must finish my prayers for the dead before we proceed."
    
    Hethia rolls her eyes, but stays quiet until the priestess has finished her rite.
    
    "Oh goddess of the sun, I beg you lead the ignorant to the light. Lead the wayward from temptation. Grant us the strength to resist temptation, that we may embrace your solar majesty with purity in our hearts."
    
    The stone of the tomb grinds and rumbles in answer to Elthara's prayer. Some hidden mechanism causes it to open, revealing a staircase underneath that leads down into the dark. And from that dark you hear a ragged sobbing, a woman's voice reaching out to you in wordless distress. Could it be the same as the source of the shrieking? Perhaps... but if so, it's lost much of its terrible roar already. No telling how long that'll last, though.
    
    "Th-that's been down there this whole time!?" Ryn gasps, staring down the hidden stairs. "But... my parents..."
    
    "They are safely buried below, Lady Regent. Or did you think only your parents had the honor of resting beneath the royal palace?"
    
    Ryn's ears twitch, prompting the priestess to reach down and ruffle her hair. "There there. Shall we go?"
    
    No time like the present, you suppose. You draw your [pc.weapon] and lead the way down stairs hewn of solid ice. Behind you, Elthara conjures up a roiling ball of heatless sunlight in her hand, holding it aloft like a torch to light your way. The other elves follow shortly behind her[party.som||, with [companion.name] taking up the rear|with your own party taking up the rear].
    
    You descend only perhaps ten feet, down the narrow passage and into a dark, dank tomb that stretches out beneath the streets of the Winter City for — 
    
    There's another horrible scream, ripping down the corridor like a tidal wave of thunderous force. It's nearly enough to knock you down — and it sends your elves toppling over each other down the last of the steps. You catch Ryn in your arms, keeping the princess from cracking her head on the solid ice of the floor. When you look up from her, the stairway has become flooded with... something, an ichorous white mass that seems to writhe and billow like mist. Hethia strikes at it with her bow, and is met with so much resistance that you could swear you hear the wood cracking. 
    
    "Shit!" she huffs, reeling. "Oh I think we're trapped, now."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[party.manyCompanions
            |And [comp1.is etheryn|[comp2.name]|[comp1.name]] is on the other side...|And your companions are trapped on the wrong side. Shit, indeed.
        ]
        |[party.som|At least you aren't alone for once.|And [companion.name] is on the other side...|And your companions are trapped on the wrong side. Shit, indeed.]
    ]
    
    "We'll just have to find the source of the screams, then," Elthara says evenly, lifting her flame high and couching her scythe under arm. "Our goal is unchanged. On your lead, Champion."
rows.translation:
你加入了[pc.ra elf| 其他] 楼梯下装，精灵们站在一对巨大的石棺前。埃尔萨拉低头虔诚地祈祷，而赫希娅则在检查她弓上的弦。

“终于！”女德鲁伊叹了口气，“我们赶紧出发吧，否则……
    
    安静！”埃尔萨拉厉声命令道，目轻型严厉地盯着她们。“在我们继续之前，我必须完成为逝者祈祷的仪式。”

赫希娅翻了个白眼，但始终保持着沉默，直到那位女祭司完成了她的仪式。

“哦，太阳女神啊，我恳求您引领那些无知的人们走向轻型明，引导那些迷失方向的人远离诱惑。请您赐予我们抵御诱惑的力量，让我们能够以纯洁的心灵来仰慕您的轻型辉。
    
    墓碑上的石头在回应艾尔塔拉的祈祷时发出碾动和轰鸣声。某种隐藏的机制使它缓缓打开，露出下方通往暗影的阶梯。而从那暗影中，你听到了断断续续的啜泣声——那是某个女人在无声的痛苦中发出的呼唤。这声音，会不会就是那些尖叫声的来源呢？也许吧……但如果是这样的话，那种可怕的吼声应该已经减弱了许多。不过，谁也说不准这种情况会持续多久。
    
    那……它一直都在那里吗？！”瑞恩惊愕地望着那段隐藏的楼梯，“但是……我的父母……”

“他们已经被安葬在下面了，摄政夫人。您难道以为只有您的父母才有资格安息在王宫的地下吗？
    
    瑞恩的耳朵微微动了动，这让女祭司忍不住俯下身去，轻轻揉了揉她的头发。“好了好了，我们该走了吧？”  

现在正是最好的时机，你这么想吧。你拔出了 [pc.weapon] 然后你们沿着由坚实的冰块凿成的楼梯向下走去。在你身后，埃尔萨拉手中凝聚出一个由无热阳轻型构成的旋转轻型球，她将这个轻型球高高举过头顶，就像一支火炬一样为你们照亮前路。其他精灵也紧随在她身后。[party.som||，与……一同 [companion.name] 殿后|而你的队伍则殿后支援。]你向下走了大约十英尺，穿过狭窄的通道，进入了一座阴暗潮湿的墓穴。这座墓穴延伸在冬城的街道下方……

又一声可怕的尖叫划破了走廊，那声音如同惊涛骇浪般剧烈而恐怖。 这一击几乎足以把你击倒——同时也让你的精灵们一个个在最后的几级台阶上摔得东倒西歪。你及时接住了瑞恩，让公主没有头部撞到坚硬的冰面上。当你从她身上抬起头时，发现整个楼梯已经被水淹没了。那是一团白色的、仿佛在蠕动、像雾气一样翻腾的物质。赫希娅用弓箭去攻击它，却遇到了巨大的阻力，那种阻力大到让你几乎能听到弓弦断裂的声音。

“该死！”她气喘吁吁地咒骂着，踉跄着后退。 哦，我想我们现在被困住了。
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[party.manyCompanions
            |而且 [comp1.is etheryn|[comp2.name]|[comp1.name]] 在另一边……|而你的同伴却被困在了错误的一边。真是见鬼了。
        ]
        |[party.som|至少这一次，你并不孤单。|而且 [companion.name] 在另一边……|而你的同伴却被困在了错误的一边。真是见鬼了。]
    ]
    
    那么，我们只需要找到那些尖叫声的来源就行了，”埃尔萨拉平静地说道，她将火焰举得更高，把镰刀别在臂下。“我们的目标并没有改变。由你来带领我们，冠军。

rows.original:
"Ah, our radiant goddess!" 

    Elthara sighs with relief as you enter the chamber at the heart of the crypt, a circular room dominated by a statue of the solar deity. At least, that's the closest approximation you can imagine. It's an elven woman, tall and slender and regal-looking, holding aloft a beacon of flame in one hand, with a scythe much like Elthara's own couched under her other arm. The goddess's armor has been painted gold, and her hair is flaxen-blonde, but otherwise the stone has worn to colorless gray by the passage of countless centuries. 
    
    It's certainly different than any other depiction of Lumia you've seen. Doubtless much older, too. 
    
    "I wonder how her flame stays alight," Hethia muses, walking up behind Elthara and tapping her chin. "It's not like anyone comes down here and tends these flames, do they?"
    
    The ever-present chill clinging to the walls of the glacial palace seems to alleviate itself in answer to the druidess's words. For a moment you think it might be some sign of divine favor from Lumia... until you hear laughter all around you. From all four tunnels that lead from the chamber, even the one you've just come from!
    
    You draw your [pc.weapon] to meet the threat behind. 
    
    It's an elf, that much is clear at a glance: she's statuesque and well-built, not unlike the palace guards outside, but she's clad in resplendent golden-bronze armor, with a helm bearing a pair of gilded wings that protect her long ears. A teardrop shield is strapped to one arm, and the other carries a war spear at her side, its tip glinting with searing white flame.
    
    "Our sunlit lady's flames are fueled by our faith!" the elf howls, stepping into the light. Three other similarly-clad warriors approach your party, two with spears and two with bows, their quivers full of sunlight. As they draw near, though, you realize that you can, if you squint, see ever so slightly through these warriors, and they trail a haze of icy mist all around themselves, ethereal and incandescent all at once. 
    
    They're ghosts, specters of the dead still clinging to this world. No doubt about it.
    
    Elthara draws the same connection, bringing the flame in her hand to bear on the nearest of the four — a muscular bow-woman who's already drawing a coruscating golden arrow from her hip. "Wayward spirits!" the priestess intones, stoking the flame to shine ever-brighter. "Get back to your rest. You have no place left in this world!"
    
    The ghosts laugh at her. One answers, aiming her spear squarely at Hethia. "Our place is ever at our queens side, until this land is finally purged of the heathen and the witch!"
    
    "Lumians, always the same," Hethia scowls, nocking an arrow. 
    
    [etheryn.lnhConfidence|"P-please!" Ryn gasps, putting her hands up to the ghosts. "We want to help!"|Etheryn steps up between the specters and Hethia. "By my will as Regent, there will be no purging. We wish to help you, but we won't let you harm anyone!"|Etheryn steps up between the specters and Hethia. "By my will as Regent, there will be no purging. We wish to help you, but we won't let you harm anyone!"]
    
    The warriors stalk closer, weapons raised. Elthara brings her scythe to bear, mirroring the statue. "Save your words, princess. There's no reasoning with them."
    
    So there isn't.
rows.translation:
啊，我们轻型辉的女神！”

当你走进这座位于地窖中心的圆形房间时，埃尔萨拉松了一口气——房间中央矗立着一尊象征太阳神明的雕像。至少，你可以这样理解它。 那是一位精灵女子，身材高挑纤细，气质高贵。她一手部举着燃烧的火把，另一只手部臂下则横着一把与埃尔萨拉本人使用的镰刀极为相似的武器。这位女神的铠甲被涂成了金色，她的头发也是亚麻金色的，但除此之外，由于历经了无数个世纪，这块石头已经变成了无色的灰色。 
    
    这肯定与你见过的任何关于Lumia的描述都不同。而且，它看起来也古老了许多。

“我想知道她的火焰是如何一直燃烧下去的，”赫希娅边说边走到埃尔萨拉身后，轻敲着她的下巴，“毕竟应该没有谁会专门来这里照料这些火焰吧？那股始终萦绕在冰宫墙壁间的寒意，似乎在听到女德鲁伊的话语后有所减轻。有那么一瞬间，你甚至以为这可能是卢米娅赐予的神圣恩典……直到你听到周围传来的笑声。 从通往这个房间的四条隧道中，甚至包括你刚刚走来的那条隧道！

你拔出了你的 [pc.weapon] 为了应对潜藏在这背后的威胁……

那显然是一个精灵：她身材高挑、体态匀称，与外面的宫廷卫兵颇为相似，但她身着轻型彩夺目的金铜色铠甲，头戴的头盔上装饰着一对镀金的翅膀，这些翅膀能够保护她那长长的耳朵。她的一只手部臂上绑着一块泪滴形的盾牌，另一只手部臂则挎着一把战矛，矛尖闪烁着灼热的白焰。
    
    我们这位被阳轻型照耀的女士，她的火焰正是源于我们的信仰！”精灵高声喊道，同时踏入了轻型芒之中。另外三名穿着相似的战士也向你们的队伍走来——其中两人手部持长矛，另外两人则持弓，他们的箭袋仿佛装满了阳轻型。然而，当他们逐渐靠近时，你们发现只要稍微眯起眼睛，就能隐约看到这些战士的身体；他们的周围笼罩着一层冰冷的雾气，这种雾气既缥缈又炽热，仿佛将他们笼罩在一种超凡脱俗的轻型环之中。 
    
    它们是鬼魂，是那些仍执着于这个世界的死者的幽灵。这一点毋庸置疑。

埃尔萨拉也感受到了同样的联系，她将手部中的火焰对准了那四个幽灵中最靠近的一个——那个肌肉结实的弓箭手部，她已经从腰间抽出了一支闪闪发轻型的金色箭矢。“叛逆的灵魂们！”女祭司低声说道，同时将火焰拨得更加明亮，“回到你们的安息之地吧。这个世界上已经没有你们的容身之地了！
    
    那些鬼魂嘲笑她。其中一个回答道，同时将长矛对准了赫希娅：“我们的忠诚永远属于我们的女王，直到这片土地彻底摆脱异教徒和女巫的侵扰！”

“卢米安人，还是一如既往啊，”赫希娅皱着眉头，搭上了箭。 
    
    [etheryn.lnhConfidence|求求你们了！”瑞恩惊慌地叫道，双手朝着那些幽灵伸去，“我们真的想帮忙的！|伊瑟琳站在那些幽灵和赫希娅之间，说道：“作为摄政王，我坚决反对任何形式的清洗行动。我们愿意帮助你们，但绝不会允许你们伤害任何人！|伊瑟琳站在那些幽灵和赫希娅之间，说道：“作为摄政王，我坚决反对任何形式的清洗行动。我们愿意帮助你们，但绝不会允许你们伤害任何人！]
    
    战士们悄悄逼近，手部中武器已举了起来。埃尔萨拉也拔出了她的镰刀，动作与那座雕像一模一样。“省省你的口水吧，公主。跟他们讲道理是没有用的。”

确实如此。
rows.raw:
'
    "Ah, our radiant goddess!" 

    Elthara sighs with relief as you enter the chamber at the heart of the crypt, a circular room dominated by a statue of the solar deity. At least, that's the closest approximation you can imagine. It's an elven woman, tall and slender and regal-looking, holding aloft a beacon of flame in one hand, with a scythe much like Elthara's own couched under her other arm. The goddess's armor has been painted gold, and her hair is flaxen-blonde, but otherwise the stone has worn to colorless gray by the passage of countless centuries. 
    
    It's certainly different than any other depiction of Lumia you've seen. Doubtless much older, too. 
    
    "I wonder how her flame stays alight," Hethia muses, walking up behind Elthara and tapping her chin. "It's not like anyone comes down here and tends these flames, do they?"
    
    The ever-present chill clinging to the walls of the glacial palace seems to alleviate itself in answer to the druidess's words. For a moment you think it might be some sign of divine favor from Lumia... until you hear laughter all around you. From all four tunnels that lead from the chamber, even the one you've just come from!
    
    You draw your [pc.weapon] to meet the threat behind. 
    
    It's an elf, that much is clear at a glance: she's statuesque and well-built, not unlike the palace guards outside, but she's clad in resplendent golden-bronze armor, with a helm bearing a pair of gilded wings that protect her long ears. A teardrop shield is strapped to one arm, and the other carries a war spear at her side, its tip glinting with searing white flame.
    
    "Our sunlit lady's flames are fueled by our faith!" the elf howls, stepping into the light. Three other similarly-clad warriors approach your party, two with spears and two with bows, their quivers full of sunlight. As they draw near, though, you realize that you can, if you squint, see ever so slightly through these warriors, and they trail a haze of icy mist all around themselves, ethereal and incandescent all at once. 
    
    They're ghosts, specters of the dead still clinging to this world. No doubt about it.
    
    Elthara draws the same connection, bringing the flame in her hand to bear on the nearest of the four — a muscular bow-woman who's already drawing a coruscating golden arrow from her hip. "Wayward spirits!" the priestess intones, stoking the flame to shine ever-brighter. "Get back to your rest. You have no place left in this world!"
    
    The ghosts laugh at her. One answers, aiming her spear squarely at Hethia. "Our place is ever at our queens side, until this land is finally purged of the heathen and the witch!"
    
    "Lumians, always the same," Hethia scowls, nocking an arrow. 
    
    [etheryn.lnhConfidence|"P-please!" Ryn gasps, putting her hands up to the ghosts. "We want to help!"|Etheryn steps up between the specters and Hethia. "By my will as Regent, there will be no purging. We wish to help you, but we won't let you harm anyone!"|Etheryn steps up between the specters and Hethia. "By my will as Regent, there will be no purging. We wish to help you, but we won't let you harm anyone!"]
    
    The warriors stalk closer, weapons raised. Elthara brings her scythe to bear, mirroring the statue. "Save your words, princess. There's no reasoning with them."
    
    So there isn't.'

rows.original:
Hethia claims the last 'kill,' such as it is, feathering the final spirit with a volley of arrows that leave it staggering back, then erupting in a flash of light. When your eyes clear, there's nothing left of any of the warrior-elves but a thick, cold mist that clings to the floor. 

    Ryn sighs, leaning on her [etheryn.weapon]. "Those were..."
    
    "Valkyries," Elthara finishes, planting her staff at her side and looking up at the divine statue. "The goddess's truest servants. Or they were, in life. Now?"
    
    "Now just overzealous ghosts," Hethia spits. "Ironic, isn't it — ghostly paladins. That was divine magic they were wielding, too. Sunlight spears."
    
    Elthara nods solemnly. "It seems we were correct. Something is deeply wrong here. And they mentioned a queen..."
    
    Ryn's ears tuck down at the thought. "I don't like that... [etheryn.lnhConfidence|p-p-please don't make me fight one of my ancestors, [pc.name]!"|Please, I don't want to have to fight one of my ancestors."|Could it really be one of my ancestors? I'd love to meet her, but... I don't relish the thought of fighting her."]
    
    
    Considering the terror Alissa was whilst gravidly pregnant, you can only imagine what facing a warrior-queen with the resilience of a ghost would be like. 
    
    "Well?" Hethia says, twirling an arrow idly between her fingers. "Which way then, priestess? Surely you have special burial chambers for your royalty still."
    
    "Dead ahead," Elthara confirms. "On your lead, Champion."
rows.translation:
赫希娅声称，最后的那一击才是真正的“致命一击”——她用一连串的箭矢击中那个最终的神灵，使其踉跄后退，随后那神灵便在一阵轻型芒中消失了。当你的视线恢复清晰时，那些战士精灵已经不复存在，只剩下一层浓稠的寒雾粘在地面上。

瑞恩叹了口气，靠在她的肩上 [etheryn.weapon]那些是……”

“女武神，”埃尔萨拉说完，将法杖插在身侧，抬头望向那座神圣的雕像，“这位女神最忠实的仆从。至少在她们生前是这样。但现在呢？”

“现在不过是一群过于狂热的幽灵罢了，”赫希娅冷笑道。 真是具有讽刺意味，不是吗——那些幽灵般的圣骑士。他们使用的也是神圣魔法，那种能将阳轻型化为长矛的魔法。”

埃尔萨拉严肃地点了点头：“看来我们是对的。这里肯定发生了什么严重的问题。而且他们还提到了一个女王……一想到这个，瑞恩的耳朵立刻耷了下来。“我可不喜欢这样…… [etheryn.lnhConfidence|求求你，千万别让我和自己的祖先之一战斗。 [pc.name]!"|求你了，我可不想与自己的祖先之一发生冲突。|真的会是我的祖先之一吗？我很想见到她，但是……一想到要和她战斗，我就觉得有些害怕。]
    
    
    考虑到阿莉莎在怀孕期间所经历的种种恐惧，你完全可以想象，面对一位拥有幽灵般坚韧意志的战士女王，会是什么样子。

“那么，该往哪个方向走呢？”赫希娅一边用手指随意地转动着一支箭，一边问道，“女祭司，你们肯定为王室成员准备了专门的墓室吧。”

“就在正前方，”埃尔萨拉回答道，“由你来带路吧，冠军。

"Lay these heathens low!" the leader of the spectral warriors howls, driving her flaming spear into Hethia's chest. "Feed them all the light of the sun!"

    Oh, no! Hethi-
    
    You feel a bright star of pain explode in your chest, and look down to see an arrow protruding from your [pc.skinFurScales]. Another impact strikes you higher, and your world goes black. The last thing you hear is Ryn screaming your name.
rows.translation:
把这些异教徒全部消灭！”幽灵战士的领袖怒吼着，将燃烧着的长矛刺入了赫希娅的胸膛。“让他们的灵魂永远陷入黑暗吧！”

rows.original: You motion to your elven followers, telling Elthara to take point — she has the light, after all, and it's pitch black down there in the depths. "Very well," the priestess says, couching her scythe under an arm. "Tread lightly now. The ice is slick, and very old." "Sounds like someone I know," Hethia mumbles, falling in behind her. You go next, letting Etheryn take the rear. Harrick squawks from his perch on her shoulder, pitching his shrill voice down into the darkness. The echo bounces cacophonously off the icy walls, enough to make you [pc.hasEmoteEars |and your companions all wince and cover your sensitive ears! |wince; the elf-girls have it worse, forced to cover their sensitive ears. ] When you reach the bottom, you find the floor made not of ice, as was the crypt above, but of solid earth. Small insects scurry away into tiny crevices in the icy walls, beneath rows upon rows upon rows of the dead. There must be hundreds of skeletons interred down here, each shrouded in silk and jewels, but no crowns. [flags.CAT_HAR_DWN | |"The old monarchs, before Lumia came, would keep harems to stud or breed," Hethia mentions off-hand, running a hand along the cold ground. "They're buried here, generations of loyal concubines that nevertheless failed to produce heirs." "Yes, we can thank Lumia for introducing us to the idea of marriage," Elthara nods. "And guaranteeing our queens' fertility!" Etheryn stops the priests before they can get into it, holding up a hand. "Hey, look! There's something buried here." The princess scrapes her boot over the dirt dead-center of the pit, revealing a plate of solid iron set into the ground. There's a brass latch on the front of it, just barely sticking up above the dirt line. Leave it to Ryn's keen senses to pick up on what you'd have thought was just a pair of rocks. "A trap door?" Ryn muses, taking a knee. Elthara puts a hand on the smaller elf's pale shoulder. "I wouldn't, dear. The souls of the dead are disquiet enough without our rousing their ire looting." ]
rows.translation: 你向你的精灵追随者们示意，让埃尔萨拉走在最前面——毕竟她拥有轻型明，而在那漆黑的深渊中，轻型明才是最重要的。 “好的，”女祭司说道，将她的镰刀夹在臂下。“现在要小心行事了。 冰面很滑，而且非常古老。” “听起来像我认识的人……”赫希娅喃喃道，跟在她的后面。你先走，让伊瑟琳走在后面吧。哈里克站在她的肩膀上，用它那尖细的声音在黑暗中喊道。 回声在冰冷的墙壁上杂乱无章地反射着，其声响之大足以让你 [pc.hasEmoteEars |而你的同伴们也都忍不住皱起眉头，捂住自己敏感的耳朵！ |哎哟……那些精灵女孩的情况更糟糕，她们甚至不得不捂住自己敏感的耳朵。 ] 当你到达下装时，会发现这里的地面并非由冰构成，与上方的地窖不同，而是由坚实的泥土构成。一些小昆虫匆匆逃进了冰墙上的细小裂缝中，而这些裂缝就在层层叠叠的骷髅之下。这里肯定埋葬着数百具骷髅，每一具都包裹着丝绸和珠宝，但却没有任何王冠。 [flags.CAT_HAR_DWN | |在Lumia出现之前，那些古老的君主们都会拥有后宫，用来选育后代，”赫希娅随意地说道，一边用手抚摸着冰冷的地面。“这些女性都被埋葬在这里——一代又一代忠贞的妃子，却终究没能为他们生下继承人。没错，正是Lumia让我们认识了婚姻的概念，”埃尔萨拉点头说道，“而且它还确保了我们的女王们能够生育后代！” 在祭司们还想要继续讨论之前，伊瑟琳举手制止了他们。 嘿，看！这里好像埋着什么东西。” 公主用靴子刮了刮坑洞正中央的泥土，结果发现了一块坚硬的物体。 铁 被埋在地下。它的正面装着一个黄铜锁扣，仅仅微微高出地面。就靠瑞恩敏锐的感官吧，去发现那些你原本以为只是普通石块的东西。 “一扇活板门？”瑞恩蹲下身子，若有所思地说道。 埃尔萨拉把手放在那个身材较矮的精灵苍白的肩上：“我可不这么认为，亲爱的。死者的灵魂已经够不安宁了，我们再惹他们生气、扰乱他们的安宁，就太不应该了。 ]

rows.raw: "Pull open the trap door and see what someone would bury under a burial ground."

rows.original:
"Let's see what's down there," you say, shooing Ryn away from the latch. [pc.strengthRange 50
        |You grab the handle and put your back into it, heaving against the solid iron.
        |You grab the handle and pull... and pull... and puullll! But it's no good, you're not strong enough to wrench it open!
        
        "Oh, don't strain yourself, [pc.name]," Elthara says soothingly, gently pushing you aside. "Let us big girls do the work, if you're sure this is what you want."
        
        Hethia huffs. "Oh great, volunteer me. Fine!"
        
        On your command, the two bigger elf-women brace their feet on either side of the trap door and grasp the handle. They glare at each other, forced to get uncomfortably close to work together like this, but they put their backs in nevertheless. When they pull, their chests momentarily slap together, sheer clothes rubbing as they strain.
        
        Ryn can't help but giggle as they bicker over it, but your eyes are inexorably drawn to the accidentally sensual display... before they finally manage to haul the hatch open for you.
    ] The door cracks open with a howl of rust and cracking ice, echoing painfully off the chamber walls. Gods, they probably heard that all the way in the palace courtyard! Ow!
    
    Beneath the trap door is a rectangular shaft, maybe four feet deep, lined with more iron that hasn't been rusted through even half as much. Before you can lean in and see what's down there, though, there's a high-pitched shriek from behind you — and then a body crashes into you, nearly knocking you on your ass.

让我们看看下面有什么吧，”你说着，把瑞恩从门闩旁赶开。 [pc.strengthRange 50
        |你抓住把手，使出全身力气去拉，用力对抗那坚硬的铁门。

“哦，别太用力了 [pc.name]让我们这些大姑娘来处理这件事吧，”埃尔萨拉轻声说道，同时轻轻地将你推到一边，“如果你确定这就是你想要的的话。”

赫希娅哼了一声：“哦，太好了，那就让我来当志愿者吧！行吧！”

按照你的指令，那两位身材高大的精灵女性站在活板门的两侧，握住了门把手。 他们互相瞪视着，被迫在这种尴尬的距离内合作，但依然全力以赴。当他们用力拉扯时，他们的胸膛会短暂地贴在一起，薄薄的衣物在用力过程中相互摩擦。
        
        当他们为这件事争吵时，瑞恩忍不住咯咯笑了起来，但你的目光却不由自主地被那场无意中发生的“性感表演”吸引住了……直到他们终于帮你把舱门打开了。
    ] 门在铁锈与碎冰的摩擦声中缓缓打开，那刺耳的声音在房间墙壁间回荡，听起来简直让人难受极了。天啊，他们肯定在宫殿的院子里都听到了这个声音！哎哟！

rows.original: "[pc.name]!" Etheryn squeals, pointing up. You follow her arm to the walls, eyes going wide as you see spectral forms crawling out of the alcoves — more elves, like the valkyries from the altar, but these slender figures are a mix of men and women, dressed in lush silks and bedecked in ostentatious jewelry. The spirits of the royal harem! "Ohhh, aren't you cute little thieves!" one of the spirits purrs, crawling down the wall. Another, phasing through the ice at your flank, reaches out towards Hethia. '
    As Hethia and Elthara raise their weapons to defend themselves against the incoming horde of specters, you tell them to stop and drop their weapons.
    
    "What?" Hethia spits. "Are you insane, [pc.name]?"
    
    No, you're completely serious. The spirits of the queen's harem don't want to fight any of you in the first place; they just want to be put to rest in the way they know best. Look, you'll do it first if they still doubt you.
    
    With those words, you carefully place your [pc.weapon] on the ground and step forward with your hands up and outstretched. Ryn gasps as she finally notices what you're doing and moves to draw you back, but the massed spirits nearest to you have already noticed what you're doing and have dropped their aggressive stances, looking more forlorn than angry.
    
    "W-what is the meaning of this, [pc.race]?" one of them says in a hoarse, ghostly whisper.
    
    They want to be free, no? While you're not sure if you can replace the lost love the elven queen once had for them, you can at least try. You're not thieves, but here to put them to rest. Isn't that right?
    
    "T-that's right!" Ryn declares, mustering all her courage in front of her grandmother's harem. "I am Atheldred's granddaughter, current regent of the Winter City. It is under my request that my companions are here to investigate the hauntings."
    
    "Blood of Atheldred, eh? You have more the cut of the consort about your face than the queen herself."
    
    Ryn sighs and shakes her head. "Hethia, Elthara... please, just set down your weapons. [pc.Name] is right. These people don't need any more sadness or violence — they already had plenty of that while they were alive. They need love; my grandmother haunting must be keeping them here against their will."
    
    "Love!" the ghosts sigh as one. "We desire love."
    
    Like you said, while you don't know if your love can match the old elven queen's, you think you should be able to do enough between the four of you to give these restless dead their peace despite whatever tethers that may be holding them here.
    
    Hethia and Elthara look at each other, then at the ghosts. There's a spark of tension in the air between them, then as one, they set their weapons down on the floor and step back. A longing sigh rises through the harem of spirits as a heavy peace falls over the room like a thick blanket of snow, muffling sound and emotion alike.
    
    The only question that remains, then, is how to send off the queen's harem to whatever afterlife awaits them...
    '

rows.original:
Well then, now that everything's calmed down and people can actually do work instead of scuffling about uselessly, perhaps both Hethia and Elthara can see to finally giving these spirits their final rest. They're the religious folk amongst their people, surely they know how to conduct the appropriate rites, yes?
        
        Priestess and druidess share a glance. "That is... correct, yes. Although given the sheer number in the queen's harem, it would be better if we worked together to send them off — "
        
        "Bend the knee to their human goddess?"
        
        "Never!"
        
        "We chose to die rather than convert, and the years have not changed that resolve of ours!"
        
        Elthara folds her arms. "Even if it means remaining as forlorn spirits for all eternity, bound to this place by your spite?"
        
        "Yes!"
        
        The priestess sighs and turns her gaze to you, then a more beseeching one to Etheryn. Clearing her throat a little nervously, Ryn steps forward to address her grandmother's harem.
        
        "These two represent my attempts to heal the rift that my grandmother opened in the boer'alvar," Etheryn says. "I know you've been wronged, but it is the wish of both Lumia and the wyld trees that the schism in our people be finally healed so that we can even begin to have a chance of standing against the oncoming darkness. Please, as the regent, can you find it in your hearts to at least allow the two of them to see you off, even if it will include some of the Lumian rites?
        
        "You desired love, and so here it is: love to heal this tear that has rent our people apart; while I can love with all my heart, it has to be met coming the other way to bear fruit. Once more, I beg your understanding and your forgiveness, such that you can swallow your pride as the two of them have."
        
        Ryn's words touch off considerable consternation amongst the harem spirits, their hoarse whispers of discussion echoing throughout the tomb. At least, one of them — a broad-hipped intersexed woman — steps forward and addresses Hethia. "Is this right, druidess?"
        
        "I wish... I wish it were not so, but the regent speaks the truth. Our time is finally coming to an end, and the dying wish of the wyld trees is that we not be so stiff-necked as to choose destruction over reconciliation. As hard as this is to swallow, it is my oath to obey them, even if I disagree."
        
        More murmuring amongst the spirits, and then finally:
        
        "We accept, though with reluctance. In exchange for your love, we give you what we have — we will not need them where we're going. Perhaps her gifts to us, now passed on to you, will remind you of your grandmother, regent, and what she has done; may you never have to do such a thing in your lifetime."
        
        "Thank you," Ryn sighs. "Thank you all so much. Hethia, Elthara, would you please begin?"
        
        The words that follow next are in the pale elf tongue, rough and ruddy to your ears; Elthara and Hethia's voices rise in unison at first, then they take turns speaking. Neither of them seem very sure of themselves in all this, and you guess that they're improvising this whole ceremony, making it up as they go along. Yet it suffices for the spirits of Atheldred's harem, the translucent mass of restless dead funnelling two by two before them; as druidess and priestess alike touch their brows, they lose substantiality and corporeality alike, fading away into fine mist before disappearing completely.
        
        You don't know how long this goes on for — even though each pair takes no more than a few seconds to be dealt with, there must be hundreds of elves in the old queen's harem, and time feels slow and indistinct in this tomb. Eventually, though, there're no more than a hundred left, then twenty, then none; as the last duo of elven ghosts evaporate into nothingness, Elthara wrings her wrists and sighs heavily but contentedly.
        
        "Rest in Lumia's light. They were willing to compromise for their own good."
        
        "Just understand that a compromise goes both ways, priestess."
        
        "Oh, I do, I do."
        
        The four of you are left in the quiet of the tomb, surrounded by the desiccated remains of the queen's harem. For now, you have a moment's respite...

那么，现在一切都平静下来了，人们也可以专心工作，而不再无谓地争吵了。或许赫希娅和埃尔萨拉可以想办法为这些灵魂举行最后的安葬仪式。她们在族人中属于宗教人士，肯定知道该如何举行适当的仪式，对吧？
        
        女祭司和女德鲁伊交换了一个眼神。“没错，确实是这样。不过考虑到王后后宫里的女子数量实在太多，如果我们能齐心协力把她们送走的话会更好——”

“向她们的人类女神屈膝吗？”

“绝对不行！
        
        我们宁愿选择死亡也不愿改信他教，这些年来，我们的决心丝毫未变！”

埃尔萨拉双臂交叉：“即使这意味着我们要永远成为这些孤独的灵魂，被你们的怨恨束缚在这个地方？”

“是的！
        
        女祭司叹了口气，将目轻型转向你，然后又以更加恳切的神情望向伊瑟琳。瑞恩有些紧张地清了清嗓子，走上前对祖母的后宫成员们说道：

“这两个人，代表了我为弥补祖母在‘博尔阿尔瓦’地区造成的裂痕而所做的努力。”伊瑟琳说道。 我知道你受到了不公，但无论是卢米亚还是那些古老的森林之树，都希望我们族群之间的分歧能够最终得到化解，这样我们才有可能共同面对即将到来的黑暗。请吧，作为摄政王，你是否能够心怀慈悲，至少允许他们两人送你离开，哪怕这其中需要一些卢米亚的传统仪式呢？
        
        你渴望得到爱，那么现在这份爱就在这里：这份爱旨在治愈那道将我们人民分裂开的伤痕；虽然我可以全心全意地去给予爱，但这份爱也需要对方的回应才能结出果实。我再次恳求你的理解与原谅，希望你也能像他们那样放下自己的骄傲。
        
        瑞恩的话语在那些后宫精灵们中间引起了不小的恐慌，她们嘶哑的讨论声在墓穴中回荡。最终，其中有一个——一个臀部宽大的雌雄同体女性——站了出来，对赫希娅说道：“这样真的合适吗，女德鲁伊？
        
        我真希望……希望事实并非如此，但摄政王说的是实话。我们的时代终于要结束了，而那些古老树木的最后愿望，就是希望我们不要如此固执，不要选择毁灭而非和解。尽管这很难接受，但我发誓会遵从他们的意愿，即使我并不认同。
        
        精灵们之间又传来一阵低语，最终他们说道：

“我们接受了，尽管有些不情愿。作为对你爱的回报，我们把我们所拥有的一切献给你——在我们即将去的地方，这些已经不再需要了。也许她送给我们的礼物，现在转交到了你手中，会让你想起你的祖母，那位女统治者，以及她所做的一切；愿你在有生之年永远不必经历这样的事情。
        
        谢谢大家，”瑞恩叹息道，“真的非常感谢。赫希娅、埃尔萨拉，你们能开始吗？”

接下来说出的话语是用淡色精灵语表达的，这些语言对人类听众来说听起来有些粗糙且带有浓重的地方口音；埃尔萨拉和赫希娅起初是同时开始说话的，随后便轮流发言。 在他们俩看来，整个过程似乎都缺乏十足的把握，你可以猜到，他们完全是即兴发挥，边做边想。然而，这样的仪式已经足够让阿瑟雷德后宫中的那些灵魂感到满足了——那些半透明、躁动不安的亡灵一个接一个地从他们面前经过；当女德鲁伊和女祭司们触碰他们的额头时，那些灵魂便逐渐失去了实体与形态，化作细雾消散得无影无踪。
        
        你根本不知道这个过程会持续多久——虽然每一对精灵的处理过程不过几秒钟而已，但老女王的后宫里肯定有数百名精灵，而在这个墓穴里，时间仿佛变得缓慢而模糊不清。最终，剩下的精灵数量越来越少，从一百个减少到二十个，最后一个个都消失了；当最后一对精灵幽灵也消散得无影无踪时，埃尔萨拉扭了扭手腕，深深地叹了口气，但脸上却露出了满足的神情。
        
        在卢米娅的轻型芒中安息吧。他们愿意为了自己的利益而做出妥协。”

“请记住，妥协是相互的，女祭司。”

“哦，我明白的。”

此刻，你们四个人独自留在这座寂静的墓穴中，周围环绕着女王后宫中那些干枯的遗骸。暂时而言，你们可以得到片刻的宁静……

            You have no idea how long this lasts — it feels like days, but can't have been more than an hour at most. Time is relative here in the dusky glow of the harem's tomb, and as the spirits spend themselves on you handful by handful you notice on the edge of what consciousness remains that isn't subsumed by sex that they're dissipating, evaporating into ghostly mist before vanishing altogether. Their desire fulfilled, their love sated, the spirits of Atheldred's harem are winking out of existence, finding peace at last. One by one, the spirits depart — with only a hundred remaining, then twenty, then five, until all that remains are Ryn and you, your bodies joined, naked and still coated in gooey ectoplasmic stuff. It's only then that the both of you part from each other with a sigh of relief, heaving and panting before sharing one final kiss.
        
            Your things lie strewn about all over the ground, strewn about as a matter of course for the orgy that just happened; chill fluids slowly drip from your mouth and run off your body, pooling on the ground before dissipating in a chill, pale mist.
            
            A little way away, Hethia and Elthara are in similar states, the two very definitely not looking at each other as they begin to recover from the ghosts' passions upon their bodies. Feeling the rush of sex slowly begin to die down in your body, you clamber over to the both of them and ask if they're okay.
            
            "I-I'm fine," Hethia gasps, coughing. "They... they were far less rough with us than they could have been."
            
            You won't ask what they did with the both of them, then.
            
            "They still loved the queen, [pc.name]. Despite all that she did to them, they still loved her, each and every one of them. I just wish that... that could have gone better." Elthara looks thoughtful. "What a woman she must have been, to inspire that kind of loyalty in people who should have had every reason to loathe her."
            
            "Oh, it's not surprising," Hethia mutters, wiping ectoplasmic cum off her face and looking appropriately disgusted with herself and Elthara. "There're plenty of recorded cases of prisoners falling in love with their jailers. Nothing new, truly."
            
            "I think that settles that," Ryn says. "Let's get dressed and move on... there's still my grandmother herself to deal with, if nothing else."
            
            "Agreed."
            
            After you've cleaned yourself up as best as you can, you stagger to your feet and press on as best as you can. There's still work to be done in these catacombs, but maybe you should take a breather first after such vigorous activity... 
            '

rows.original: Grant the harem spirits their final request and allow them to expend their passions upon all of you.
rows.translation: 满足后宫精灵们的最后愿望，让她们将所有的热情都倾注在你们所有人身上吧。
rows.raw: "Grant the harem spirits their final request and allow them to expend their passions upon all of you."

rows.original: The chamber is empty, devoid of the throng of ghosts that once populated it. There might still be something left over were you to search the room, as disturbing as that might be.
rows.translation: 这个房间空荡荡的，再也看不到曾经居住在这里的那些鬼魂了。不过，如果你仔细搜查这个房间的话，或许还能找到些什么——尽管这样做可能会让人感到非常不安。
rows.raw: "\n    The chamber is empty, devoid of the throng of ghosts that once populated it. There might still be something left over were you to search the room, as disturbing as that might be."

rows.original: "Are you sure that's the right thing to do?" Elthara asks when you bring up the matter. "Desecrating the dead is pretty awful most places you go." "Well, I'm not sure it counts as desecrating the dead if they're truly departed," Hethia counters. "We saw them leave. Those bones are truly bones at this point, and they did bequeath their things to us." "That's true, but — " "Enough, the both of you!" Ryn interjects. Hethia and Elthara glower at each other, but defer to Ryn and settle for vicious muttering in lieu of arguing any further. "I'm regent, and we do need what money we can get our hands on after Alissa emptied the treasury funding that demoness' plans. Regardless of who my grandmother's harem consisted of or what they might have believed in, if they were kind enough to leave anything of value for us then I don't see why we shouldn't take them up on that offer. "Now if you don't mind, let's start stripping these bodies. I'm not going to enjoy it any more than either of you, but it has to be done." Both druidess and priestess are as reluctant as the other, but once Ryn starts grabbing the jewelry off the desiccated bones they finally give in and start gathering up the gold and gems, trinkets and baubles for all the good they'll do the royal treasury — which, to be honest, isn't insubstantial. Atheldred must've truly loved her harem to dote on them like that, and the Winter City must've been far, far richer than it was before the time of Ryn's parents for such expense to be justified... At the end of perhaps half an hour, the four of you have gathered quite the haul, which Ryn wraps up in a cloth — but not before apportioning out several of the choicier pieces for you. "Here, [pc.name]. Something for you." [pc.isDK |About time. "You deserve as much," Ryn says with a smile. "We were going to fight them all, as impossible as it seemed, but then you realized what truly needed to be done for the poor spirits to finally calm down enough to depart." Well, it's good that your contributions are being acknowledged around here. |Is she sure? She and what's left of the Winter City's government could use the money much more than you could. "I want you to have it, [pc.name]." Ryn gives you a genuine smile. "Consider it a regency expense if it'll make you feel better." ] "There's something else I found as well," Elthara says, handing you a small bottle. "You should have this — just looking at razorcup reminds me of Alissa's parties, and thinking back to those just makes me sick at how powerless I was to do anything about the whole situation." Hethia sniffs. "Or maybe you were too cowardly." Oh, if the two of them would just fuck already. That shuts them up long enough for you to take stock of your new acquisitions, which stow away nicely amongst your other possessions. While you make a brief survey of the remainder of the room, you don't spot any more unlooted bones; all that remains is the harem itself, reposed in death as they were in life. "Lumia's light shine upon you." "Walk with the wyld." Now, to move on... You gain 2000 EC's worth of old treasure. You gain 1x Razorcup Nectar.
rows.translation: 你确定这样做是正确的吗？”当你提起这件事时，埃尔萨拉问道，“在大多数地方，亵渎死者都是非常恶劣的行为。” “嗯，但如果他们真的已经离世了，那么这种行为或许并不算亵渎死者吧，”赫希娅反驳道，“我们亲眼看到他们离开了人世。那些骨头，现在也已经真正成为了骨头罢了 做了 把他们的东西留给了我们。” “确实是这样，但是——” “够了，你们两个！”瑞恩打断了他们。赫希娅和埃尔萨拉互相瞪了瞪眼，但还是听从了瑞恩的安排，没有再继续争论，只是恶狠狠地嘟囔了几句。 我是摄政王，在阿莉莎耗尽了国库资金来支持那个女魔头的计划之后，我们确实需要一切能够搞到的钱。无论我祖母的后宫里有哪些人，也不管他们信仰什么，只要他们还留有一些有价值的东西给我们，那我实在不明白我们为什么不应该接受这些馈赠。 现在，如果你们不介意的话，我们就开始清理这些遗骸吧。说实话，我并不比你们中的任何一个人更乐意做这件事，但这项工作必须完成。” 女德鲁伊和女祭司都同样不情愿，但当瑞恩开始从那些干枯的骨骼上摘下珠宝时，她们最终还是放弃了抵抗，开始收集那些黄金、宝石以及各种小饰品——毕竟这些东西对王室财政来说确实很有帮助，说实话，数量也不算少。 阿塞尔雷德一定是真心爱着他的后宫，才会如此宠溺她们；而冬城当时的财富，想必也远比莱恩的父母在世时丰富得多，才能负担得起这样的开销…… 大概半个小时后，你们四个人已经收集到了不少东西。Ryn把这些东西用布包了起来，但在那之前，她先把其中一些比较珍贵的物品分给了你们。 “给你。 [pc.name]有东西给你。 [pc.isDK |真是时候了。” “你确实值得这样的回报，”瑞恩微笑着说，“我们本来打算与他们所有人战斗，尽管这看起来几乎是不可能的，但后来你意识到了真正需要做些什么，才能让那些可怜的灵魂最终平静下来，从而离开这里。” 嗯，很高兴你的贡献在这里得到了认可。 |她确定吗？她和冬城政府剩下的那些人，比你更需要这笔钱。 “我希望你能够得到它。 [pc.name]瑞恩向你露出了真诚的微笑，”她说，“如果这能让你感觉好一些，就把这当作是摄政期间的开销吧。 ] 我还发现了另一样东西，”埃尔萨拉说着，递给你一个小瓶子。“你应该收下这个——只要看到这种植物，就会让我想起艾莉莎举办的派对，而每当我回想起那些日子，就会感到自己当时是多么无能为力，根本无法改变任何事情。” 赫希娅嗤之以鼻：“或者，也许你只是太懦弱了。” 哦，要是她们俩能赶紧滚开该多好啊 那个 这些声音很快便安静下来，让你有时间仔细查看自己新获得的物品——它们和其他财物一起被妥善地存放了起来。当你简要地扫视房间其余的部分时，你并没有发现任何其他未被掠夺的骨头；剩下的，只有那座后宫，它们如今安静地躺在那里，就如同生前的样子。 “卢米亚的轻型芒照耀着你。” “与大自然同行。” 现在，是时候继续前进了…… 你获得了价值2000 EC的古老宝藏。 你将获得1份Razorcup花蜜。

rows.original: Search the chambers for anything left that might be of value.
rows.translation: 在那些房间里搜寻任何可能还有价值的东西。
rows.raw: "Search the chambers for anything left that might be of value."

rows.original:
Something near the back of the room catches your eye — a glint of metal, tarnished as it is, hidden behind some rotted old drapes. While the old fabric turns to dust when you try to push the silks aside, the silvered bronze that was originally supposed to be concealed behind them is as sturdy as it was on the day it was installed. Brushing away the dust, you reveal an ornately carved safe in the wall, complete with a very curious locking mechanism.
        
        "Ah, a wordlock mechanism," Elthara muses. "One of the queen's curiosities, the luxury no doubt lavished upon some favorite. We have a couple others about the palace, or at least those that Alissa hasn't pawned off already to pay for... just about everything, to be honest."
        
        "I remember," Ryn adds with a sigh. "When father was alive, he'd let me play with some of those which he kept in the study. Great-grandmother had them imported from Tychris — each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the device itself. The words she chose were all her favorite things, and father said that they reminded him of her..."
        
        [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte
        |Indeed, you've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests were a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, although you didn't know their popularity stretched even this far from the heartlands. If you could solve the riddle and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest — or in this particular case, the safe — would unlock and allow you to claim its contents.
        
        |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a safe, but such devices are rarely made with practicality in mind. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens.
        ]
         
        Of course, though, there's the matter that everything written on the bronze plaque on the safe's front is in boreal elvish... 
        
        "And a rather antiquated version of the language at that," Ryn adds with a sad sigh. "Some of the phrasing is archaic, but I'll do my best to — "
        
        Hethia smirks. "Allow me, regent. The druidic version of our tongue hasn't changed that much since the day we departed the Winter City. This shouldn't be too hard to translate..."
rows.translation:
房间的后排某个地方吸引了你的注意——有一抹金属的光芒，尽管已经生锈了，但仍隐藏在一些腐烂的旧窗帘后面。当你试图把那些丝绸窗帘拨到一边时，那些旧布料立刻化作尘埃，而原本应该被隐藏在窗帘后的银色青铜制品，却依然像刚安装那天一样坚固完好。 拂去灰尘后，你发现墙上有一座雕刻精美的保险箱，其锁闭机制显得十分奇特。

“啊，这是文字锁机制啊，”埃尔萨拉喃喃道，“肯定是女王收藏的奇珍异宝之一，肯定是送给某个她特别宠爱的人的礼物。 我们还有一些关于那座宫殿的物品，至少是那些阿丽莎还没有拿去抵债的物品……说实话，几乎所有东西她都用来还债了。”

“我记得，”莱恩叹息着说道，“父亲在世的时候，会允许我玩他书房里那些物品。 曾祖母从提克里斯进口了这些密码锁——每个锁都设置了密码，为了帮助使用者记住密码，锁身上通常还会附带一个谜语。她选择的那些词语都是她最珍视的东西，父亲说，这些词语让他总会想起她。.."
        
        [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte
        |事实上，你在过去确实遇到过这类东西——密码锁箱子曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，不过你可能不知道，这种流行风气甚至已经传播到了远离中心地带的地区。只要你能解开谜题，将转盘调整到正确的位置，箱子——或者说在这个例子中是保险箱——就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。
        
        |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这看起来确实是一种相当迂回的方式来确保安全，但这类装置很少会以实用性为设计原则。你试了几次这个机制，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有。
        ]
         
        当然，问题在于，保险箱前面的青铜牌子上写的所有内容都是用北方精灵语写的……

“而且还是那种相当古老的语言版本，”瑞恩叹了口气说道，“有些表达方式已经过时了，但我会尽力去翻译的……”

赫希娅露出了得意的笑容：“让我来吧，摄政王。自从我们离开冬城以来，我们这种语言的德鲁伊版本并没有发生太大的变化，所以翻译起来应该不会太难……

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls; maybe something's lost in the translation Hethia's providing for you, but you doubt that's the case. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的内容仿佛是一道无法逾越的障碍；也许在赫希娅为你提供的翻译中有些信息丢失了，但你怀疑并非如此。直到你弄清楚这个问题之前，那个箱子里的东西恐怕永远也取不出来。

The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls; maybe something's lost in the translation Hethia's providing for you, but you doubt that's the case. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out."

rows.original: Never resting, never still Moving silently, hill to hill It does not walk, run or trot All is cool where it is not
rows.translation: 永不停歇，永不静止 悄无声息地，一座山丘接着另一座山丘…… 它既不会行走，也不会奔跑或小跑。 没有问题的地方，一切都很顺利。
rows.raw: " Never resting, never still Moving silently, hill to hill It does not walk, run or trot All is cool where it is not"

rows.original: Something within the safe's mechanism clicks, followed by a loud thump as the locks within the heavy bronze device disengage. Nothing immediately happens, though, and you're beginning to wonder if the wordlock has decayed with the passage of time Hethia pushes past you and grabs hold of the handle, giving it a firm pull. With a tremendous groan and grinding noise that echoes throughout the tomb, the safe swings open with an accompanying burst of foul-smelling stale air. "Ugh!" Hethia says, a scowl on her face as she steps back. "Let's see what's in here, though... oh." Through the dust and grime, you spy a tightly-sealed crystal vial of what must be wyldsap — even if you didn't recognize the legendary color of the viscous liquid, unspoiled by age, you can scent it through the vial. That's not all, of course: lying by the vial are two tomes, a little yellowed about the edges but otherwise perfectly fine. Perhaps being kept like this in the cool, airtight darkness has preserved them better than most? "Given the harem, I'd have expected more valuables, but this isn't anything we can use. Wyldsap might have once been useful, but it won't cure what ails the Winter City. That, and these volumes... well. If I may suggest, with the regent's permission — " "Of course. [pc.name] can definitely get more out of these than we can!" Ryn replies, waving off Elthara's concern. "It's the least we can do, given that [pc.heShe]'s helping us out like this. Here, why don't you take these?" You receive 1x Wyldsap. You receive 1x Tome of Driving Thrust. You receive 1x Tome of Bark Skin. With the safe emptied, there's nothing left for you here. If you've concluded your business here in the tomb, perhaps you should be on your way.
rows.translation: 保险箱的机械装置内部传来“咔嗒”一声，随后那重型的青铜制保险箱的锁具纷纷解开了，伴随着一声巨响。然而紧接着却什么也没有发生，你开始怀疑这个密码锁是否已经随着时间的流逝而失效了。这时，赫希娅从你身边挤过去，抓住了保险箱的把手，用力一拉。 随着一声巨大的呻吟声和令人不快的摩擦声在墓穴中回荡，保险箱终于打开了，同时有一股散发着恶臭的陈旧空气涌了出来。 “呃！”赫希娅皱着眉头，向后退了一步。 让我们看看里面有什么吧……哦。” 在灰尘和污垢之中，你看到了一支密封严实的水晶小瓶，里面装的肯定是一种名为“野性汁液”的物质——即使你无法认出这种粘稠液体的传奇颜色，也无法通过瓶子的外观判断它的品质，但你能闻到它散发出来的气味。 当然，还有其他东西：在那个小瓶子旁边，还有两本书，书边有些发黄，但除此之外都完好无损。也许正是因为被保存在这样阴凉、密闭的环境中，它们才比大多数书籍保存得更好吧？ 考虑到还有后宫这些资源，我本以为会找到更多有价值的物品，但这些根本没什么用处。‘野性汁液’或许曾经有用，但它无法治愈冬城所面临的困境。至于这些卷轴……唉，如果得到摄政王的允许，我有个建议…… 当然。 [pc.name] 我们肯定能从中获得更多的好处！”瑞恩回答道，同时摆了摆手，表示不需要埃尔萨拉担心。“考虑到这一点，这是我们最起码应该做的。 [pc.heShe]他这样帮助我们，来，这些你拿去吧。 你将获得1份野生树液。 你将获得1本《驾驶推力之书》。 你将获得1本树皮皮囊之书。 既然保险箱已经被清空了，这里已经没有什么值得你留下来的了。如果你已经完成了在这座墓穴里想要做的事情，或许该离开了。
rows.raw: " Something within the safe's mechanism clicks, followed by a loud thump as the locks within the heavy bronze device disengage. Nothing immediately happens, though, and you're beginning to wonder if the wordlock has decayed with the passage of time Hethia pushes past you and grabs hold of the handle, giving it a firm pull. With a tremendous groan and grinding noise that echoes throughout the tomb, the safe swings open with an accompanying burst of foul-smelling stale air. "Ugh!" Hethia says, a scowl on her face as she steps back. "Let's see what's in here, though... oh." Through the dust and grime, you spy a tightly-sealed crystal vial of what must be wyldsap — even if you didn't recognize the legendary color of the viscous liquid, unspoiled by age, you can scent it through the vial. That's not all, of course: lying by the vial are two tomes, a little yellowed about the edges but otherwise perfectly fine. Perhaps being kept like this in the cool, airtight darkness has preserved them better than most? "Given the harem, I'd have expected more valuables, but this isn't anything we can use. Wyldsap might have once been useful, but it won't cure what ails the Winter City. That, and these volumes... well. If I may suggest, with the regent's permission — " "Of course. [pc.name] can definitely get more out of these than we can!" Ryn replies, waving off Elthara's concern. "It's the least we can do, given that [pc.heShe]'s helping us out like this. Here, why don't you take these?" You receive 1x Wyldsap. You receive 1x Tome of Driving Thrust. You receive 1x Tome of Bark Skin. With the safe emptied, there's nothing left for you here. If you've concluded your business here in the tomb, perhaps you should be on your way. "

rows.original: There's something odd behind those old drapes...
rows.translation: 那些旧窗帘后面似乎藏着什么奇怪的东西……
rows.raw: "There's something odd behind those old drapes..."

rows.original:
There's a horrible, wailing sob coming from the far end of this side tomb... the unmistakable sound of a woman crying her soul out. Perhaps literally, considering the spirits you've encountered already.

    You put a hand up to your elven followers, telling them to be cautious, as you brace yourself to meet whoever — whatever — is making that noise. Yet when she comes into view, you still find yourself doing a double take between her and Etheryn. Were it not for the spirit's spectral outline, misty and indistinct... and the fact that she's wearing little more than stockings and garters, leaving the spirit's modest cock and small balls bare to the eye... they'd look almost the same. It's an unmistakable family resemblance.
    
    The slender half-sexed spirit stands at the very end of the tomb, hands covering her face as she wails forlornly. Only when you draw near does she snap her head up, pale lips twisting into a snarl between ragged sobs. 
    
    "You!" she shrieks, surging forward in a shroud of mist. "You're standing between me and my thrice-damned love! Did she send you to mock me again? To taunt me into giving up the Wyld for her new goddess? Tell her that I died first!"
    
    The spirit wails, so loudly that you can't stop yourself from covering your [pc.ears]. Your whole world shakes with the deafening peal; ice cracks and shatters along the walls surrounding you. Ye gods, you have to silence her!
rows.translation:
从这个侧墓的远处传来一阵凄厉的哭声……那绝对是女人撕心裂肺的哀嚎。考虑到你们已经遇到过的那些幽灵，这种哭声简直就像是灵魂在哀号。

你抬手部示意你的精灵追随者们保持警惕，然后做好准备，去面对那个发出这种声音的东西……不管那到底是什么。 然而，当她出现在视线中时，你还是会不由自主地将她与伊瑟琳进行对比。要不是那道幽灵般朦胧、模糊不清的轮廓……以及她身上几乎只穿着长袜和吊袜带，使得那幽灵的阴部部位完全暴露在眼前，你真的会怀疑她是不是伊瑟琳。它们看起来几乎一模一样，这种家族相似性是显而易见的。

那个身材纤细、具有中性特征的灵魂站在墓穴的尽头，双手部掩住脸，发出凄厉的哀嚎。只有当你靠近时，她才会突然抬起头，苍白的嘴唇在断断续续的啜泣声中扭曲成愤怒的表情。 
    
    你！”她尖叫着，裹着迷雾冲了上来，“你挡在了我和我那该死的爱情之间！是她派你来嘲笑我的吗？想逼我为了她的新女神而放弃对荒野的追求吗？告诉她，我会先死！那幽灵的哀嚎声如此之大，以至于你忍不住要捂住自己的耳朵。 [pc.ears]整个世界都在那震耳欲聋的巨响中颤抖；你周围的冰墙开始出现裂缝，最终纷纷碎裂。众神啊，你们必须让她安静下来！

rows.original: [var0 |With a flick of your wrist, you unweave the magic binding the poor spirit to this world. She screams as she's banished from this world, sent along to the next: "ATHEL.... ATHELDREEEEED!" And then there is, finally, blessed silence. "... Athledred," Ryn murmurs behind you. "That's my grandmother's name. Was that girl..." "The last royal consort," Elthara finishes, examining the grave. "Queen Atheldred's most honored spouse, your ancestor as well. Why in the Sun's name would she be a revenant down here, though?" Hethia scoffs. "That was Synneva, then? I had heard that the Sunbringer's stud was halfsex; that she was banished from the court for refusing to convert. But if that were true, how did she end up back here, in the royal crypt of all places? Curious." You don't doubt that girl was Ryn's ancestor; the resemblance was uncanny. It's hard not to wonder, then, if this Queen Atheldred will be the spitting image of Alissa, then. "Perhaps," Elthara shrugs. "None of us had the honor of meeting the Sunbringer, but her depiction in the epics would make her out to be quite the statuesque stunner. And if that spirit was wailing for her beloved queen, I have a feeling I know what lurks at the end of this accursed place. But first..." While Elthara's talking, Hethia reaches into the burial hollow and retrieves a shard of ice — one that's clearly been sculpted, carved into an angular shape like a dagger's blade. "This was clasped in her hands. Perhaps it will remind the queen of what she cast aside." Perhaps. |"Nooooooo!" the spirit wails, slumping to her knees before you. Tears stream down her cheeks, turning to ice on the crypt floor. "Athel, my love... I can't... can't bear to be apart, yet I cannot stand to be with you. Please, stranger, release me from this torment!" Etheryn peers out from behind you, looking at her nearly-naked near-doppleganger with a mix of pity and confusion. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"W-who... who are you?" she finally manages to squeak out, almost jumping back at her own echoing voice. |"You look... you look just like me!" Ryn murmurs, kneeling beside the spirit and placing a hand on her shoulder. Living flesh sinks ever so slightly into the ethereal. "Who are you?" ] "Who?" the spirit echoes, sitting back on her heels. "I am... was... Synneva, favored consort of my beloved Queen Atheldred — damn her soul to the depths! She's down here too, I'd know that aura of her disdain anywhere! But as for you, child, I do not know. I-" "... You are her grandmother," Hethia says with surety. "Even setting the resemblance aside, any Druid would recognize the name Synneva. The Sunbringer's stud. A martyr for the Wyld, weren't you?" The spirit sighs. "Grandmother? My darling Alraince had children after all, did she? What's your name, young lady?" [etheryn.lowConfidence |"E-E-Etheryn, m-ma'am." |"It's Etheryn. I'm glad to meet you, grandmother." ] "Etheryn. What a pretty name, for a pretty girl. Like I'm staring in a mirror to my youth. Tell me, girl, do you hold to Lumia or the Wyld? It seems you travel with servants of both faiths." Your princess glances askance, between her two zealous companions. "I was raised Lumian." The word seems to crush Synneva, and for a moment, she seems even less there than before. The mist bleeding off her body grows thicker; whatever will is keeping her bound to this world wavers. "Your friend called me a martyr for the old faith. It's not that simple, druidess. I watched my peoples' culture and history, our very gods, be thrown away by the woman I love — the woman who bore my children! I, and the other members of Athel's harem, all vowed to withhold ourselves from our queen until she vowed to stop her madness! She may have saved the boer'alvar, but what is left of us without our very soul?" The spirit's fists tighten into balls, and you see the tears well in her eyes again. For a moment you brace for her to wail again, but she controls herself — perhaps for Etheryn's sake, putting her hands on the princess's shoulders. "I wanted our children to grow up as boreal elves, not to lose everything we fought and bled to save during the Godswar. For our insolence, I and all the queen's harem were thrown into a tower out on the Rift and left to rot until we converted... and so we rotted!" Synneva pouts, eyes downcast. "My beloved... she cared more for her goddess than for us." "A true trial. I am sorry, lady." Elthara takes a knee beside the consort, glancing up to you. "Mayhaps there is something we can do to help?" "Maybe swear off your cruel goddess, for a start," Hethia grumbles. "This woman suffered less than some in her 'trials' your clergy put the druids through. But... failing that, we should unbind her spirit. Give her release." The consort's eyes narrow dangerously. "You cannot! My love keeps me here. My beautiful, wicked queen... I cannot forgive her, and yet even after all these years I still crave her love. To be embraced again..." Ryn glances up at you over her shoulder. "[pc.name]... we have to help her. Please." Sure, but how do you help a spirit that craves her lover's embrace? ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你只需轻轻一挥手腕，就能解开束缚那个可怜灵魂的魔法。当她被逐出这个世界，被送往另一个世界时，她发出了凄厉的尖叫：“阿瑟尔……阿瑟尔迪里……” 最终，一片宁静降临了。 ……阿瑟尔雷德，”莱恩在你身后轻声说道，“那是我祖母的名字。那个女孩……” “最后一位王室配偶，”埃尔萨拉继续说道，同时凝视着那座坟墓，“阿瑟尔雷德女王最受尊敬的配偶，也是你的祖先。 究竟为什么她会变成这样的存在，出现在这里呢？” 赫希娅嗤笑道：“原来是指辛内瓦啊？我听说过那个‘太阳使者’的伴侣是半性人；听说她因为拒绝改信其他信仰而被逐出了宫廷。 但如果那是真的，那么她究竟是怎么回到这里的？偏偏还是在这座皇家地窖里？真是让人好奇。 你肯定不会怀疑那个女孩吧 是 林的祖先；这种相似之处实在令人惊叹。因此，人们不禁会想：这位阿瑟德雷德女王会不会和艾莉莎一模一样呢？ “也许吧，”埃尔萨拉耸了耸肩说道，“我们当中没有人有幸见过那位‘光明使者’，但史诗中对她的描述确实让她显得美得令人窒息。 如果那股怨灵是在为它深爱的女王哀号的话，我有种预感，我知道这个被诅咒的地方的尽头隐藏着什么。但首先…… 当埃尔萨拉说话时，赫希娅伸手进入那个墓穴，取出一块冰块——那块冰显然被雕刻过，被削成了匕首刀刃般的尖锐形状。 这东西曾被她紧紧握在手中。或许，它能让女王想起那些她曾经抛弃的东西。” 或许吧。 |不——！！”那个灵魂哀嚎着，瘫软在你面前跪倒在地。泪水从她的脸颊流下，在墓室的地板上凝结成冰。“阿瑟尔，我的爱人……我无法……无法忍受与你分离，却又无法忍受与你在一起。求你了，陌生人，请把我从这种折磨中解救出来吧！” 艾瑟琳从你身后探出头来，看着这个几乎赤裸的、与自己极为相似的灵魂，眼中既有怜悯，也有困惑。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |你、你是谁……？”她终于挤出了这句话，听到自己的声音在空气中回荡，差点吓得跳了回去。 |你看起来……你和我一模一样！”莱恩轻声说道，跪在那个灵体旁边，将手放在她的肩上。那具血肉之躯微微融入了那虚无缥缈的能量之中。“你究竟是谁？ ] 谁？”那个灵魂回荡着，她重新坐回椅子上。“我是……曾经是……辛内瓦，我亲爱的阿瑟尔德雷德女王的宠妃——愿她的灵魂坠入深渊！她也在下面，我一定能认出她那充满轻蔑的气息！但至于你，孩子，我就不知道了。 ……你是她的祖母，”赫希娅肯定地说道，“就算不考虑外貌上的相似之处，任何德鲁伊都能认出‘辛内瓦’这个名字——那位‘光明使者’的同伴，为荒野而牺牲的烈士，对吧？ 灵魂叹息道：“祖母？我亲爱的阿尔兰斯终究还是生了孩子，对吧？这位年轻女士，您叫什么名字呢？ [etheryn.lowConfidence |埃-埃-伊瑟琳，夫人。 |我是艾瑟琳，很高兴见到您，奶奶。 ] 伊瑟琳……多是个美丽的名字，也配一个如此美丽的女孩。感觉我仿佛在镜中看到了自己年轻时的模样。告诉我，姑娘，你是追随卢米亚信仰，还是支持荒野一族？看来你身边既有信仰卢米亚的人，也有信仰荒野一族的人啊。” 你的公主侧目看了看她那两位热忱的同伴，然后说道：“我是在一个卢米亚信仰的环境中长大的。” 这个回答似乎让辛内瓦感到非常震惊，有那么一瞬间，她看起来更加 那里 比以前更加如此。她身上散发出的雾气越来越浓密；究竟是什么力量将她束缚在这个世界上，也开始变得模糊不清了。“你的朋友称我为旧信仰的殉道者。但事情并没有那么简单，德鲁伊女士。我亲眼看到，我的族人的文化与历史，甚至我们的神明，都被我所爱的女人给毁掉了——那个生下了我的孩子的女人！ 我和阿瑟后宫中的其他成员都发誓，除非女王承诺停止她的疯狂行为，否则我们绝不与她发生关系！她或许拯救了那些兽人，但失去了灵魂，我们又算什么呢？ 那幽灵的拳头紧紧握成了拳状，你再次看到她眼中噙着的泪水。 有那么一刻，你以为她又会开始哀嚎，但她还是控制住了自己——或许是为了伊瑟琳着想，她把手部放在了公主的肩上，说道：“我原本希望我们的孩子能够在一个……这样的环境中长大。 极北精灵我们不能让在“神战”中为我们所奋斗、为我们所流的血白费。就因为我们的傲慢，我和女王的后宫全体成员都被关进了裂谷边的那座塔里，被遗弃在那里任其腐烂，直到我们改过自新……而我们，确实就这样腐烂了！ 辛内瓦撅着嘴，目光低垂：“我亲爱的……她更在乎她的神明，而不是我们。” “真是场严峻的考验。我很抱歉，夫人。”埃尔萨拉在王后的身旁单膝跪地，抬头看着你：“或许我们能做些什么来帮助她呢？或许可以先放弃你们那位残忍的女神吧，”赫希娅抱怨道，“这个女人所经历的‘考验’，其实比你们神职人员让德鲁伊们承受的那些还要轻。但是……如果那样不行，我们就应该解开她灵魂的束缚。 放她走吧。” 王后的眼睛危险地眯了起来。“你不能这么做！我的爱人让我留在这里。我那美丽而邪恶的王后……我无法原谅她，然而即便过了这么多年，我依然渴望得到她的爱。 再次被拥抱……” 瑞恩侧过身来，抬头看着你。[pc.name]……我们必须帮助她。求你了。” “当然，但我们要如何帮助一个如此渴望得到爱人怀抱的灵魂呢？ ]

rows.original:
"Hethia?" you ask, turning to your druidess. "She followed your faith."
    
    The elf gives you a slight nod of approval and produces a talisman from her belt. "It is time you found peace, Synneva. You endanger all the city now, even druids. Return to the embrace of the Wyld."
    
    The spirit moves to speak, opening her mouth, but no sound comes out. Cracks form across her skin as if she were made of ice, and when Hethia presses her talisman to the spectral halfsex's brow, she shatters into a thousand pieces. What's left becomes naught but mist, fading away to nothing as Hethia blows it away with a single deep breath.
    
    "There," the druidess proclaims once she's seen Synneva off. "One less reminder of how my people have suffered for the gods' hubris. Come then, let's put an end to the — hmm, what's that?"
    
    She reaches past where the consort had knelt, into one of the burial hollows, and retrieves a shard of ice — one that's clearly been sculpted, carved into an angular shape like a dagger's blade. "Look here, a pretty bauble clasped in her hands. Perhaps it will remind the queen of what she cast aside. Better to usher her along to join her so-called beloved."
    
    Perhaps.

You crumple to the ground, clutching your bleeding ears as the banshee's screams reach a deafening pitch. The ice of the crypt cracks, shards raining down on you and your priestesses. Etheryn, though... you can see her fall to her knees at the feet of the half-naked ghost, eyes distant and vacant as the spirit approaches her. The banshee finally ceases her scream, reaching down and cupping Ryn's chin.
    
    "I am Synneva, favored consort of Atheldred Sunbringer," the spirit murmurs, stroking Ryn's hair. "You... you will be the perfect instrument of my revenge. Come to me, child."
    
    She tilts Etheryn's head back and leans down to the transfixed princess, kissing her lips. As she does so, the spirit's already-translucent body begins to fade away, becoming wisps of cold mist that slither into the princess's mouth, nose, ears, until there's nothing left of her near-naked doppelganger ghost. When the last of the mist is gone, Ryn lurches forward, bracing on hands and knees and gasping for breath. You've almost recovered yourself by now, enough that you can reach out to try and get her attention.

rows.original: A woman is kneeling at center of the royal burial chambers, shrouded in cold mist, and wearing a crown of sunlit ice upon her brow. A pair of ghostly wings sprout from her back, draped across the tombs to either side. She's gripping a whitewood bow, just like Etheryn's, at her side, while on her back sits a quiver of arrows that seem made of pure sunlight. As you draw near, you can hear her voice, strong and zealous, carrying from her lips in prayer: "Oh goddess of the sun, I beg you lead the ignorant to the light. Lead the wayward from temptation. Grant me the strength to resist her..." [var0 |"Athel!" Consort Synneva phases past you, throwing her arms open to the ghostly warrior. "Please, my love. My queen! Is two centuries not enough to realize the hurt you've caused me — to all those you held dear? Can you truly not accept me even in death?" The spirit of Atheldred jerks upright, turning to face your party. She's beautiful, a warrior-woman unmistakably in Alissa's shape, though she's lost no muscle to the passage of years and pregnancy, as did the queen you faced before. "You!" the queen scowls, narrowing her gaze at her consort. "Synne, my love. Have you finally found the wisdom to embrace Lumia's light?" Synne sighs. "Why must you obsess over that still? We are dead Athel, bound here for eternity until we make amends. Please, love, don't do this." "'Don't do this'?" the queen snarls, drawing an arrow from her quiver. "You speak of peace even as you bring a party of warriors to force my hand. No! I am your queen, the Sunbringer, blessed of Lumia, the first of her valkyries! I will not be strong armed, no matter how it tears my heart apart. In the goddess's name, I will force you to yield, Synne!" "Damn it, you bull-headed child, won't you ever listen to me once in your miserable life — or after, for that matter!?" The consort hisses, darting back behind your party. She puts a hand on your shoulder and whispers, "Please, knock this stubbornness out of her like you did to me. Then maybe we can have a chance to talk like adults, for the first time in centuries!" You suppose the queen will leave you no other choice. |Ryn pushes past you, bow clutched to her chest. "Grandmother!" The queenly spirit jerks upright, fingers white around her weapon as she turns to face you. Her eyes take in your party with cold calculation... until she alights on Ryn, and her mien darkens with fury. "You! Synne, my love... have you finally found the wisdom to embrace Lumia's light?" All these centuries, and you have learned nothing! Our people would be slaves to the Wraiths without Lumia's protection. We owe her everything. Our lives... Alraince's life, all our childrens'! By my vow to the Radiant One, I cannot tolerate the heathen or the witch within her sacred city. Even... even you. It's time to go back to the tower, Synne. Time to think on what you've put us both through!" Fury rises in Atheldred's voice, and the writhing mist around her grows denser, clinging to your feet as the queen nocks a sunlight arrow and raises her bow. It seems you have no choice! ] '

rows.translation: [var0 |不——！！！！！！！！！！” 随着一股强大的力量，这位幽灵般的女王被送到了她应该去的地方——来世。你的精灵同伴们松了一口气，放下了手中的武器。 [var1|当你环顾四周，试图寻找辛妮娃时，却发现那位王后根本不在那里。或许你为了得到她，把另外一个人也赶走了吧？] 完成了，”埃尔萨拉说道，然后将她的镰刀搭在肩上。 赫希娅耸了耸肩：“感觉有点虎头蛇尾啊。不过至少也是一场精彩的法术表演，值得称赞。 [pc.name]蕾恩只是叹了口气，肩膀耷了下来。“奶奶们……哦，我真希望……真希望自己有机会和你们谈谈。我只是……希望自己能以某种方式让她们为我感到骄傲。” 她摇了摇头，转身准备离开。“我们回楼上吧。 |[var1 |就在幽灵女王跪倒在地之前，辛妮已经站在她身边，扶住那位身材高大的女性的肩膀，轻轻地将她搀倒下来。 “哦，我的爱人，”辛妮轻声说道，将自己的额头贴在女王的肩膀上，“我亲爱的阿瑟尔，你难道看不见自己做了什么吗？我们彼此之间究竟造成了多大的伤害？所有这些痛苦，究竟都是为了什么呢？” 辛妮伸手拉住艾瑟琳，将这位同样拥有双重性别的同伴拉到阿瑟雷德面前，说道：“亲爱的 这个 这就是我们一直以来争论不休的问题——谁才是真正的受害者。这位就是伊瑟琳，我们的孙女。 阿瑟尔德雷德缓缓认出了她，随着逐渐明白过来，他的表情也发生了变化。“孙女？辛妮，她长得和你一模一样……”女王伸出手，轻轻触碰了伊瑟琳的脸颊。 瑞恩 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |她虽然脸红得厉害，但还是强挤出一丝笑容，说道：“喂……你好。 |她微笑着，将手放在女王的手上：“喂，奶奶……终于见到您了，真是太高兴了。 |她真诚地微笑着，伸手握住了女王的手：“你好，奶奶。终于能见到您了，真是太高兴了。 ] 女王强忍泪水，目轻型在丈夫和女儿之间来回移动。“哦，女神啊……你们真是太美了，简直就像辛妮一样……哦，我的爱人，我们究竟做了些什么呢？这些年来我们一直在互相仇恨，而如今我第一次看到了我们的孙子/孙女。第一次，我们两个人所付出的一切，都感觉有了意义。” 或许，这正是让这两颗受伤的心重归于好的好机会……但是，应该从哪里入手部呢？ |幽灵女王双膝跪地，手部中的长弓重重地摔在身旁。“怎…卢米娅，怎么会这样！？你为什么抛弃我…为什么我感到如此寒冷、如此空虚…辛妮，你在哪里？” “我不是辛妮娃，”伊瑟琳小心翼翼地朝这位女武神走去，“但我确实是你的孙女…我是伊瑟琳。阿尔兰斯曾是我的母亲… 阿塞尔德雷德缓缓抬起头，脸上挂着泪痕：“你……你就是……可你长得和她一模一样……” “我们注意到了，”赫希娅轻笑道，“真是太不可思议了。” “而你的另一个孙女，艾莉莎，也和你很像，”埃尔萨拉接着说道。你瞥了那位女祭司一眼，生怕她再提到关于恶魔的事情。 围绕着女王的雾气缓缓弥漫开来，充满了整个房间。那位古老的精灵抽泣着，将双手部放在瑞恩的脸颊上：“女神啊，看看你……多么美丽啊。哦，伊瑟琳……我真希望你能知道，我为了你付出了多少，我们的族人失去了什么。但这一切都是值得的，所有的牺牲，甚至包括失去辛内瓦，只为了能见到你……我的孙女…… 奶奶，您为什么还留在这里？”瑞恩回头问道，“我们已经见到了辛内瓦，也把她放走了。您也应该准备继续前行了吧？” “我的辛内瓦啊！哦，神啊，要是我能再看到她一次该多好……我的宝贝……为什么她就是不明白呢，为什么她始终不理解，那位女神才是我们在这个充满黑暗与绝望的世界里唯一的希望？啊，我的宝贝，我多么渴望再感受一次她的拥抱啊…… 另一个同样渴望爱的灵魂……然而，你该如何帮助她继续前行呢？ ] ]
