rows.original:
"I am sorry, Queen Atheldred," the Lumian priestess sighs, approaching at your order. "Consort Synneva has moved on, and now so too must you. I beg of you, embrace the goddess's peace."
    
    She holds out her holy symbol, pressing it to the specter's bow. Atheldred's once-fearsome demeanor falters, both in the face of her grand-child and in the presence of Lumia's light. 
    
    You can hope she finds at least some small comfort in it, as she reaches out to stroke Ryn's cheek one last time. "You will do fine, child. Hold fast to your faith, and follow your heart — as I failed to do. Find your courage, and there is nothing that will stand in your way. Here."
    
    The queen takes Ryn's bow in hand and closes her eyes, running her spectral fingers across the taut string. "Take my light, and I will be with you always."
    
    The bowstrong glows white-hot as the royal spirit fades away, becoming wisps of light and frost before slipping away to nothing. Ryn gasps, tears streaking her cheeks, and her hand lingers where her grandmother had touched her — if only for a moment. Her bow remains glowing in her hand, infuzed with the valkyrie's holy power. Something to remember her by, you suppose.
    
    When Ryn's able to dry her tears and stand, she gives you a nod full of newfound determination. "I feel grandmother still with me. All the spirits of this place. They're watching me... I can only hope we make them proud. Let's... let's go back upstairs, shall we?"
rows.translation:
对不起，阿瑟尔雷德女王，”卢米亚的女祭司叹息着，应您的命令走了过来。“辛内瓦王后已经离世，现在您也该放下这一切了。请您接受女神的安宁吧。”

她将自己的神圣象征物递过来，将其贴在幽灵的弓上。面对她的曾孙，也在这卢米亚的轻型芒照耀下，阿瑟尔雷德那曾经令人生畏的神态终于软化了。 
    
    你可以希望她能从中获得一些小小的慰藉。当她最后一次伸手轻抚瑞恩的脸颊时，说道：“孩子，你会没事的。坚守你的信念，跟随你的心声——就像我当年没有做到的那样。鼓起你的勇气，没有什么能够阻挡你。拿着吧。
    
    女王手持瑞恩的弓，闭上双眼，用她那如幽灵般的手指轻轻抚过紧绷的弓弦。“汲取我的轻型芒吧，我将永远与你同在。”

随着王室灵魂渐渐消散，那把弓发出了炽热的白轻型，最终化作一丝丝轻型晕与霜花，彻底消失无踪。 瑞恩倒抽着气，泪水顺着脸颊流淌，她的手还停留在祖母曾经触碰过的地方——哪怕只是那一瞬间。她手中的弓依然散发着轻型芒，那轻型芒蕴含着女武神的圣力。或许，这把弓就是纪念她的东西吧。
    
    当瑞恩终于止住泪水站起身来时，她向你点了点头，眼中充满了新的决心。“我觉得奶奶还在我身边，这个地方的所有灵魂都在注视着我……我只能希望我们能让她们感到骄傲。我们……我们还是回楼上吧，好吗？

rows.original: If there's one thing these two star-crossed lovers ought to be able to find common ground over, it's [etheryn.lnhConfidence |giving their poor, abused heiress a much-needed confidence boost |the chance to get to know their meek little grand-daughter |the chance to get to know their charming little grand-daughter ]. The two ghostly royals exchange a glance, and turn their attention to the princess now kneeling on the dias between them. "You say your name is Etheryn, child?" the queen says softly, brushing a ghostly hand across Ryn's cheek. "That was my aunt's name. A strong name. [etheryn.lowConfidence |It's something to aspire to. |It suits you. ]" Ryn blushes, putting her hand over her grandmother's. Synneva seats herself beside her near-doppelganger and crosses a leg, the closest thing to modesty you've seen from the nearly naked elf so far. Athedred looks between the both of them, and you swear you see a little smile creeping its way onto the sun-blessed elf's face. "You two really do look just the same. It seems your seed was even stronger than I thought, Synne." The consort preens, running a hand through her hip-long mane. "Clearly. But she has your eyes, love." "And you... m-my big sister, used to look just like you too," Ryn forces herself to admit. "Sister!" Synneva claps, "You didn't mention a sister. Tell us all about our other grandchildren, please!" Ryn tries to hide a grimace, glancing between queen and consort. "She, uh... Queen Alissa's gone, now. But she was... was the greatest warrior of her generation. The folk of the city loved her." Atheldred nods, seemingly pleased and pained at the same time. "I am sorry for your loss, Etheryn. Does that make you queen, then?" "My parents died when I was born, and Alissa was my only sibling. So I... I rule the Winter City now, yes. I know I'm not much to look at, but I just hope that... that I can make you both proud." "Oh, sweetheart," Atheldred sighs, stroking Ryn's cheek again. "Sweet child. Just look at yourself. So beautiful, so regal. How could you ever think we would be anything but proud? Would that we could stay and watch over your rule, give you wise counsel on the throne. But how then would you grow into your own." "You'll do fine!" Synneva insists, kissing Ryn's cheek. "You might not have gotten Athel's muscle, [etheryn.highConfidence |but you got her heart, and |or her confidence, but ] with my charm and wits you'll have nothing to fear in court or in love." Atheldred laughs. "Ever the humble one, weren't you Synne?" Her consort smiles and laughs... which in turn sets the ghostly queen to giggling, reaching for her lover's hand. Their eyes meet for the first time since the confrontation began. "Goddess, what have we been doing, Synne?" the queen sighs. "All this time wasted when we've had such a treasure so close at hand." Synne shakes her head. "Let's not talk about that now, my love, lest we devolve into another argument. Let's... let's leave our granddaughter with a better impression of us. One worthy of us both." "Of course. Ah, Etheryn... that bow of yours. Let me see it, please." Etheryn takes the weapon from her back and reverently presents it to the ghostly queen. It truly is the same bow as Atheldred herself wields, unmistakably identical to the spectral outline at the queen's feet. She takes it from Etheryn with clear affection, running her fingers across its whitewood body before closing them around the string. "Take my light-" "-And my love!" Synneva adds, covering the queen's hand with her own. "... And we will be with you, always." The bowstring begins to glow a radiant white-hot, infused with the spirits' combined passions — and in turn, the pair of them become ever-more translucent, fading into cold mist as the valkyries did before them. They each lean into their granddaughter, embracing her and kissing both cheeks. Ryn all but melts into their arms, hugging them as tight as she can before they slip through her fingers, nearly translucent now. The last you see of the royal couple is them turning to each other and embracing, lips touching in the moment before they become nothing but rolling mist dissipating across the tomb's floor. rows.original:
Elthara frowns at your question. "That's a rather sensitive matter."
    
    Of course it is, but Ryn's asked you to investigate and ask around; since she's the last surviving member of the Lumian priesthood here in the palace, she's the only person you can ask as to the priesthood's involvement in the matter of the king dowager's death. Was she around that day?
    
    She takes several moments to consider her reply before nodding slowly. "Yes. I was an initiate at the point, so I wasn't personally involved in the investigation. I do know what I heard, though, but you know how accounts of these matters grow in the telling."
    
    You do. Still, it's something you want to hear.
    
    Elthara muses on that a moment. "From what I remember... the king was rushed into the chapel of light, [pc.name]. We were in the middle of preparing for the evening service — what might have been considered the vespers amongst humans, I think..."
    
    What did the king look like?
    
    "I only caught a glimpse of him before we initiates were rushed out, but it's not something I'll ever forget, [pc.name]. He was pretty pale, but gritting his teeth and stubbornly refusing to die; I think he knew the price his wife's kingdom would pay if he were to succumb to his wound. They'd bound his stomach, and the cloth was soaked right through with blood; they said the boar had gored him pretty bad. When everyone had recovered from the shock of seeing the king dowager on death's door, everyone who wasn't necessary was shooed out of the chapel and the high priestess of the time began work on him.
    
    "It was no good. Like so many other gut wounds, the injury itself wasn't fatal, but rather the sepsis that resulted from his guts leaking out into his blood. Healing magic — or at least the kind that we have — doesn't possess that kind of power that was necessary to save the king dowager. His injury fouled in short order, and he was in great pain and dead within days."
    
    ... 
    
    "For what it's worth, everyone tried to save him to the best of their ability, [pc.name]. When it became apparent that only a miracle would suffice, we initiates were instructed to pray to the goddess to save our king, while the high priestess herself made the trek to the glorious fortress of the valkyries to beg for her providence and mercy."
    
    The answer was no, you take it.
    
    Elthara deliberates, then nods slowly. "The goddess denied the petition to work a miracle and save our king."
    
    Why?
    
    "The answer was given to all of us Lumians as we prayed: the king dowager was well-known to have a penchant for the thrill of danger, and that with the risks he constantly took throughout his life, it was only through extreme good fortune and Lumia's providence that he had survived this long. That foolhardy eagerness in the face of danger was what drew the late queen's eye to him, but also was his undoing in the end. To snatch him from death through direct divine intervention would be to open the gates to more and more petitions of the same nature, and tread upon Tira's domain when it came to the reaping of people whose appointed hour had come.
    
    "When we received this answer, there was nothing to be done but make the king dowager's passing as peaceful as possible and arrange the state funeral as a religious matter."
    
    ...And what does she know of Elyon's role in all of this?
    
    "The master of hawks and hounds was promptly arrested as the prime suspect; as the man who had led the hunt and prepared the equipment beforehand, if any foul play was involved in the king's death, it was through him. However, since the palace guard and constabulary could not establish any motive, nor find any evidence of wrongdoing, he was eventually released.
    
    "It didn't matter. The Winter City wasn't about to get angry at their goddess for declining to save the king dowager, but they needed a scapegoat nonetheless. In the months following the king dowager's death and transition of power to Alissa, he was effectively under house arrest; leaving the palace would have meant him being lynched in the streets. He was always loyal to the crown beforehand, but I believe his guilt and these unfortunate circumstances led him to serve Alissa unquestioningly despite his better judgement. Not that the queen ever acknowledged his presence, unless it was to torment him, but in hindsight her disinterest in the man and his maluses was a kindness in and of itself. Imagine if she'd decided to make him her plaything; he'd have been a full-blown demon like her instead of merely tainted."
    
    You scratch your chin and consider what you've heard. Elyon's tale might have been tragic, but [pc.isDK
        |but you don't give a shit about that being an excuse for his behavior
        |that doesn't excuse his current behavior
    ]. Which is, you suppose, why Ryn is trying to find a way to help him. The more you learn about his circumstances, the more you think these outbursts are related to his own guilt rather than anything Alissa or Kasyrra might have done to him — which in turn gives you hope that he could be cured in some way.
    
    "O-of course. From everything, the path to the huntsmaster's recovery appears to lie not in potions and tonics, but his own strength of will. Perhaps it's selfish for me to say as much, but he's been as helpful as he can be in these trying times. I would hate to lose him... not just as another pair of capable hands, but also as a man I once knew, if not very well. Dear Etheryn is very fond of the man."
    
    All right, you think you've gotten a clearer picture of the circumstances surrounding the king dowager's death. You can only hope that you haven't been too intrusive on the matter.
    
    "If [etheryn.crowned
        |her Majesty
        |the regent
    ] ordered as much, then it's my duty to reply in the full, my dear champion. Now then, is there anything more I can do for you?"

埃尔萨拉沉思了一会儿，说道：“据我记忆……国王是被匆忙带到了轻型明礼拜堂里 [pc.name]我们当时正在准备晚祷——我想，在人类社会中，这应该可以被称作晚祷仪式吧……”

“在我们这些被召入仪式的人被匆忙带出去之前，我只是匆匆瞥了他一眼，但那一幕我永远也不会忘记。 [pc.name]他的脸色非常苍白，但仍然咬紧牙关，坚决不肯放弃生命；我想他心里很清楚，如果自己死了，他的妻子和她的王国将会付出多么沉重的代价。他们已经用布绑住了他的腹部，但那些布已经被鲜血浸透了；据说那头野猪刺伤他的地方非常严重。 当所有人都从看到王太后生命垂危的震惊中恢复过来后，那些无关人员都被赶出了小教堂，当时的首席女祭司开始对王太后进行治疗。

……

“不管怎么说，大家都尽了最大努力去救他。 [pc.name]当人们意识到唯有奇迹才能拯救我们的国王时，我们这些祭司们被命令向女神祈祷，祈求她的庇佑与怜悯；而大祭司本人则亲自前往那些庄严而辉煌的英灵殿堂，恳求女神施展她的力量与慈悲。
    
    答案是否定的，你明白了吧。

埃尔萨拉沉思片刻，然后缓缓点了点头：“女神拒绝了我们祈求她创造奇迹拯救国王的请求。”

为什么呢？

“当我们所有人虔诚祈祷时，女神就已经给出了答案：那位王太后向来热衷于追求危险与刺激，而她一生中不断冒着的种种风险，使得她能够活到今天，完全得益于极好的运气以及卢米亚神的庇护。 那种在危险面前仍不顾一切的鲁莽行为，正是让已故女王注意到了他，但最终也导致了他的灭亡。如果通过神的直接干预将他从死亡中拯救出来，那就意味着会有越来越多类似的请求出现，而在那些注定面临死亡的人被带走的过程中，这也侵犯了蒂拉的权力范围。
    
    当我们收到这个答复后，我们只能尽力让王太后的离世过程尽可能平静，并将国葬办成一场宗教仪式。”

……那么，她又了解埃利昂在这整件事中的角色什么呢？
    
    那位负责组织猎鹰和猎犬狩猎活动的人很快就被列为主要嫌疑人。由于正是他负责指挥狩猎行动并提前准备好了所有所需设备，因此如果国王的死亡与什么阴谋有关，那么肯定与他有关。然而，由于宫廷卫队和警察既无法确定他的作案动机，也找不到任何证明他有违法行为的证据，最终他还是被释放了。

        |但你根本不在乎这是否可以成为为他这种行为找的借口。
        |但这并不能成为他目前这种行为的借口。
    ]也就是说，这正是Ryn试图寻找办法帮助他的原因。你越是了解他的处境，就越会认为他的这些情绪爆发与他自己的内疚感有关，而不是因为Alissa或卡希拉对他做了什么——而这反而让你产生了希望，认为他或许可以通过某种方式得到治愈。
    
    哦，当然。从种种情况来看，让这位狩猎大师恢复健康的途径似乎并不在于各种药剂或补品，而在于他自身的意志力。这么说或许有点自私，但在这些艰难的时刻，他已经尽了最大的努力来帮助我们。 我真不愿意失去他……不仅仅是因为他是一双能干的手部，更因为他曾是我认识的人，虽然算不上非常熟络。亲爱的伊瑟琳，她非常喜欢这个男人。

好吧，你认为自己已经对王太后死亡背后的情况有了更清晰的了解了吧。 你只能希望自己在这件事上没有做得太过分。 [etheryn.crowned
        |女王陛下
        |摄政王
    ] 既然您点了这么多，那么我有责任向您做出完整的答复，我亲爱的勇士。那么，还有什么我可以为您做的吗？

"
    Elthara frowns at your question. "That's a rather sensitive matter."
    
    Of course it is, but Ryn's asked you to investigate and ask around; since she's the last surviving member of the Lumian priesthood here in the palace, she's the only person you can ask as to the priesthood's involvement in the matter of the king dowager's death. Was she around that day?
    
    She takes several moments to consider her reply before nodding slowly. "Yes. I was an initiate at the point, so I wasn't personally involved in the investigation. I do know what I heard, though, but you know how accounts of these matters grow in the telling."
    
    You do. Still, it's something you want to hear.
    
    Elthara muses on that a moment. "From what I remember... the king was rushed into the chapel of light, [pc.name]. We were in the middle of preparing for the evening service — what might have been considered the vespers amongst humans, I think..."
    
    What did the king look like?
    
    "I only caught a glimpse of him before we initiates were rushed out, but it's not something I'll ever forget, [pc.name]. He was pretty pale, but gritting his teeth and stubbornly refusing to die; I think he knew the price his wife's kingdom would pay if he were to succumb to his wound. They'd bound his stomach, and the cloth was soaked right through with blood; they said the boar had gored him pretty bad. When everyone had recovered from the shock of seeing the king dowager on death's door, everyone who wasn't necessary was shooed out of the chapel and the high priestess of the time began work on him.
    
    "It was no good. Like so many other gut wounds, the injury itself wasn't fatal, but rather the sepsis that resulted from his guts leaking out into his blood. Healing magic — or at least the kind that we have — doesn't possess that kind of power that was necessary to save the king dowager. His injury fouled in short order, and he was in great pain and dead within days."
    
    ... 
    
    "For what it's worth, everyone tried to save him to the best of their ability, [pc.name]. When it became apparent that only a miracle would suffice, we initiates were instructed to pray to the goddess to save our king, while the high priestess herself made the trek to the glorious fortress of the valkyries to beg for her providence and mercy."
    
    The answer was no, you take it.
    
    Elthara deliberates, then nods slowly. "The goddess denied the petition to work a miracle and save our king."
    
    Why?
    
    "The answer was given to all of us Lumians as we prayed: the king dowager was well-known to have a penchant for the thrill of danger, and that with the risks he constantly took throughout his life, it was only through extreme good fortune and Lumia's providence that he had survived this long. That foolhardy eagerness in the face of danger was what drew the late queen's eye to him, but also was his undoing in the end. To snatch him from death through direct divine intervention would be to open the gates to more and more petitions of the same nature, and tread upon Tira's domain when it came to the reaping of people whose appointed hour had come.
    
    "When we received this answer, there was nothing to be done but make the king dowager's passing as peaceful as possible and arrange the state funeral as a religious matter."
    
    ...And what does she know of Elyon's role in all of this?
    
    "The master of hawks and hounds was promptly arrested as the prime suspect; as the man who had led the hunt and prepared the equipment beforehand, if any foul play was involved in the king's death, it was through him. However, since the palace guard and constabulary could not establish any motive, nor find any evidence of wrongdoing, he was eventually released.
    
    "It didn't matter. The Winter City wasn't about to get angry at their goddess for declining to save the king dowager, but they needed a scapegoat nonetheless. In the months following the king dowager's death and transition of power to Alissa, he was effectively under house arrest; leaving the palace would have meant him being lynched in the streets. He was always loyal to the crown beforehand, but I believe his guilt and these unfortunate circumstances led him to serve Alissa unquestioningly despite his better judgement. Not that the queen ever acknowledged his presence, unless it was to torment him, but in hindsight her disinterest in the man and his maluses was a kindness in and of itself. Imagine if she'd decided to make him her plaything; he'd have been a full-blown demon like her instead of merely tainted."
    
    You scratch your chin and consider what you've heard. Elyon's tale might have been tragic, but [pc.isDK
        |but you don't give a shit about that being an excuse for his behavior
        |that doesn't excuse his current behavior
    ]. Which is, you suppose, why Ryn is trying to find a way to help him. The more you learn about his circumstances, the more you think these outbursts are related to his own guilt rather than anything Alissa or Kasyrra might have done to him — which in turn gives you hope that he could be cured in some way.
    
    "O-of course. From everything, the path to the huntsmaster's recovery appears to lie not in potions and tonics, but his own strength of will. Perhaps it's selfish for me to say as much, but he's been as helpful as he can be in these trying times. I would hate to lose him... not just as another pair of capable hands, but also as a man I once knew, if not very well. Dear Etheryn is very fond of the man."
    
    All right, you think you've gotten a clearer picture of the circumstances surrounding the king dowager's death. You can only hope that you haven't been too intrusive on the matter.
    
    "If [etheryn.crowned
        |her Majesty
        |the regent
    ] ordered as much, then it's my duty to reply in the full, my dear champion. Now then, is there anything more I can do for you?"
    "

rows.original:
As you enter Ryn's throne room, you're greeted by the sight of [party.has etheryn
        |Bailiff Daliza striding purposefully towards the both of you, a grimace on her face. "[etheryn.crowned
            |Your Majesty
            |Lady Regent
        ]. About time you finally showed up. Been here a couple of days wondering if I should just return down south and leave it all to Elthara, but I don't trust anyone but me to give my reports straight."
        
        Ryn glances at you [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |for reassurance
            |curiously
        ], then gives the bailiff a quick nod. "What's the matter, Bailiff?"
        
        "Her men found someone while they were traveling the forest paths to and from the Winter City, [etheryn.crowned
            |Your Majesty
            |Regent
        ]," Elthara says from her usual spot beside the throne. "While you were away with [pc.name], the bailiff and I had some words about the matter and although we don't agree on a number of the details, we still managed to concur that the extenuating circumstances warranted your personal judgement on the matter."
        
        Sighing, Ryn trundles up to her throne and flops in it, assuming the most un-queenly pose a boreal elf can. You don't blame her, given the nannying tone that Elthara's using, the very one that says a lot by leaving so much unsaid. "[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |I-I'm sorry for making the two of you w-wait for me. Daliza, Elthara, t-thanks for keeping the matter and letting me make a decision on it, whatever it is. I d-don't mean to be away from the Winter City and my duties as r-regent for such long stretches, b-but — "
            |Elthara, you don't have to take that tone with me; I know full well you're having a hard time running things in my absence and that there're certain decisions that only I can make. That being said, being out there with [pc.name] is an education in and of itself. Thank you, the both of you, for keeping the matter long enough for me to come back and make a decision on it... whatever it is.
        ]"
        
        "Just get it all out of your system so you don't come down with a terminal case of adventuring spirit in your middle age like some of your ancestors did," Daliza spits. "All right, [etheryn.crowned
            |Your Majesty
            |Lady Regent
        ] — I'll have the prisoner sent in."
        |Ryn, Bailiff Daliza and Elthara all clustered about the throne deep in discussion. There's a bit of a raucous caucus going on in the audience chamber, and unsurprisingly, Ryn's the first one to look up from the heated discussion and notice you.
        
        "[pc.name]! [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |T-thank the gods you've come. Bailiff Daliza here b-brought someone in — as in, arrested him — and she and Elthara have been a-arguing over what to do with the man since morning
            |Talk about a sight for sore eyes — Bailiff Daliza here brought someone in — as in, arrested him — this morning, and both she and Elthara have been arguing non-stop over what's to be done with the man. I've been mediating the whole session, but that's about all I can do; while I'm making up for it, Alissa was never one to teach me the finer details of our criminal law, and so I'm stuck listening to them go back and forth about it
        ]."
        
        You look between Ryn, Daliza and Elthara, and for the first time since you've entered the audience chamber the latter two women stop their bickering and turn to you. Well, if things are going to be like this, why don't they just pause for a moment, and you can take it from the start?
        
        Daliza's the first one to make a move, stepping forward briskly and giving you a curt nod. "Ah, m'[pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]. While moving to and from the Winter City, some of my men happened upon someone whom [etheryn.crowned
            |her Majesty
            |the Lady Regent
        ] has some sentimental regard for. Given his condition, we promptly arrested him — for his own safety, of course — and had him marched to the palace."
    ]
    
    A prisoner, huh. Was he any trouble?
    
    "None at all. In fact, the custody is more for his own protection than anything else — he threw himself on our mercy when we came across him, and was practically begging to be taken in. The prison cells beneath the palace seemed unnecessary, so we've put him on house arrest after a sort in one of the guest quarters. Shall I have him sent in?"
    
    Ryn sighs. "If you don't mind."
    
    Daliza salutes sharply and turns on her heel, gesturing to one of the amazons by the door. The two disappear from the throne room, and Elthara coughs sharply.
    
    "[etheryn.crowned
        |Your Majesty
        |Regent
    ], please keep in mind that despite whatever sentimentality you may have for the man, he is — "
    
    "We'll see, Elthara."
rows.translation:
当你走进瑞恩的王座厅时，首先映入眼帘的是 [party.has etheryn
        |法警达丽莎面带严肃的表情，大步地向你们走来。[etheryn.crowned
            |陛下
            |摄政王夫人
        ]你终于来了，真是迟到了。我在这里等了几天，都在考虑是否应该直接回到南方，把一切都交给埃尔萨拉处理……但我相信，除了我自己，没有人能够把我的报告如实传达出去。”

瑞恩瞥了你一眼。 [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |为了让人放心
            |奇怪的是……
        ]然后他快速地向执事点了点头。“怎么了，执事？”

“她的手下在往返于冬城之间的森林小路上发现了某个人 [etheryn.crowned
            |陛下
            |摄政王
        ]虽然你当时不在这里，”埃尔萨拉从她惯常坐在王座旁边的位置说道，“但 [pc.name]关于这件事，我和执达员进行了一些讨论。虽然我们在一些细节上存在分歧，但最终还是达成了一致意见：这些特殊情况确实需要你亲自来做出判断。

叹了口气，瑞恩拖着脚步走向她的王座，重重地坐了下去，摆出了一个北境精灵所能做出的最不“女王”样的姿势。考虑到埃尔萨拉那种居高临下、言外之意甚多的说话方式，你也确实不能责怪她。[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |很抱歉让你们俩等我这么久。达丽莎、埃尔萨拉，谢谢你们一直等待，让我有时间来做出决定，无论这个决定最终是什么。我并不是想长时间离开冬城，也不想忽视自己作为摄政王的职责，但是——
            |埃尔萨拉，你不必用那种语气和我说话；我非常清楚，在我不在的时候，你管理这些事务肯定很困难，也有一些决定只有我才能做出。话虽如此，但我还是希望你能和我一起 [pc.name] 这本身就已经是一种教育了。谢谢你们俩，让这件事有足够的时间让我回来做出决定……无论最终会是什么决定。
        ]把那些东西都从你体内赶出去，这样你就不会在中年时患上‘冒险精神过剩症’，就像你的一些祖先那样。”达丽莎说道。“好吧， [etheryn.crowned
            |陛下
            |摄政王夫人
        ] — 我会把犯人带进来。
        |雷恩、执事达丽莎和埃尔萨拉都聚集在王座周围，正在热烈地讨论着什么。观众席里也传来了一阵嘈杂的声音，不出所料，雷恩是第一个从激烈的讨论中抬起头，注意到你的存在的人。[pc.name]! [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |谢天谢地，你终于来了。执事达丽莎把一个人带了过来——也就是逮捕了他——从早上开始，她和埃尔萨拉就一直在争论该如何处理这个人。
            |真是让人眼前一亮啊——今天早上，执达员达丽莎把一个人带了进来，也就是逮捕了他，从那以后她和埃尔萨拉就一直在争论该如何处置这个人。我一直都在试图调解他们之间的矛盾，但这也只能算是我所能做的了。说实话，艾丽莎从来都没有详细地向我解释过我们的刑法规定，所以现在我只能听他们不停地争论来争论去。
        ]你的目光在瑞恩、达丽莎和艾尔塔拉之间游移，自从你进入这个会议室以来，这两位女性终于停止了争吵，转而看向了你。嗯，如果事情总是这样发展的话，她们为什么不暂时停下来，让你从头开始讲述呢？

达丽莎第一个采取了行动，她快步走上前，简短地向你点了点头。“啊，先生[pc.mf
            |领主
            |女士
        ]在往返于冬城的过程中，我的一些手下偶然遇到了某个人 [etheryn.crowned
            |女王陛下
            |摄政王夫人
        ] 他对这个人怀有某种感情。考虑到他的状况，我们立即逮捕了他——当然是为了他的安全着想——然后将他带到了宫殿。
    ]
    
    一个囚犯，啊。他有没有惹过什么麻烦？

“完全没有。事实上，把他关起来更多是为了保护他——当我们遇到他的时候，他完全是主动求我们收留他的，简直是在恳求我们把他带走。 宫殿下面的那些牢房似乎并没有必要，所以我们就把他关在其中一个客房里进行软禁了。需要让人把他带进来吗？

瑞恩叹了口气：“如果你不介意的话……”

达丽莎迅速行礼，然后转身示意门口的那名亚马逊女战士带人进来。 两人从王座厅中消失后，埃尔萨拉突然剧烈地咳嗽起来。[etheryn.crowned
        |陛下
        |摄政王
    ]请记住，无论你对这个人怀有怎样的感情，他终究是——“

“我们拭目以待吧，埃尔萨拉。

rows.original: At length, Daliza returns with a boreal elf man, watched over by the amazon guardswoman. He's tall and broad-shouldered as is expected of the menfolks of his people, his skin a pale blue and scratched up in several places; if the bailiff's people encountered him out in the woods, it certainly looks like he's had a rough time of it. The leathers he's wearing might have once been fine and practical, but they bear several rips and tears; similarly, while he might have once been clean-shaven, it doesn't look like he's had the opportunity to put the razor to his dirty-blond stubble any time recently. Still, for all his unkempt nature, the man doesn't seem too worse for the wear for having lived out in the woods for a while now; he certainly hasn't gone hungry, if nothing else. The shackles about his wrists are little more than a formality, and given how his head's bowed and shoulders are slumped there's certainly an air of resignation about him. If Daliza arrested this man, he's certainly making no move to change his situation. "On your knees before the [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the Lady Regent ]," the bailiff snaps, pushing him down to the cold floor of the audience chamber. "May I present for your judgement Elyon Eliamsson, Master of the Hounds and Hawks. Or former Master? He certainly hasn't been around to perform his duties for a while." The elven man looks about with wide but weary eyes, his gaze finally alighting on Ryn atop her throne. "Ah. I didn't quite want to believe it myself, but it doesn't look like Daliza was lying, after all. The younger princess has indeed deposed her sister." You look over at Ryn — she's trying to not let her feelings show in an appropriately queenly fashion, but you've known her long and well enough to tell her that she's struggling with something. It's then that Harrick, who's been perched quietly atop the back of Ryn's throne, flutters over to the man. For a second, you wonder if the bird is going to try and claw his eyes out, but Harrick instead lands atop Elyon's head and does a little shuffling about-turn. "I see you still haven't managed to breed that behavior out of that line, prin — I mean, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Lady Regent ]," Elyon replies. "The palace is rather more empty than when I last left it." "When did you last leave it?" Ryn inquires. "Shortly after you left. Your sister... your sister told me to be useful for once in my whole life and drag you back by any means necessary. I was not to return until that task was accomplished. As it stands, you've done that on your own, and once again my services were no longer needed." Ryn sighs and slumps in her throne. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I-I know you, Huntsmaster. If you w-were intent on tracking me down, you'd have accomplished as much |I know you, Huntsmaster. If you were intent on tracking me down, you'd have had me in front of Alissa before the day was out ]." "I cannot say that my heart was wholly in the matter, no; it was the least I could do to make up for all the other orders of hers I obeyed against my better judgement. But on the other hand, I cannot bring myself to disobey a var Ridell." "Fine." [etheryn.lowConfidence |Squaring her shoulders and making a partially successful effort to pull herself together, Ryn shoots Daliza the best queenly glare she can muster, which bounces off the steely woman's exterior harmlessly. "Bailiff, just what c-charges are this man u-under, for him to have been arrested?" |Squaring her shoulders and pulling herself together, Ryn glares daggers at Daliza. It's a good attempt, but the steely woman's armored exterior deflects it without a hitch. "Bailiff, just what has this man been charged with for you to have arrested him?" ] "Laws? He has not broken any. But the man has been tainted by the demonic corruption which your sister helped spread within the palace, and he was a potential danger to you, [etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ]. Begging your pardon, but it's one of my jobs to keep the peace of your realm, and anything happening to you would damn well be a breach of said peace." At that, Ryn confers briefly with Elthara, then goes back to eyeing Daliza. "He looks perfectly normal to me, bailiff." Daliza tsks. "His eyes, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], look at his eyes. That, and..." Eylon makes no move to resist the bailiff as she pulls off his ragged leather gloves. Where nails should be sprout sharp, hooked claws the color of obsidian, and now that Daliza's pointed it out... yes, his eyes are golden and slitted, much like Kasyrra's. For the first time, the elven man speaks with anything but a mumble, raising his gaze to address Ryn. "I do not deny it. The change came upon me when I was in the woods ostensibly hunting you, uh — [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]. After hearing from Daliza about what happened to the former queen as well as Captain Jael'yn amongst others, the last piece fell into place. I was sent away too late to avoid the taint that was spreading through the palace." Ryn leans forward and tents her fingers. "Unlike Jael'yn, you still seem to have your senses, Huntsmaster." Daliza coughs. "Begging your pardon, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], but there's no way to tell if this is some kind of ruse. And that is why I've arrested him — for your own safety. You can't be too sure." "Well then, I want him unshackled. Get those things off his wrists." "With all due respect, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], I don't believe that's a good idea." "Bailiff, remember your place and where you are. You make too many presumptions, even if [ryn.lowConfidence |the Crown is grateful for your mindful service," Elthara snaps. Daliza shoots Elthara a dirty look — the bailiff's got little doubt as to who's pulling the throne's strings here. |I'm thankful for your mindful service," Ryn says, frowning. Daliza stiffens herself and salutes. "Treat him like you've just treated me and I'll have no problems, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]. You've understood my point quite well." ] "It's all right," Elyon mumbles. "I deserve as much for what I've done." Elthara clears her throat amidst all this, the calm in a brewing storm. "What is to be done, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]? Your judgement, please." Ryn doesn't answer immediately, instead tenting her fingers and contriving to appear pensive. At last, she shakes her head and gestures at Elyon. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"If you've b-broken no laws of the boer'alvar, Huntsmaster, then I can't rightly judge you guilty of anything. Welcome back, Elyon Eliamsson. Given how long I was gone, you must m-miss the palace as much as I d-did." "I can't rightly say I did when your sister was on the throne." "Well then, things have c-changed, and they're going to continue changing; with us short on hands here in the palace, a-anyone with any capability from my father's days is welcome. E-elthara, I want both him and his old quarters by the mews cleaned up, and for the man to be fed a proper meal. After that, we can discuss what kind of role he's to play in my administration going forward." |"If you've broken no laws of the boer'alvar, Huntsmaster, then I can't rightly judge you guilty of anything. Welcome back, Elyon Eliamsson. Given how long I was gone, you must miss the palace." "I can't rightly say I did when your sister was on the throne." "Well then, things have changed, and they're going to continue changing; with us short on hands here in the palace, anyone with any capability from my father's days is welcome. Elthara, I want both him and his old quarters by the mews cleaned up, and for the man to be fed a proper meal. After that, we can discuss what kind of role he's to play in my administration going forward." ] Elthara bows. "As you wish, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Lady Regent ]. Come along then, both of you." Daliza doesn't look happy about any of this, but grits her teeth and manhandles Elyon to his feet, perhaps with a little more force than what's strictly necessary. Elthara takes the lead with Daliza bringing up the rear, their charge sandwiched between the two of them. When the two of you are finally alone, Ryn settles back in her throne, Harrick flapping over and perching on her arm; she fusses and coos over the bird for several moments, then sighs and turns to you. "[pc.name]. What do you think?" [pc.isDK |Frankly? She's too soft-hearted. A man who would disobey her sister, even passively like Elyon did, would disobey her too. She needs to keep that in mind. Ryn shakes her head. "[pc.name]..." What? There's nothing inaccurate about what you said — once you've established a traitor for what he is, it's only a matter of what the price is. If she does insist on being magnanimous and giving the huntsmaster a chance, then she needs to watch her back and keep him away from any critical role in her rule. "So, treat him like Alissa did. No, I don't think I'll be doing that." You shrug. She asked for your opinion, and you gave an honest reply which you think will benefit her position going forward. What more does she want? It's not like you asked for her to execute him or anything. |You have your doubts about her taking in yet another corrupted individual. Yes, Elthara is her right-hand woman at this point, but this Elyon looks to be more tainted than the high priestess — he's already started changing physically. Yes, you spared Jael'yn, but the collar and cockring are insurance against bad behavior, and the person who used — important word there, used — to be the guard captain has been removed from the palace. "You're... you're not wrong, I must admit. That being said, [pc.name], he looked like he was himself all the time during the audience. Jael'yn and Elthara weren't themselves when we first encountered them on their return — whatever he looks like on the outside, I believe Elyon's all there on the inside. If it's just his body, I'm sure we can fix him with alchemy or something. If it's his head, though... well, I don't believe it is." You understand; were you in Ryn's shoes, you'd feel the same way towards someone who showed you some small kindness in the past when few others would. That being said... you still want her to be careful. ] "All right. You've made your point. I just hope he settles in well, [party.has etheryn |given that we're going to be heading out again soon and I won't be around to ease him into his new role |given how there really isn't any actual need for a huntsmaster anymore. We've got to make him do something in line with his skills, but at the same time he'd know if I just had him do make-work ]." Well, what's left of the Winter City's guard still have a handful of wargs around. You understand such animals are pretty close to their handlers and might not take well to a third party, but as she said, Elyon needs something actually meaningful to do around the palace if she's going to be keeping him about. "I'll find something, [etheryn.lowConfidence |[pc.name]," Ryn replies with a sigh |don't you worry," Ryn replies with a shrug ][party.has etheryn | as she levers herself out of her throne. "Or more correctly, Elthara will. While we're going to be leaving soon, it was good that we came back just in time to deal with this |. "There have to be matters of state I can delegate him to; I'm sure Elthara will be glad for the help ]. Elyon was... is kind to me, or as much as anyone dared under Alissa's rule." You'll see about that...
rows.translation: 最终，达丽莎带着一位极北精灵男子回来了，这位男子一直由那位亚马逊女卫兵看守着。正如人们对他这个族群的男性所期望的那样，他身材高大，肩膀宽阔，皮肤呈淡蓝色，身上还有几处擦伤；如果执法人员的手部下在森林里遇到他，肯定会认为他刚刚经历了一段艰难的遭遇。 他现在穿的这些皮衣，或许曾经质量上乘、实用耐用，但现在已经有了好几处裂口和破损；同样，他也许曾经刮得干干净净，但最近显然没机会再修剪那些脏兮兮的金色胡茬了。 尽管这个男人看起来有些邋遢不修边幅，但在森林里生活了这么久之后，他似乎并没有受到太大的影响；至少他没有挨饿。他手部腕上的镣铐只不过是形式而已。而从他低垂的头和萎靡的肩膀来看，他显然已经接受了这种处境。 如果达丽莎逮捕了这个男人，他肯定不会采取任何行动来改变自己的处境。 “跪下来吧 [etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王夫人 ]砰！”法警厉声说道，将那人推倒在观众席冰冷的地板上。“现在，让我向各位介绍这位有待你们裁决的人——埃利昂·埃利亚姆森，猎犬与猎鹰队的队长。或者应该说，前队长？因为他已经有一段时间没有履行自己的职责了。那个精灵男子用那双充满疲惫却仍环顾四周的眼睛，最终将目光落在了坐在王座上的瑞恩身上。“啊……我本来也不太愿意相信，但看来达丽莎并没有撒谎。 这位年轻的公主确实废黜了她的姐姐。” 你看向瑞恩——她正在努力以一位女王应有的姿态来掩饰自己的情绪，但你太了解她了，因此能看出她正在为某件事而苦恼。 就在这时，那只一直静静地栖息在瑞恩王座背后的哈里克飞到了那个男人的身上。有那么一瞬间，你会怀疑这只鸟会不会试图挖出他的眼睛，但哈里克却选择了落在伊利恩的头上，然后轻轻摇晃着身体转了个方向。 我看你还是没能让那一代人改掉那种行为习惯，亲……我是说 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王夫人 ]埃利恩回答道，‘这座宫殿现在比我上次离开时更加空荡荡了。’” “你上次是什么时候离开的？”瑞恩问道。 “就在你离开后不久。你的姐姐……她让我这辈子总该有一次发挥作用，不惜一切代价把你带回来。直到完成这个任务之前，我都不准回来。而现在，你已经自己把事情解决了，我的帮助也就不再被需要了。” 瑞恩叹了口气，瘫坐在王座上。[etheryn.lowConfidence |我……我知道你，狩猎大师。如果你真的打算找到我，现在早就成功了。 |我认识你，狩猎大师。如果你真的决心要找到我，的话，今天天还没黑之前，你早就已经把我抓到阿丽莎面前了。 ]我必须承认，我并不是真心愿意做这件事的；不过，这也是我能够做的最起码的事情，用来弥补那些我违背自己的判断、遵从她的其他命令的事情吧。但另一方面，我实在无法违抗一位瓦·里德尔的要求。” “好吧。 rows.raw: " At length, Daliza returns with a boreal elf man, watched over by the amazon guardswoman. He's tall and broad-shouldered as is expected of the menfolks of his people, his skin a pale blue and scratched up in several places; if the bailiff's people encountered him out in the woods, it certainly looks like he's had a rough time of it. The leathers he's wearing might have once been fine and practical, but they bear several rips and tears; similarly, while he might have once been clean-shaven, it doesn't look like he's had the opportunity to put the razor to his dirty-blond stubble any time recently. Still, for all his unkempt nature, the man doesn't seem too worse for the wear for having lived out in the woods for a while now; he certainly hasn't gone hungry, if nothing else. The shackles about his wrists are little more than a formality, and given how his head's bowed and shoulders are slumped there's certainly an air of resignation about him. If Daliza arrested this man, he's certainly making no move to change his situation. "On your knees before the [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the Lady Regent ]," the bailiff snaps, pushing him down to the cold floor of the audience chamber. "May I present for your judgement Elyon Eliamsson, Master of the Hounds and Hawks. Or former Master? He certainly hasn't been around to perform his duties for a while." The elven man looks about with wide but weary eyes, his gaze finally alighting on Ryn atop her throne. "Ah. I didn't quite want to believe it myself, but it doesn't look like Daliza was lying, after all. The younger princess has indeed deposed her sister." You look over at Ryn — she's trying to not let her feelings show in an appropriately queenly fashion, but you've known her long and well enough to tell her that she's struggling with something. It's then that Harrick, who's been perched quietly atop the back of Ryn's throne, flutters over to the man. For a second, you wonder if the bird is going to try and claw his eyes out, but Harrick instead lands atop Elyon's head and does a little shuffling about-turn. "I see you still haven't managed to breed that behavior out of that line, prin — I mean, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Lady Regent ]," Elyon replies. "The palace is rather more empty than when I last left it." "When did you last leave it?" Ryn inquires. "Shortly after you left. Your sister... your sister told me to be useful for once in my whole life and drag you back by any means necessary. I was not to return until that task was accomplished. As it stands, you've done that on your own, and once again my services were no longer needed." Ryn sighs and slumps in her throne. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I-I know you, Huntsmaster. If you w-were intent on tracking me down, you'd have accomplished as much |I know you, Huntsmaster. If you were intent on tracking me down, you'd have had me in front of Alissa before the day was out ]." "I cannot say that my heart was wholly in the matter, no; it was the least I could do to make up for all the other orders of hers I obeyed against my better judgement. But on the other hand, I cannot bring myself to disobey a var Ridell." "Fine." [etheryn.lowConfidence |Squaring her shoulders and making a partially successful effort to pull herself together, Ryn shoots Daliza the best queenly glare she can muster, which bounces off the steely woman's exterior harmlessly. "Bailiff, just what c-charges are this man u-under, for him to have been arrested?" |Squaring her shoulders and pulling herself together, Ryn glares daggers at Daliza. It's a good attempt, but the steely woman's armored exterior deflects it without a hitch. "Bailiff, just what has this man been charged with for you to have arrested him?" ] "Laws? He has not broken any. But the man has been tainted by the demonic corruption which your sister helped spread within the palace, and he was a potential danger to you, [etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ]. Begging your pardon, but it's one of my jobs to keep the peace of your realm, and anything happening to you would damn well be a breach of said peace." At that, Ryn confers briefly with Elthara, then goes back to eyeing Daliza. "He looks perfectly normal to me, bailiff." Daliza tsks. "His eyes, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], look at his eyes. That, and..." Eylon makes no move to resist the bailiff as she pulls off his ragged leather gloves. Where nails should be sprout sharp, hooked claws the color of obsidian, and now that Daliza's pointed it out... yes, his eyes are golden and slitted, much like Kasyrra's. For the first time, the elven man speaks with anything but a mumble, raising his gaze to address Ryn. "I do not deny it. The change came upon me when I was in the woods ostensibly hunting you, uh — [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]. After hearing from Daliza about what happened to the former queen as well as Captain Jael'yn amongst others, the last piece fell into place. I was sent away too late to avoid the taint that was spreading through the palace." Ryn leans forward and tents her fingers. "Unlike Jael'yn, you still seem to have your senses, Huntsmaster." Daliza coughs. "Begging your pardon, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], but there's no way to tell if this is some kind of ruse. And that is why I've arrested him — for your own safety. You can't be too sure." "Well then, I want him unshackled. Get those things off his wrists." "With all due respect, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ], I don't believe that's a good idea." "Bailiff, remember your place and where you are. You make too many presumptions, even if [ryn.lowConfidence |the Crown is grateful for your mindful service," Elthara snaps. Daliza shoots Elthara a dirty look — the bailiff's got little doubt as to who's pulling the throne's strings here. |I'm thankful for your mindful service," Ryn says, frowning. Daliza stiffens herself and salutes. "Treat him like you've just treated me and I'll have no problems, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]. You've understood my point quite well." ] "It's all right," Elyon mumbles. "I deserve as much for what I've done." Elthara clears her throat amidst all this, the calm in a brewing storm. "What is to be done, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Regent ]? Your judgement, please." Ryn doesn't answer immediately, instead tenting her fingers and contriving to appear pensive. At last, she shakes her head and gestures at Elyon. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"If you've b-broken no laws of the boer'alvar, Huntsmaster, then I can't rightly judge you guilty of anything. Welcome back, Elyon Eliamsson. Given how long I was gone, you must m-miss the palace as much as I d-did." "I can't rightly say I did when your sister was on the throne." "Well then, things have c-changed, and they're going to continue changing; with us short on hands here in the palace, a-anyone with any capability from my father's days is welcome. E-elthara, I want both him and his old quarters by the mews cleaned up, and for the man to be fed a proper meal. After that, we can discuss what kind of role he's to play in my administration going forward." |"If you've broken no laws of the boer'alvar, Huntsmaster, then I can't rightly judge you guilty of anything. Welcome back, Elyon Eliamsson. Given how long I was gone, you must miss the palace." "I can't rightly say I did when your sister was on the throne." "Well then, things have changed, and they're going to continue changing; with us short on hands here in the palace, anyone with any capability from my father's days is welcome. Elthara, I want both him and his old quarters by the mews cleaned up, and for the man to be fed a proper meal. After that, we can discuss what kind of role he's to play in my administration going forward." ] Elthara bows. "As you wish, [etheryn.crowned |your Highness |Lady Regent ]. Come along then, both of you." Daliza doesn't look happy about any of this, but grits her teeth and manhandles Elyon to his feet, perhaps with a little more force than what's strictly necessary. Elthara takes the lead with Daliza bringing up the rear, their charge sandwiched between the two of them. When the two of you are finally alone, Ryn settles back in her throne, Harrick flapping over and perching on her arm; she fusses and coos over the bird for several moments, then sighs and turns to you. "[pc.name]. What do you think?" [pc.isDK |Frankly? She's too soft-hearted. A man who would disobey her sister, even passively like Elyon did, would disobey her too. She needs to keep that in mind. Ryn shakes her head. "[pc.name]..." What? There's nothing inaccurate about what you said — once you've established a traitor for what he is, it's only a matter of what the price is. If she does insist on being magnanimous and giving the huntsmaster a chance, then she needs to watch her back and keep him away from any critical role in her rule. "So, treat him like Alissa did. No, I don't think I'll be doing that." You shrug. She asked for your opinion, and you gave an honest reply which you think will benefit her position going forward. What more does she want? It's not like you asked for her to execute him or anything. |You have your doubts about her taking in yet another corrupted individual. Yes, Elthara is her right-hand woman at this point, but this Elyon looks to be more tainted than the high priestess — he's already started changing physically. Yes, you spared Jael'yn, but the collar and cockring are insurance against bad behavior, and the person who used — important word there, used — to be the guard captain has been removed from the palace. "You're... you're not wrong, I must admit. That being said, [pc.name], he looked like he was himself all the time during the audience. Jael'yn and Elthara weren't themselves when we first encountered them on their return — whatever he looks like on the outside, I believe Elyon's all there on the inside. If it's just his body, I'm sure we can fix him with alchemy or something. If it's his head, though... well, I don't believe it is." You understand; were you in Ryn's shoes, you'd feel the same way towards someone who showed you some small kindness in the past when few others would. That being said... you still want her to be careful. ] "All right. You've made your point. I just hope he settles in well, [party.has etheryn |given that we're going to be heading out again soon and I won't be around to ease him into his new role |given how there really isn't any actual need for a huntsmaster anymore. We've got to make him do something in line with his skills, but at the same time he'd know if I just had him do make-work ]." Well, what's left of the Winter City's guard still have a handful of wargs around. You understand such animals are pretty close to their handlers and might not take well to a third party, but as she said, Elyon needs something actually meaningful to do around the palace if she's going to be keeping him about. "I'll find something, [etheryn.lowConfidence |[pc.name]," Ryn replies with a sigh |don't you worry," Ryn replies with a shrug ][party.has etheryn | as she levers herself out of her throne. "Or more correctly, Elthara will. While we're going to be leaving soon, it was good that we came back just in time to deal with this |. "There have to be matters of state I can delegate him to; I'm sure Elthara will be glad for the help ]. Elyon was... is kind to me, or as much as anyone dared under Alissa's rule." You'll see about that... "

Seeing this, Ryn squeals and runs up in delight, squatting down by the warg and petting its head and back as if it were a big puppy, undoing all of Elyon's careful grooming. You'd imagine a beast all fangs and claws would protest, but like the brush, it's content to lie there and be pampered. Why, isn't it a good [dayNight |day. He looks like he's enjoying himself. |evening. He's up so late caring for the animals at this hour? ] "Time was that I wouldn't have to groom the wargs' fur myself, but we're short on hands," Elyon grumbles. "No apprentices to do the job as they should, and their riders are too high and mighty to care for their steeds themselves. For us, it's back to basics. Takes me back decades." "I used to help the huntsmaster brush the wargs when I was feeling upset," Ryn explains, not stopping in the slightest. "It's very calming. Especially after Father — uh, it's very calming." "It is." The shift in tone from both Ryn and Elyon is palpable, though, prompting the warg to perk its ears up and look around. He hurries to calm the animal, giving it a few strokes with the stiff-bristled brush, then sighs and pats it on the back. "Well, so much for that. Now neither I nor my poor friend here is in the mood for brushing, so I might as well talk to you while [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ] plays with the animals. Birds... "[etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ]. Champion." Elyon's gaze doesn't leave his hawk, but he gives the both of you a tilt of his head. "How may I help you today?" "[pc.Name] has some business with you, I think. Then again, seeing you at it like old times, Huntsmaster..." Ryn looks thoughtful, then smiles. "I've always found it funny how you can train a bird to give up its kill through bribery. It's like convincing a tame pig to not eat the truffle it's found." Elyon coughs. "Business with me?" Indeed. It's him you want to see. Ryn giggles at that, then gives Elyon a wink. "Well, color me surprised, I'm not the most important person in the room for once. Don't mind me, I'll just take the birds back to the mews, then." The huntsmaster opens his mouth as if to protest, then gives up as Ryn turns her back on him and leaves with both animals in tow. Stripping off his falconry glove and hanging it up, Elyon folds his arms and fixes his glare on you. "All right, you wanted to see me, and now you've got my undivided attention. State your business." |As it turns out, you find Elyon in one corner of the rose gardens under a gazebo, supervising Ryn as she works on several papers from a thick stack in the [dayNight |calm |evening ] breeze that rustles through the rosebushes. He looks up as you approach, lips set into a thin straight line, then sets down his quill and forces a smile. "Good [dayNight |day, champion." It's then that Ryn, too, looks up from the work and pushes away her pen and inkwell. "Why, [pc.name] — a-a surprise to see you here! Well, it shouldn't be a surprise, but still!" And good day to the both of them. Hopefully you're not interrupting them in the middle of something? "Elthara would like [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s help in managing what's left of the treasury, so here I am. When the king dowager was alive, I used to run the logistics for the kennels and mews, so I know something about how to cook a book." |evening, champion." It's then that Ryn, too, looks up from the work and pushes away her pen and inkwell. "Why, [pc.name] — a-a surprise to see you at this hour! Well, it shouldn't be a surprise, but still!" And a good evening to the both of them. They're out working this late? "Elthara would like [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s help in managing what's left of the treasury, so here I am. I can't say I'm an accountant by trade, even if the logistics of the palace kennels and mews were under my purview. It's slow going teaching her the details while trying to get that selfsame work done... which is why we've been at this for a while now. Still, I wouldn't do it any other way — learning with a practical example is quite fine." ] Ah. You take it that you shouldn't be bothering them, then. Ryn sighs. "Actually, no. I'm getting rather frustrated with looking over rows upon rows of double-entry accounting for hours on end, and I need to stop soon or I'll lose my mind. You look like you've business with the huntsmaster, so I'll call it here for today." Well, she doesn't have to put it in such a cold manner. But yes, you have business with him. "Well then, I'll just make myself scarce and take these back to Elthara." Scooping up the papers in her arms, Ryn gives the both of you a nod and cheery wave, and the two of you watch her go together. At last, Elyon turns to you and folds his arms. "So much for that. Now, is there something you wanted of me, champion?" |As it turns out, you find Elyon sitting about in one of the rose garden's gazebos, catching a small break [dayNight |from the rigors of the day ]as he stares straight ahead into the [dayNight |distance |clear night sky ]. Or maybe he did, and just was pretending to not notice... "Champion. You certainly show up here a lot." rows.translation: [party.has etheryn |[rand |当你走进舞厅旁边的花园，找到那位负责狩猎活动的主管时，他会坐在一张凳子上，手中拿着一支刷子，仔细地梳理着一头野兽粗糙的毛皮。那只野兽则趴在地上，开心地接受着他的抚摸，任由他轻轻梳理那些缠结在毛皮中的毛发。 看到这一幕，瑞恩高兴地尖叫着跑过来，蹲在那只魔兽旁边，像抚摸一只大小狗一样轻轻抚摸它的头和背部，把伊利恩之前精心打理的毛发都弄乱了。你可能会觉得这样一只满身尖牙利爪的野兽应该会反抗，但它却像对待那只毛刷一样，乐意接受这种宠爱。 为什么，这不是个很好的选择吗？ [dayNight |那天，他看起来玩得很开心。 |晚上这么晚了，他还在照顾动物？ ] 以前我根本不需要亲自为那些狼人梳理毛发，但现在人手部实在太不够了，”伊莱恩抱怨道，“没有学徒来承担这份本该他们做的活计，而那些骑狼人的贵族们也太高高在上，根本不愿意自己照顾他们的坐骑。 对我们来说，这就像是回归本源。让我回想起了几十年前的事情。” “每当我感到不安的时候，我就会去帮助猎场主管刷那些狼人，”莱恩边说边继续着手部手部中的工作，丝毫没有停下来的意思，“这种事情真的能让人平静下来。尤其是在父亲……呃，那种事情发生之后，这种活动更是能带来极大的慰藉。确实如此。”瑞恩和伊利恩的肌肉度变化十分明显，这一变化让那只战兽立刻竖起了耳朵，四处张望起来。他急忙安抚这只动物，用那把硬毛刷轻轻抚摸它几下，然后叹了口气，拍了拍它的背。 好吧，这件事就说到这里吧。现在我和我这位可怜的朋友都没有心情刷牙，所以不妨趁这个机会和你聊聊。 [etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ] 和动物们一起玩耍。你到底想要什么，冠军？ |走进花园，你会看到伊利恩和他的鸟正在追逐一只被放出来活动的雪鞋兔——你注意到，哈里克看到另一只鸟时，立刻挺起胸膛，在瑞恩的肩膀上炫耀着自己的英姿。鸟儿们[etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]冠军。”伊利恩的目光始终没有离开他的鹰，但他还是向你们两人点了点头。“今天有什么可以帮到你们的吗？[pc.Name] 我想，这件事和你有些关系吧。不过，看到你像过去一样认真地做这件事，狩猎大师……”瑞恩若有所思地笑了笑，然后说道：“我一直觉得挺有意思的——你居然能用贿赂的手部段让一只鸟放弃它抓到的猎物。 这就好比试图让一头被驯服的猪不要吃它找到的松露。” 埃利恩轻咳了一声：“有事情要找我谈吗？” “没错，你正是想见的人。” 瑞恩听到这话后咯咯笑了起来，然后朝埃利恩眨了眨眼。 哎呀，真让我吃惊，这一次我居然不是房间里最重要的人了。没关系，我先把这些鸟带回鸡舍吧。” 猎场主管刚张开嘴似乎想抗议，但看到瑞恩转身带着两只动物离开了，也就只好作罢。 埃利恩脱下他的猎鹰手部套，将其挂好，然后双臂交叉，目光紧紧地盯着你。 “好吧，你本来就想见我，现在我已经全神贯注地听你说了。有什麽事就快说吧。" |原来，你在玫瑰园的一个角落里，在一个凉亭下找到了伊利恩。她正在监督瑞恩，看着瑞恩从那一叠厚厚的文件中挑选出几份来着手部处理。 [dayNight |冷静 |晚上 ] 微风轻拂着玫瑰丛，发出沙沙的声响。当你靠近时，他抬起头，嘴唇紧抿成一条细细的直线，然后放下羽毛笔，强挤出一丝微笑。 “你好。 [dayNight |天啊，冠军。” 就在这时，瑞恩也停止了手中的工作，把笔和墨水瓶推到了一边。“为什么 [pc.name] 在这里见到你真是太意外了！不过，其实也不应该感到意外吧……” 祝他们俩一天愉快。希望我没有打扰到他们正在做的事情吧？ “埃尔萨拉应该会希望 [etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]在管理王室剩余的财库方面，我得到了她的帮助，因此我现在才在这里。在王太后在世的时候，我负责管理那些养狗场和马厩的后勤工作，所以我对此很熟悉。 某个东西 关于如何“把一本书煮熟”…… |晚上好，冠军。” 就在这时，瑞恩也从工作中抬起头，把笔和墨水瓶推到了一边。“为什么 [pc.name] 在这个时间见到你，真是太意外了！不过，其实也不应该感到意外吧……” 祝他们俩晚安。他们工作到这么晚吗？ “埃尔萨拉应该会 [etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]在管理剩余的财政事务方面，她给予了很大的帮助，因此我才会在这里。虽然宫廷犬舍和马厩的相关事务确实由我负责，但我并不能说自己是一名专业的会计。在教导她这些细节的同时，我还得继续完成自己的工作……正因如此，我们才一直忙到现在。不过，我并不认为还有其他更好的方式——通过实际操作来学习，确实是一种很有效的方法。 ] 啊，那你就认为不应该去打扰他们吧。” 瑞恩叹了口气：“其实并不是这样。连续几个小时盯着那一大堆复式记账凭证看，我真的感到很烦躁，必须尽快停止这样做，否则我会疯掉的。 看样子你有什么事要跟猎场主管谈，那我就先不打扰你们了。” “嗯，她没必要说得这么冷淡。不过，确实你有事要跟他谈。” He's up so late caring for the animals at this hour? ] "Time was that I wouldn't have to groom the wargs' fur myself, but we're short on hands," Elyon grumbles. "No apprentices to do the job as they should, and their riders are too high and mighty to care for their steeds themselves. For us, it's back to basics. Takes me back decades." "I used to help the huntsmaster brush the wargs when I was feeling upset," Ryn explains, not stopping in the slightest. "It's very calming. Especially after Father — uh, it's very calming." "It is." The shift in tone from both Ryn and Elyon is palpable, though, prompting the warg to perk its ears up and look around. He hurries to calm the animal, giving it a few strokes with the stiff-bristled brush, then sighs and pats it on the back. "Well, so much for that. "[pc.Name] has some business with you, I think. Then again, seeing you at it like old times, Huntsmaster..." Ryn looks thoughtful, then smiles. "I've always found it funny how you can train a bird to give up its kill through bribery. It's like convincing a tame pig to not eat the truffle it's found." Elyon coughs. "Business with me?" Indeed. It's him you want to see. Ryn giggles at that, then gives Elyon a wink. "Well, color me surprised, I'm not the most important person in the room for once. Don't mind me, I'll just take the birds back to the mews, then." The huntsmaster opens his mouth as if to protest, then gives up as Ryn turns her back on him and leaves with both animals in tow. Stripping off his falconry glove and hanging it up, Elyon folds his arms and fixes his glare on you. "All right, you wanted to see me, and now you've got my undivided attention. State your business." |As it turns out, you find Elyon in one corner of the rose gardens under a gazebo, supervising Ryn as she works on several papers from a thick stack in the [dayNight |calm |evening ] breeze that rustles through the rosebushes. He looks up as you approach, lips set into a thin straight line, then sets down his quill and forces a smile. "Good [dayNight |day, champion." It's then that Ryn, too, looks up from the work and pushes away her pen and inkwell. "Why, [pc.name] — a-a surprise to see you here! Well, it shouldn't be a surprise, but still!" And good day to the both of them. Hopefully you're not interrupting them in the middle of something? "Elthara would like [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s help in managing what's left of the treasury, so here I am. I can't say I'm an accountant by trade, even if the logistics of the palace kennels and mews were under my purview. I'm getting rather frustrated with looking over rows upon rows of double-entry accounting for hours on end, and I need to stop soon or I'll lose my mind. You look like you've business with the huntsmaster, so I'll call it here for today." Well, she doesn't have to put it in such a cold manner. But yes, you have business with him. "Well then, I'll just make myself scarce and take these back to Elthara." rows.original: Crossing from the ballroom to the adjoining gardens, you hail the Huntsmaster — Elyon, wasn't that his name? — and clear your throat. He glances at you briefly, but his attention is drawn away from the hawk landing on his glove, which he rewards with a small strip of fresh meat before returning your greeting proper. [party.has etheryn |"Hmp. Hello, Etheryn. And you, hm, hm. I don't think we've actually been introduced yet." Ryn quickly clears her throat, her voice turning formal as she does her best to assert herself. "Elyon, this is [pc.name]. [pc.HeShe]'s been a vital part to finally doing away with my wicked sister and cleaning the palace of what's been going on within." Elyon looks you up and down, clearly assessing your strength; you're obliged to return the gesture, of course. He's cleaned up and shaved off the scraggly beard that you saw him with when Bailiff Daliza dragged him into Ryn's throne room, but the morose posture is ever the same; that's something no amount of washing up and decent clothing can ever hope to hide. "Ah. You're the new Champion of Winter everyone's been talking about. Everyone who's still left in the palace, at any rate." He looks between you and Ryn, bites back what might be a half-scowl, and forces himself to smile. "I've heard a lot about you in the short time since my return to the Winter City; it's edifying to finally be able to meet you in the flesh." And him? You know he's the Master of Hounds and Hawks, which is self-explanatory, but you'd like to get to know everyone close to Ryn better. "What business of it is — " Elyon begins, then catches himself, realizing Ryn's standing next to you. How quickly the man's expression turns from frustrated and annoyed to sheepish isn't lost on you. "Forgive me that outburst. I'm aware that I've gotten more... emotional since this corruption took hold on my body. It's one of the reasons why I didn't want to return to the Winter City at first." "Elthara's told me she's offered to send you to an alchemist to remedy those eyes and claws. You haven't done that." "No, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ]. Not until I've made up for all the mistakes I've made that've harmed the var Ridells." Ryn looks worried at that, but lets it drop. You may have to pick up on that later yourself. So then, he's some kind of huntsmaster? "That's... right. But there are few wargs left in the kennels, and the mews are all but empty. Elthara has me doing other tasks for the Crown, since the duties I assumed during the time of the old King Dowager can hardly keep me occupied these days. I must say that my experience with stewardship has greatly expanded very recently." "Like Jael'yn, Elyon was one of the few people who showed me some small kindness when doing so would certainly draw Alissa's wrath down upon them," Ryn pipes up. "He was the one who gave me the first Harrick, and trained me in falconry." The two of them do seem very close. "We... were. But about you, uh, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ] — you've saved the Winter City, helped Etheryn, and she's now thought to make you not just her champion, but a marcher [pc.mf |baron |baroness ] in the bargain. Like it or not, the city is abyss with talk about you. I take it I'll be seeing a lot more of you going forward?" You intend to be around the Winter City for some time to come, yes. "Well then, I suppose we'll have to get used to each other." He gives you a nod, a little more curt and stiff than strictly necessary. "Good day, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], champion." With that, Elyon turns back to his bird again, sending it out with a shake of his wrist. Ryn watches him for several seconds, then sighs as she falls in step behind you. "When did it all change? It happened so slowly that I never thought about it since Father died... then Alissa..." Come on, cheer up. Maybe it's by Lumia's grace that more and more of the people who were kind to Ryn when she was down managed to survive what happened in the palace... and those that didn't aren't here anymore. These are the people she can work with to reestablish some kind of sanity in her benighted city — imagine if she'd had to deal with Alissa's courtiers in trying to establish her rule. Ryn rubs her eyes. "You're right. I just... I just wonder how much of the man I once knew is left in there. Jael'yn... [pc.name], can I ask a favor of you?" What is it? "Please be kind to him, even if he doesn't return your gestures at first. You saw how he almost behaved — if not for me being around, I'm sure he'd have snapped at you. Elthara tells me he's struggling, not just with himself but to make sense of this new world. Can you do that for me, if not him?" [pc.isDK |You'll consider it. Ryn slumps her shoulders. "All right." |Of course. "Thank you." ] Above you, Elyon's hawk circles, and Harrick screams together with it. |"Hmp. I remember you; weren't you present when Daliza dragged me before the [etheryn.crowned |Queen |regent ]?" That's right. You're the champion of the Winter City. "Of course. Everyone in not just the palace, but in the city proper is abuzz with how you didn't just save the Winter City and overthrew the wicked queen Alissa, and the [etheryn.crowned |Queen |regent ]'s now thought to make you not just her champion, but a marcher [pc.mf |baron |baroness ] in the bargain. I take it I'll be seeing a lot more of you going forward?" You intend to be around the Winter City for some time to come, yes. "Well then, I suppose we'll have to get used to each other." He gives you a nod, a little more curt and stiff than strictly necessary. "It's edifying to finally be able to meet you in the flesh." And him? You know he's the Master of Hounds and Hawks, which is self-explanatory, but you'd like to get to know everyone close to Ryn better. "What business of it is yours?" Elyon snaps, his demeanor instantly shifting even as the hawk circling in the sky screams. "Do you expect me to spill out my life story to you at a moment's notice just because you're the queen's champion?" [pc.isDK |The fuck is he running his mouth on about? While you don't know what nerve you just hit in this corrupted man, you've damn well set it off straight. Excuse the fuck me, but you seem to remember that Bailiff Daliza was more than willing to clap him in chains and have him dealt with; it's only by the grace of Ryn that he's still standing here. Having a shitty attitude towards the [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]'s champion, who's just trying to make nice, is a surefire recipe for quickly exhausting that grace. |Whoa, what's gotten into him? You said absolutely nothing about wanting his life story — if you're both going to be on the same team in Ryn's service, then it makes perfect sense to at least get all the petty misunderstandings out of the way to begin with. Ryn was graceful enough to give him a second chance when Bailiff Daliza was more than willing to clap him in chains and have him dealt with; antagonizing people who're just trying to work with him isn't going to reflect well on her and her judgement. ] Elyon opens his mouth to fire back some angry retort, then catches himself at the mention of Ryn's name; how quickly the man's expression turns from frustrated and annoyed to sheepish isn't lost on you. "Forgive me that outburst. I'm aware that I've gotten more... emotional since this corruption took hold on my body. It's one of the reasons why I didn't want to return to the Winter City at first." He's gotten more emotional, he says. "People are right not to trust me — half the time, I don't know if I can even trust myself, not with me feeling like a stranger in my own mind and body. I know that I was calmer in the past, that I wasn't so easily provoked, but... having useful work to do keeps the mind off other matters." It's all right if he doesn't want to talk in detail about himself, but something basic to begin with would be nice. Well, if this is going to be about work, what did he do before all this went down? So then, he's some kind of huntsmaster? "That's... right. But there are few wargs left in the kennels, and the mews are all but empty. Elthara has me doing other tasks for the Crown, since the duties I assumed during the time of the old King Dowager can hardly keep me occupied these days. I must say that my experience with stewardship has greatly expanded very recently." The time of the old King Dowager, huh... "For example, I was asked to instruct the young Etheryn in the basics of falconry. It, alongside with boar hunting, was one of the King Dowager's favorite hobbies, and he wanted his daughters to share in his interests, especially since Alissa was fond of it." So then, Alissa also made use of his services as huntsmaster after she became queen? "No." That's surprising. "It's a long story." Elyon shakes his head. "Either way, that's as much as I want to tell you. Suffice to say that the previous queen all but relieved me of my more erstwhile duties and only took to the hunt with her closest friends." But — "All right, that's enough!" The angry scowl returns to the huntsmaster's expression, and he turns back to his bird again, the large hawk perching on his glove with an angry, sullen glare that mirrors its master's. Well, if he was the one to give Ryn Harrick senior and train her in the beast's handling, you can tell where the bird gets his foul temperament from. No, no, that's not right. Was he changed by his corruption, or did it merely bring out what was already there to begin with? You throw a glance at Elyon, but he's busy tending to his bird, offering it a strip of raw meat. The man doesn't even look at you as he gives you a dismissive little shrug, far more curt and stiff than strictly necessary. "Good day, champion." ]
rows.translation: 从舞厅穿过通往相邻花园的通道，你叫住了那位猎鹰训练师——他的名字应该是伊利恩吧？然后清了清嗓子。他匆匆瞥了你一眼，但他的注意力立刻被一只落在他手套上的猎鹰吸引住了。他给那只猎鹰喂了一小块新鲜肉，这才认真地回应了你的问候。 [party.has etheryn |哼，你好，伊瑟琳。还有你，嗯，嗯……我想我们还没有正式介绍过吧。” 瑞恩迅速清了清嗓子，语气变得正式起来，她尽力让自己显得更加自信：“埃利恩，这是 [pc.name]. [pc.HeShe]这确实是我最终除掉那个恶毒的妹妹、清理宫廷里那些乱七八糟的事情的关键。” 伊利恩上下打量着你，显然在评估你的实力；你当然也必须以同样的方式回应他。他现在已经洗漱干净，把当初 bailiff 达丽莎 把他拖进 Ryn 的王座室时他那蓬乱的胡子也剃掉了，但那忧郁的神情依然没有改变——显然，再怎么清洗身体、穿上体面的衣服，也无法掩盖这种情绪。 啊，原来你就是大家一直在谈论的那位新任冬季冠军啊。至少在宫里还留下来的人都是这么说的。”他目光在你和瑞恩之间来回扫视，强压下可能浮现的皱眉，努力挤出一丝笑容。“自从我回到冬城后，很多人都跟我提起过你；现在终于能亲眼见到你，真是令人欣慰。 那他呢？你知道，他是猎犬与猎鹰的统领，这一点不言而喻，但你应该更深入地了解与瑞恩关系密切的每一个人。 “这与我们有什么关系……”伊利恩刚开口，却突然意识到瑞恩就站在你身边，于是立刻住了口。 你肯定注意到了，那个人的表情是多么迅速地从沮丧、恼怒变成了羞愧。“请原谅我的那一番爆发。我知道，自从这种腐败势力侵入我的身体之后，我的情绪确实变得更加……容易失控了。这也是我最初不愿意回到冬城的原因之一。" 埃尔萨拉告诉我，她愿意帮你去找一位炼金术士，让你的眼睛和爪子恢复正常。你还没有去这么做啊。” “没有， [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]直到我弥补所有那些伤害了里德尔家族的错误，我才算真正做到了。” 听到这里，瑞恩显得很担忧，但也没有再继续追问。这件事可能以后还得由你自己去处理。那么，他算是某种猎场管理者吗？ 没错……但是狗舍里剩下的狼人已经不多了，那些小巷也几乎空无一人。自从老王太后在世时让我承担那些职责以来，埃尔萨拉又让我去做其他事情了，所以这些日子我的工作其实已经忙得不可开交了。 我必须承认，最近我在管理方面的经验得到了极大的丰富。” “就像贾埃尔琳一样，伊利恩也是为数不多的那些在我面临风险时会伸出援手的人之一——因为这样的行为肯定会招致艾莉莎的愤怒。”瑞恩插话道。 正是他给了我第一把哈里克武器，还教会了我如何驯养猎鹰。” 他们两个人的关系确实看起来非常亲密。 “我们……曾经是。不过关于你，呃[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] — 你拯救了冬城，帮助了艾瑟琳，而如今她认为，你不仅会成为她的守护者，更会成为她的得力助手。 [pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ] 总之，不管你愿不愿意，这座城市里到处都在谈论你。看来在未来的日子里，我还会经常见到你吧？” “是的，我打算在冬城待上一段时间。” “那么，我想我们还是得慢慢习惯彼此吧。”他点了点头，这个动作比必要的还要生硬、正式。“再见。 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]冠军。” 说完，伊利恩再次转向他的鸟，轻轻一抖手腕，就将鸟放了出去。莱恩注视着他好几秒钟，然后叹了口气，跟在了你的身后。 “这一切究竟是从什么时候开始改变的？ 这件事发生得如此缓慢，以至于自从父亲去世后，我就再也没想过这件事……直到艾丽莎的事情发生了…… 加油，振作起来。也许正是卢米娅的恩典，才让那些在瑞恩遭遇困境时曾经帮助过她的人，能够在宫殿里发生的那些事情中幸存下来。而那些没有配合的人，现在已经不在人世了。这些人正是她可以携手合作的对象，共同帮助她那陷入混乱的城市恢复秩序——试想，如果她当初在试图建立自己的统治时，还得应对阿丽莎那些宫廷贵族，那该有多艰难啊。 瑞恩揉了揉眼睛。“你说得对。我只是……我在想，我曾经认识的那个男人，现在还有多少留在他身上呢。杰尔琳…… [pc.name]能请你帮个忙吗？” “什么事？” “请对他好一点，即使他一开始没有回应你的善意。你也看到了他的表现——要不是我在场，他肯定会对你发火的。埃尔萨拉告诉我，他现在正在经历很大的困扰，不仅是在自我调整方面，也在努力理解这个全新的世界。就算不是为了他，也请为我这个忙吧？ [pc.isDK |你会考虑的。 莱恩耸了耸肩：“好吧。 |谢谢。 ] 在你的头顶上，伊利恩的鹰正在盘旋，而哈里克也跟着它一起发出尖叫。 |哼，我记得你；当时达丽莎把我拖到那里的时候，你不也在场吗？ [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]没错，你就是冬城的英雄。” “当然。不仅皇宫里，整个城市的人都在热议你如何拯救了冬城，又如何推翻了邪恶的艾莉莎女王 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]现在人们认为，这种方式不仅能让你成为她的捍卫者，还能让你成为一支勇往直前的队伍中的一员。 [pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ] 顺便说一下，我想以后我们会经常见到你们的吧？” “是的，我打算在冬城待上一段时间。” “那么，我想我们还是得慢慢适应彼此吧。他向你点了点头，这个动作显得有些生硬，甚至有些多余。能够终于亲眼见到你，真是令人欣慰。 那么他呢？你知道他是“猎犬与猎鹰之王”，这个头衔已经说明了一切，但你还是想更深入地了解与Ryn关系密切的每一个人。 这与你有什么关系？”伊莱恩厉声说道，他的态度瞬间发生了变化，与此同时，天空中盘旋的鹰也发出了尖锐的叫声。“就因为你是女王的捍卫者，你以为我就会立刻向你倾诉我的整个人生经历吗？" [pc.isDK |他到底在胡说些什么鬼话？虽然你不知道自己这次到底触到了这个堕落之人的哪根神经，但你自己确实把他惹毛了。恕我直言，你似乎忘了——Bailiff Daliza本来非常乐意把他关进监狱，让他受到应有的惩罚；只是因为Ryn的干预，他才还能站在这里。他对别人态度恶劣，还 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]那位只是想表现得友善的冠军，其实只会让这种优雅迅速消失殆尽。 |哇，他这是怎么了？你根本没说过想要了解他的生平经历啊——如果你们俩都要为瑞恩效力，那么首先消除这些不必要的误会才是明智之举。当执法官达丽莎简直想立刻把他关起来处理掉的时候，瑞恩还慷慨地给了他第二次机会。如果去招惹那些只是想与他合作的人，这对她自己的形象和判断力可没什么好处啊。 ] 伊利恩张开嘴，正要回嘴几句愤怒的话，但一听到瑞恩的名字，立刻住了口。你肯定也注意到了——那个人的表情瞬间从沮丧恼怒变成了尴尬。“请原谅我的失态。 我知道，自从这种腐败势力侵入我的身体之后，我变得更容易情绪化了。这也是我最初不愿意回到冬城的原因之一。 他说，自己确实变得更容易情绪化了。 人们不信任我，这是有道理的——有一半的时间，我甚至不确定自己是否能够信任自己，因为在我自己的头脑和身体里，我总觉得自己像个陌生人。 知道 我以前更加冷静，也不那么容易被激怒，但是……有有意义的工作去做，确实能让人的注意力从其他事情上转移开。” 如果他不愿意详细谈论自己的经历，那也没关系，但至少应该先讲一些基本的情况吧。那么，如果话题是要围绕工作来展开的话，那么在这一切发生之前，他是从事什么工作的呢？那么，他应该是某种猎场管理者之类的职业吧？ 没错……但是狗舍里剩下的狼人已经不多了，那些小巷也几乎空无一人。自从老王太后在位时我承担的那些职责以来，埃尔萨拉让我去做一些为王室服务的工作，所以这些日子我的时间几乎都被占用了。不得不说，最近我在管理事务方面的经验确实得到了很大的提升。 在老王太后的时代，嗯…… “比如说，我被要求教导年轻的伊瑟琳关于猎鹰训练的基础知识。这项活动，以及猎野猪，都是王太后最喜欢的爱好之一，她希望自己的女儿们也能分享她的这些兴趣爱好，尤其是艾莉莎对这方面很感兴趣。 那么，艾丽莎在成为女王之后，也利用他作为猎场主管的服务吗？ “没有。” 这真是令人惊讶。 “这是个漫长的故事。”伊利恩摇了摇头，“总之，这就是我想告诉你的全部内容了。可以这么说，前任女王几乎把我之前承担的所有职责都免除了，她只和最亲密的朋友们一起参加狩猎活动。 好了，够了！”猎场主脸上又浮现出愤怒的神情，他再次将注意力转向那只鸟——那只巨大的鹰正栖息在他的手套上，它那愤怒而阴沉的目光与主人一模一样。嗯，如果真的是他负责训练瑞恩·哈里克并教会她如何驾驭这种野兽，那么也就不难理解这只鸟为何会拥有如此暴躁的性格了。 不，不对，事情不是这样的。是腐败改变了他，还是仅仅让原本就存在于他内心的东西显现了出来呢？你瞥了眼埃利恩，但他正忙着喂他的鸟，给它喂着一条生肉。那个男人甚至都没有看你一眼，只是冷淡地耸了耸肩，动作显得比必要的还要生硬和粗鲁。“再见，冠军。 ]

It's all right if he doesn't want to talk in detail about himself, but something basic to begin with would be nice. Well, if this is going to be about work, what did he do before all this went down? So then, he's some kind of huntsmaster? "That's... right. But there are few wargs left in the kennels, and the mews are all but empty. Elthara has me doing other tasks for the Crown, since the duties I assumed during the time of the old King Dowager can hardly keep me occupied these days. I must say that my experience with stewardship has greatly expanded very recently." The time of the old King Dowager, huh... "For example, I was asked to instruct the young Etheryn in the basics of falconry. It, alongside with boar hunting, was one of the King Dowager's favorite hobbies, and he wanted his daughters to share in his interests, especially since Alissa was fond of it." So then, Alissa also made use of his services as huntsmaster after she became queen? "No." That's surprising. "It's a long story." Elyon shakes his head. "Either way, that's as much as I want to tell you. Suffice to say that the previous queen all but relieved me of my more erstwhile duties and only took to the hunt with her closest friends." But — "All right, that's enough!" The angry scowl returns to the huntsmaster's expression, and he turns back to his bird again, the large hawk perching on his glove with an angry, sullen glare that mirrors its master's. Well, if he was the one to give Ryn Harrick senior and train her in the beast's handling, you can tell where the bird gets his foul temperament from. No, no, that's not right. Was he changed by his corruption, or did it merely bring out what was already there to begin with? You throw a glance at Elyon, but he's busy tending to his bird, offering it a strip of raw meat. The man doesn't even look at you as he gives you a dismissive little shrug, far more curt and stiff than strictly necessary. "Good day, champion." ] "
