rows.raw: " So... this is the site where Ryn's dad died, is it? From where you're standing, the western base of the old stone bridge still stands, although its span has long since fallen into the fjord a long time ago. If you peer over the edge, you can still see the rubble of the fallen masonry, peeking out above the water... nature's reclaimed a lot of the elven ruins around here, or rather, integrated the two. It's quite tranquil, and as far as you can tell, no different from any stretch of woodland in the Frostwood. If not for the stories you've been hearing while on the wild goose chase that Ryn sent you on, you'd never have suspected its sordid past. [party.has etheryn |Looking around, Ryn swallows hard as she takes in the small first clearing and the broken bridge. She's clearly having a moment of her own, [pc.isDK |but you're sure she'll get over herself. Everyone does |but you think she needs to be alone for now; perhaps you'll be able to speak with her about the matter later. Or as it turns out, maybe that chance has just arrived ]. "So, this is where..." her voice trails off. She's never seen it before? "Well, I did pass it by when escaping from the palace on my horse, but as you can understand, I wasn't about to stop to take in the scenery." Without her around, you wouldn't have given the clearing a second glance, but now that you're here with her there's a definite melancholic air to the place. It's that kind of heart-tugging sad that really bites at one's emotions... ] Feeling that you're obligated to Ryn to at least perform a cursory search of the place, you set about giving the clearing a good look-over, taking in the oldest-looking trees for perhaps markings from — oh, you don't know. But you have to look nonetheless, right? Then it'll be easier to tell Ryn that you really tried and found nothing — [pc.bg hunter barbarian |And then your years of living in the wilderness kick in, and you whirl around, taking several purposeful steps around to an ancient pine where the shadows about one side of the broad trunk are just a shade darker than they should be. When you get within striking distance, though, Elyon steps out from around the old, rugged tree and gives you a nod. "Not bad. I didn't think I was that poorly hidden, but this dog is getting old." You chuckle dryly. He'd rather put himself down than acknowledge that you're capable of something? "Embrace the word 'and', my dear champion. It works wonders." [pc.isDK |You didn't come out all this way into the forest to take shitty sass from him, you're here to help Ryn take that stick out of his butt and start towards accepting help instead of being a little bitch about everything. |While you've tried to be understanding of his circumstances, the constant shtick of him-pushing-you-away-but-not-far-enough-so-you-can-come-back is getting quite tiring. You're trying to be patient with him for Ryn's sake, but even that has its limits. ] |And then he's at your side. Not approaching from the front, for that would be confrontational, but not from the back either, for that would be sneaking up on you. Elyon's simply approached when you... you don't even think you were preoccupied; catching his attention was the real reason you're out here in the first place, aren't you? If anyone was going to sneak up on you in these woods, it'd have to be the royal huntsman of the boreal elves, you guess... "This old dog isn't getting any younger, but I guess I should be heartened to know that I can still sneak up on the untrained." You chuckle dryly. Self-depreciating even in victory, isn't he? "It helps to have a realistic view of the situation." [pc.isDK |Well, if he doesn't mind excusing your language, fuck him and his realism |Well, that's honestly doing more harm than good, if he doesn't mind you being frank ]. You're trying to help him, Ryn's trying to help him, Elthara's trying to help him. If he wants to make it up to the var Ridell line for what he sees as his past sins, the first step on that is to get himself out of the way. That's what this whole wild goose chase has been about. ] [party.has etheryn |Elyon frowns and looks like he's about to reply with some kind of bitter comeback, but then notices Ryn standing a little ways to your side. Your elven companion gives him a pleading look and a small nod, whereupon he drops his gaze and relents. ] "Hmph. Well, I'm here. You're here. If you want us to talk, we can talk." Half-turning away from you, the huntsman sweeps his arm over the forest, the fjord, the broken bridge. "You've been asking about what happened here, champion. I know that much. So you know the story, then?" Enough to understand that he was detained as the prime suspect in the king dowager's death. "The guard wasn't wrong in that it was my fault. The only real question here is if it was murder, or a death caused through my negligience." And would he still blame himself if Hethia's suspicions were right and the druids somehow had a hand in Ryn's dad dying? "Perhaps my culpability would be lessened, that's true, but at the end of the day the fault would still lie with me. I should have checked over the boar spear to ensure it wouldn't have snapped like a twig, I should have realized that there was something with the boar and urged his Majesty to safety, regardless of whether he would heed me or not. Neither were performed to satisfaction or in time, and as such I am still to blame." "That's not to mention that whether Xadaron and her inner circle had anything to do with the king dowager's death is a question that will never be concretely answered, so this entire line of questioning is a farce. There has to be a better way for you to help me than to try and push the blame on the druids, champion." And for all that he's said, there's got to be a better way for him to live than trying to blame himself for the death of the king dowager, and by extent Alissa's rise to the throne and the collapse of the Palace of Ice into a madhouse, a fate the Winter City itself nearly shared. Does his self-imposed martyrdom actually accomplish anything here when his liege actually needs him, or is he just feeding his ego? Elyon's brow creases. "Harsh." No, that's just realistic. How does he like them apples, huh? [party.has etheryn |Ryn glances back and forth between the both of you, looking ready to leap in should the situation flare up and matters come to blows, but it hasn't come to that. Yet. After all, a var Ridell's very presence at this confrontation, by its very nature, helps cool tempers... ] Elyon grunts and shakes his head. "Have it your way, champion. If that's what you think of me." It's how he's been acting all this while. If he wants people to view him differently, maybe he should try acting differently? Look, he took the trouble of tailing you all the way out here from the palace. Why doesn't he show you around, tell you his version of things that happened that day? The huntsman gives you a long, hard look, [party.has etheryn |then turns to Etheryn and gets an encouraging nod from your elven companion in return. Maybe that was all it was going to take — Ryn pushing just a bit in the right places for him to give in — but at last Elyon gives the both of you a slow nod. "All, right. [etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ], champion |then cocks his head and shrugs. "I don't know why [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the Regent ] couldn't ask me herself and had to send you on all of this, but since it's for her I'll go along with this game. Champion ], why don't you walk with me for a while and I'll show you the sights?" "

rows.original: "Back in the day, the bridge then spanned the fjord was still whole," Elyon said. "The old king, Lumia bless his heart, still cared enough to continue his wife's efforts and keep the public works in the Frostwood's northern trails in reasonable, if not good shape. The hounds had picked up the scent on the other side, near the temple of terrestrial fire, and it was my task to flush the prey out from the trees and into the open towards the king's hunting party." "Sure, it was a pretty big pig, but it wasn't anything that the king hadn't faced down before. Smart critter, too — boars are plenty strong, but faced with a pack of wargs nipping at its heels it wasn't going to fight if it could run. While I was only a couple years into the job, I felt pretty confident at this because I'd done this so many times on my own, even before my master formally retired and let me in the position of master of hawks and hounds." You nod and motion for Elyon to go on. "We hounded it across the bridge; it was so fat and heavy that you could hear its trotters click on the stones as it made its way towards the king, who'd long since dismounted his warg and was waiting with the boar spear." Slowly, Elyon steps up to the foot of the bridge on this side and taps a moss-covered post. "Here. Here was where the king dowager stood, champion. [party.has etheryn |Here is where your father stood for the last time, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ]. ]May Lumia bless his eternal soul. "The king dowager had a flair for the dramatic; he wanted to give the nobs in his hunting party a good show. In the absence of a war to fight, a hunt is a good second best choice for building reputations of one's martial prowess, after all. I'd checked over the boar spear that morning with the harnesses and all the other gear the hunting party was intending to use, and everything had seemed fine..." Elyon points across the bridge's now-collapsed span to the bog and hills on the other side of the fjord, a strange, wistful look in his golden demonic eyes. Pausing to gather himself, the huntsman returns to your side and paces in a circle, scuffing his boots on the dirt and undergrowth. "Here, right here. Seeing the ferocious desperation of the boar that was realizing it was being cornered between the hounds on its tail and the man in front of it, the king took a step back and braced himself. The hog tried to swerve away when it reached this side, but he stepped in its way and thrust. It was strong, oh it was strong — when it realized it wasn't getting around the king, it did its damndest to go through him like any other boar would do." "I don't know if it's the same way in other places, champion, but boar spears of pale elf make have a disc with a couple of extra prongs midway down the length to catch the hog because it'll impale itself all the way down the shaft to get you otherwise. It held fine, all right; I'd checked it over thrice, because I knew the king dowager was going after boar. What I didn't expect was for the pig to be so bloody-minded that it cracked the spear right in two. Just like that, it twisted its massive body, and the wood just snapped and splintered; all the king was left holding was this jagged stump of what used to be the boar spear." "I remember his face, champion. [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ], I remember your father's face. ]He was overjoyed. He found this sudden turn of events exciting. This was what he lived for, outside of those dreary policy council meetings and holding court. I saw it in his eyes; he was going to throttle this big pig in front of his with his bare hands, and everyone was going to love him for it." "And then the fucking boar gutted him with its tusks." Breathing heavily, Elyon looks down at the mossy forest floor, covered with pine needles; he stamps his boot on the dirt, then sighs deeply and slumps his shoulders. He can go on... you're still listening. Just being able to tell this tale honestly and openly is helping him, you can see that. Sure, you've no doubt he's told the likes of Daliza this story dozens of times, but that's where the openly part comes in, doesn't it? "The nobs who'd come along for the hunt in their fancy coats and boots, none of them stopped to even consider helping their king. Most of those assholes had kin, if not ancestors who'd fought in the Godswar, and they scattered like leaves on the wind in the face of a big pig. They just ran away, spurred their wargs in the other direction well away from the boar and left the king dowager to bleed out on the dirt. Without anyone telling them what to do in the face of a snorting, bloodied monster, the servants they'd towed along for the ride were worse than useless, although I couldn't blame them for it. I set the hounds on the damned pig — all half-dozen of them — and let them tear the ugly bastard to pieces while I tried to bind up the king dowager. And you know what he was doing all the while, champion?" "He was smiling. Had this big, glorious grin on his face that didn't match up with the wide-eyed expression of shock he had, but he was smiling. And it reminded me of the smile he had on the day his wife the old queen took me into her service, and how it was supposed to have captured her heart. I don't know why I was thinking that while I was trying to save him from bleeding out on the ground, but... he was dying and he was happy about it." And then he was arrested, you take it. "The hounds tore the boar apart — not without taking some wounds of their own, but I'd trained them well. Once it became clear that the danger had passed, it was only then that everyone came down to gawk at the scene." He has to admit, the first official thing on the record being him kneeling over the dying king dowager, trying to save his monarch or not, would've raised suspicion... but you think you understand Elyon enough to know that it wouldn't have mattered anyway. "It wasn't even on my mind to begin with. It wasn't until the constabulary clapped me in shackles and told me that I was under suspicion of conspiracy to murder to king that it sank in. They couldn't accuse me of directly murdering the king because everyone saw the boar gore him with its tusks and me trying to save him afterwards, but they could damn well accuse me of being involved somehow." The priestesses' examination of the king dowager's wounds and eventually, their autopsy exonerated him, though. "Does it matter? With that kind of public accusation standing next to your name, you may as well done the deed. Not that anyone said I couldn't have done it, but only that there wasn't any evidence that I did. And with the way things turned out, all the things I could've done... who's to say I didn't inadvertently kill him anyway?" All right, this martyrdom is getting out of hand. Could he have foreseen that the boar spear would snap despite him having gone over everything? Could he have foreseen that the boar itself would have been unnaturally strong, by all appearances? The way he's blaming himself by stretching his culpability to the limit, why didn't the king's court share any of the blame for abandoning their monarch when he went down onto the forest floor? Why doesn't he blame the priestesses for failing, or even Lumia herself for refusing to save Ryn's dad? There're so many things that could've happened that might have conceivably saved the king dowager, but strangely enough only he seems to think the blame is his and his only. Yes, everyone else may have made him a convenient scapegoat to avoid implicating the failures of those with greater social standing than he had, but for him to believe it himself so fervently and for so long... you don't know whether to be impressed, dumbstruck, or just plain pity the man. Not that you were going to find anything concrete in this silly little chase to begin with, but you care about Ryn, and Ryn cares about him. So there. If nothing else, if he still remembers the oath he made to the king and queen while still alive, he can at least put aside his own demons and actually focus on serving Ryn, who's proven herself a far better candidate for his loyalty than Alissa. Unless he's not willing to do for Ryn what he was for her sister, and for a much better reason at that? [party.has etheryn |Elyon's eyes turn from you to Ryn, then back again. Bowing his head, the huntsman takes a slow step forward, approaching his liege. "[etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ], I — " "I've known you as far back as I can remember, Ely. I want you to know that you and Harrick helped keep me together while Alissa was on the throne. While I don't think we can make things the way they were before my father passed on, I'm still hoping that something of the man I once knew as a girl still remains after all of this. I want that man back, in my palace, helping me rule — in a different capacity in which he served my father and mother, perhaps, but still something of that." Elyon swallows hard. "If I may, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], why all this?" "Because you'd never have accepted it if it'd come from me. That's why I had to enlist [pc.names] help. Would you have come out here today if it weren't for [pc.himHer]?" |Elyon scowls. "I still don't get why she couldn't have told me all this directly instead of sending you to poke your nose around and lure me out here for a chat." For the very simple reason that if it'd come directly from her without going through all of this, he simply would have brushed off her words and continued on the same self-destructive path! You're not wrong about this, he knows it, you know it; Ryn's still hoping that even if there's no way to make things the way they were before the king dowager passed on, she's still hoping that there's something that still remains of the man she once knew as a girl! ] "...No. You're not wrong." The both of you eye each other carefully, as if expecting someone to lash out and start a fight or something. After half a minute of this impasse, Elyon steps back and sighs, half-turning his back on you[party.has etheryn | and Ryn ], clearly intending to leave. That's it? He's running away? After the chance Ryn's given him? "I'm not running away," he growls. "I'm just heading back to the palace, because there's nothing left to say. You won't find any hidden clues here that've escaped notice for decades — I should know, I've looked again and again so many times over the years. Now that you've my side of the story... I guess it's up to you to put the pieces together and draw your own conclusions. [party.has etheryn |By your leave, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], I'm getting out of here." "Wait," Ryn says, hurrying forward and wrapping her arms about Elyon's waist so he can't make an aloof escape. "Thank you." "Whatever for? Even if you're going to forbid me from blaming myself for your father's death, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], that doesn't change the fact that I didn't manage to save him. I..." Elyon's about to say more when Ryn quietly hushes him. "Maybe that's so, but you saved him for long enough that Alissa and I were able to say goodbye to him. That's more than we would've had if not for you, and I've got to thank you for that." "I... I don't deserve this, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ]. Because he died, your sister was given free rein to torment you for so long." "None of us deserve what's happened to us, and yet we somehow make do. There's no way out of this but forward." "Your mother was more inspiring. But good try; I'm sure you'll surpass her in time." In a move that's most scandalous of a man behaving as much to his [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ], the huntsman reaches down and briefly tousles her hair. "I'm out of here |I'm done here ]." With that, Elyon turns tail and starts back in the direction of the Winter City without so much as looking back at you. It's all you can do to watch him disappear amidst the pines of the Frostwood, one shadow blending into many others until there's no trace of him left. Well, that's that. You've done all you could, put up with this nonsense for as long as you were willing to stand it and pushed the envelope as far as you could. Whether [pc.isDK |this bastard |Elyon ] wants to fix himself is up to him and Ryn now. It might be interesting to watch these events develop, but as far as you're concerned you're not touching this mess any further, even with a ten-foot pole...
rows.translation: 在过去，那座横跨峡湾的桥梁依然是完整的，”伊莱恩说道，“那位已故的老国王——愿卢米娅保佑他——依然十分关心这些公共设施，他继续他妻子的努力，让弗罗斯特伍德北部地区的道路保持良好的状态，即使不能说堪称完美，至少也是相当不错的。 那些猎犬已经在另一边，靠近大地之火神庙的地方，发现了猎物的踪迹。我的任务就是把猎物从树林里驱赶出来，让它进入开阔地带，从而落入国王的猎队手部中。 “没错，那确实是一头相当大的野猪，但这种级别的猎物，对国王来说根本不是什么难对付的东西。 这些动物也很聪明——野猪确实力气很大，但一旦有一群狼群在后面追赶，它们肯定会选择逃跑而不是战斗。虽然我刚开始这份工作才几年时间，但我对此还是相当有信心的，因为在我师傅正式退休、让我接任猎鹰与猎犬队的负责人之前，我就已经独立完成过很多这样的任务了。你点了点头，示意埃利昂继续说下去。 “我们追着它穿过桥梁；它实在太胖太大了，以至于你能听到它的蹄子踩在石头上发出的咔嗒声，它一路跑向国王那里——而国王早就下了他的战马，手部持长矛在等待着。慢慢地，伊利恩走到了这座桥的这一侧，轻轻敲了敲那根长满苔藓的柱子。‘就是这里，冠军。正是在这里，王太后曾经站立过。 [party.has etheryn |这就是你父亲最后一次站立的地方。 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]. ]愿卢米亚保佑他的灵魂安息。 “那位王太后天生就喜欢戏剧性的场面；她想给自己的狩猎队伍里那些贵族们上演一场精彩的表演。毕竟，在没有战争可打的情况下，狩猎也是彰显一个人武艺高强的一种不错方式。 那天早上，我仔细检查了那支野猪矛，以及狩猎队打算使用的所有装备，看起来一切都完好无损…… 埃利昂指向桥面已经坍塌的部分，指向峡湾对岸的沼泽和山丘，他那金色的恶魔之眼中流露出一种奇怪而充满怀旧的神情。 猎人停下来调整了一下自己的状态，然后回到你身边，开始在周围来回走动，他的靴子在泥土和灌木丛中发出沙沙声。 “就是这里，就在这里。看到那头野猪陷入了绝境——它既被后面的猎犬逼得无处可逃，又前面有一个人挡着它的去路，它陷入了极度的绝望之中，国王便后退了一步，做好了准备。 当那头猪来到这一侧时，试图转弯躲开，但他挡在了它的路上，并猛地刺了上去。那头猪力气很大，真的非常大——当它意识到无法绕过那个人时，便使出了全力想要逃脱。 通过 就像其他野猪一样，它也会这样。” “我不知道其他地方是否也是这样，冠军，但苍白精灵使用的野猪长矛，在矛身中间会装有一个带有几个额外尖刺的圆盘，这样就可以抓住那些野猪了——因为如果没有这个装置，那些野猪只会把整个身体刺进长矛里，从而无法被捕获。 它确实很结实，没问题；我检查了三遍，因为我知道王太后是要去追猎野猪的。但我没料到那头猪会如此凶残，竟然把长矛直接折成了两截。真是 那个它扭动着自己庞大的身躯，木头立刻断裂成碎片；国王手部中只剩下那根曾经用来刺杀野猪的、如今已经变得参差不齐的木桩。 “我记得他的面容，勇士。 [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]我记得你父亲的面容。 ]他欣喜若狂，对这种突如其来的转机感到无比高兴。 令人兴奋的这就是他活着的意义——除了参加那些枯燥的政策委员会会议和主持各种仪式之外。我从他的眼中看到了这一点：他真的打算用双手部掐死这只肥猪，而所有人都会因此而崇拜他。” “结果，那只该死的野猪却用它的獠牙刺穿了他的身体。 埃利昂喘着粗气，低头看着被松针覆盖的苔藓丛生的森林地面；他用靴子踩了踩泥土，然后深深地叹了口气，肩膀也耷拉了下来。 他还可以继续说下去……你还在听啊。能够如此坦诚、公开地讲述这个故事，确实对他有所帮助，这一点你看得出来。当然，他肯定已经把这个故事讲给达丽莎这样的朋友很多次了，但关键就在于这种公开的讲述方式，不是吗？ 那些穿着华丽外套、脚蹬高档靴子前来参加狩猎的贵族们，没有一个停下来考虑过帮助自己的国王。那些混蛋们中，大多数人的亲戚或祖先都参加过神战，然而在面对这样一只强大的对手部时，他们却像风中的落叶一样四散逃开了。 他们只是逃跑了，驱使着自己的魔兽朝另一个方向跑去，远远地离开了那头野猪，任由王太后在尘土中流血而死。面对这样一个喷着鼻息、浑身是血的怪物，根本没有人告诉他们该怎么做，那些被他们牵着一起逃跑的仆从们，简直毫无用处，不过我也不能因此责怪他们。 我派了那六只猎犬去追捕那只该死的猪，让它们把那个丑陋的家伙撕成碎片，而我自己则尽力去包扎王太后的伤势。你知道吗，冠军，他在整个过程中都在干些什么？ 他正在微笑，脸上挂着那种灿烂、耀眼的笑容，但这与他那充满震惊的茫然神情似乎并不相符。但他确实在微笑。这让我想起了他妻子——那位老女王——把我收为仆从的那一天，他脸上的那种笑容……据说，正是那种笑容打动了她的心。我不知道为什么在试图挽救他、阻止他流血而死的那一刻，我会想到这些……但他确实正在死去，而且 开心 就这样。” 然后他就被逮捕了，你能想象吗？ “那些猎犬把那头野猪撕得粉碎——虽然它们自己也受了些伤，但我训练它们得很到位。直到危险真正过去，人们才纷纷下来观看那一幕。 他不得不承认，有记录以来他第一次公开出现的场景，就是他跪在垂死的王太后身旁，试图挽救自己的君主——无论他是否真的试图这么做，都会引起怀疑……但你觉得自己对伊利恩已经足够了解，因此知道这种怀疑其实毫无意义。 一开始我根本没考虑过这个可能性。直到警察给我戴上手部铐，告诉我我被怀疑参与了谋杀国王的阴谋，我才真正意识到了这一点。他们无法指控我直接谋杀了国王，因为所有人都看到了那头野猪用獠牙刺伤了他，也看到了我之后试图救他；但他们完全有理由指控我与这件事有某种关联。 然而，女祭司们对王太后的伤口进行了检查，最终进行的尸检也证明她并无过错。 “这还有关系吗？既然你的名字已经被这样公开指责，那你还不如承认自己真的做了那件事。并不是说有人认为我不可能犯下这种罪行，只是没有证据证明我确实做了。而考虑到事情的发展结果，所有那些我可能犯下的行为……谁又能说我就不可能在无意中害死了他呢？ 好吧，这种自我牺牲的行为已经变得有些过分了。他难道能预料到，尽管他已经检查了一切，但那支用来刺野猪的矛还是会折断吗？他难道能预料到，那只野猪会变得异常强壮吗？ 他把自己应负的责任无限放大，以此来责备自己。可是，当国王倒在地上时，为什么王室成员中没有一个人为抛弃他们的君主而承担任何责任呢？为什么他不责备那些女祭司的失职，甚至不责备卢米娅本人，因为正是她拒绝拯救瑞恩的父亲啊？ 本来可能有很多办法可以挽救王太后的性命，但奇怪的是，最终却只有一种方法可行。 他 他似乎真的认为这一切责任都应该由他来承担，而且只有他才该负责。没错，其他人或许把他当作一个方便的替罪羊，以此来避免让那些社会地位比他高的人承担责任，但让他自己如此坚信这一点，并且持续了这么长时间……你真的不知道是该感到佩服、震惊，还是应该为他感到同情。其实，从一开始，你就不指望能从这场愚蠢的“追责游戏”中找到什么实质性的证据，但你关心Ryn，而Ryn也在乎 他所以，就是这样。即便没有其他原因，只要他仍然记得自己生前对国王和王后立下的誓言，他就至少应该放下自己的私心，真正专心地为瑞恩服务——毕竟，瑞恩显然比艾莉莎更值得他忠诚。除非他不愿意为瑞恩做那些他曾为她的姐姐做过的事，而且还有更充分的理由阻止他这么做？ [party.has etheryn |伊利恩的目光从你身上转向瑞恩，然后又转回来。那位猎手低着头，缓缓向前迈出了一步，走向他的领主。[etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]从我记事起，我就认识你了，艾利。我想让你知道，在艾莉莎执政期间，是你和哈里克帮助我保持了内心的平衡。虽然我认为我们无法让一切恢复到我父亲在世时的样子，但我仍然希望，经过这一切之后，那个我小时候认识的那个男人，还有一部分存在在现在的我身上。 我想要那个男人回到我的宫殿，帮助我统治国家——也许他的职责会与当年帮助我父母时有所不同，但本质上还应该是类似的。 伊莱恩艰难地咽了口唾沫，说道：“如果可以的话 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]为什么非得这样呢？” “因为如果这番话是由我亲口说出来的，你绝对不会接受的。所以，我不得不通过别人来说出这些话。 [pc.names] 帮帮忙。如果今天没有这件事发生，你会出来这里吗？ [pc.himHer]?" |埃利昂皱起了眉头：“我还是不明白，她为什么不能直接把这些事情告诉我，而不是派你来打探消息，然后把我引到这里来聊天。” 原因很简单：如果这些话是直接从她口中说出来的，而不是经过这些曲折的环节，他肯定会直接忽略她的話，继续沿着那条自我毁灭的道路走下去！ 你说的没错，他心里也明白，你也知道；瑞恩仍然希望，即使已经没有办法让一切恢复到王太后去世之前的样子，至少还能找到那个她小时候认识的那个男人的某些痕迹吧！ ] ……不，你没有错。” 你们两人小心翼翼地互相注视着，仿佛在等待对方突然发怒、引发争吵之类的。在这种僵持状态持续了半分钟后，伊利恩终于退后一步，叹了口气，然后半转身背对你说道。[party.has etheryn | 还有瑞恩 ]显然，他是打算离开。 就这样？他就这么逃走了？在Ryn给了他这样的机会之后？ “我不是在逃走，”他低吼道，“我只是要回宫殿去，因为已经没有什么可说的了。你们在这里找不到任何被忽视了几十年的隐藏线索——我应该最清楚这一点，这些年来我反复寻找过很多次。现在你们已经了解了我的说法……我想，剩下的就是你们自己去把事情弄清楚，然后得出自己的结论了。 [party.has etheryn |请允许我离开。 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]我得走了。” “等等，”瑞恩急忙上前，搂住伊利恩的腰，防止他独自离开。“谢谢你。” “何必这么说呢？就算你不想让我因为你父亲的死而自责 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]但这并不能改变一个事实：我终究没能救他……” 就在埃利昂准备继续说下去时，瑞恩轻声让他住了口。“也许事实确实如此，但你在他身边陪伴了他的时间足够长，让艾丽莎和我有机会与他道别。如果没有你，我们根本无法做到这一点，因此我必须感谢你。” “我……我根本不配得到这样的感谢 [etheryn.crowned |陛下 |摄政王 ]因为他去世了，你姐姐才得以肆无忌惮地折磨你这么久。” “我们所有人都不应遭受这样的对待，然而我们还是不得不继续活下去。除了向前看，没有其他的出路。” “你母亲的做法其实更加令人敬佩。不过，你努力尝试吧——我相信假以时日，你一定能够超越她。”一个男人做出这样的举动，实在是一件极其荒谬的事情 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]猎人低头轻轻拨了拨她的头发，说道：“我走了。 |我在这里的任务已经完成了。 ]就这样，伊利恩转身朝冬城的方向走去，甚至没有回头看你一眼。你只能眼睁睁地看着他消失在霜木丛中，他的身影渐渐融入其他众多的影子之中，最终彻底消失无踪。 好吧，事情就是这样。你已经尽了全力，忍受了这一切荒谬的事情，也已经做到了你能做的最大限度。无论结果如何 [pc.isDK |这个混蛋 |伊莱恩 ] 是否想要改变自己，现在取决于他和Ryn了。观察这些事情的发展过程或许会很有意思，但对你来说，就算用十英尺长的杆子也绝不会再插手部这个烂摊子了……
rows.raw: " "Back in the day, the bridge then spanned the fjord was still whole," Elyon said. "The old king, Lumia bless his heart, still cared enough to continue his wife's efforts and keep the public works in the Frostwood's northern trails in reasonable, if not good shape. The hounds had picked up the scent on the other side, near the temple of terrestrial fire, and it was my task to flush the prey out from the trees and into the open towards the king's hunting party." "Sure, it was a pretty big pig, but it wasn't anything that the king hadn't faced down before. Smart critter, too — boars are plenty strong, but faced with a pack of wargs nipping at its heels it wasn't going to fight if it could run. While I was only a couple years into the job, I felt pretty confident at this because I'd done this so many times on my own, even before my master formally retired and let me in the position of master of hawks and hounds." You nod and motion for Elyon to go on. "We hounded it across the bridge; it was so fat and heavy that you could hear its trotters click on the stones as it made its way towards the king, who'd long since dismounted his warg and was waiting with the boar spear." Slowly, Elyon steps up to the foot of the bridge on this side and taps a moss-covered post. "Here. Here was where the king dowager stood, champion. [party.has etheryn |Here is where your father stood for the last time, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ]. ]May Lumia bless his eternal soul. "The king dowager had a flair for the dramatic; he wanted to give the nobs in his hunting party a good show. In the absence of a war to fight, a hunt is a good second best choice for building reputations of one's martial prowess, after all. I'd checked over the boar spear that morning with the harnesses and all the other gear the hunting party was intending to use, and everything had seemed fine..." Elyon points across the bridge's now-collapsed span to the bog and hills on the other side of the fjord, a strange, wistful look in his golden demonic eyes. Pausing to gather himself, the huntsman returns to your side and paces in a circle, scuffing his boots on the dirt and undergrowth. "Here, right here. Seeing the ferocious desperation of the boar that was realizing it was being cornered between the hounds on its tail and the man in front of it, the king took a step back and braced himself. The hog tried to swerve away when it reached this side, but he stepped in its way and thrust. It was strong, oh it was strong — when it realized it wasn't getting around the king, it did its damndest to go through him like any other boar would do." "I don't know if it's the same way in other places, champion, but boar spears of pale elf make have a disc with a couple of extra prongs midway down the length to catch the hog because it'll impale itself all the way down the shaft to get you otherwise. It held fine, all right; I'd checked it over thrice, because I knew the king dowager was going after boar. What I didn't expect was for the pig to be so bloody-minded that it cracked the spear right in two. Just like that, it twisted its massive body, and the wood just snapped and splintered; all the king was left holding was this jagged stump of what used to be the boar spear." "I remember his face, champion. [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ], I remember your father's face. ]He was overjoyed. He found this sudden turn of events exciting. This was what he lived for, outside of those dreary policy council meetings and holding court. I saw it in his eyes; he was going to throttle this big pig in front of his with his bare hands, and everyone was going to love him for it." "And then the fucking boar gutted him with its tusks." Breathing heavily, Elyon looks down at the mossy forest floor, covered with pine needles; he stamps his boot on the dirt, then sighs deeply and slumps his shoulders. He can go on... you're still listening. Just being able to tell this tale honestly and openly is helping him, you can see that. Sure, you've no doubt he's told the likes of Daliza this story dozens of times, but that's where the openly part comes in, doesn't it? "The nobs who'd come along for the hunt in their fancy coats and boots, none of them stopped to even consider helping their king. Most of those assholes had kin, if not ancestors who'd fought in the Godswar, and they scattered like leaves on the wind in the face of a big pig. They just ran away, spurred their wargs in the other direction well away from the boar and left the king dowager to bleed out on the dirt. Without anyone telling them what to do in the face of a snorting, bloodied monster, the servants they'd towed along for the ride were worse than useless, although I couldn't blame them for it. I set the hounds on the damned pig — all half-dozen of them — and let them tear the ugly bastard to pieces while I tried to bind up the king dowager. And you know what he was doing all the while, champion?" "He was smiling. Had this big, glorious grin on his face that didn't match up with the wide-eyed expression of shock he had, but he was smiling. And it reminded me of the smile he had on the day his wife the old queen took me into her service, and how it was supposed to have captured her heart. I don't know why I was thinking that while I was trying to save him from bleeding out on the ground, but... he was dying and he was happy about it." And then he was arrested, you take it. "The hounds tore the boar apart — not without taking some wounds of their own, but I'd trained them well. Once it became clear that the danger had passed, it was only then that everyone came down to gawk at the scene." He has to admit, the first official thing on the record being him kneeling over the dying king dowager, trying to save his monarch or not, would've raised suspicion... but you think you understand Elyon enough to know that it wouldn't have mattered anyway. "It wasn't even on my mind to begin with. It wasn't until the constabulary clapped me in shackles and told me that I was under suspicion of conspiracy to murder to king that it sank in. They couldn't accuse me of directly murdering the king because everyone saw the boar gore him with its tusks and me trying to save him afterwards, but they could damn well accuse me of being involved somehow." The priestesses' examination of the king dowager's wounds and eventually, their autopsy exonerated him, though. "Does it matter? With that kind of public accusation standing next to your name, you may as well done the deed. Not that anyone said I couldn't have done it, but only that there wasn't any evidence that I did. And with the way things turned out, all the things I could've done... who's to say I didn't inadvertently kill him anyway?" All right, this martyrdom is getting out of hand. Could he have foreseen that the boar spear would snap despite him having gone over everything? Could he have foreseen that the boar itself would have been unnaturally strong, by all appearances? The way he's blaming himself by stretching his culpability to the limit, why didn't the king's court share any of the blame for abandoning their monarch when he went down onto the forest floor? Why doesn't he blame the priestesses for failing, or even Lumia herself for refusing to save Ryn's dad? There're so many things that could've happened that might have conceivably saved the king dowager, but strangely enough only he seems to think the blame is his and his only. Yes, everyone else may have made him a convenient scapegoat to avoid implicating the failures of those with greater social standing than he had, but for him to believe it himself so fervently and for so long... you don't know whether to be impressed, dumbstruck, or just plain pity the man. Not that you were going to find anything concrete in this silly little chase to begin with, but you care about Ryn, and Ryn cares about him. So there. If nothing else, if he still remembers the oath he made to the king and queen while still alive, he can at least put aside his own demons and actually focus on serving Ryn, who's proven herself a far better candidate for his loyalty than Alissa. Unless he's not willing to do for Ryn what he was for her sister, and for a much better reason at that? [party.has etheryn |Elyon's eyes turn from you to Ryn, then back again. Bowing his head, the huntsman takes a slow step forward, approaching his liege. "[etheryn.crowned |Your Majesty |Regent ], I — " "I've known you as far back as I can remember, Ely. I want you to know that you and Harrick helped keep me together while Alissa was on the throne. While I don't think we can make things the way they were before my father passed on, I'm still hoping that something of the man I once knew as a girl still remains after all of this. I want that man back, in my palace, helping me rule — in a different capacity in which he served my father and mother, perhaps, but still something of that." Elyon swallows hard. "If I may, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], why all this?" "Because you'd never have accepted it if it'd come from me. That's why I had to enlist [pc.names] help. Would you have come out here today if it weren't for [pc.himHer]?" |Elyon scowls. "I still don't get why she couldn't have told me all this directly instead of sending you to poke your nose around and lure me out here for a chat." For the very simple reason that if it'd come directly from her without going through all of this, he simply would have brushed off her words and continued on the same self-destructive path! You're not wrong about this, he knows it, you know it; Ryn's still hoping that even if there's no way to make things the way they were before the king dowager passed on, she's still hoping that there's something that still remains of the man she once knew as a girl! ] "...No. You're not wrong." The both of you eye each other carefully, as if expecting someone to lash out and start a fight or something. After half a minute of this impasse, Elyon steps back and sighs, half-turning his back on you[party.has etheryn | and Ryn ], clearly intending to leave. That's it? He's running away? After the chance Ryn's given him? "I'm not running away," he growls. "I'm just heading back to the palace, because there's nothing left to say. You won't find any hidden clues here that've escaped notice for decades — I should know, I've looked again and again so many times over the years. Now that you've my side of the story... I guess it's up to you to put the pieces together and draw your own conclusions. [party.has etheryn |By your leave, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], I'm getting out of here." "Wait," Ryn says, hurrying forward and wrapping her arms about Elyon's waist so he can't make an aloof escape. "Thank you." "Whatever for? Even if you're going to forbid me from blaming myself for your father's death, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ], that doesn't change the fact that I didn't manage to save him. I..." Elyon's about to say more when Ryn quietly hushes him. "Maybe that's so, but you saved him for long enough that Alissa and I were able to say goodbye to him. That's more than we would've had if not for you, and I've got to thank you for that." "I... I don't deserve this, [etheryn.crowned |your Majesty |Regent ]. Because he died, your sister was given free rein to torment you for so long." "None of us deserve what's happened to us, and yet we somehow make do. There's no way out of this but forward." "Your mother was more inspiring. But good try; I'm sure you'll surpass her in time." In a move that's most scandalous of a man behaving as much to his [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ], the huntsman reaches down and briefly tousles her hair. "I'm out of here |I'm done here ]." With that, Elyon turns tail and starts back in the direction of the Winter City without so much as looking back at you. It's all you can do to watch him disappear amidst the pines of the Frostwood, one shadow blending into many others until there's no trace of him left. Well, that's that. You've done all you could, put up with this nonsense for as long as you were willing to stand it and pushed the envelope as far as you could. Whether [pc.isDK |this bastard |Elyon ] wants to fix himself is up to him and Ryn now. It might be interesting to watch these events develop, but as far as you're concerned you're not touching this mess any further, even with a ten-foot pole... "

I don't understand why you keep on coming back to me, but if you're going to be such a pest I guess it's the only thing I can do to get rid of you." Of course, there are other things he could do to get rid of you, but your lips are sealed and he knows that full well. Without warning, the huntsman [pc.heightRange 70 |hooks an arm about your waist and pulls you close to him, pricking your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with the clawed tips of his fingers even he presses your body against him. As he pulls you through the palace hallways, earning several curious stares from the staff out and about, you can't help but feel a sense of giddy joy that keeps you a pliant putty in his hands |sweeps you off your feet in a well-practiced motion, grabbing you by about your waist and draping you over his shoulder like a sack of potatoes. You've seen him carry off full-grown wargs in this fashion before... and just like the beasts, there's a sense of calm there that keeps you content to be manhandled about as he brings you through the palace hallways and to his chambers ]. You did ask for this, after all... [pc.raMulti lupine catfolk leothran fox |and the way his hand's reaching over to pinch the nape of your neck makes you feel comfortable to be manhandled in a strange way that you can't quite explain. rows.translation: 空气中弥漫着尴尬的沉默，这种沉默持续了整整两秒钟，然后伊利恩清了清嗓子说道：“好吧，如果这就是你想要的……我不明白你为什么一直缠着我，但如果你非要这么烦人，我想这也是我摆脱你的唯一办法了。” 当然，其实还有其他办法可以摆脱你，但你的嘴唇紧闭着，而他心里清楚这一点。 那个 果然如此。毫无征兆地，猎人 [pc.heightRange 70 |他用手臂挽住你的腰，将你拉向自己，同时轻轻刺了一下你的 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 他用手部指有爪般的指尖将你的身体紧紧压在自己身上。当他牵着你穿过宫殿的走廊时，周围的工作人员纷纷投来好奇的目光，而你却不禁感到一种兴奋与喜悦，这种情绪让你完全任由他摆布。 |他以一套熟练的动作将你抱起，抓住你的腰，像扛着一袋土豆一样把你甩到自己的肩上。你之前见过他以这种方式搬运那些成年狼族……和那些野兽一样，他身上也散发着一种让人感到安心的气息，因此你并不介意被他这样粗暴地抱着，任由他带着你穿过宫殿的走廊，走向他的房间。 ]你 做了 毕竟，这是你自己要求的…… [pc.raMulti lupine catfolk leothran fox |而他那只手伸过来捏你的后颈的方式，会让你在这种奇怪的被触碰的感觉中感到一种莫名的舒适。换句话说，大拇指和食指的这个简单动作，会让你觉得自己像只小狗一样渺小无助，虽然这种感觉完全不合常理，但确实如此。 非常 令人满意。 |而他那只手伸过来捏你的后颈的方式，会让你感到一种莫名的安心——尽管这种被以一种奇怪的方式“摆布”的感觉其实很难用语言来描述。大拇指和食指的简单动作，就让你的四肢失去了所有的力量，取而代之的，是一种温暖的满足感，让你乐意跟随他的意愿，去任何他想让你去的地方。这种感觉，确实很像猫……虽然完全无法用逻辑来解释，但事实就是如此。 非常 令人满意。 |而他那只手伸过来捏你的后颈的方式，会让你觉得以这种奇怪的方式被“摆布”其实是一种很舒适的感觉，这种感觉你根本无法用语言来形容。大拇指和食指的简单动作，就会让你全身的力量都仿佛消失无踪，取而代之的，是一种温暖而满足的感觉——你愿意被他带到任何他想让你去的地方。这种感觉，确实很像猫的行为……虽然完全不合常理，但就是如此，非常奇妙。 非常 令人满意。 |而他那只手伸过来捏你的后颈的方式，会让你觉得以这种奇怪的方式被“摆布”其实也挺舒服的，只不过这种感觉实在难以用语言来形容。总之，大拇指和食指的那个简单动作，会让你觉得自己就像一只弱小的小狐狸一样渺小无助——虽然这种感觉完全不合常理，但确实如此。 非常 令人满意。 ] 但最终，你们俩还是来到了猎人的房间。当你们穿过宫殿的最后一条走廊时，旁边狗舍里传来的声音传入了你们的耳中。他夸张地把你扔到床上，脸上的表情十分严肃。伊莱恩以极其夸张的动作擦了擦手部，然后看着躺在床垫上的你，伸出了手部 [pc.armor] 甚至你的手部也不由自主地伸向他的外衣。不久之后，你的衣服就乱七八糟地散落在地上，而你则开始思考：该如何巧妙地处理这一局面，同时让这位猎人先生以为一切都是他在主导……

rows.original:
Elyon doesn't say anything for several moments, his eyebrows furrowing more and more as he studies you. For a moment, you think he's going to have another one of his explosive emotional outbursts, and from the way he shudders and sighs, he almost did. Nevertheless, you have to respect the force of will it takes for him to control himself at your question.
    
    "So, that's what it's come down to, hasn't it?"
    
    He's making it sound like you're challenging him to a duel or something. That isn't what this is about!
    
    Elyon shakes his head slowly. "Did [etheryn.crowned
        |her Majesty
        |the regent
    ] put you up to this?"
    
    He knows the answer to this — indirectly, yes. But as to wanting to do this, no, Ryn didn't put you up to it. Propositioning him for sex was entirely your own idea. He's been beating himself up over the whole matter with allowing Ryn's dad to die during the hunt, and though he was never convicted of any charges, he may as well have been from the way everyone in his life treated him. He believes that he was responsible for it, doesn't he?
    
    The huntsmaster glares daggers at you, and you know you've struck a nerve. Yet he doesn't erupt in an inferno of icy rage the way he's done during some of your previous conversations.
    
    He can't keep on doing this forever; Ryn needs him, the Winter City needs him. Even if he can't bring himself to be forgiven, then at the very least he should try and set it aside, if only because it's getting in the way of him properly serving the var Ridells. And by everything you've reckoned him by, he does want to make it up to the royal line for all his sins, right? That begins with finally letting it go — if only for a while.
    
    Elyon grits his teeth, looks down at his feet. Then all of a sudden, he grunts and grabs you by the chin[pc.heightRange 79
        | despite you being taller than him, dragging your gaze down to meet his as those demonic eyes glower into your own
        |, dragging your gaze up to meet his as those yellow, demonic eyes glower into your own
    ].[pc.strengthRange 70
        | Sure, you could break out of his hold any time you wanted, but that would defeat the point of you instigating this to begin with, right? Besides... that coarse thumb and fingers pressing into your face aren't all that bad to begin with.
    ]
    
    "What the fuck do you know, [pc.ra elf
        |[pc.title]
        |[pc.race]
    ]. Sure, you're the Champion of Winter, but that that doesn't mean shit when it comes to our history." He heaves a deep sigh, a mixture of regret, frustration, and sadness pouring out of him in that one heady exhalation. "I don't have to take this shit from you, not when you wormed your way into the crown's good graces..."
    
    While you can't help but half-wonder if he's actually going to take your bait, Elyon speaks again; his deep voice rumbles out before you can goad him further, as if he had a sixth sense for your intentions — or maybe your arousal:
    
    "So, you want to fuck, huh? Word's around the palace that you're fucking everyone who's anyone within these halls, so-called champion. Don't know how much truth there is to those rumors, but everything feels like that would be the way things are if you were indeed fucking what remains of the nobs. Lumia's tits, guess I should be glad I'm counted amongst their number now, right?"
    
    Releasing his hold on your chin, Elyon plants that selfsame hand on your shoulders; you can feel the power of his grip through his fingerless gloves and his claws pricking at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]; your body flushes with warmth as his heat, scent and raw masculine presence shamelessly invade your personal space. It's clear from the huntsman's aggressive posture that he'll be the dominant partner in any sexual activity, even if you suggested it, and frankly you should've known this beforehand. What would you have expected from a corrupted, hunky elf man prone to fits of anger and aggression?
    
    Right.
    
    Sliding his grip down from your shoulder to your arm, Elyon starts tugging you onward, frogmarching you in a no-nonsense manner befitting of Daliza back to the servants' wing of the palace. His strides are wide and firm; the man clearly knows what he wants and you can't help but wonder in the back of your mind if this is the kind of tack he takes with his wargs when training them.[silly
        | Maybe you'll even end up in a warg cage at the end of all this, complete with a bunch of stuffed toys... no, that's too patently silly, even for a game like this with shitposting authors.
    ]
    
    Eventually, though, you're brought back to Elyon's quarters, and the simple, one-room accommodations are overshadowed by the tools of his trade on display, stacked up upon shelves and overflowing from boxes. Gloves, collars, leashes, harnesses, hoods... but all of those pale to the sight of Elyon himself, the man's presence inevitably drawing your thoughts towards his virility and the sight of the growing bulge in his leather breeches. Is that the corruption speaking, or is that just him?
rows.translation:
埃利恩好一会儿都没有说话，他的眉头越皱越紧，仔细地打量着你。有那么一瞬间，你以为他又要爆发一次情绪激烈的发作了——从他颤抖着、叹息的样子来看，他确实差点就那么做了。 然而，你必须承认，他在听到你的问题时所表现出的那种自我控制力实在令人钦佩。

“所以，归根结底就是这个原因，对吧？”

他说的方式，让人觉得你是在向他发起挑战，甚至像是要求进行决斗之类的。 这根本不是我们讨论的重点！

埃利恩缓缓摇了摇头。“难道 [etheryn.crowned
        |女王陛下
        |摄政王
    ] 这是不是你主动提出来的？”

他心里其实知道答案——间接来说，确实是这样。但至于自己是否真的愿意这么做，答案是否定的。提出与Ryn发生性关系这个想法完全是你自己提出的。自从在那次狩猎中导致Ryn的父亲死亡之后，他一直为此感到内疚不已。虽然他从未被起诉，但周围人的态度让他感觉自己简直就像是个罪犯一样。 他觉得自己应该对这件事负责，不是吗？

猎场主管用充满敌意的目光盯着你，你知道自己触到了他的痛处。然而，他并没有像在之前的一些对话中那样，爆发出激烈的愤怒。
    
    他不能永远这样下去；瑞恩需要他，冬城也需要他。即使他无法让自己得到原谅，至少他也应该试着把这件事放在一边，因为这正在妨碍他好好地为里德尔家族服务。 根据你对他所有的了解，他确实想要为自己的所有过错向王室赎罪，对吧？而这一切的第一步，就是终于放下那些过去的事——哪怕只是暂时放下而已。

伊利恩咬紧牙关，低头看着自己的足部。 然后，他突然发出一声低吼，抓住你的下巴。[pc.heightRange 79
        | 尽管你比他高，但当你低下目光与他的视线相遇时，那双恶魔般的眼睛正紧紧地盯着你。
        |当你抬起目光与他的视线相遇时，那双黄色的、充满邪恶气息的眼睛正紧紧地盯着你。
    ].[pc.strengthRange 70
        | 当然，你随时都可以挣脱他的控制，但那样就违背了你当初引发这一切的初衷了，对吧？另外……那粗糙的拇指和手指按在你的脸上，其实也并没有那么糟糕。
    ]
    
    你他妈懂个什么啊， [pc.ra elf
        |[pc.title]
        |[pc.race]
    ]当然，你可能是冬季的冠军，但在我们的历史面前，这一切都毫无意义。”他深深地叹了口气，那一声叹息中充满了懊悔、沮丧与悲伤。“我根本没有必要忍受你的这种侮辱，尤其是当你通过不正当手段赢得了王室的青睐之后。……”

虽然你忍不住会怀疑他是否真的会中你的计，但伊莱恩又开口了；他的低沉声音在你进一步激怒他之前就已经响起，仿佛他拥有预知你意图的第六感——又或许，他察觉到了你的兴奋之情。
    
    所以，你是想找乐子吧？宫里到处都在传，说你这个所谓的冠军，正在和这里所有有地位的人上床。不知道这些传言有多少真实性，但听上去，如果你真的在和那些贵族残余势力乱搞关系的话，事情确实会是这样的。 卢米娅的胸部……我想，能成为她们中的一员，我应该感到庆幸吧？”

rows.original:
[pc.mf|"Daddy!"|"Mommy!"] 

    You're alerted by her delighted cry only moments before you're hit head-on by the sort-of-flying tackle-hug of your daughter, and she wraps her sweatered arms around your head and giggling. "Hi."
    
    She giggles when you reach up and tickle her ribs, before squealing and retreating to your shoulders. Her tail wraps around them too, giving you a second hug even while her little claws [pc.hasHair|comb your hair|tickle your scalp]. "Hello, sweetie."
    
    "Hi [pc.mf|daddy|mommy] I love you." She hugs your head and smiles, getting comfortable while Aileh watches, just about turning to jelly at the side of you in the midst of [pc.mf|p|m]aternal bliss.
    
    "Love you too."
    
    Aileh grins, holding up a little pouch of coins. "Say, poor [freja.name]'s been looking for an excuse to spend her allowance—"
    
    "You have an allowance?" you ask, perplexed.
    
    "Mhm!" [freja.name] nods enthusiastically.
    
    Aileh continues, clearing her throat. "As I was saying; I can hardly go traipsing around the Winter City."
    
    "Why not?" [freja.name] asks.
    
    "Because I'm so busy," Aileh [silly|lies, lyingly|awkwardly explains]. She can hardly go saying aloud that her mother — and [freja.name]'s grandma — is persona-non-grata in the Winter City. She herself would probably feel awkward, considering her arrival is synonymous with Kasyrra's unveiling.
    
    [freja.name] doesn't appear convinced, but thankfully there's no pushing of the issue. "So you get to take me instead, [pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy]!" 
    
    Once again your head is hugged by the happy-flappy rapscallion, and Aileh gives you a little grin. "It's a shame," the dragoness admits, grin weakening after a moment. "Maybe one day I'll get to come too."
    
    "Alright, go make sure to brush and get ready." You hug your dragon daughter and peel her off of your head while she giggles and flaps. Once she's left for the moment, Aileh's expression sinks into something a little more crestfallen.
    
    "I could get a disguise, obviously. But then I'd have to explain that to [freja.name]. Plus I'm proud of who I am... perhaps if you have an in with the Valkyries you could get permission? A bit weird to ask, admittedly."
    
    "I'll ask if I get the chance," you promise, catching [freja.name] as she returns and flap-leaps into your arms, giving you a noisy cheek-smooch. "Ready to go?"
    
    "Mhm!"
    
    "Teeth brushed?"
    
    "We're gonna eat while we're out!" [freja.name] pouts.
    
    Aileh pipes up, snorting again while her tail lashes about. "Teeth, especially so that you're nice and fresh when I get my bye-bye kiss."
    
    Eventually, you have a dragon-daughter ready, and sitting on your shoulders. [party.som||[companion1.name] will smile and leave you to your family time; there're plenty of things to do here in the Wayfort for a few hours.|Your companions will smile and leave the two of you to your family time; there're plenty of other things to get up to in the Wayfort, or people to get into. More than enough to pass a few hours by.]

[pc.mf|爸爸！|妈妈！] 

    就在你即将被女儿这个仿佛会飞一般的扑抱动作撞到的瞬间，她那欢快的叫声引起了你的注意。她穿着毛衣，用双臂紧紧抱住你的脖子，咯咯地笑着：“嗨。”

当你伸手去挠她的肋骨时，她又笑了起来，然后尖叫着躲到了你的肩膀上。她的尾巴也缠在了你的肩膀上，这样她就又给了你一次拥抱——同时，她那小小的爪子 [pc.hasHair|整理头发|让人感到痒痒的，让人忍不住想要挠挠头皮]喂，亲爱的。”
“嗨 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈] 我爱你。”她把你的头抱在怀里，微笑着，渐渐放松下来。而艾莱则在一旁看着，站在你身旁，几乎要被看得融化掉 [pc.mf|p|m]永恒的幸福。

“我也爱你。”

艾莉笑着，拿出一小袋硬币：“说吧，可怜的 [freja.name]她一直在找借口花自己的零用钱——”

“你也有零用钱吗？”你困惑地问道。

“嗯！ [freja.name] 热情地点了点头。

艾莱接着清了清嗓子，说道：“就像我刚才说的，我实在没精力在冬城里到处奔波了。”

“为什么不行呢？ [freja.name] 因为我很忙，”艾莉说道。 [silly|谎言，欺骗行为|尴尬地解释道]她几乎不敢大声说出来：她的母亲——以及 [freja.name]她的祖母在冬城是个不受欢迎的人。考虑到她的到来与卡希拉的公开亮相是密不可分的，她自己恐怕也会感到尴尬。
    
    [freja.name] 他似乎并不信服，但幸运的是，没有人继续追究这个问题。“所以现在该由你来带我走了。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]又一次，那个欢快捣蛋的家伙把你的头抱在怀里，而艾莉也对你露出了微笑。“真可惜啊，”这位龙女承认道，不过她的笑容很快便消失了，“也许有一天我也能去吧。
    
    好了，去好好刷牙，准备好吧。”你抱了抱你的龙女儿，然后把她从自己头上抱下来，而她则咯咯笑着，挥动着翅膀。等她离开后，艾莱的表情变得有些沮丧起来。
    
    我当然可以弄一套伪装。但那样的话，我就得向别人解释这个原因了 [freja.name]另外，我为自己的身份感到自豪……或许如果你能和女武神们建立一些联系，就能得到他们的允许吧？不过，承认吧，这个请求确实有点奇怪。”

“如果有机会的话，我一定会去问的。”你承诺道。 [freja.name] 当她回到你身边，欢快地跳进你的怀里，然后亲了你的脸颊一下，大声说道：“准备好了吗？”

“嗯！”

“牙齿刷好了吗？”

“我们出去的时候再吃饭吧！ [freja.name] 撅起嘴来。

艾莉又开始大声抱怨，一边哼哼着，一边甩动她的尾巴。“牙齿啊，尤其是那些牙齿，这样当我亲你道别时，你的牙齿才会干净整洁。”

最终，你终于培养出了一位会坐在你肩膀上的龙之女儿。 [party.som||[companion1.name] 它会微笑着让你继续享受与家人的时光；在荒废驿堡，有很多事情可以在几个小时内去做。|你的同伴会微笑着离开，让你们俩享受属于家庭的时光；在荒废驿堡，还有很多其他的事情可以去做，也有很多人可以结识。绝对有足够的事情可以让你们度过这几个小时。]

rows.original: [freja.name]'s great big eyes are even more emotive than usual, arms wide, wings flapping, and tail holding your shoulders for balance while you're holding her feet. The journey up was a peaceful enough one; there aren't many things out there stupid enough to threaten you on the well-trodden road. You could have taken the waystone up there, but there had been a merchant caravan literally passing through the fort just as you were leaving. The two of you get off the caravan as you approach the gate, leaving them in the hands of the guards for whatever checks need to be done, while you make your entrance into the Winter City proper. "It's so pretty..." [freja.name] gasps, hugging your head so tightly you've got to actually peel her off again. "Brr, and cold..." "Is it too cold?" you ask, worried; perhaps you should've looked into dragon-foot-booties for her... "Nuh-uh, I'm always warm." [freja.name] smiles brightly, patting your side as though to reassure you, in a surprisingly adult fashion. One of the boreal guards sees you two and crouches down — a handsome man, with a powerful build, and a well-cropped beard — and gives your daughter a look. "A new visitor to our esteemed city, and in the hero's company? You must be the uh..." "My daughter," you finish. "[freja.name]." "Ah, of course, I should have guessed." He speaks... diplomatically; obviously she looks nothing like you, but [freja.name] looks delighted to be treated as someone recognized. "Have a wonderful day, Lady [freja.name]." There's a proud spring in your daughter's step as you approach the courtyard, drawing the attention of many passing elves as she does so. She's an icon of warm red, looking at everyone and everything while they make space for you, or give the both of you pleased little waves. When you reach the heart of the city, it's at the foot of the proud statue of an armored elven maiden with a golden spear that [freja.name] finally speaks up. "It's so big here! Like, really-really..." her clawed hands scrunch up into balls, and she furrows her button nose cutely as she hunts for the vocabulary to describe such 'bigness,' before she gives up. "Big!" That it is... You've got options here; [flags.FREJA_26|visiting Annika and the 'Balkrys', ]a meal at a restaurant featuring great big fish tanks, a stall with some ice cream treats, beyond which is a great big snow park, not to mention [freja.name] has gravitated almost immediately towards what could only be described as 'an adventuring store', whose shop front is attached to a backroom blacksmith. "Wow, a big knight shop..." [freja.name] mumbles, as though to hammer that particular point home. At [freja.name]'s age— or at least the sped-up-alchemically version of her age, being in such a big city where everyone's completely different to you would probably be intimidating. It's with no small amount of pride swelling in your breast, that she turns around, grabs your hand, and giggles brightly. "What first?"

rows.original: [freja.name] bounds forward ahead of you, at least until you clear your throat and extend a hand. "A-hem." The dragonlet gives you a meek look and runs back over, taking your hand in one of hers and giving it a squeeze. "Oookay..." You smile and heft your daughter up onto your shoulders, making for the waystone with a bounce in your step that makes her giggle. [aileh.wintercity|Aileh falls in behind you, retracting her wings and pulling a cloak on, before she takes your right hand in her left and follows along. "It's just like visiting gramma!" [freja.name] cheers, hugging your head and wrapping her tail around your shoulders for balance. "You don't... go there without me, do you?" Aileh quirks a brow at your daughter, having tip-toe in order to make clearer eye-contact with the flame-scaled rapscallion. "Nope! You said I couldn't, so I didn't and I won't so it's fine!" [freja.name] wiggles on your shoulders, smiling yet again. She looks too proud of this fact to be duplicitous so you make sure to brace her with your left hand.|] To your child's credit, she doesn't look too disoriented when you pass through; there's only a momentary squeezing sensation and a couple of little wing-flaps for balance as the world becomes something entirely different. Once you've stepped out into reality once more, it's with a shock in the face of the full-on bracing winds channeled down from the icy heights of the Winter City. [freja.name] gasps, letting go of you with her hands and putting her arms up in the air. "Brr!" "Brr? Not too cold?" "Nope, Iiii'm always warm," she announces proudly, and indeed she's like a little stove, giving off plenty of heat for you and actually beginning to steam a little. "What do we get to do first?" rows.original: [var0 |[freja.name]'s grip on your hand tightens, and there's plenty of giddy wiggling as you move onto the park. The dragonlet's stride does a valiant job of carving through the snow, leaving little dragon-claw-shaped puddles in her wake from contact with so much of the fluffy whiteness. "It sounds so quiet!" She squeals — loudly — and hop-flaps for a better look. She's not wrong, the blanket of ever-falling cotton eats up all the sound, so that your observation of the families at play, and walking couples, seems to be from a world apart. "Can we play?" [freja.name] looks up at you with the wide, familiar smile of a rapscallion who's definitely going to play even if you say no. Instead, your response is to scoop up a giant armful of snow and try to dump the whole load on her while she screams and flap-runs through the snow. "Eeee!" Your first attempted snow-dump only catches her tail, but it's still enough to make [freja.name] squeal and flail, falling face-first into the snow with a 'pbblt!'. She goes still for a few moments, and there's a genuine moment of panic, thinking that your draconic daughter's hurt herself... at least until you hear the special giggle of someone who thinks they're being very sneaky. Well, you might as well indulge... "[freja.name]?" you call out, stomping close with a little extra motion, swinging your arms mechanically. And then you are surprised, when a gigantic cloud of steam washes over you from a fiery sneeze, melting the snow pile she'd been intending to blast you with. "Bleh!" [freja.name] gasps and splutters, hopping to her feet in a sodden ball of red scale and wet hair. "Oopsers." ...And then she catches a snowball in the face from you; it's only fair, that steam soaked you more than a snowball ever could've. She laughs and runs away, trying to build up fortifications to make return-fire. All of her excited laughter, along with the floofed-up black hair, deep red scales, and steam-cloudiness draws plenty of attention... and it proves only a matter of time before you and a few of the boreal parents are being pelted by an armada of child snowballs, with a cackling [freja.name] stood on a snowy rampart like some mighty commander. The dramatic stance does eventually melt through the impromptu fortification however, and the parent-offensive redoubles. You charge forward, arms wide, and scoop [freja.name] into your arms, hefting her skyward amongst the falling snowflakes while she giggles and flaps her wings. At which point you're utterly drenched when the movement wrings half a lake of melted snow out of your daughter's soaked sweater. "I think..." you gasp, hefting the still-laughing dragonling under one arm like luggage, "it's time to go dry off." Telling [freja.name] you can tell that she's tired wouldn't help either, and so you add "plus, [pc.mf|dad|mom]'s tired. Shall we go do something else?" |[freja.name] hits the park like a woman who knows what she wants; to create a child army of snowballers, and to pelt every adult in range. It's an impressive feat for a girl her size, in the midst of the falling snow — up near to her waist in the thicker snowdrifts — to even gather so many other kids up. Especially for a girl of her... actual age; it's often hard to tell what her perceived age is, thanks to whatever inter-dimensional alchemy is at work on her. It's selfish to think, you know, but watching her roar and flap like some old beast of legend while the young boreals scamper and laugh, you want these younger years to last so, so much longer for her. You want this lovely dragonling to live as incomprehensibly long as the dragons of yore, and bring warmth to countless lives. Maybe she will; you've no real way of knowing. While your thoughts are hovering between fondness and melancholic, that doesn't last for long; [freja.name] has succeeded in gathering her forces, and a snowball bounces off of your shoulder while you duck for cover. You're not the only grownup under fire too, and a number of flush-faced elves are ducking away from the concerted assault. One of the younger-looking mothers looks up at you [aileh.wintercity|and Aileh, ]and grins, "your daughter, right? You know my kids were so excited to see a dragon last time." Your breast swells with pride just in time to be brought crashing back down to reality, and for your [pc.ears] to be filled with snow as your daughter directs a handful of her newly-radicalized infant goons into pelting you. "I am the dragon queeeeen!" [freja.name] cheers, to the warcries of children both younger and older. [aileh.wintercity|"Oh my gods our baby is so precious I'm going to fucking die." Aileh absolutely beams with delight. Right before you draft her into building up snow mounds for you as the child-pelting continues.] The parent legion does everything that it can to put up barricades, but you're far outnumbered, and guerrilla squads of children keep rushing around in the snowdrifts to pelt you from the sides. It's a valiant battle, but you're unfortunately left with no choice but unconditional surrender. Not to mention all of this snow is starting to make 'the dragon queen' look overly drenched and bedraggled. Far better to call it now while you've been lucky to avoid any injuries. "I accept your surrender!" [freja.name] proudly poses, hands on hips, while there's yet another cheer from the rest of the kids. "Alright, 'Queen [freja.name], how about we get you dried up a little?" "Okidokie!" she turns around and faces the rest of the boreal kids and waves, smiling brightly. "I love you, buh-bye!" Most of the other parents — looking similarly soaked — collect their children too, but there are plenty of smiles on their faces. "Did you have fun?" you ask, attempting to straighten her hair out a little. That endless floofiness has been, at least temporarily, flattened down by snowmelt. You're sure in a matter of minutes she'll be a poofball again, though. [aileh.wintercity|Aileh looks delighted, though just as soaked. Her cloak is drenched flat against her back and giving off steam while she tries to shake it clean. "[freja.name] sweetie, I will never stop being proud of you. Clearly you've got a lot of 'general' in you, huh?" "Queen General!!" [freja.name] proudly announces with a damp flap of her wings, and a smug smile on her toothy, precocious maw. "Are you still a general mommy?" "Eeeh... in name, but I don't do any, uh, general-ing. I love being close to home, and you." Aileh nearly goes in for the hug, but your daughter is still drenched. "Okay, dry time now, though."] ] [freja.name] giggles when you[aileh.wintercity| both] make a quick snow-shelter and wring her clothes out, before pulling them quickly back over her. The rest of her residual draconic heat should steam the flappy sweater dry, but it doesn't hurt to give her a head-start. "Oookay, what next?"

All of her excited laughter, along with the floofed-up black hair, deep red scales, and steam-cloudiness draws plenty of attention... and it proves only a matter of time before you and a few of the boreal parents are being pelted by an armada of child snowballs, with a cackling [freja.name] stood on a snowy rampart like some mighty commander. The dramatic stance does eventually melt through the impromptu fortification however, and the parent-offensive redoubles. You charge forward, arms wide, and scoop [freja.name] into your arms, hefting her skyward amongst the falling snowflakes while she giggles and flaps her wings. At which point you're utterly drenched when the movement wrings half a lake of melted snow out of your daughter's soaked sweater. "I think..." you gasp, hefting the still-laughing dragonling under one arm like luggage, "it's time to go dry off." Telling [freja.name] you can tell that she's tired wouldn't help either, and so you add "plus, [pc.mf|dad|mom]'s tired. Shall we go do something else?" |[freja.name] hits the park like a woman who knows what she wants; to create a child army of snowballers, and to pelt every adult in range. It's an impressive feat for a girl her size, in the midst of the falling snow — up near to her waist in the thicker snowdrifts — to even gather so many other kids up. Especially for a girl of her... actual age; it's often hard to tell what her perceived age is, thanks to whatever inter-dimensional alchemy is at work on her. It's selfish to think, you know, but watching her roar and flap like some old beast of legend while the young boreals scamper and laugh, you want these younger years to last so, so much longer for her. You want this lovely dragonling to live as incomprehensibly long as the dragons of yore, and bring warmth to countless lives. Maybe she will; you've no real way of knowing. While your thoughts are hovering between fondness and melancholic, that doesn't last for long; [freja.name] has succeeded in gathering her forces, and a snowball bounces off of your shoulder while you duck for cover. You're not the only grownup under fire too, and a number of flush-faced elves are ducking away from the concerted assault. One of the younger-looking mothers looks up at you [aileh.wintercity|and Aileh, ]and grins, "your daughter, right? You know my kids were so excited to see a dragon last time." Your breast swells with pride just in time to be brought crashing back down to reality, and for your [pc.ears] to be filled with snow as your daughter directs a handful of her newly-radicalized infant goons into pelting you. "I am the dragon queeeeen!" [freja.name] cheers, to the warcries of children both younger and older. [aileh.wintercity|"Oh my gods our baby is so precious I'm going to fucking die." Aileh absolutely beams with delight. Right before you draft her into building up snow mounds for you as the child-pelting continues.] The parent legion does everything that it can to put up barricades, but you're far outnumbered, and guerrilla squads of children keep rushing around in the snowdrifts to pelt you from the sides. It's a valiant battle, but you're unfortunately left with no choice but unconditional surrender. Not to mention all of this snow is starting to make 'the dragon queen' look overly drenched and bedraggled. Far better to call it now while you've been lucky to avoid any injuries. "I accept your surrender!" [freja.name] proudly poses, hands on hips, while there's yet another cheer from the rest of the kids. "Alright, 'Queen [freja.name], how about we get you dried up a little?" "Okidokie!" she turns around and faces the rest of the boreal kids and waves, smiling brightly. "I love you, buh-bye!" Most of the other parents — looking similarly soaked — collect their children too, but there are plenty of smiles on their faces. "Did you have fun?" you ask, attempting to straighten her hair out a little. That endless floofiness has been, at least temporarily, flattened down by snowmelt. You're sure in a matter of minutes she'll be a poofball again, though. [aileh.wintercity|Aileh looks delighted, though just as soaked. Her cloak is drenched flat against her back and giving off steam while she tries to shake it clean. "[freja.name] sweetie, I will never stop being proud of you. Clearly you've got a lot of 'general' in you, huh?" "Queen General!!" [freja.name] proudly announces with a damp flap of her wings, and a smug smile on her toothy, precocious maw. "Are you still a general mommy?" "Eeeh... in name, but I don't do any, uh, general-ing. I love being close to home, and you." Aileh nearly goes in for the hug, but your daughter is still drenched. "Okay, dry time now, though."] ] [freja.name] giggles when you[aileh.wintercity| both] make a quick snow-shelter and wring her clothes out, before pulling them quickly back over her. The rest of her residual draconic heat should steam the flappy sweater dry, but it doesn't hurt to give her a head-start. "Oookay, what next?"'

rows.original: [var0 |You had expected to be hit square-on by the smell of fish, but there's a beautifully rustic smell that rides on the back of it, and mellows out its potency. There are a number of stews on a bed of low coals in one corner of the restaurant, while fishtanks line the opposite wall next to a bar counter, where a few patrons sit and drink while waiting for the table or friends. It's with surprising adroitness that a neatly-dressed, seven-foot-tall elven man sidles over to you with a smile. "Welcome, can I interest the two of you in a table?" "Yes!" [freja.name] proudly announces, still steaming away the falling snow. You reach down and ruffle her hair, making her wiggle and hiss while the waiter leads you on. "What do you serve?" you ask, sitting down at a little booth opposite your daughter. The waiter smiles and waves around the room, indicating the fish tanks. "Well, we do fish, as you might expect. You pick one, and then we prepare it for you either on a fried bread, or roasted bed of crushed potatoes. We've got a cheese sauce made from goat's milk, and we serve plenty of spiced stews as well." [freja.name] openly drools, picking up cutlery and looking half-tempted to bang it on the table until you give her a look. "Spicy! Lotsaspice!" "Extra spice? We can do that, but are you sure? It might be a bit bitter—" when [freja.name]'s response is a little burp of smoke, the waiter doesn't lose a beat. "Very well, we can do that. Want to pick a fish?" Your daughter looks between him and you, eyes inquisitive. "Go ahead, pick one for me too, okay love?" "Yess..." [freja.name] puts her cutlery back down, hops from her chair, and follows after the tall elf with an excited wiggle. She 'ums' and 'ah's while someone else brings tea for you both... but when you move to pay the waitress for her service she just shakes her head. Apparently you're allowed to eat for free here; [etheryn.crowned|Queen's|Princess'] orders, you suppose. When your draconic sweetie returns to her chair, she looks incredibly pleased with herself. "So many fishies, I didn't know which to choose..." "So what did you choose?" [freja.name] giggles, little wings flapping. "Issa secret [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]." Thankfully dinner doesn't remain a mystery for long; the original waiter returns while the two of you sip tea, and delivers a giant platter of snow crab, with gravy boats full of — presumably very — spicy sauce, and two plates of roasted crispy potato to serve the crab and gravy onto. "Enjoy, and let me know if you need anything else," he says, before heading off. To your surprise, [freja.name] doesn't immediately pounce on the meal... and then with burning red cheeks, and twiddling fingers, and a drooling mouth, she grumbles "can you cut it please [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]." It's easy to forget that her independence can only go so far, but it's nice to be needed. You stand up so that you can dig into the crab for her, adding servings to her plate of potatoes before pouring the spicy, buttery gravy across it all. And then she pounces. Her eyes actually water a little at the spicy gravy, but there's no stopping her from ravenously consuming as though she'd not eaten for hours. In fairness, the chill of the Winter City does work up an appetite. The two of you get a chance to enjoy a little people-watching, before making the contents of your plates vanish. [freja.name] polishes off her plate in record time, pausing only to throw her head back and hiss, exhaling a little smoke. In fairness, plenty of people watch you as opposed to the other way around, which means you're forced to smile politely each time you accidentally make eye-contact with someone. After half an hour of eating, and drinking tea, you're finished... albeit with a tongue that's positively burning. [freja.name] on the other hand looks as though her furnace has been thoroughly stoked by the spices, constantly smacking her lips with a pleased expression. "[pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy]? Next time we should eat with Mom!" Agreed, you're sure your draconic girlfriend would approve of the food too. When the waiter comes around to take your plates, he appears delighted with their relative emptiness. "Did you enjoy?" "Yes!" [freja.name] cheers, beaming a smile at him. It takes her a second before she — very proudly for remembering — thanks him for the meal. "I'll pass your thanks along to the chef. Please, come again soon." |[aileh.wintercity |Aileh sucks in a deep, satisfied breath, holding [freja.name]'s left hand, while you hold the dragonling's right. She swings happily between the two of you, eyes already on the fish swimming around in their tanks. "I love the smell of heavy spices, I don't think I could go back to eating simple travel food anymore." "Rations are adventure-food though!" [freja.name] pouts, wings flapping a little. Your girlfriend blinks, trying to parse the phrase. "I... suppose so?" Maybe you need to take [freja.name] camping some time, and eat rations together. She'd probably get sick of them fast. While your thoughts are grinding on, a waitress — a young slip of a thing — approaches you with a smile, and a pitcher of water. |You quickly catch the sight of a waitress as you enter, who approaches with a smile, and a pitcher of water. ] "Grab a seat anywhere, we're always happy to serve the champion and [pc.mf|his|her] family!" "Thank you!" [freja.name] beams up at her, squeezing your hand[aileh.wintercity|s]. The [aileh.wintercity|three|two] of you pick a comfortable booth so that there's plenty of space to watch the rest of the world go by through the restaurant's main window. Water is left for you, with chunks of ice still floating in the liquid, and a series of glasses are laid out. It doesn't take long for a familiar elven waiter-man to approach, still as impressive and vikingr as usual. His beard is neatly cropped, his hair's bound in tight skull-braids at the top, and shorn on the sides. He looks as though he should be digging into a fight, axe and nail... instead his face is an open smile, and he bows his head respectfully to [freja.name] like a little princess. "Would the lady like to select her [aileh.wintercity|parents'|parent's] meal?" "Yes!" "Extra-spicy?" "Uh-huh!" [aileh.wintercity |Aileh's got a delighted smile on her face, watching her daughter confidently make for the fish tanks. "I love this, you know, dear heart. You're just the sweetest for this, and [freja.name] loves it too." You grin and give your girlfriend's hand a little squeeze, feeling her tail hug your leg beneath the table. ]It takes [freja.name] a few minutes to choose, before eventually settling on something and heading back. She's already starting to salivate, having gotten closer to the kitchens, and in sniffing range of whatever powerful peppers they have hiding back there. "I couldn't help it I picked crab and taters again! We can always get fishies back home!" [aileh.wintercity |"Mhm, it's easy enough to fish for more, the giant snow crabs though? That's something we'll only ever get here." Aileh agrees with a firm nod, incredibly proud of her little girl's reasoning skills. Or at least her willingness to make an excuse that sounds reasonable, to go along with the thing she wants— or as it's sometimes called, diplomacy. |Your daughter's ability to reason — or at least put a reasoning-sounding-spin on her desires — fills you with pride. ] Unaware of just how much endearment she's earning, [freja.name] flap-leaps back up into her chair and gets comfy while the waiter brings you tea and passes on your order. You [aileh.wintercity|all|both] look outside the window, watching as people travel back-and-forth while thick fluffy snow falls from sleet-gray skies. The way the snow frames the edges of this thick glass... which is a tremendous commodity, now that you think about it, makes the outside seem like an entirely different world. And then you're brought back to your own reality by the arrival of hot tea, a dish of cream, and a humongous, still-sizzling snow crab. It takes a second trip to fetch your plates; [aileh.wintercity |two of roasted spiced potatoes, and one of fried bread for Aileh |two covered in roasted spiced potatoes, laid out in a bed for you to serve your crab on ]. Once more, [freja.name] gives the waiter a polite "thanky-you!" when he places down the boat of incredibly-spicy-gravy, and waits for you to prepare the crab for her. You serve up crab meat for [aileh.wintercity|the whole table|the both of you], and then dig into the meal with gusto. It's wholly uninterrupted family time, with pauses taken only for [freja.name][aileh.wintercity| and Aileh] to pause and gently belch a little smoke before continuing. Sweat beads on your forehead from the spices, but the rich flavors and luscious crab meat keep you going throughout. By the time you're finished, every one of your limbs is tingling, your [pc.ears] feel like they're giving off excess heat. But the sensation has you feeling alive. "That was super-tasty," [freja.name] agrees with your wordless sigh of satisfaction. [aileh.wintercity |"Agreed, I wish I could cook like that. Luckily the beegirl back home does a better job than me, huh?" "I like your eggytoast." [freja.name] nods proudly, as though Aileh insinuating she were anything but a fantastic cook were a grave personal insult. "Heh, I know you do sweetie. What would you rather have; eggytoast, or snow crab?" Now your daughter is undone; she has to choose between lying, or pride. "Both," she eventually decides. Fuck she's just too clever. Aileh bursts out laughing, before pulling up her cloak's hood when that garners a few looks. "A-hem. Anyway, shall we get going?" |"I suppose now, it's the question of what we do next?" You reach over and muss [freja.name]'s hair, before climbing out of your seats with warm, full bellies. ] ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你原本以为会闻到浓重的鱼腥味，但实际上，这种气味中还带着一种朴实而迷人的香气，使得整体味道变得更为柔和。在餐厅的某个角落，一些炖菜正在低矮的炭火上烹制；而另一侧墙壁上则排列着鱼缸，旁边是吧台，有几位顾客坐在那里边喝酒边等待座位或朋友的到来。 一个衣着整洁、身高七英尺的精灵男子，以出人意料的敏捷身手走到你面前，微笑着说道：“欢迎光临，两位需要预订一张桌子吗？” “当然需要！ [freja.name] 我们自豪地宣布——此时，落雪仍在纷纷飘落。你伸手轻抚她的头发，她立刻扭动身体、发出“嘶嘶”的声响，而服务员则引领你向前走去。 “你们提供什么食物？”你坐在女儿对面的小隔间里问道。 服务员微笑着在房间里四处示意，指向那些鱼缸。“嗯，正如你们所料，我们确实提供鱼类菜肴。你们可以选择一种鱼，然后我们会用炸面包或烤土豆泥来为你们制作这道菜。我们还配有用山羊奶制成的奶酪酱，同时也提供许多加了香料的炖菜。" [freja.name] 她张着嘴流口水，拿起餐具，看起来差点就要把它们摔在桌子上，直到你看了她一眼。“太辣了！辣味太足了！” “再加些辣味吗？当然可以，但你确定吗？这样可能会有点苦 [freja.name]他的回答只是一阵轻烟般的回应，但服务员丝毫没有慌乱。“好的，我们可以这么办。您想选哪种鱼吗？” 您的女儿好奇地注视着他和您，眼中充满疑问。“爸爸，也帮我选一种吧，好吗？” “好啊 [freja.name] 她把餐具放回原处，从椅子上跳下来，兴奋地摇着尾巴跟在那个高个子的精灵后面。当有人为你们俩端来茶水时，她不停地“嗯”啊着……但当你想要付钱给服务员表示感谢时，她却只是摇了摇头。 看来在这里，你是可以免费吃饭的啊 [etheryn.crowned|女王的|公主的] 命令，你猜的没错。 当你的那个龙形宠物回到它的座位上时，它看起来对自己非常满意。那么 好多鱼啊，我都不知道该选哪一条……” “那又怎样？ 做了 由你来选择吧？ [freja.name] 咯咯笑着，小翅膀扑腾着：“这是个秘密哦。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]幸运的是，晚餐并没有持续太久就揭晓了；当你们俩一边喝茶时，原来的服务员回来了，他端来了一大盘雪蟹，还有装满调味酱的碟子——想必是用来搭配雪蟹吃的。 非常 辣酱，还有两盘烤脆土豆，用来搭配螃蟹和肉汁一起食用。请尽情享用，如果还需要什么，随时告诉我，”他说完便离开了。 令你惊讶的是 [freja.name] 她并不会立刻扑上去吃掉食物……然后，脸颊涨得通红，手指不停地扭来扭去，嘴里还流着口水，她才会嘟囔着：“你能把它切好一点吗？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]人们很容易忘记，她的独立能力也是有限度的，但被人需要确实是一件令人愉快的事情。你会站起身来，为她挖出螃蟹，再往她盘里的土豆上添加更多的食物，最后再淋上那香辣可口的黄油肉汁。 而 然后 她迫不及待地扑了上去。那辣味的肉汁让她的眼睛都有点湿润了，但她还是狼吞虎咽地吃了起来，仿佛已经好几个小时没吃东西一样。说实在的，冬城的寒冷确实会让人胃口大开。 你们俩也有机会好好观察周围的人，然后再把盘子里的食物一扫而空。 [freja.name] 她以惊人的速度吃光了盘子里的食物，只偶尔仰头发出“嘶”的一声，同时呼出一缕烟雾。公平地说，有很多人都在看着这一幕。 你 与相反的情况相比，后者意味着每次不小心与别人对视时，你都不得不礼貌地微笑。 吃了半个小时的食物，喝了半个小时的茶，终于吃完了……不过此时你的舌头简直像是在燃烧一样难受。 [freja.name] 另一方面，看起来那些香料为她增添了无穷的活力，她总是满意地舔着嘴唇。[pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]下次我们还是和妈妈一起吃饭吧！”
