|艾莉深深地吸了一口气，脸上露出满足的表情，然后紧紧地握住了手中的东西。 [freja.name]你握住小龙的右手，而我则牵着它的左手。它在你们两人中间开心地摇来摇去，眼睛却一直盯着水族箱里游来游去的鱼。‘我喜欢那种浓郁香料的味道，我想我再也无法适应吃那些简单的旅行食品了。’” “不过，口粮其实就是一种冒险食品啊！ [freja.name] 撅着嘴，翅膀微微扑动。 你的女朋友眨了眨眼，试图理解这句话的意思。“我……应该是吧？” 也许你需要好好解释一下。 [freja.name] 他们一起露营一段时间，还一起吃口粮。不过她很可能很快就会对这些感到厌烦。 就在你思绪纷乱的时候，一位年轻的女服务员微笑着走到你面前，递给你一壶水。 |一进门，你立刻看到了一位女服务员，她微笑着走了过来，同时还拿着一壶水。 ] 随便找个地方坐下吧，我们总是很乐意为这位冠军服务的。 [pc.mf|他的|她] 家人！” “谢谢！ [freja.name] 微笑着看着她，紧紧握住她的手。[aileh.wintercity|s]这个 [aileh.wintercity|三|两个] 你们可以挑选一个舒适的座位，这样就有足够的空间通过餐厅的主窗户观看外面的景象。水已经准备好了，里面还漂浮着冰块，同时也准备了一排杯子供你们使用。 不久之后，一位熟悉的精灵侍者走了过来，他依旧像往常一样英武潇洒。他的胡须修剪得整整齐齐，头上的头发被紧紧地编成发带，两侧的头发也被剪短了。他看起来简直就像是一个随时准备投入战斗的人，手持斧头，准备一决高下。相反，他的脸上挂着灿烂的笑容，还恭敬地低下了头。 [freja.name] 像个小公主一样。“这位女士是否愿意挑选她自己喜欢的 [aileh.wintercity|父母的|父母的] 吃饭了吗？” “吃了！” “要特别辣的吗？” “当然要！ [aileh.wintercity |艾莱脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容，看着女儿自信地走向鱼缸。“我真喜欢这样，你知道的，亲爱的。你做这件事的时候，真的最可爱了 [freja.name] 我也非常喜欢。” 你微笑着轻轻捏了捏女朋友的手，感觉到她在桌子底下用尾巴蹭着你的腿。 ]这需要 [freja.name] 她花了几分钟时间挑选，最终选定了某样东西，然后便转身回去。随着她越来越接近厨房，那些被藏在那里的辛辣辣椒散发出的气味也进入了她的嗅觉范围，让她不禁开始流口水。“我实在忍不住，又选了螃蟹和土豆！不过回家后我们总还能买到鱼吧！ [aileh.wintercity |嗯，再弄些来其实挺容易的，不过那些巨大的雪蟹……那可是只有在这里才能找到的。”艾莉坚定地点了点头，她为自己女儿的推理能力感到无比自豪。至少，她愿意想出一些听起来合理的借口，来达成自己想要的目标——也就是人们常说的‘外交技巧’吧。 |你女儿的推理能力——或者至少是她能够将自己的愿望用看似合理的理由来表达——让你感到无比自豪。 ] 她完全没有意识到自己赢得了人们如此多的喜爱与喜爱之情。 [freja.name] 她迅速坐回椅子里，找了个舒服的姿势，这时服务员端来了茶水，并告知了你点的菜已经上来了。你 [aileh.wintercity|所有|两者都] 你望着窗外的景象，看着人们来来往往地穿梭在道路上，而厚厚的雪花正从灰蒙蒙的天空纷纷落下。那些雪花映照在这层厚厚的玻璃上……仔细想来，玻璃其实是一种极其珍贵的资源，它让外面的世界看起来仿佛完全是一个不同的世界。 然后，热茶、一碟奶油，以及一只还冒着热气的巨大雪蟹，将你拉回了现实。你还得再去拿一次盘子才行。 [aileh.wintercity |为Aileh准备两份烤香料土豆，以及一份炸面包。 |两块裹着烤香料土豆的螃蟹，被摆放在盘中，方便你将螃蟹取出来食用。 ]再一次， [freja.name] 当服务员端来那碗辣味十足的酱汁时，她会礼貌地说道“谢谢！”然后等待你为她准备螃蟹。 接着，你将螃蟹肉端上桌。 rows.raw: ' [var0 |You had expected to be hit square-on by the smell of fish, but there's a beautifully rustic smell that rides on the back of it, and mellows out its potency. There are a number of stews on a bed of low coals in one corner of the restaurant, while fishtanks line the opposite wall next to a bar counter, where a few patrons sit and drink while waiting for the table or friends. It's with surprising adroitness that a neatly-dressed, seven-foot-tall elven man sidles over to you with a smile. "Welcome, can I interest the two of you in a table?" "Yes!" [freja.name] proudly announces, still steaming away the falling snow. You reach down and ruffle her hair, making her wiggle and hiss while the waiter leads you on. "What do you serve?" you ask, sitting down at a little booth opposite your daughter. The waiter smiles and waves around the room, indicating the fish tanks. "Well, we do fish, as you might expect. You pick one, and then we prepare it for you either on a fried bread, or roasted bed of crushed potatoes. We've got a cheese sauce made from goat's milk, and we serve plenty of spiced stews as well." [freja.name] openly drools, picking up cutlery and looking half-tempted to bang it on the table until you give her a look. "Spicy! Lotsaspice!" "Extra spice? We can do that, but are you sure? It might be a bit bitter—" when [freja.name]'s response is a little burp of smoke, the waiter doesn't lose a beat. "Very well, we can do that. Want to pick a fish?" Your daughter looks between him and you, eyes inquisitive. "Go ahead, pick one for me too, okay love?" "Yess..." [freja.name] puts her cutlery back down, hops from her chair, and follows after the tall elf with an excited wiggle. She 'ums' and 'ah's while someone else brings tea for you both... but when you move to pay the waitress for her service she just shakes her head. Apparently you're allowed to eat for free here; [etheryn.crowned|Queen's|Princess'] orders, you suppose. When your draconic sweetie returns to her chair, she looks incredibly pleased with herself. "So many fishies, I didn't know which to choose..." "So what did you choose?" [freja.name] giggles, little wings flapping. "Issa secret [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]." Thankfully dinner doesn't remain a mystery for long; the original waiter returns while the two of you sip tea, and delivers a giant platter of snow crab, with gravy boats full of — presumably very — spicy sauce, and two plates of roasted crispy potato to serve the crab and gravy onto. "Enjoy, and let me know if you need anything else," he says, before heading off. To your surprise, [freja.name] doesn't immediately pounce on the meal... and then with burning red cheeks, and twiddling fingers, and a drooling mouth, she grumbles "can you cut it please [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]." It's easy to forget that her independence can only go so far, but it's nice to be needed. You stand up so that you can dig into the crab for her, adding servings to her plate of potatoes before pouring the spicy, buttery gravy across it all. And then she pounces. Her eyes actually water a little at the spicy gravy, but there's no stopping her from ravenously consuming as though she'd not eaten for hours. In fairness, the chill of the Winter City does work up an appetite. The two of you get a chance to enjoy a little people-watching, before making the contents of your plates vanish. [freja.name] polishes off her plate in record time, pausing only to throw her head back and hiss, exhaling a little smoke. In fairness, plenty of people watch you as opposed to the other way around, which means you're forced to smile politely each time you accidentally make eye-contact with someone. After half an hour of eating, and drinking tea, you're finished... albeit with a tongue that's positively burning. [freja.name] on the other hand looks as though her furnace has been thoroughly stoked by the spices, constantly smacking her lips with a pleased expression. "[pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy]? Next time we should eat with Mom!" Agreed, you're sure your draconic girlfriend would approve of the food too. When the waiter comes around to take your plates, he appears delighted with their relative emptiness. "Did you enjoy?" "Yes!" [freja.name] cheers, beaming a smile at him. It takes her a second before she — very proudly for remembering — thanks him for the meal. "I'll pass your thanks along to the chef. Please, come again soon." |[aileh.wintercity |Aileh sucks in a deep, satisfied breath, holding [freja.name]'s left hand, while you hold the dragonling's right. She swings happily between the two of you, eyes already on the fish swimming around in their tanks. "I love the smell of heavy spices, I don't think I could go back to eating simple travel food anymore." "Rations are adventure-food though!" [freja.name] pouts, wings flapping a little. Your girlfriend blinks, trying to parse the phrase. "I... suppose so?" Maybe you need to take [freja.name] camping some time, and eat rations together. She'd probably get sick of them fast. While your thoughts are grinding on, a waitress — a young slip of a thing — approaches you with a smile, and a pitcher of water. |You quickly catch the sight of a waitress as you enter, who approaches with a smile, and a pitcher of water. ] "Grab a seat anywhere, we're always happy to serve the champion and [pc.mf|his|her] family!" "Thank you!" [freja.name] beams up at her, squeezing your hand[aileh.wintercity|s]. The [aileh.wintercity|three|two] of you pick a comfortable booth so that there's plenty of space to watch the rest of the world go by through the restaurant's main window. Water is left for you, with chunks of ice still floating in the liquid, and a series of glasses are laid out. It doesn't take long for a familiar elven waiter-man to approach, still as impressive and vikingr as usual. His beard is neatly cropped, his hair's bound in tight skull-braids at the top, and shorn on the sides. He looks as though he should be digging into a fight, axe and nail... instead his face is an open smile, and he bows his head respectfully to [freja.name] like a little princess. "Would the lady like to select her [aileh.wintercity|parents'|parent's] meal?" "Yes!" "Extra-spicy?" "Uh-huh!" [aileh.wintercity |Aileh's got a delighted smile on her face, watching her daughter confidently make for the fish tanks. "I love this, you know, dear heart. You're just the sweetest for this, and [freja.name] loves it too." You grin and give your girlfriend's hand a little squeeze, feeling her tail hug your leg beneath the table. ]It takes [freja.name] a few minutes to choose, before eventually settling on something and heading back. She's already starting to salivate, having gotten closer to the kitchens, and in sniffing range of whatever powerful peppers they have hiding back there. "I couldn't help it I picked crab and taters again! We can always get fishies back home!" [aileh.wintercity |"Mhm, it's easy enough to fish for more, the giant snow crabs though? That's something we'll only ever get here." Aileh agrees with a firm nod, incredibly proud of her little girl's reasoning skills. Or at least her willingness to make an excuse that sounds reasonable, to go along with the thing she wants— or as it's sometimes called, diplomacy. |Your daughter's ability to reason — or at least put a reasoning-sounding-spin on her desires — fills you with pride. ] Unaware of just how much endearment she's earning, [freja.name] flap-leaps back up into her chair and gets comfy while the waiter brings you tea and passes on your order. You [aileh.wintercity|all|both] look outside the window, watching as people travel back-and-forth while thick fluffy snow falls from sleet-gray skies. The way the snow frames the edges of this thick glass... which is a tremendous commodity, now that you think about it, makes the outside seem like an entirely different world. And then you're brought back to your own reality by the arrival of hot tea, a dish of cream, and a humongous, still-sizzling snow crab. It takes a second trip to fetch your plates; [aileh.wintercity |two of roasted spiced potatoes, and one of fried bread for Aileh |two covered in roasted spiced potatoes, laid out in a bed for you to serve your crab on ]. Once more, [freja.name] gives the waiter a polite "thanky-you!" when he places down the boat of incredibly-spicy-gravy, and waits for you to prepare the crab for her. You serve up crab meat for [aileh.wintercity|the whole table|the both of you], and then dig into the meal with gusto. It's wholly uninterrupted family time, with pauses taken only for [freja.name][aileh.wintercity| and Aileh] to pause and gently belch a little smoke before continuing. Sweat beads on your forehead from the spices, but the rich flavors and luscious crab meat keep you going throughout. By the time you're finished, every one of your limbs is tingling, your [pc.ears] feel like they're giving off excess heat. But the sensation has you feeling alive. "That was super-tasty," [freja.name] agrees with your wordless sigh of satisfaction. [aileh.wintercity |"Agreed, I wish I could cook like that. Luckily the beegirl back home does a better job than me, huh?" "I like your eggytoast." [freja.name] nods proudly, as though Aileh insinuating she were anything but a fantastic cook were a grave personal insult. "Heh, I know you do sweetie. What would you rather have; eggytoast, or snow crab?" Now your daughter is undone; she has to choose between lying, or pride. "Both," she eventually decides. Fuck she's just too clever. Aileh bursts out laughing, before pulling up her cloak's hood when that garners a few looks. "A-hem. Anyway, shall we get going?" |"I suppose now, it's the question of what we do next?" You reach over and muss [freja.name]'s hair, before climbing out of your seats with warm, full bellies. ] ]'

rows.original: [var0 |[freja.name] holds onto your hand tightly, eyes wide at the sight of a stall whose colors stand out magnificently to the slate-gray of the snow-laden sky. Pale pink has been painted onto the stall's stone exterior, with wooden siding all the way around. Most buildings have some amount of heating in them in the city, despite the inhabitants being largely immune to the natural chill; it just wouldn't do to have everything freezing, and dark, and miserable. In this case, there's only one illuminating lamp in the roof of the stall, and your breath continues to fog even as you enter — while yet more steam rolls off of [freja.name]. She gasps in such delight you're afraid she'll cough up a mouthful of fire, but instead the cheerful child scampers up to the stall's counter and hippy-hops on the spot. "These look so cool!" "Of course they should, they're ice cream!" A young elven man — perhaps only a teenager — leans over the counter to wave down at her, crossing his arms beneath his chest. "What can I get you cutie?" "What do you make?" "Oh, well, we have milk that's churned up with syrup from trees, and that turns into a soft tasty cold thing. And we have another one that's from great big blocks of clear ice that's shaved down by a bunch of handsome burly dudes with axes every morning, that we pour syrups or crush some fruits onto. "What kindsafruits?" "Mostly wild berries, but we occasionally get in some nice apples from the southern portions of the forest, or Harvest Valley these days. That route opening up has been amazing for business." "Ah-uuuh... [pc.mf|daddy|mommy] which should I get?" [freja.name] turns around and faces you, looking — for once — completely struck by indecision. "We can just get one of each, and share." "Yes!" [freja.name] lets you scoop her up and you hold her couched under one arm and against your hip for support so that she can actually see properly over the counter. A thick, ceramic jar is dug into with a spoon, and the contents served up into a thin dish of carved ice... "You'll have to be quick so that it doesn't melt, but the bowl should hold up for long enough." Both of you dig in with gusto, humming with satisfaction as the frozen treat is delivered to your tongue and melts into smooth creaminess, or crisp sweetness. And then the brain-freeze sets in. You wince and grit your teeth, bouncing your heels a few times as the sensation takes its sweet time moving on. "What was that?" "Oh! Right, yes. Been a while since I've seen a foreigner eat iced-cream. You'll be fine you just had it too fast." "But I ate even quicker!" [freja.name] pokes her now syrup-colored tongue out with a soft 'aaah', and the vendor laughs. "I guess you're warm enough to beat the freeze. Probably for the best, it looks unfun." You only grunt your agreement. All too soon, the frosted sweets are finished, and [freja.name] is looking up at you with expectant eyes. "Can we have more?" "Absolutely not, your mom'll tell us off." [freja.name] giggles, letting you slide her down from your hip so that she's stood on two claws again. "Ooookay. Thank you mister I love you bye-bye!" "Take care, young miss." |[aileh.wintercity |When you make for the painted exterior of the ice-cream stall, Aileh scoops [freja.name] into her arms and gives her a smooch on the cheek. "Which should we get, sweetie?" "Uuuh, the sweetest!" "Not the creamiest?" Aileh teases, holding her aloft and brushing melting snow off before returning the dragonling to her hip as you enter. "Ooooh... can we do both? [pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy] said we could do both last time." Aileh quirks a brow at you, and you shrug; you always cave for this girl. It proves to be persuasive enough, at least, or perhaps it's just the sight of a happy couple leaving with a dish of shaved ice, and ice cream between them and looking satisfied. "Alright, fine." "Yesss..." [freja.name] cheer-hisses. |"Treat time?" You scoop [freja.name] up and hold her against your hip, and she clings to you with a happy little wiggle. "Yes! Can we do both again?" "Of course we can," you grin wickedly. "Just remember to say thank you." "Thank you!" ] She's jumping the gun a little, but you only squeeze tighter and enter. The inside's dim and freezing cold, but the warmth of your daughter pressed against your side is like a little furnace. "Go ahead and order, sweetie." "Oh! Uuuh, one icy-creams, and one shaved ice please and thank you!" [freja.name] is in such a rush that she gets all of her manners out of the way first, which is an expeditiousness you can really get behind. The treats are much as you'd experienced before; creamy, sweet, and tangy. You're careful not to eat too fast, as your own insides aren't fire-pit warm, and you're a lot more prone to brainfreeze than the greedily-nomming, and happily-hissing dragonlet you're hugging with your other arm. The sweets are served in dishes of ice, but there's no fear of them melting before you're finished; you maybe only manage a couple of bites yourself before [freja.name] finishes the whole lot... but she's happy, and that's plenty of joy already. "That was super-tasty, I want icy-creams all the time." "You'd get fat if you did that," the young man at the counter insists. "But I won't turn down additional sales." "Afraid not, cutie," you hug [freja.name] again and let her down, returning what remains of the ice-dishes to the counter for disposal. "We definitely don't want you getting fat." "I can't get fat I'mma dragon!" "I bet dragons can get fat," you tease. [ashe.around| "Can not." Ashe huffs in your head, though her petulant tone leads you to believe otherwise.] "Nuh-uuuh..." [freja.name] pouts, "but okay! What now?" ]
rows.translation: [var0 |[freja.name] 她紧紧握着你的手，当看到那个色彩格外鲜艳的摊位时，她的眼睛瞪得大大的——在被积雪覆盖的灰蒙蒙的天空中，那些色彩显得格外醒目。那个摊位的石制外壁被涂成了淡粉色，四周则用木板围了起来。 在这座城市里，大多数建筑都配备了供暖系统，因为居民们大多已经习惯了这种寒冷的气候；如果让一切都变得冰冷、暗影且令人难以忍受，那肯定是不行的。 在这种情况下，这个摊位的屋顶上只有一盏灯在发光，而当你走进去时，你的呼吸依然会在空气中形成雾气——与此同时，更多的水蒸气也从其他地方不断散发出来 [freja.name]她高兴得直喘气，生怕会咳出一口火来，然而这个活泼的孩子却快步跑到摊位的柜台前，然后在原地跳起了欢快的舞蹈。“这些看起来太酷了！” “当然很酷了，它们可是冰淇淋啊！一个年轻的精灵男孩——或许还只是个青少年——趴在柜台上朝她招手，双臂交叉抱在胸前。“小可爱，你想喝点什么呢？” “你们有什么饮品？” “哦，我们有一种用树上的果汁制成的牛奶，喝起来口感柔软、味道香甜，而且还是冰镇的哦。 我们还有一种是由一大块块透明的冰块制成的，每天早上都会有一些身材魁梧、力气大的家伙用斧头把这些冰块削薄，然后我们会在上面淋上糖浆或者加入一些水果碎。 “会加入哪些水果呢？主要是野莓，不过偶尔也能从森林的南部地区或者现在的丰收谷采到一些不错的苹果。那条新的运输路线对我们的生意帮助很大。” “啊…….. [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈] 我应该买哪一个呢？ [freja.name] 他转过身来面对你，这一次，他的脸上明显写满了犹豫不决。 “我们可以各买一个，然后一起分享。” “好啊！ [freja.name] 你可以将她抱起来，用一只手臂托着她，让她靠在你的腰上获得支撑，这样她就能清楚地看到柜台上的东西了。人们会用勺子从那个厚厚的陶瓷罐中取出食物，然后将其盛到装有雕刻冰块的薄盘子里端上来。你得动作快一点，否则它就会融化掉，不过这个碗应该足够耐用，能撑得住。” 你们俩都兴致勃勃地开始吃起来，当那些冷冻甜点接触到舌头，瞬间融化成丝滑的奶油状或酥脆的甜味时，你们都满意地发出满足的哼声。 然后，那种刺痛感就出现了。你不由得皱起眉头，咬紧牙关，脚后跟不停地跳动，那种刺痛感似乎迟迟不肯消失。“那是什么感觉？” “哦！对了，确实很久没有看到外国人吃冰淇淋了。 你不会有事的，只是吃得太快了而已。” “但我吃得更快啊！ [freja.name] 她现在轻轻地将那片呈糖浆色的舌头伸了出来。 啊……卖家笑了起来。 “我想你应该已经暖和 enough，不会被冻坏了吧。这样也好，看起来那些冰冻甜点确实没什么意思。” 你只是闷闷地应了一声。很快，那些冰冻甜点就被吃光了 [freja.name] 它正用充满期待的眼神望着你，说道：“我们还能再要一些吗？” “绝对不行，你妈妈会责备我们的。 [freja.name] 她咯咯笑着，让你把她从你的腰上放下来，这样她就可以再次用两只爪子站立了。“好吧，谢谢你，先生！我爱你，再见啦！” “照顾好自己，小姑娘。 |[aileh.wintercity |当你朝着冰淇淋摊那涂着彩色的外立面走去时，艾莱正在舀冰淇淋。 [freja.name] 将他拥入怀中，然后在他的脸颊上轻吻一下。“亲爱的，我们该选哪一个呢？” “呃……那个最甜的那个吧！” “那不是最奶油味的那个吗？”艾莉开玩笑地说道，把她举到高处，帮她拂去身上的积雪，然后又把小龙放回她的腰间。 “哦……我们可以两个都买吗？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈] 上次我们说过我们可以同时做这两件事。” 艾莱赫挑了挑眉毛看着你，你只是耸了耸肩。 总是 为了这个女孩，就妥协吧。至少，这种做法似乎足够有说服力；或者，也许只是看到一对幸福的情侣拿着一碗刨冰和冰淇淋，面带满足地离开的场景，就让人心软了。“好吧，行吧。” “耶 [freja.name] 欢呼声。 |该休息了？”你说道。 [freja.name] 你把她抱起来，让她靠在你的腰上，她开心地扭动着身体，紧紧地抱住你。 “太好了！我们能再做一次吗？” “当然可以，”你坏笑着说，“只要记得说‘谢谢’就行了。” “谢谢！ ] 她有点急功近利了，但你只需要再用力挤一下，然后进去就行了。里面很昏暗，也冷得刺骨，但女儿依偎在你身旁的温暖就像一个小火炉一样。“去点餐吧，亲爱的。” “哦！嗯，请给我来一份冰霜甜点，再要一份刨冰，谢谢！ [freja.name] 她急得连礼貌都顾不上，这种办事效率确实值得称赞。 这些点心和你以前吃过的没什么两样：口感细腻、甜中带酸。你小心翼翼地吃着，不敢吃得太快，因为你的身体还没暖和起来，很容易就会感到头晕目眩——而你另一只手臂正抱着那只贪吃得欢快叫着的小龙呢。 这些甜点被盛放在装满冰块的盘子里，不过不必担心它们会在你吃完之前融化；说不定你自己也只来得及尝上两口而已。 [freja.name] 把所有东西都吃完了……但她很开心，这就已经足够让人快乐了。‘太好吃了，我以后想一直吃冰淇淋。’” “如果你一直这样吃，会变胖的。”柜台前的年轻男子坚持说道，“不过我当然不会拒绝多卖一些产品啦。” “才不会呢，小可爱。”你笑着拥抱了他。 [freja.name] 又一次让她失望了，于是把剩下的冰盘都送回了柜台准备处理。“我们可不想让你变胖啊。” “我怎么可能变胖呢？我可是龙啊！” “我打赌龙也会变胖的，”你开玩笑地说道。 [ashe.around| 能吗？ 不是阿什在你耳边嘟囔着什么，不过她那任性的语气让你产生了其他的误解。] 不——不 [freja.name] 撅着嘴说：“好吧！接下来该怎么办呢？ ]
rows.raw: ' [var0 |[freja.name] holds onto your hand tightly, eyes wide at the sight of a stall whose colors stand out magnificently to the slate-gray of the snow-laden sky. Pale pink has been painted onto the stall's stone exterior, with wooden siding all the way around. Most buildings have some amount of heating in them in the city, despite the inhabitants being largely immune to the natural chill; it just wouldn't do to have everything freezing, and dark, and miserable. In this case, there's only one illuminating lamp in the roof of the stall, and your breath continues to fog even as you enter — while yet more steam rolls off of [freja.name]. She gasps in such delight you're afraid she'll cough up a mouthful of fire, but instead the cheerful child scampers up to the stall's counter and hippy-hops on the spot. "These look so cool!" "Of course they should, they're ice cream!" A young elven man — perhaps only a teenager — leans over the counter to wave down at her, crossing his arms beneath his chest. "What can I get you cutie?" "What do you make?" "Oh, well, we have milk that's churned up with syrup from trees, and that turns into a soft tasty cold thing. And we have another one that's from great big blocks of clear ice that's shaved down by a bunch of handsome burly dudes with axes every morning, that we pour syrups or crush some fruits onto. "What kindsafruits?" "Mostly wild berries, but we occasionally get in some nice apples from the southern portions of the forest, or Harvest Valley these days. That route opening up has been amazing for business." "Ah-uuuh... [pc.mf|daddy|mommy] which should I get?" [freja.name] turns around and faces you, looking — for once — completely struck by indecision. "We can just get one of each, and share." "Yes!" [freja.name] lets you scoop her up and you hold her couched under one arm and against your hip for support so that she can actually see properly over the counter. A thick, ceramic jar is dug into with a spoon, and the contents served up into a thin dish of carved ice... "You'll have to be quick so that it doesn't melt, but the bowl should hold up for long enough." Both of you dig in with gusto, humming with satisfaction as the frozen treat is delivered to your tongue and melts into smooth creaminess, or crisp sweetness. And then the brain-freeze sets in. You wince and grit your teeth, bouncing your heels a few times as the sensation takes its sweet time moving on. "What was that?" "Oh! Right, yes. Been a while since I've seen a foreigner eat iced-cream. You'll be fine you just had it too fast." "But I ate even quicker!" [freja.name] pokes her now syrup-colored tongue out with a soft 'aaah', and the vendor laughs. "I guess you're warm enough to beat the freeze. Probably for the best, it looks unfun." You only grunt your agreement. All too soon, the frosted sweets are finished, and [freja.name] is looking up at you with expectant eyes. "Can we have more?" "Absolutely not, your mom'll tell us off." [freja.name] giggles, letting you slide her down from your hip so that she's stood on two claws again. "Ooookay. Thank you mister I love you bye-bye!" "Take care, young miss." |[aileh.wintercity |When you make for the painted exterior of the ice-cream stall, Aileh scoops [freja.name] into her arms and gives her a smooch on the cheek. "Which should we get, sweetie?" "Uuuh, the sweetest!" "Not the creamiest?" Aileh teases, holding her aloft and brushing melting snow off before returning the dragonling to her hip as you enter. "Ooooh... can we do both? [pc.mf|Daddy|Mommy] said we could do both last time." Aileh quirks a brow at you, and you shrug; you always cave for this girl. It proves to be persuasive enough, at least, or perhaps it's just the sight of a happy couple leaving with a dish of shaved ice, and ice cream between them and looking satisfied. "Alright, fine." "Yesss..." [freja.name] cheer-hisses. |"Treat time?" You scoop [freja.name] up and hold her against your hip, and she clings to you with a happy little wiggle. "Yes! Can we do both again?" "Of course we can," you grin wickedly. "Just remember to say thank you." "Thank you!" ] She's jumping the gun a little, but you only squeeze tighter and enter. The inside's dim and freezing cold, but the warmth of your daughter pressed against your side is like a little furnace. "Go ahead and order, sweetie." "Oh! Uuuh, one icy-creams, and one shaved ice please and thank you!" [freja.name] is in such a rush that she gets all of her manners out of the way first, which is an expeditiousness you can really get behind. The treats are much as you'd experienced before; creamy, sweet, and tangy. You're careful not to eat too fast, as your own insides aren't fire-pit warm, and you're a lot more prone to brainfreeze than the greedily-nomming, and happily-hissing dragonlet you're hugging with your other arm. The sweets are served in dishes of ice, but there's no fear of them melting before you're finished; you maybe only manage a couple of bites yourself before [freja.name] finishes the whole lot... but she's happy, and that's plenty of joy already. "That was super-tasty, I want icy-creams all the time." "You'd get fat if you did that," the young man at the counter insists. "But I won't turn down additional sales." "Afraid not, cutie," you hug [freja.name] again and let her down, returning what remains of the ice-dishes to the counter for disposal. "We definitely don't want you getting fat." "I can't get fat I'mma dragon!" "I bet dragons can get fat," you tease. [ashe.around| "Can not." Ashe huffs in your head, though her petulant tone leads you to believe otherwise.] "Nuh-uuuh..." [freja.name] pouts, "but okay! What now?" ]'

rows.original: [var0 |"There's a big knight shop! Can we go?" [freja.name] bounces excitedly up and down, grabbing your hand. "Alright, lead on." She can't charge headlong thanks to the grip you've got on her, but the little dragon leads you unerringly towards a stall full of gear. The smell of coals, the muted sound of metal being hammered in an adjacent room, the woodshop smell of fresh northwood lumber being stripped... it's definitely a place of work at the back. The front shop itself is the part to capture your daughter's attention though; mannequins wear suits of armor, shields and swords line the walls next to bearded axes, and a collection of beautiful bows rest against them. "Greetings, hun." The most slender elven waif you've seen in a long while saunters up to the shop's counter, a smile on her face. "Welcome to my establishment." "Hi miss! Did you make all these?!" [freja.name]'s eyes glitter, and her wings flap as you release her hand so that she can browse properly. To your surprise, the elf nods; she looks like she could barely lift a hammer, let alone make a full bronze panoply. As though to specifically prove you wrong, she hefts up a well-used hammer, bounces it in her grasp, and returns it to a similarly weighty-looking belt. "Been doing it for a long, long time. As has my husband and wife." "You have both?" [freja.name] gasps. "Mhm, lucky girl huh? Are you here for something, or just to browse?" "I wanna swo—" [freja.name] begins, but you cut her off with a hand between the horns, and a little rub on the head. "Just to browse, she's a bit young." "Huff." [freja.name] pouts, until you give her another squeeze and begin to follow her around the shop. Each little icon of adventure induces glee in your child; she attempts to try on some helmets, but pouts when her horns block the way. "Boo..." "You know, I tend to do all my orders for the guards," the blacksmith begins. "But if you come back when you're older, I'll make you a helm that you put on from behind..." she gestures behind her head for a wrapping-around motion. "Though honestly I feel you'd suit a heavy leather hood instead so that your lovely hair can hang out." "That sounds supercool!" [freja.name] bounces, disappointment immediately washed away. You give the blacksmith-slash-trader a thankful smile, and continue showing your daughter around. What she does sell to non-guards appears to be swords, axes, shields, coats, bows, and — of course — arrows to go with them. Good to remember if you're ever in a pinch. Once you're finished with 'the knight store', you and [freja.name] move onto the next shop... this one also captures your daughter's delight, considering they sell camping equipment, and fancy travel-rations. "Can we go camping one day?" "Sure, I'd like that..." you give her a rub behind the ear frills, and she giggles before hugging you tightly. The rest of the shops bare less interest for your dragonling, but she enjoys the sounds and colors, and talking to the different sellers plenty. [ashe.around |"She cares, and that goes such a long way." You nearly leap out of your skin at Ashe's sudden voice, but you settle down and give her flanges a little rub. "Long way to what?" "To being the best paladin, of course," your mace sounds incredibly proud of this fact. "You should be proud of her.[silly | One day she'll kick the shit out of the world's woes. ]" "I am proud." |It makes you proud to see her so invested in the lives of everyone she meets; even if she'll forget half of what she learns today, your daughter leaves a good impression on each elf. ] Eventually your shopping adventure comes to an end... or at least poses a risk of boring [freja.name] now that you've gone to everywhere she wanted to see. "That was nice, I liked a buncha the shops!" [freja.name] beams. "What now?" |[aileh.wintercity |"Shopping? Well now that's a way to spend a few hours," Aileh grins, crouching down to brush snow from [freja.name]'s hair. Your daughter giggles and wiggles, hissing and tippy-toeing to kiss Aileh's retreating hand, before setting forth towards her favorite store; the adventurer's market. |[freja.name] giggles and bounce-flaps, before taking your hand and leading you onward to the adventurer's market. ] As before, the impossibly-slender waif of a blacksmith saunters out to the counter, smiling and waving when she sees some familiar — if unique — faces. "Welcome back to my store, [freja.name]-and-family." "Hi miss, I love you!" [freja.name] waves, dashing for a selection of slick, polished bearded axes. [aileh.wintercity |Aileh snorts in amusement, moments before charging after her before the dragonling can swing one around. |You're quick to follow on her heels, attempting to head her off before she can swing one of the axes around. ] To her credit, the blacksmith only smiles and taps the counter. "If you break any of the stands, you're paying for them, lady [freja.name]." The red-scaled rapscallion comes skidding to a halt, wings flapping to stabilize. "Okay!" Instead [aileh.wintercity |the three of you |the two of you ] take a little more time with your exploration, even taking turns trying on ranger coats and testing the pull on a few bows. [aileh.wintercity |"Urgh," Aileh sighs, adjusting her grip on one of the bows. "My boobs get in the way, and my aim is terrible. I'll take a throwing axe or javelin any day." |They're of good make, for sure, though every piece is quite standardized. ] The insignia of the Winter City guard, as well as the maker's mark of this smith-slash-bowyer rests on the handle of the ashen gray wood. "Do you think I'd be good at shooting?" [freja.name] asks. Honestly, if she grows up anything like her mother, the dragonling will have a hard time getting a bow draw past her chest... but hey; your little girl can do anything she wants, of that you're certain. She tries many more 'toys' in the store, thankfully injury-free, before you move onto the next few locales; there're a few clothing places [aileh.wintercity |that you and [freja.name] go into for Aileh's sake, clapping when she saunters out in a lovely sheer dress. Which she immediately buys with a wicked grin, and a knowing glance in your direction that has [freja.name] blowing raspberries— you lucky [pc.mf|boy|girl]. |that you and [freja.name] surreptitiously avoid, instead seeking out a bakery. ] The bakery proves to be a highlight, particularly when [freja.name] gets a free syrupy sweetroll. Anything related to adventure, or food, and your rapscallion beelines for it with glee, dragging you[aileh.wintercity | and Aileh by the hands | by the hand ]. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |有家很大的骑士用品店！我们可以去吗？ [freja.name] 它兴奋地上下跳动着，紧紧抓住你的手部。 “好了，带路吧。” 由于你的手部紧紧握着它，它无法贸然冲向前去，但这只小龙依然准确地带你走向了一个摆满各种装备的摊位。 煤炭的气味，隔壁房间里金属被敲打时发出的沉闷声响，还有木工车间里新鲜北木被切割时散发出的气味……显然，那后面是一处工作场所。 不过，真正能吸引你女儿注意力的，是前面的店铺部分：模特们穿着盔甲，墙上排列着盾牌和剑，还有长着胡须的斧头，而一些精美的弓也靠在墙上。 你好，亲爱的。”那个你许久未见过的最纤细的精灵少女微笑着走到商店的柜台前，“欢迎来到我的小店。” “嗨，小姐！这些都是你亲手部制作的吗？！ [freja.name]她的眼睛闪闪发光，当你松开她的手部，让她能够自由活动时，她的翅膀也开始轻轻振动。 令你惊讶的是，这个精灵竟然点了点头；她看起来似乎连一把锤子都举不起来，更别说制作一套完整的青铜盔甲了。然而，仿佛是为了证明你是错的，她举起了那把使用过的锤子，在手部中轻轻晃了晃，然后又把它放回了那条看起来同样重型的腰带上。“我们已经做了很久很久了。我的丈夫也是。” “你们夫妻俩都从事这个工作？ [freja.name] 呼……真是个幸运的女孩啊，对吧？你是有什么事要找人帮忙，还是只是随便逛逛而已？” “我想 [freja.name] 本来要开始的，但你用手部挡住了她的去路，还轻轻揉了揉她的头。” “只是想随便看看而已，她还太小了。” “哼。 [freja.name] 她会撅起嘴来，直到你再捏她一下，然后开始跟着她在商店里四处走动。 每一个充满冒险意味的小图标都会让孩子感到开心；她会尝试戴上一些头盔，但当头盔上的角挡住了她的去路时，她又会撅起嘴来。 嘘……” “你知道，我通常都是为守卫们制作这些装备的，”铁匠开始说道，“但如果你长大后再回来，我会为你制作一顶可以从后脑部戴上的头盔……”她一边说着，一边用手部比划着头盔的佩戴方式。 不过说实话，我觉得你戴个厚皮帽会更好看，这样你那漂亮的头发就能自然地垂下来啦。” “那听起来真是太酷了！ [freja.name] 那些弹跳的声音让失望的情绪立刻烟消云散了。 你向那位既是铁匠又是商人的男人报以感激的微笑，然后继续带着女儿四处参观。她 做 卖给非守卫角色的话，似乎就可以出售剑、斧头、盾牌、外套、弓，当然还有配套的箭矢。如果将来遇到紧急情况，这个信息会非常有用。 等你完成了“骑士商店”的相关任务后，你就可以 [freja.name] 接着去下一家商店吧……这家商店也一定会让你的女儿感到开心，因为他们出售露营装备和各种精美的旅行食品。“我们有一天能去露营吗？” “当然可以，我也很希望这样……”你轻轻揉了揉她耳后的头发，她咯咯笑着，然后紧紧地抱住了你。 其他的商店对你的小龙女来说吸引力没那么大，但她很喜欢那里的各种声音、色彩，也喜欢和不同的店主聊天。 [ashe.around |她在乎你，这一点非常重要。” 听到阿什突然发出的声音，你差点吓得从椅子上跳起来，但很快平静下来，轻轻揉了揉她的侧翼。“重要在什么方面呢？” “当然是为了让你成为最出色的圣骑士啊。”你的战锤似乎对这个事实感到无比自豪。“你应该为她感到骄傲。[silly | 总有一天，她一定会彻底解决世界上所有的麻烦。 ]我感到非常自豪。 花更多的时间去探索吧，不妨轮流试穿那些游荡者的外套，也试着拉拉几把弓，看看它们的弹力如何。 [aileh.wintercity |唉，”艾莉叹了口气，调整着自己握住的那把弓的姿势。“我的胸部总是妨碍我瞄准，而且我的射击技术也很差。比起用弓，我宁愿使用投斧或者标枪。 |这些产品的质量确实很好，不过每一个部件都相当标准化。 ] [aileh.wintercity |你和 [freja.name] 看在艾莉的份上，当她穿着那条漂亮的透明连衣裙优雅地走出来时，大家纷纷鼓起掌来。而她立刻就笑着买下了那条裙子，同时还向你投来了一个意味深长的眼神 [freja.name] 吹口哨呢——你真幸运啊 [pc.mf|男孩|女孩]. |你和 [freja.name] 悄悄地避开了那个地方，反而去找了一家面包店。 ] rows.raw: ' [var0 |"There's a big knight shop! Can we go?" [freja.name] bounces excitedly up and down, grabbing your hand. "Alright, lead on." She can't charge headlong thanks to the grip you've got on her, but the little dragon leads you unerringly towards a stall full of gear. The smell of coals, the muted sound of metal being hammered in an adjacent room, the woodshop smell of fresh northwood lumber being stripped... it's definitely a place of work at the back. The front shop itself is the part to capture your daughter's attention though; mannequins wear suits of armor, shields and swords line the walls next to bearded axes, and a collection of beautiful bows rest against them. "Greetings, hun." The most slender elven waif you've seen in a long while saunters up to the shop's counter, a smile on her face. "Welcome to my establishment." "Hi miss! Did you make all these?!" [freja.name]'s eyes glitter, and her wings flap as you release her hand so that she can browse properly. To your surprise, the elf nods; she looks like she could barely lift a hammer, let alone make a full bronze panoply. As though to specifically prove you wrong, she hefts up a well-used hammer, bounces it in her grasp, and returns it to a similarly weighty-looking belt. "Been doing it for a long, long time. As has my husband and wife." "You have both?" [freja.name] gasps. "Mhm, lucky girl huh? Are you here for something, or just to browse?" "I wanna swo—" [freja.name] begins, but you cut her off with a hand between the horns, and a little rub on the head. "Just to browse, she's a bit young." "Huff." [freja.name] pouts, until you give her another squeeze and begin to follow her around the shop. Each little icon of adventure induces glee in your child; she attempts to try on some helmets, but pouts when her horns block the way. "Boo..." "You know, I tend to do all my orders for the guards," the blacksmith begins. "But if you come back when you're older, I'll make you a helm that you put on from behind..." she gestures behind her head for a wrapping-around motion. "Though honestly I feel you'd suit a heavy leather hood instead so that your lovely hair can hang out." "That sounds supercool!" [freja.name] bounces, disappointment immediately washed away. You give the blacksmith-slash-trader a thankful smile, and continue showing your daughter around. What she does sell to non-guards appears to be swords, axes, shields, coats, bows, and — of course — arrows to go with them. Good to remember if you're ever in a pinch. Once you're finished with 'the knight store', you and [freja.name] move onto the next shop... this one also captures your daughter's delight, considering they sell camping equipment, and fancy travel-rations. "Can we go camping one day?" "Sure, I'd like that..." you give her a rub behind the ear frills, and she giggles before hugging you tightly. The rest of the shops bare less interest for your dragonling, but she enjoys the sounds and colors, and talking to the different sellers plenty. [ashe.around |"She cares, and that goes such a long way." You nearly leap out of your skin at Ashe's sudden voice, but you settle down and give her flanges a little rub. "Long way to what?" "To being the best paladin, of course," your mace sounds incredibly proud of this fact. "You should be proud of her.[silly | One day she'll kick the shit out of the world's woes. ]" "I am proud." |It makes you proud to see her so invested in the lives of everyone she meets; even if she'll forget half of what she learns today, your daughter leaves a good impression on each elf. ] Eventually your shopping adventure comes to an end... or at least poses a risk of boring [freja.name] now that you've gone to everywhere she wanted to see. "That was nice, I liked a buncha the shops!" [freja.name] beams. "What now?" |[aileh.wintercity |"Shopping? Well now that's a way to spend a few hours," Aileh grins, crouching down to brush snow from [freja.name]'s hair. Your daughter giggles and wiggles, hissing and tippy-toeing to kiss Aileh's retreating hand, before setting forth towards her favorite store; the adventurer's market. |[freja.name] giggles and bounce-flaps, before taking your hand and leading you onward to the adventurer's market. ] As before, the impossibly-slender waif of a blacksmith saunters out to the counter, smiling and waving when she sees some familiar — if unique — faces. "Welcome back to my store, [freja.name]-and-family." "Hi miss, I love you!" [freja.name] waves, dashing for a selection of slick, polished bearded axes. [aileh.wintercity |Aileh snorts in amusement, moments before charging after her before the dragonling can swing one around. |You're quick to follow on her heels, attempting to head her off before she can swing one of the axes around. ] To her credit, the blacksmith only smiles and taps the counter. "If you break any of the stands, you're paying for them, lady [freja.name]." The red-scaled rapscallion comes skidding to a halt, wings flapping to stabilize. "Okay!" Instead [aileh.wintercity |the three of you |the two of you ] take a little more time with your exploration, even taking turns trying on ranger coats and testing the pull on a few bows. [aileh.wintercity |"Urgh," Aileh sighs, adjusting her grip on one of the bows. "My boobs get in the way, and my aim is terrible. I'll take a throwing axe or javelin any day." |They're of good make, for sure, though every piece is quite standardized. ] The insignia of the Winter City guard, as well as the maker's mark of this smith-slash-bowyer rests on the handle of the ashen gray wood. "Do you think I'd be good at shooting?" [freja.name] asks. Honestly, if she grows up anything like her mother, the dragonling will have a hard time getting a bow draw past her chest... but hey; your little girl can do anything she wants, of that you're certain. She tries many more 'toys' in the store, thankfully injury-free, before you move onto the next few locales; there're a few clothing places [aileh.wintercity |that you and [freja.name] go into for Aileh's sake, clapping when she saunters out in a lovely sheer dress. Which she immediately buys with a wicked grin, and a knowing glance in your direction that has [freja.name] blowing raspberries— you lucky [pc.mf|boy|girl]. |that you and [freja.name] surreptitiously avoid, instead seeking out a bakery. ] The bakery proves to be a highlight, particularly when [freja.name] gets a free syrupy sweetroll. Anything related to adventure, or food, and your rapscallion beelines for it with glee, dragging you[aileh.wintercity | and Aileh by the hands | by the hand ]. ]'

rows.original:
"This might be a little awkward... one second love." You heft [freja.name] onto your shoulders, heading for a city guard.

    "Can I help you, [pc.mf|sir|ma'am]?" The guard asks, a young woman with sharp features, offset by a faint, polite smile. 
    
    "I wanted to send a runner up to the Valkyries, the name's [pc.name]." 
    
    "Ah! You're the hero who saved the city, of course!"
    
    [freja.name] giggles on your shoulders, hugging your head.
    
    "And this must be your..."
    
    "Daughter," you confirm. "[freja.name]."
    
    "An honor! What's the message, then? I can't leave duty, but I'll write it up and have it sent with anyone traveling up for the evening mass." 
    
    "Just permission for this one's mother to visit as well, and to join us on visits to the Valkyries in the future. I don't expect they'd say no, but we don't want to surprise them... that could be awkward."
    
    The guard doesn't appear to understand the minutiae of Aileh walking into the stronghold of a goddess, being that she's Kasyrra's daughter... but then that's to be expected, not many people would've known your girlfriend used to be general to a demonic force. "I appreciate it, thanks."
    
    "Thank-yoouuu!" [freja.name] squeezes your head and smiles.
    
    "My pleasure, lady [freja.name], champion [pc.name]."

这可能会有点尴尬……一瞬间的爱情。”你说道。 [freja.name] 需要帮忙吗？ [pc.mf|先生|女士]请问有什么可以帮您的？”守卫问道。这位年轻女子五官轮廓分明，但脸上带着一丝礼貌而淡淡的微笑，使得她的面容显得更加柔和。

“我想为‘女武神’队伍送一位替补成员，她的名字是…… [pc.name]啊！你就是拯救了这座城市的英雄，果然如此！
    
    [freja.name] 她咯咯地笑着，把头靠在你的肩膀上。

“那么，这个一定就是你的……”

“女儿，”你确认道。[freja.name]真是荣幸！那么，具体是什么事情呢？我目前无法离开岗位，但可以把内容写下来，让那些晚上要去参加弥撒的人帮忙带去。”

“只是想请求允许这位患者的母亲也能前来探望，并且今后也能和我们一起去看望那些女武神。 我并不指望他们会拒绝，但我们也不想给他们带来意外……那样可能会显得很尴尬。

那个守卫似乎并不明白，作为卡希拉的女儿，艾莉进入一位女神的据点，这一行为本身就包含了许多微妙的含义。不过这也情有可原，毕竟没多少人会知道你的女朋友曾经是一支恶魔势力的将军吧。“我很感激，谢谢你。”

“谢谢你啊！ [freja.name] 她歪着头，露出了微笑。

“能为您效劳，真是我的荣幸，女士。 [freja.name]冠军 [pc.name]."

rows.original: [freja.name]'s jaw drops open as soon as you emerge from the Waystone into Lumia's vast, valkyrie-filled hall. It stays that way for a solid several seconds. There's a lot to take in, after all — the glittering mosaics of Lumian art, the frescos, the stained glass, the magical candles, easily a hundred warmaidens out and about — and all of it in full glow. "So?" you prompt, smiling. "What do you think?" "It's so bright and friendly..." She turns to you, eyes still wide. "[pc.swornGod lumia |Do you live here when you're not with me and Mommy?" "Not right now; I move around a lot. But this is where I became a valkyrie." You crouch down behind her[pc.bellyPregRange 25| as best as your expectant belly will allow] and point toward the other sun-maidens in the hall. "Because of that, all of those ladies are my sisters now." "Oooh! So they're my..." Her brow furrows. "... aunts?" You pat her on the shoulder. "[pc.isBimbo|That's right! You've got, like, forty bajillion aunties!|Close enough, sweetie.]" |Are all those ladies valkyries?" "They are! They're the [pc.isBimbo|bestest sun mommies ever|sworn shield-sisters of the valkyrie order]." You[pc.bellyPregRange 25| do your best to] crouch behind her and pat her on the shoulder. "And they're all just as nice as [annika.numKids 1|your Aunt|Miss] Anni is[pc.isBimbo|!|.]" ] "Do they all rescue damsels, too? Girl damsels and boy damsels?" "Good question!" You can see Annika walking over from her usual spot and waving excitedly at [freja.name]. A gentle nudge puts the Keep's seneschal in your daughter's view. "Well, there's [annika.numKids 1|Aunt|Miss] Anni right now. Why don't we say hi and ask her?" At the sight of someone else she already knows, her eyes light up. "Okay!" Without waiting for you[aileh.wintercity| or Aileh] — after all, now she has permission — she sets off. With so many winged warmaidens around, your daughter seems to feel the need to show off her own wingies too. She bounces and flaps her way down the great hall [aileh.wintercity|with both [pc.mf|parents|mothers] in tow|with you hustling a little way behind], and as she races down a lane cleared by the fortunately-thoughtful and -alert valkyries, she even flaps her way a foot or so off the ground with some of her bounds. But she's also got the presence of mind to know when to slow down, and as she gets closer to Annika she goes back to running on her legs only. It's only when she reaches the seneschal that she stops, gives a little flapflap, and ends up right in the boreal elf's arms. "Hiiii, [annika.numKids 1|Aunt|Miss] Anni!" she chirps. "Hello there, Miss Wayfarer!" Annika gives her a friendly squeeze before setting her down and kneeling to stay eye-to-eye. "It's so nice to see you here! I'm glad you were able to come visit." "Me, too!" [freja.name] says earnestly. "It's really bright here. And pretty. And big! And there are lots of ladies here." Anni's eyes twinkle. "Would you like to meet some of them?" "Yes, please!" There are a lot — a lot — of valkyries who clearly want to say hello to your brave little dragon daughter. But, since meeting all of them one by one would take too long and leave [freja.name] with no time to play, Anni keeps the group small. [freja.name] is endlessly fascinated by the women she does meet — by Eira's eye-wings, Thrud's enormous size and muscles, Hjörr's horns[pc.hasHorns| ("just like [pc.mommyDaddy]'s!", she says)] — and has plenty of questions for them as it is. Those questions keep coming, because once she's met people, the whole group of you walk on an impromptu tour of the Palace of Light. Sometimes the questions are about the things you see: the frescoes, the altars, the nurseries. More often, though, the questions are about the valkyries' adventures. [silly |"Have you ever fired two guns whilst flying through the air?" Behind them, Halima tries to hold in a laugh. Annika simply smiles and says, "No, sweetie." It takes [freja.name] about two seconds to come up with her follow-up question: "Have you ever been in a high-speed pursuit?" "Yes, I have..." |"How much heroine stuff have you done, Miss Turidel?" Between Annika and Halima, the younger frost-elf valkyrie blushes. "I did hunt a ferocious troll that was attacking a village once." "A whole troll?" your daughter gasps.[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED 1| "[pc.MommyDaddy] told a story about that! It sounds really tough."] Turidel admits, "It was one of the hardest things I've ever done." ] "Did you ever..." Then [freja.name] stops, because she's seen what lies ahead in the next room: one of the valkyries' obstacle courses. "Ohhhh. Wowwwww... can we play there, [pc.MommyDaddy]?" You scan the wooden structures and metal bars. [flags.THRUD_OBSTACLE |This is one of the tamer rooms, at least compared to the ones you usually use with Thrud. |You're pretty sure that the valkyries have more intense training experiences, something that the single-feather legend on the door seems to substantiate. ] It certainly looks safe enough for a little dragonlet, something you confirm with a quick head-bob to Annika, who's stopped walking at the door expectantly. "It sounds like that's the plan!" Anni grins. "That is the plan. How about we use this place to train you up to rescue damsels?" She immediately takes your hand. "Yes! Let's go do hero stuff, [pc.MommyDaddy]!"
rows.translation: [freja.name]当你从道路之石中走出来，走进卢米娅那宽敞而充满女武神的大厅时，你的下巴简直会掉下来——好几秒钟里，你都保持着这个姿势。毕竟，有太多东西让人目不暇接：卢米娅风格的闪闪发轻型的马赛克装饰、壁画、彩绘玻璃、那些充满魔力的蜡烛，还有大大小小上百位女武神在周围活动……而这一切，都在灿烂的轻型芒中展现着。 “那么？”你微笑着问道，“你觉得怎么样？” “太明亮了，也太温馨了……”她转过头来，眼睛仍然睁得大大的。[pc.swornGod lumia |你呢？ 直播 当你不在我身边，也不在妈妈身边的时候，我就会来到这里。” “现在不在这里；我经常搬家。但就是在这里，我成为了女武神。”你蹲在她身后。[pc.bellyPregRange 25| 在你的肚子允许的范围内，尽你所能吧。] 然后指向大厅里的其他那些太阳女神们，说道：“因为这个原因，现在所有这些女士都成了我的姐妹。” “哦哦！那么她们就是我的……”她的眉头皱了起来，“……阿姨们吗？” 你轻拍着她的肩膀，说道：“没错。[pc.isBimbo|没错！你拥有差不多四十万亿位“阿姨”呢！|已经很接近了，亲爱的。]" |是吗？ 所有 那些女士们，就是女武神吗？” “没错！她们就是女武神。 [pc.isBimbo|有史以来最棒的太阳妈妈们|誓约守护的英灵殿姐妹们]你[pc.bellyPregRange 25| 尽你最大努力] 我蹲在她身后，轻拍着她的肩膀说：“而且它们全都一样可爱。 [annika.numKids 1|你的阿姨|小姐] 安妮是[pc.isBimbo|!|.]" ] 他们也会去拯救那些少女吗？那些年轻的女子 以及 男孩们，姑娘们？” “问得好！”你可以看到安妮卡从她常待的地方走过来，兴奋地朝大家招手。 [freja.name]轻轻一推，城堡的总管就出现在你女儿的视野中了。“嗯，就是他 [annika.numKids 1|阿姨|小姐] 现在就是安妮的时间了。我们去打个招呼，问问她吧。” 一看到这个她已经认识的人，她的眼睛立刻亮了起来。“好啊！”她没有等你继续说下去，就立刻答应了。[aileh.wintercity| 或艾莱赫] — 毕竟，现在她得到了许可 — 她便出发了。 在周围有这么多长着翅膀的战斗女仆的情况下，你的女儿似乎也觉得有必要展示自己的翅膀了。她蹦蹦跳跳地，拍打着翅膀，沿着大厅飞了下去。 [aileh.wintercity|两者皆具备 [pc.mf|父母|母亲们] 跟随在后面|在你稍落后一点的地方忙碌着……]当她沿着那些由考虑周到、反应敏捷的瓦尔基里们清理出来的通道飞奔时，有几次她的跳跃甚至让她离地面有一英尺高。但她也很有分寸，知道什么时候该减速。当她越来越接近安妮卡时，她又重新改用双腿奔跑。直到她终于到达那位年长的女仆面前，她才停下来，轻轻扑腾了几下翅膀，就这样落在了那位极北精灵的怀里。 “嗨 [annika.numKids 1|阿姨|小姐] 安妮！”她欢快地叫道。 “你好啊，旅行者小姐！”安妮卡友好地握了握她的手，然后让她坐下，自己也跪下来与她平视。“能在这里见到你真是太好了！我很高兴你能来拜访我们。” “我也很高兴！ [freja.name] 她认真地说：“这里真的非常明亮，而且很漂亮，空间也很大！这里还有很多女士呢。” 安妮的眼睛闪闪发亮：“你想认识其中的一些人吗？” “当然想啦！请一定要帮忙！” 这里的人真的很多——真的很多 很多 ——那些显然都想向你勇敢的小龙女儿问好的女武神们。不过，如果逐一与她们见面的话，肯定会花费太长时间，而且 [freja.name] 由于没有时间玩耍，安妮把团队规模控制得很小。 [freja.name] 她对那些女性充满了无尽的迷恋。 做 以艾拉的眼轻型来看，瑟鲁德那庞大的身躯与强健的肌肉，还有赫约尔的角[pc.hasHorns| 就像……一样 [pc.mommyDaddy]s!’，她说。] 她对他们有很多问题要问。这些问题源源不断地出现，因为一旦她遇到了这些人，你们整个小组就会一起进行一场即兴的“光之宫殿”游览。有时候，这些问题是关于你们所看到的事物：壁画、祭坛、育婴室等等。不过，更多的时候，这些问题其实是关于女武神的冒险经历的。 [silly |你有没有在飞行时同时开两把枪？” 在他们身后，哈利玛努力忍住笑意。安妮卡只是微笑着回答：“没有，亲爱的。” 这需要 [freja.name] 大约两秒钟后，她终于提出了接下来的问题：“你有没有经历过高速追逐的场景？” “是的，有过…… |图里德尔小姐，你到底做过多少次这样的冒险事情呢？” 在安妮卡和哈利玛的追问下，这位年轻的霜精灵女武神脸红了：“我确实曾经追捕过一只袭击村庄的凶猛巨魔。” “一整只巨魔？”你的女儿惊呼道。[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED 1| "[pc.MommyDaddy] 有人讲过一个关于那个的故事，听起来真的挺艰难的。] 图里德尔承认：“这是我做过的最困难的事情之一。 ] 你有没有曾经……”然后 [freja.name] 她停了下来，因为她已经看到了下一个房间里等待着她的东西——那是瓦尔基里们设置的障碍训练场。“哦哦哦，哇……我们能在那里玩吗？ [pc.MommyDaddy]你仔细观察那些木制结构和金属条。 [flags.THRUD_OBSTACLE |这算是比较温和的房间之一了，至少相比你通常和Thrud一起使用的那些房间来说是这样。 |你相当确信，这些女武神们接受了更为严格的训练，而门上的那句“单羽传奇”似乎也在印证这一点。 ] 对于一只小龙来说，这个地方看起来确实足够安全了。你向站在门口、满心期待地等待着的安妮卡点了点头，以确认她的想法。“听起来这个计划挺不错的！” 安妮笑了：“是啊，这个计划确实不错。 是 这个计划怎么样？我们就用这个地方来训练你，让你能够去拯救那些陷入危险中的姑娘们吧？” 她立刻握住了你的手：“好啊！让我们一起去做英雄该做的事吧！ [pc.MommyDaddy]!"
rows.raw: ' [freja.name]'s jaw drops open as soon as you emerge from the Waystone into Lumia's vast, valkyrie-filled hall. It stays that way for a solid several seconds. There's a lot to take in, after all — the glittering mosaics of Lumian art, the frescos, the stained glass, the magical candles, easily a hundred warmaidens out and about — and all of it in full glow. "So?" you prompt, smiling. "What do you think?" "It's so bright and friendly..." She turns to you, eyes still wide. "[pc.swornGod lumia |Do you live here when you're not with me and Mommy?" "Not right now; I move around a lot. But this is where I became a valkyrie." You crouch down behind her[pc.bellyPregRange 25| as best as your expectant belly will allow] and point toward the other sun-maidens in the hall. "Because of that, all of those ladies are my sisters now." "Oooh! So they're my..." Her brow furrows. "... aunts?" You pat her on the shoulder. "[pc.isBimbo|That's right! You've got, like, forty bajillion aunties!|Close enough, sweetie.]" |Are all those ladies valkyries?" "They are! They're the [pc.isBimbo|bestest sun mommies ever|sworn shield-sisters of the valkyrie order]." You[pc.bellyPregRange 25| do your best to] crouch behind her and pat her on the shoulder. "And they're all just as nice as [annika.numKids 1|your Aunt|Miss] Anni is[pc.isBimbo|!|.]" ] "Do they all rescue damsels, too? Girl damsels and boy damsels?" "Good question!" You can see Annika walking over from her usual spot and waving excitedly at [freja.name]. A gentle nudge puts the Keep's seneschal in your daughter's view. "Well, there's [annika.numKids 1|Aunt|Miss] Anni right now. Why don't we say hi and ask her?" At the sight of someone else she already knows, her eyes light up. "Okay!" Without waiting for you[aileh.wintercity| or Aileh] — after all, now she has permission — she sets off. With so many winged warmaidens around, your daughter seems to feel the need to show off her own wingies too. She bounces and flaps her way down the great hall [aileh.wintercity|with both [pc.mf|parents|mothers] in tow|with you hustling a little way behind], and as she races down a lane cleared by the fortunately-thoughtful and -alert valkyries, she even flaps her way a foot or so off the ground with some of her bounds. But she's also got the presence of mind to know when to slow down, and as she gets closer to Annika she goes back to running on her legs only. It's only when she reaches the seneschal that she stops, gives a little flapflap, and ends up right in the boreal elf's arms. "Hiiii, [annika.numKids 1|Aunt|Miss] Anni!" she chirps. "Hello there, Miss Wayfarer!" Annika gives her a friendly squeeze before setting her down and kneeling to stay eye-to-eye. "It's so nice to see you here! I'm glad you were able to come visit." "Me, too!" [freja.name] says earnestly. "It's really bright here. And pretty. And big! And there are lots of ladies here." Anni's eyes twinkle. "Would you like to meet some of them?" "Yes, please!" There are a lot — a lot — of valkyries who clearly want to say hello to your brave little dragon daughter. But, since meeting all of them one by one would take too long and leave [freja.name] with no time to play, Anni keeps the group small. [freja.name] is endlessly fascinated by the women she does meet — by Eira's eye-wings, Thrud's enormous size and muscles, Hjörr's horns[pc.hasHorns| ("just like [pc.mommyDaddy]'s!", she says)] — and has plenty of questions for them as it is. Those questions keep coming, because once she's met people, the whole group of you walk on an impromptu tour of the Palace of Light. Sometimes the questions are about the things you see: the frescoes, the altars, the nurseries. More often, though, the questions are about the valkyries' adventures. [silly |"Have you ever fired two guns whilst flying through the air?" Behind them, Halima tries to hold in a laugh. Annika simply smiles and says, "No, sweetie." It takes [freja.name] about two seconds to come up with her follow-up question: "Have you ever been in a high-speed pursuit?" "Yes, I have..." |"How much heroine stuff have you done, Miss Turidel?" Between Annika and Halima, the younger frost-elf valkyrie blushes. "I did hunt a ferocious troll that was attacking a village once." "A whole troll?" your daughter gasps.[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED 1| "[pc.MommyDaddy] told a story about that! It sounds really tough."] Turidel admits, "It was one of the hardest things I've ever done." ] "Did you ever..." Then [freja.name] stops, because she's seen what lies ahead in the next room: one of the valkyries' obstacle courses. "Ohhhh. Wowwwww... can we play there, [pc.MommyDaddy]?" You scan the wooden structures and metal bars. [flags.THRUD_OBSTACLE |This is one of the tamer rooms, at least compared to the ones you usually use with Thrud. |You're pretty sure that the valkyries have more intense training experiences, something that the single-feather legend on the door seems to substantiate. ] It certainly looks safe enough for a little dragonlet, something you confirm with a quick head-bob to Annika, who's stopped walking at the door expectantly. "It sounds like that's the plan!" Anni grins. "That is the plan. How about we use this place to train you up to rescue damsels?" She immediately takes your hand. "Yes! Let's go do hero stuff, [pc.MommyDaddy]!"'

rows.original: You and the valkyries take turns figuring out ways to set up bad-guy strongholds from which [freja.name] — and a few sun-warrior allies — can rescue damsels. While you do that, Annika shows your daughter a padded training stick and shows her how to use it safely. Then, once your daughter is ready to rescue some damsels, you and the other valkyries take turns being just that. Sometimes you cackle nefariously until your dragon daughter gently taps the side of your leg with her 'mace'; sometimes, you storm the ramparts alongside her. Annika acts as referee, so to speak, gently guiding [freja.name] in the direction of teamwork... a very small dragon-girl's understanding of teamwork, to be sure, but teamwork all the same. There is play-fighting, plenty of shouting, and running. So much running. So much so that, after much rescuing, you can see even your daughter is a little winded. At the last, you're playing the 'damsel', and [freja.name] has just bested a giggling sun-warrior to secure your freedom. She crests the rise with a teensy bit of the war-weariness you've exhibited yourself, dragging her 'mace' on the ground and breathing a little heavier than usual. Then she flashes you a toothy smile and boops you on the nose. "You're free, [pc.MommyDaddy]!" You [pc.isBimbo|give her the absolute biggest and bestest mommy hug ever|grin]. "Thank you for saving me, Lady Wayfarer! You're so brave." "It's... all in a day's work!" [pc.isBimbo|comes her muffled reply|she declares]. [pc.isBimbo|Once you let her go, s|S]he takes you by the hand and leads you back across the training room, past obstacles, 'defeated enemies', and cheering allies. There's another person standing there, though, and she's making the room quite a bit brighter. The Dawn Maiden herself is at the door, [lumia.isPregnant|glowing not just with sunlight but with maternity|aglow with divine sunlight]. "Hello, Miss Wayfarer," she says. "Thank you for rescuing your [pc.mf|father|mother]. I don't know what I'd do without [pc.himHer]!" [freja.name] gasps, and her tiredness vanishes in an instant. "Are you Miss Lumia?" "I am, and it is very lovely to meet you." She smiles. "Have you been having fun here at my house?" "Yes, ma'am! It's really bright and pretty and there's so many hero ladies here! We rescued Miss Turi, and then we rescued Miss Thrud, and then we rescued Miss Halima, and then we rescued [pc.MommyDaddy]!" Your daughter tugs on your hand a little for emphasis. At that, Lumia beams. "I'm proud to have such a brave paladin here among my warriors! Rescuing and saving people are the things I like best, too. Did you get outfitted like a proper warrior while you were here rescuing people?" "I did!" [freja.name] says excitedly. With both hands, she lifts her wooden and padded practice 'mace' up to the goddess, full of a young girl's best impression of a reverent paladin. "This is what I picked. Do you like maces?" "I do indeed." She runs her hand along it. "They are very good at bonking[silly|, and also very good at sending people to a certain sort of jail that you're too young to know about yet]. You chose well, brave adventurer." "We'll have to have it ready for you to use the next time you come back," Annika says apologetically. "Unfortunately, a lot of our sun maidens have to go back to doing warrior stuff against monsters and demons soon." "Awwwww..." The Dawn Maiden takes her by the hand and smiles reassuringly. "It was lovely to have you here, though, Miss [freja.name][aileh.wintercity| — and you as well, Lady Aileh]. I was very happy to meet you[aileh.wintercity| both], and I can't wait for you to visit again soon!" "Thank you, Miss Lumia!" Your daughter looks back at you[aileh.wintercity| and Aileh] excitedly. "Can we come back soon, [pc.MommyDaddy]?" "[pc.isBimbo|Of course, sweetie!|We can]. But for now, let's figure out what to do next."
rows.translation: 你和那些女武神轮流想出各种办法，来摧毁那些反派的据点 [freja.name] — 还有几位太阳战士盟友 — 也能帮助拯救那些少女们。当你忙于这些事情时，安妮卡会给你的女儿展示一根有软垫的训练棒，并教她如何安全地使用它。等你的女儿准备好去拯救那些少女们时，你和其他女武神们就会轮流承担这个任务。有时候，你会发出邪恶的笑声，直到你那条龙形态的女儿用她的“战锤”轻轻敲打你的腿；有时候，你会和她一起冲上城墙。可以说，安妮卡扮演着裁判的角色，温柔地引导着大家 [freja.name] 朝着团队合作的方向前进……虽然小女孩对团队合作的理解还很有限，但毕竟还是在努力进行团队合作。游戏中会有打闹、大量的喊叫声，还有奔跑。 奔跑的次数实在太多了。 多到在经过多次救援之后，就连你自己的女儿也会显得有点气喘吁吁。最后，你反而扮演起了“拯救者”的角色。 [freja.name] 她刚刚击败了一个咯咯笑的太阳战士，从而为你赢得了自由。她爬上山坡时，脸上带着与你一样显露出的疲惫神情，拖着她的“战锤”，呼吸也比平时更加急促。然后，她向你露出了灿烂的笑容，还轻轻地碰了碰你的鼻子。 “你自由了 [pc.MommyDaddy]你 [pc.isBimbo|给她一个有史以来最温暖、最贴心的妈妈式拥抱吧。|露出笑容]谢谢你救了我，旅人女士！你真是太勇敢了。” “这……不过是我的分内之事罢了！ [pc.isBimbo|她传来了一声低沉的回应|她宣布道]. [pc.isBimbo|一旦你放她走，s|S]他牵着你的手部，带你穿过训练室，越过各种障碍物、“被击败的敌人”，以及那些欢呼助威的盟友。 然而，那里还有另一个人，她的存在让整个房间显得明亮了许多。晨曦少女本人就站在门口。 [lumia.isPregnant|它不仅仅在阳光下闪耀，更因孕育生命而散发光芒。|在神圣阳光的照耀下，熠熠生辉]你好，旅行者小姐，”她说，“感谢你救了 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]要是我没有它，真不知道该怎么办。 [pc.himHer]!" [freja.name] 她倒吸了一口气，疲惫感瞬间消失了。“您是卢米娅小姐吗？” “是的，很高兴见到您。”她微笑着说道，“您在我家玩得开心吗？” “非常开心，夫人！这里真的很明亮、很漂亮，还有这么多英勇的女士们！我们救出了图里小姐，然后又救出了瑟拉德小姐，最后还救出了哈利玛小姐 然后 我们成功救出了他们。 [pc.MommyDaddy]你的女儿特意拉了拉你的手部，想强调这一点。” 听到这里，卢米娅脸上露出了灿烂的笑容：“能有一位如此勇敢的骑士在我的战士们中间，我感到非常自豪！拯救人们也是我最喜欢做的事情。你在救援别人的时候，是不是也穿上了真正的战士服装呢？” “是的，我确实穿上了！ [freja.name] 她兴奋地说道。双手部将那把木质且带有软垫的练习用“钉头锤”举到女神面前，完全展现出一个年轻女孩对虔诚圣骑士的完美想象。“这是我挑选的。您喜欢钉头锤吗？” “我确实很喜欢。”女神用手部抚摸着那把锤子，“它们用来敲打东西确实非常合适。[silly|而且，它还非常擅长把人们送进某种你目前还太小、还不了解的监狱里。]你的选择很明智，勇敢的冒险者。” “我们得把这些东西准备好，等你下次再来时就能使用，”安妮卡歉意地说道，“可惜，我们的许多太阳少女很快又要回去与怪物和恶魔战斗了。” “哎呀……” 黎明少女握住她的手部，安慰地笑了笑：“不过，能有你在这里，我们真的很开心，小姐。 [freja.name][aileh.wintercity| — 你也是，艾莉丝女士。]见到你，我非常高兴。[aileh.wintercity| 两者都]真的非常感谢，我迫不及待地希望您能尽快再次来访！” “谢谢您，卢米娅小姐！”您的女儿回头对您说道。[aileh.wintercity| 还有艾莱赫] 兴奋地问道：“我们能早点再回来吗？ [pc.MommyDaddy]?" "[pc.isBimbo|当然可以，亲爱的！|我们能做到。]但眼下，我们先想办法决定接下来该做什么吧。

"Thank you for rescuing your [pc.mf|father|mother]. I don't know what I'd do without [pc.himHer]!" [freja.name] gasps, and her tiredness vanishes in an instant. "Are you Miss Lumia?" "I am, and it is very lovely to meet you." She smiles. "Have you been having fun here at my house?" "Yes, ma'am! It's really bright and pretty and there's so many hero ladies here! We rescued Miss Turi, and then we rescued Miss Thrud, and then we rescued Miss Halima, and then we rescued [pc.MommyDaddy]!" Your daughter tugs on your hand a little for emphasis. At that, Lumia beams. "I'm proud to have such a brave paladin here among my warriors! Rescuing and saving people are the things I like best, too. Did you get outfitted like a proper warrior while you were here rescuing people?" "I did!" [freja.name] says excitedly. With both hands, she lifts her wooden and padded practice 'mace' up to the goddess, full of a young girl's best impression of a reverent paladin. "This is what I picked. Do you like maces?" "I do indeed." She runs her hand along it. "They are very good at bonking[silly|, and also very good at sending people to a certain sort of jail that you're too young to know about yet]. You chose well, brave adventurer." "We'll have to have it ready for you to use the next time you come back," Annika says apologetically. "Unfortunately, a lot of our sun maidens have to go back to doing warrior stuff against monsters and demons soon." "Awwwww..." The Dawn Maiden takes her by the hand and smiles reassuringly. "It was lovely to have you here, though, Miss [freja.name][aileh.wintercity| — and you as well, Lady Aileh]. I was very happy to meet you[aileh.wintercity| both], and I can't wait for you to visit again soon!" "Thank you, Miss Lumia!" Your daughter looks back at you[aileh.wintercity| and Aileh] excitedly. "Can we come back soon, [pc.MommyDaddy]?" "[pc.isBimbo|Of course, sweetie!|We can]. But for now, let's figure out what to do next."'

rows.original: This time, [freja.name]'s feeling a little more sedate. This time, instead of running off her energy elsewhere, she asks to visit Lumia's library. While the Dawn Maiden apologizes that it's not nearly as extensive as what the Narevans often keep, there is still a great deal of history to peruse — and, to your daughter's great delight, adventures and romances too. One book in particular catches her interest, and she does a little flap-flap as she jumps to make sure she read the title correctly. "Ooh! Is it okay if I read this one?" she asks. "I'll be extra careful with it." Lumia smiles indulgently down at her; [aileh.wintercity|you and Aileh have already had a talk with her|you and she have already had a talk] about what you're okay with [freja.name] reading for now. "That one looks good to me!" As full of energy as your daughter often is, reading gets her to calm right down. Once she gets nestled into a position — on your lap[aileh.wintercity|, on Aileh's lap], on a cushion, on Lumia — she stays there. It's as quiet as things get when she's around. That doesn't mean completely quiet, of course. She whispers and mumbles out the words she reads, and asks you or Lumia about the biggest and trickiest ones. She swishes her tail from side to side, albeit idly rather than with any nervous energy. But all in all, despite that, it's all just very... relaxed. [silly|Maybe Lumia changes the nature of reality simply by being there. That's kind of how divinity works, right?] Still, the wiggles are impossible to stop permanently. After many pages, [freja.name] starts shifting restlessly; even if her attention's still on the book, you can tell that she should probably do something active soon. Lumia notices too. "Just about done?" "Just about!" she chirps. "It's a good story so far." [aileh.wintercity|Aileh leans|You lean] over to peer at her stopping point. "What do you like most about it?" "All the ideas for new adventures to go on!" Ah, of course. "Thank you for spending time relaxing with me, [freja.name]," Lumia says cheerfully. "Would you like a hug before you go?" "Yes, ma'am!" Your dragon daughter fairly leaps into the goddess's arms. "Thank you for having me over!" "Of course."
rows.translation: 这一次， [freja.name]她现在感觉平静了许多。这一次，她没有把精力消耗在别的地方，而是请求去卢米娅的图书馆看看。虽然黎明少女道歉说，这里的藏书远没有纳雷万家族所拥有的那么丰富，但这里仍然有大量的历史资料可以阅读——而且，令你的女儿非常高兴的是，这里还有许多冒险故事和爱情小说。 有一本书特别引起了她的兴趣，她兴奋地跳起来，反复确认书名是否写对了。“哦！我可以读这本书吗？”她问道，“我会特别小心的。” Lumia温柔地微笑着看着她。 [aileh.wintercity|你和艾莉已经和她谈过了。|你和她已经谈过了。] 关于你能够接受的事情 [freja.name] 目前来看，这个选项挺不错的！” 尽管你的女儿通常充满活力，但阅读确实能让她安静下来。一旦她找好一个舒适的姿势——比如坐在你的腿上[aileh.wintercity|坐在艾莱的腿上]坐在垫子上，或者使用Lumia设备——她总是待在那个地方。当她在场的时候，周围的一切都会变得如此安静。但这并不意味着 完全地 当然很安静。她阅读文字时总是低声细语，遇到那些最难理解或最复杂的部分，就会向你或Lumia请教。它的尾巴会左右摇摆，但那只是无意识的动作，并没有表现出任何紧张的情绪。总的来说，尽管有这些小动作，整个氛围依然非常……轻松自在。 [silly|也许，Lumia仅仅因为它的存在，就改变了现实的本质。某种程度上，神的力量不也是这样发挥作用的吗？] 然而，这些抖动现象根本无法被永久性地消除。经过无数次的尝试之后 [freja.name] 她开始坐立不安，即使她的注意力仍然集中在书本上，你也能看出她很快就应该去做些别的事情了。 Lumia也注意到了。“差不多读完了吗？” “快完了！”她高兴地回答，“这个故事到现在为止真的很精彩。 [aileh.wintercity|艾莱倾斜着身体。|你倾斜着身体。] 走过去，看着她停下的地方，问道：“你最喜欢它的哪一点呢？” “就是那些可以用来开展新冒险的点子啊！” 啊，当然。 “谢谢你陪我一起放松时光。 [freja.name]嗯，”卢米娅开心地说道，“在离开之前，想要一个拥抱吗？” “当然想要，女士！”你的龙之女儿欢快地跳进了女神的怀抱中，“谢谢您邀请我前来！” “当然啦。

rows.original:
Once again, you marvel at how easy it is for Anni and Thrud to convince [freja.name] to stretch and exercise. No "Mom only makes me do some of the stretches when we're at home", no grumbling like it's a chore: as soon as she knew that it was something that warriors did to train, she was completely on board.

    The valkyries, of course, are rock-solid as they work through their push-ups. "Remember to come all the way down, sweetie," Anni reminds her.
    
    "Yes, ma'am!" Your daughter straightens a little bit, clenches her core again, then does much better on the next push-up.
    
    [pc.bellyPregRange 20|Your baby bump is a little in the way, but you follow along with what activities you're physically capable of|Naturally, you keep up right along with them]; after all, modeling is one of the best ways to teach dragon daughters, and any other children for that matter.
    
    The valkyries work through the exercises and stretches gradually, making sure that [freja.name] sticks to an appropriate routine for kid stuff. Now that they've done this with her before, Anni doesn't even need to tell her that this is the best way to get strong; all your daughter has to do (and she does it quite frequently) is glance at [annika.numKids 1|her aunt's|the seneschal's] abs for motivation. It's more than enough, and she completes the routine without asking for a single break or losing attention.
    
    Which in turn means that it's time for her to storm the castle, equipped with her trusty 'mace' and surrounded by sun-warrior allies. The room is set up differently than last time and some of the participants have changed, but the goal remains the same: rescue the damsel, of course!
    
    Thrud stands atop the ramparts, doing a very credible imitation of a mean giant[thrud.pregStage 1| despite her, mmm, condition]. The enormous purple valkyrie pumps one arm into the air and uses her other to point menacingly at your plucky young warrior-daughter and her band of compatriots. "You'll never win, Wayfarer!" she shouts. "My fortress is impenetrable!"
    
    The fact that she has to cover her face to stifle a giggle afterward makes no never-mind to any of you.
    
    "We can do it!" your daughter says earnestly, looking back and forth and you and the other warriors on her team. "We just have to work together!"
    
    It is a mark of the progress she's made in minor tactics that she follows this up with actual thoughts about working together rather than charging off all by herself to win the day with her mace. Instead, she forms the group into two teams, "but stick close enough to work together!" Then, with the help of her warmaiden allies, she selects a route through all of the obstacles. With their — your — advance proceeding down mutually supporting axes, the Good Guys are able to slowly push the Bad Guys back. Many bonks are administered and sustained. And at the end, your whole team converges on Thrud and bests the laughing sun warrior with a series of coordinated bonks.
    
    Then, all that remains is for your daughter to inform [aileh.wintercity
    |a very proud Aileh that she's free. "All rescued, Mommy!"
    
    "All rescued." She hugs her savior. "Thank you for saving me!"
    
    "Oop!" she giggles, face slightly smooshed against her mama's. "You're welcome! But it wasn't just me — I couldn't have done it without the whole team."
    |a smiling Halima that she's been freed. "You're all rescued, Miss Halima!"
    
    "Thank you for saving me, Miss Wayfarer!" the human valkyrie chuckles. "Normally, I'm not the kind of girl who gets captured..."
    
    "That's okay!" [freja.name] strikes a proud pose. "I was happy to help! But I couldn't have done it without the whole team."
    ]
    
    As soon as she's released from her mama's hug, she immediately bounds over to give your leg a hug of its own. "Thanks for being on my team, [pc.MommyDaddy]."
    
    "Aw, [pc.mascFem|kiddo|sweetie]," you murmur, tousling her hair. "I'm always on your team. Except when it's my turn to play the bad guy, anyway."
    
    "Hee hee hee..."
    
    "All right, hero lady, I think that our valkyrie friend[pc.isBimbo|o]s have some more work to be doing." You kneel down[pc.bellyPregRange 15| as best you can] until you're eye to eye, then smile. "Ready to go somewhere else?"
rows.translation:
你又一次惊叹于安妮和瑟拉德是如何如此轻易地就说服了别人。 [freja.name] 进行伸展运动和锻炼。没有“只有在家里妈妈才会让我做这些伸展动作”，也没有像在做苦差事一样抱怨：一旦她了解到这些动作其实是战士们用来训练自己的，她就立刻全力配合了。

当然，这些女武神在做俯卧撑时也表现得非常认真。“记得要完全放下身体，宝贝，”安妮提醒她。

“是的，女士！”你的女儿稍微调整了一下姿势，再次收紧腹部肌肉，接下来的俯卧撑做得就好多了。
    
    [pc.bellyPregRange 20|虽然你的孕肚有点妨碍你的行动，但你会选择那些你自己身体条件允许的活动来参与。|当然，你也会跟随着他们一起前进。]毕竟，建模是教导龙之女儿们，以及其他孩子们的一种非常有效的方法。

女武神们会逐步引导孩子们完成这些练习和伸展运动，确保他们能够正确地进行这些动作。 [freja.name] 会遵循适合儿童的活动规律来安排日常事务。既然他们之前已经和她一起这样做过，安妮甚至都不需要再告诉她，这才是变得强壮的最佳方法；你的女儿只需要看一眼……就能明白该怎么做（而且她确实经常这样做）。 [annika.numKids 1|她阿姨的|总管长的] 她充满动力地投入到这项任务中。这样的精力完全足够了，她完成整个流程时，既没有要求休息，也没有分心过。

这意味着，现在是时候让她手持可靠的“战锤”，在阳光战士盟友的陪伴下，去攻占那座城堡了。这次的环境与上次不同，参与的人也有些变化，但目标依然不变：当然是去拯救那位公主啦！

瑟拉德站在城墙上，模仿着一个凶猛的巨人的样子，做得非常逼真。[thrud.pregStage 1| 尽管她的情况……嗯……是这样。]那头巨大的紫色女武神将一只手臂高高举过头顶，另一只手臂则威胁性地指向你那勇敢的年轻战士女儿以及她的同伴们。“你们永远不可能获胜的，流浪者！”她大声喊道，“我的堡垒坚不可摧！她之后不得不捂住脸才能忍住不笑，这个事实似乎并没有引起在场的任何人的注意。

“我们一定能做到！”你的女儿认真地说着，她的目光在你们这些和她同队的战士们之间来回扫视。 我们只需要共同努力就可以了！”

她能够在一些细节策略上取得进展，这一点从她接下来提出的关于需要共同努力的想法中就可以看出来——而不是独自行动，试图仅凭自己的能力取得胜利。 相反，她将小队分成两组，“但要保持足够的距离，以便能够协同作战！”在她的盟友们的帮助下，她选定了一条能够避开所有障碍物的路线。随着你们这两支队伍沿着相互支援的路线前进，好人一方逐渐将坏人逼退。 许多重击被连续施展并保持下去。最终，你们的整个团队齐心协力，对那个嘲笑太阳的战士发动了一系列协调一致的重击，最终击败了他。

然后，剩下的就是让你的女儿去通知大家了。 [aileh.wintercity
    |艾莉赫为自己能够重获自由而感到无比自豪。“妈妈，大家都被救出来了！”

“真的都救出来了。”她紧紧拥抱着自己的救命恩人，“谢谢你救了我！”

“哎哟！”她咯咯笑着，脸贴在妈妈的脸上，“不客气！不过这并不是我一个人的功劳——没有整个团队的共同努力，我根本做不到。
    |面带微笑的哈利玛显然已经获得了自由。“你们都得救了，哈利玛小姐！”

“感谢您救了我，旅行者小姐！”这位人类女武神笑着说，“通常情况下，我并不是那种会被抓走的女孩……”

“没关系！ [freja.name] 摆出了一个骄傲的姿势，说道：“我很高兴能帮忙！但没有整个团队的共同努力，我也做不到这一点。
    ]
    
    一旦她从妈妈的怀抱中挣脱出来，就会立刻跑过来，用自己的方式抱抱你的腿。“谢谢你一直支持我。 [pc.MommyDaddy]哎呀， [pc.mascFem|小家伙|甜心]这样吧，”你轻声说道，同时拨弄着她的头发，“我永远都会站在你这一边。当然，除非轮到我来扮演反派的角色。”

“嘻嘻嘻……”

“好吧，英勇的女士，我想我们的女武神朋友[pc.isBimbo|o]我们还有些工作要做。”你跪了下来。[pc.bellyPregRange 15| 尽你所能] 直到你们意见完全一致，再微笑吧。 “准备去别的地方吗？

rows.original: "All right," says Anni. "Are your hands clean, [freja.name]?" From her step-stool, your daughter holds them up for inspection. "Yes, ma'am!" "Very good. What about our ingredients?" The valkyrie gestures to the table before them, festooned with everything necessary for making a tasty treat. One by one, she holds them up: "These are the apples, and this is the bread, and this is the lemon! And we have sugar here, and these are the special spices, and this is the butter." "Good! Now, while I'm cutting up the apples and the bread, what are you going to do?" "I have to get the water and sugar and put them in the pot, and then I squeeze the lemon into it." She giggles. "I like squeezing the lemon! How come we only use one?" "It'd be very sour if we had more, sweetie. What next?" "Then you're going to put the apples in the pot, too, and then we get to use the breadcrumbs you're going to make to mix together the crust! And then we fry it with the butter and smoosh the apple slices and use them as filling inside the crust." She frowns. "Did I remember everything?" "Pretty much, dear. I think we're ready to get started!" [freja.name] doesn't bake much at home, but she's, if not a quick study, an enthusiastic one. As soon as Anni reminds her that they're making the treats for the whole family — that you[aileh.wintercity| and Aileh] are going to be having them — she throws herself into her work with excitement. You sit at the table where you waited for Anni to make mumma and simply enjoy the sounds of mixing and the smell of baking. One smell is so lovely that you can't help but stand up to see how she's getting along with it, but [freja.name] gasps and protectively covers up your view of the table — or attempts to, given her limited size and stature. "[pc.MommyDaddy], don't look! It's not ready yet!" "[pc.mascFem|Okay, okay," you chuckle.|Oh! I'm sorry," you tell her.] "It smelled so good I couldn't resist, but that's not very fair to you. I can wait." [aileh.wintercity|"Yes, dear heart," snickers Aileh. "Don't be impatient." You stick out your tongue at her in response, which makes [freja.name] and Annika laugh so hard they have to stop working for a while.] Eventually, she resumes mixing[silly| — using the by-this-point de rigueur tiny whisk, of course —] and eventually comes up with something she's satisfied with. Then comes the frying; while Anni handles the close-to-the-fire part, she does ask [freja.name] to add extra spoonfuls of butter from time to time, each delivering a wonderful gentle sizzle and an aroma that almost propels you out of your seat again. You know the rules, though... After what feels like an eternity of blissfully heavenly smells, your two bakers pronounce the meal almost done. In goes half of the breadcrumbs; then comes the nice warm apple filling; then the other half of the breadcrumbs. Then into the earthen oven for another little while, whereupon Anni turns to [freja.name] and says, "Remember, one of the best times to do cleanup is while the treats are actually baking." Slyly, your daughter points out, "Shouldn't people help with the cleaning if they're going to have fun eating the treats, too?" "Mmm. That's a pretty good rule." Anni raises her eyebrow at you. "Okay[pc.isBimbo|yyyy]," you laugh, rising to your seat, "but that [pc.isBimbo|that means li'l dragon ladies have to do that when they enjoy treats at home too, riiiight?|rule applies to anyone who gets to enjoy treats, doesn't it? Including at home?]" [freja.name] beams up at you guilelessly. "Uh-huh!" After all that, when the oven is finally done torturing you with the just-out-of-reach scent of piping hot apple compote cake, the [aileh.wintercity|four|three] of you tuck right in. It's gooey, it falls apart almost immediately, it has sweetness with just a tiny hint of sour, it's wonderfully warm, and most importantly of all: your daughter helped make it. You have absolutely zero hesitation telling her that she did a wonderful job as soon as the plate is clear[aileh.wintercity|, and both Aileh and Annika second that|, and Annika is happy to second it] to her. She climbs up onto your lap and giggles, "Thank you! I think we're getting really really good at it!" "You absolutely are." Anni leans back and stretches. "Let me know if you want to try any other recipes sometime, okay?" "I will! But I really like this one." "Of course you do, you li'l rapscallion." You tousle her hair. "Ready to hit the road again? rows.translation: 好吧，”安妮说，“你的手部干净吗？ [freja.name]从她的小凳子上，你的女儿把那些东西举起来仔细端详。“是的，夫人！” “很好。那我们的食材准备得怎么样了？”这位女武神指了指他们面前的桌子，桌上摆满了制作美味点心所需的一切材料。 她一个一个地拿起它们来：“这些都是苹果，这是面包，这是柠檬！我们这里还有糖，这些都是特别的香料，还有黄油。” “很好！现在，当我把苹果和面包切好的时候，你们打算做什么呢？我得把水和糖拿过来，放进锅里，然后再挤柠檬进去。”她咯咯笑着说，“我就喜欢挤柠檬！为什么我们只用一个柠檬呢？” “如果用更多的柠檬，味道就会太酸了，亲爱的。 接下来该做什么呢？” “然后你还需要把苹果也放进锅里，之后我们就可以用你做的面包屑来混合面团了！接着我们用黄油将面团煎熟，把苹果片压平后放在面团里面当馅料。她皱起了眉头，”我记得所有的事情吗？” “差不多吧，亲爱的。我想我们可以开始行动了！ [freja.name] 她在家不太常做饭，但她的学习能力虽然不算很快，却非常热情。只要安妮提醒她，他们是要为全家人准备这些点心——你就会看到她的积极性立刻被激发出来。[aileh.wintercity| 还有艾莱赫] 她们马上就要开始制作这些了——她满怀兴奋地投入到了工作中。你坐在桌旁，等待着安妮开始制作那些美味的食物，同时尽情享受着搅拌食材的声音以及烘焙过程中散发出的香气。 其中有一种香味实在太过诱人，让你忍不住站起身去，想看看她制作得怎么样了 [freja.name] 你倒抽一口气，然后试图挡住自己看向桌子的视线——不过考虑到她那有限的身高和体型，这个动作其实有点困难。[pc.MommyDaddy]别看！那不是 准备好了。 还不到时候！[pc.mascFem|好吧，好吧，”你笑着说。|哦！对不起，”你对她说。] 香味太诱人了，我实在忍不住，但这样对你就有点不公平了。我可以等着的。 [aileh.wintercity|是的，亲爱的，”艾莱赫窃笑道，“别急嘛。” 作为回应，你朝她吐了吐舌头，这让 [freja.name] 安妮卡和安娜笑得太过厉害，以至于不得不暂时停止工作。] 最终，她重新开始进行混合操作。[silly| — 到这个时候为止 必不可少 当然，是那根小小的拂尘。] 最终，她会想出让自己满意的方法来。接下来就是烹饪环节了；虽然安妮负责那些需要靠近火源的操作，但她还是会询问一下 [freja.name] 时不时地再加入一些黄油，每一次加入都会发出美妙的嘶嘶声，散发出令人陶醉的香气，几乎会让你再次从座位上跳起来。不过，你知道规则吧…… 在经历了仿佛永恒般的美妙香气之后，两位烘焙师宣布饭菜已经差不多做好了。首先加入一半的面包屑，然后是温暖香甜的苹果馅料，接着再加入另一半面包屑。最后把整个混合物放入土炉中继续烘烤一段时间，这时安妮转过身来说 [freja.name] 然后她说：“记住，打扫卫生的最佳时机就是当那些甜点正在烤制的时候。” 你的女儿狡黠地指出：“如果人们也想享受这些甜点的美味，那么他们就应该帮忙打扫卫生，不是吗？” “嗯，这个道理确实很有道理。”安妮挑了挑眉毛看着你。 “好吧[pc.isBimbo|年份]哈哈，”你笑着说，站起身回到座位上，“不过那 [pc.isBimbo|这意味着，当“小龙女们”在家里享用美食时，也必须这样做，对吧？|该规则适用于 有人吗？ 谁不是可以享受这些美食的呢？在家里也不例外吧？]" [freja.name] 它天真无邪地朝你“照射”过来，仿佛在说：“嗯嗯！” 经历了这一切之后，当烤箱终于停止用那香气扑鼻却永远触手部可及的热苹果果酱蛋糕的香味来“折磨”你时， [aileh.wintercity|四|三] 你们赶紧尝尝看吧。这种食物口感软糯，一碰到舌头就会立刻散开，带着一丝甜味和淡淡的酸味，味道温暖可口，而最重要的是：这是你女儿帮忙制作的。等盘子里的食物都被吃光后，你一定会毫不犹豫地告诉她，她做得非常棒！[aileh.wintercity|艾莱和安妮卡也都表示赞同。|安妮卡也很赞同这一点。] 她爬到你腿上，咯咯笑着说：“谢谢！我觉得我们真的越来越擅长这个了！” “确实是这样。”安妮向后靠了靠，伸了个懒腰。“如果以后你想尝试其他食谱，一定要告诉我哦，好吗？” “我一定会的！不过我真的很喜欢这个食谱。” “当然会喜欢啦，你这个小调皮。”你揉了揉她的头发。“准备再次出发了吗？我觉得是时候 [annika.numKids 1|阿姨|小姐] 安妮，回去继续你的工作吧。” “哎呀，好吧。谢谢你让我能和你一起烤东西！”她欢快地说道，一边挥手部告别。“下次见吧！
rows.raw: ' "All right," says Anni. "Are your hands clean, [freja.name]?" From her step-stool, your daughter holds them up for inspection. "Yes, ma'am!" "Very good. What about our ingredients?" One by one, she holds them up: "These are the apples, and this is the bread, and this is the lemon! And we have sugar here, and these are the special spices, and this is the butter." "Good! Now, while I'm cutting up the apples and the bread, what are you going to do?" "I have to get the water and sugar and put them in the pot, and then I squeeze the lemon into it." She giggles. "I like squeezing the lemon! How come we only use one?" "It'd be very sour if we had more, sweetie. What next?" "Then you're going to put the apples in the pot, too, and then we get to use the breadcrumbs you're going to make to mix together the crust! And then we fry it with the butter and smoosh the apple slices and use them as filling inside the crust." She frowns. "Did I remember everything?" "Pretty much, dear. I think we're ready to get started!" [freja.name] doesn't bake much at home, but she's, if not a quick study, an enthusiastic one.
