"It's one thing to live it, [pc.name], and another to try and put it into words for someone who might not find it all immediately obvious." ] ] ] "

rows.original: Hethia raises an eyebrow. "You want to know about what?" There's no good way to put it, so you won't beat around the bush knowing the kind of woman Hethia is. Yes, you want to ask about what the druids know of the old king dowager's death. It happened in the Frostwood, which was where they were holed up back in the day, so you don't quite believe that they knew absolutely nothing about the matter. "And what makes you think that I know anything about the old king dowager's death? Sure, I'm not going to deny that Xadaron's heirs would have stopped at little to spill his blood, that's for sure. But I was a girl back then, little more than an initiate. If they planned something, I wouldn't know anything about it." How did she know how long ago it happened? You haven't mentioned that, nor as far as you know, have Ryn, Elyon, or anyone else for that matter. "Why, it's common knowledge amongst the people, and I have been walking around the city with my fellows, trying to get used to it all." Hethia scratches her head. "If you were trying to catch me out in some kind of misdirection, I'm afraid that's not the case." You have a hard time believing that the druids would be able to keep quiet about it if they'd anything to do with the king dowager's death. Vengeful as they were for Synneva's fate, they'd have sought to make an example of him. "And they didn't." Hethia pinches the bridge of her nose. "Look, [pc.name], ever since I arrived at the palace, I've heard the rumors of what druidic powers can do, the things the people here attribute to us after a mere two and a half centuries of schism. And yes, a good number of them are correct. We could have induced a furious, unnatural rage and strength into the pig that gored Etheryn's father to death, enough to snap the boar spear. But we didn't. I was warned as a girl to stay out of the way of hunting parties from the Winter City, because they'd hunt us down like the animals they came to poach in the first place. "Could we have caused the king dowager's death? Given the way it was described to me by the palace staff — or at least, those who have returned since Alissa's deposal — yes, we could. Did we? If we did, I didn't know anything about it as an initiate. The possibility is there, [pc.name], but then again many things are possible in this world and yet don't happen. "So there's your answer, [pc.name]. We might have, but if we did, I don't know anything about it and good luck getting anything out of the last living Xadaron. This is about the most honest answer I can give you, [pc.name]." Well, you have to thank her all the same. She's certainly created quite the ruckus with her outburst back there, her voice echoing down the halls of the palace. No doubt people will be spreading hearsay about the druidess' cold-hot temper within minutes... "Hmph." Hethia folds her arms. "Anything else you want to discuss, [pc.name]? Anything but this?"
rows.translation: 赫希娅挑了挑眉毛：“你想知道关于……的事情吗？ 什么怎么说呢……考虑到赫希娅是那样一个女人，你也不会拐弯抹角了。没错，你肯定想知道德鲁伊们对那位已故王后之死的了解程度。那件事发生在霜木之地，而他们当年就是躲在那个地方，所以你很难相信他们会对这件事一无所知。 你凭什么认为我知道关于那位太皇太后的死因 anything 呢？当然，我并不否认扎达隆的继承人们会不择手段地杀了他，这一点是肯定的。但那时候我只不过是个小女孩，还只是一个初学者而已。 如果他们策划了什么，我根本不会知道。” 她是怎么知道这件事发生在多久以前的呢？你并没有提到这一点，据你所知，Ryn、Elyon，或者其他任何人也都不知道。 哎呀，这可是大家都知道的事情啊，我 拥有 我和我的伙伴们一直在城里四处走动，试图适应这里的一切。”赫希娅挠了挠头，“如果你是想用某种障眼法来引我上钩的话，那我恐怕你失败了。” 你很难相信，如果德鲁伊们与王太后的死有关，他们竟然会保持沉默。以他们对辛内瓦遭遇的怨恨，他们肯定会想借这个机会教训那个人一顿。 “但他们并没有这么做。”赫希娅捏了捏鼻梁，“听着 [pc.name]自从我来到这座宫殿，我就听说了许多关于德鲁伊力量的传闻。在这里的人们，仅仅因为在我们分裂了两个半世纪之后，就认为我们拥有那些能力。事实上，其中很多传闻都是正确的。我们 可以 这种情绪让那头猪产生了狂暴而异常的力量，它用獠牙刺死了伊瑟琳的父亲，那种力量甚至足以折断那支猎猪矛。但我们没有那么做。小时候我就被警告过，要远离冬城的狩猎队，因为他们会像对待那些他们本来就是来捕猎的动物一样，追捕我们。 我们会不会导致了王太后的死亡？根据宫廷工作人员的说法——至少是那些在艾丽莎被废黜后回来的人的说法——是的，我们有可能。但我们真的这么做了吗？如果真的做了，作为一名见习者，我对此一无所知。 这是完全有可能的。 [pc.name]不过，话说回来，这个世界上有很多事情本来是有可能发生的，但却最终没有发生。 “所以，这就是你的答案了。 [pc.name]我们可能有过这样的想法，但如果是的话，我也对此一无所知。要想从最后存活的扎达隆那里得到任何信息，恐怕难度很大。这应该是我能给你的最诚实的回答了。 [pc.name]嗯，你还是得感谢她。她刚才的举动确实引起了一阵轩然大波，她的声音在宫殿的走廊里回荡着。毫无疑问，不出几分钟，人们就会开始传播关于这位女德鲁伊喜怒无常的传闻了……” “哼。”赫希娅双臂交叉抱在胸前，“还有其他事情要讨论的吗？ [pc.name]除了这个，什么都行吧？

rows.original: You pull the whitewood bow from your belongings and hold it out to Hethia with both hands. The druidess freezes, muscles tensing, then her lips set into a thin, straight line as she quirks an eyebrow at you. "Well, what's the meaning of this? Are you mocking me for my loss? You don't have to drive home that fact — if you were strong enough to beat the former queen, I'm not match for you. No need to flaunt it." While you're sure she feels that she's surrounded by enemies day in, day out, does she have to be suspicious of everyone's motives? Or maybe it's not her, but the pale elves in general — have you inadvertently stumbled upon some humiliation ritual that's long-codified in pale elf society? Is that it? That a victor returning a loser's weapon to them signifies that the latter is well and truly defeated to not be deemed a threat even with their weapon at hand? "Hmph... maybe." You won't lie, seeing her reaction makes you not want to give her back her bow. Even so, Ryn really wants to see her people at peace, both within and without, and you'll swallow your pride to do it anyway. Maybe she can learn to do the same like she was asked instead of being such a reflexive, stuck-up... but here. You're returning her the whitewood bow as a peace offering, an attempt to restore some of her pride. Maybe she should accept the return of her treasured weapon in the spirit which it was given, instead of being an ass about it. Hethia deflates in a sigh and lets her shoulders slump. "All right, Champion of Winter. You've made your point. I... I'm sorry." Those words must've taken a lot out of her to say, so you know they're genuine. Right? "Unless the regent explained it to you, you wouldn't have had any way to know that particular custom anyway." It never came up in all the time you've known Ryn. But back to the point, you'll agree to meet her halfway, go to her if she'll come to you. That's what negotiating is about — without compromise somewhere in the middle, what's the point of talking in the first place? Now, you're going to give her back her weapon — you know that given how much pale elf society respects strength of arms, you'd have the right to keep it, having defeated her back at Westbank. And now that you've done this, you'd like Hethia to be more cordial to Ryn, if not you. You're not expecting a complete turnabout in her attitude overnight, but you'd at least like her to recognize that both Ryn and you are genuine about trying to heal the schism in the pale elves as a people, and to be at least reasonable in her attitude towards negotiations on the other side, whom you are not a part of. Is that something she can work on? Another sigh. "All right. I'll accept the peace offering, champion." There, that wasn't so hard, was it? That's a step forward for the both of you, hopefully the first of many. Hethia takes the bow in her hands, fingers flexing as they grip the carved alabaster wood; she's clearly happy to have it back with her regardless of the meaning of your gesture or whether she feels deserving of wielding it again. Certainly, there's a little guilt there — but the bulk of it is mixed with relief, no matter how she tries to hide it. The druidess puts the bow away, then gives you a small nod. "Thank you." She's welcome. "I know it might seem rude of me to leave now, but I hope you don't mind if I excuse myself for a while. There are some matters I ought to consider, and alone at that." Oh, you don't mind at all. In fact, quite the opposite — this was what you hoped to provoke with your peace offering, and you hope that her reflections bear much fruit for her. Hethia gives you a quick incline of her head, then turns and leaves. You watch her leave until she turns a corner in the palace corridor and vanishes from sight, then sigh. You think you did the right thing there... like you said, while you're not expecting it to be immediate, at least you can start mending the gulf between the two of you; even if Hethia may not be able to fully appreciate anyone who isn't a pale elf, she can at least respect you. That's as much as you can hope for.
rows.translation: 你从物品中取出那把白木弓，双手部将其递给赫希娅。这位德鲁伊少女僵住了，全身肌肉都绷得紧紧的，随后她的嘴唇紧抿成一条细线，同时挑了挑眉毛看着你。 “那么，这是什么意思？你是在嘲笑我失败了吗？你其实没必要特意强调这一点——如果你真的有足够的力量击败前女王，那我确实不是你的对手部。没必要特意炫耀这一点。 虽然你确信她每天都觉得自己被敌人包围着，但她真的有必要怀疑每个人的动机吗？又或者，问题并不出在她身上，而是出在苍白精灵这个种族身上——你是否无意中发现了某些在苍白精灵社会中早已根深蒂固的羞辱仪式？就是这样的吗？难道胜利者将失败者的武器归还给他们，就意味着后者已经被彻底击败，因此即使他们手部中还握着武器，也不会被视为威胁了吗？ 哼……也许吧。” 说实话，看到她的反应后，你真的不想把弓还给她了。不过，瑞恩真心希望自己的族人能够过上安宁的生活，无论是族内还是族外。因此，你还是决定放下自己的骄傲，去帮助她实现这个愿望。 也许她可以学会按照别人的要求去做，而不是总是那么固执己见、趾高气扬……你把那把白木弓还给她，其实是想表达和平的意愿，试图挽回她的一些尊严。或许她应该以接受这份礼物的初衷来接受这把她珍视的武器，而不是表现得那么傲慢无礼。 赫希娅叹了口气，肩膀也随之耷了下来。“好吧，冬之冠军。你把意思表达得够清楚了。我……我很抱歉。” 说出这些话一定让她耗费了很大的勇气，所以你可以肯定，她是真心的，对吧？ “除非摄政王向你解释过，否则你根本不可能知道这个特殊的习俗。 在你们认识Ryn的这段时间里，这个话题从来都没有被提起过。但归根结底，你应该会同意和她互相让步吧？如果她愿意来找你，你也会去见她。这才是谈判的意义所在——如果中间没有任何妥协的空间，那么当初谈这些又有什么意义呢？ 现在，你应该把她的武器还给她——你知道，鉴于苍白精灵社会对武力的高度重视，你在西岸击败她之后，本有权留下那把武器。而既然你已经这么做了，你肯定也希望赫希娅能对瑞恩更加友好一些，至少不对你怀有敌意。 你并不指望她的态度能在一夜之间发生彻底的改变，但至少你希望她能够认识到，你和瑞恩都是真心实意地想要弥合苍白精灵族内部的分裂，希望在与其他方的谈判中，她至少能够保持理性的态度。 不是 成为其中的一部分……这是她能够努力去实现的吧？” 又一声叹息：“好吧，我就接受这个‘和解的提议’吧，冠军。” 看，其实也没那么难吧？这对你们双方来说都是向前迈出的一步，希望这只是众多进步中的第一步而已。 赫希娅双手部握着弓，手部指紧紧地抓住那块雕刻精美的雪花石膏木头；显然，能够重新拥有它让她感到非常高兴，无论你这个举动意味着什么，也不管她是否认为自己有资格再次使用它。 当然，她心中确实会感到一丝内疚——但这种情绪更多的是伴随着如释重负的感觉，无论她如何试图隐藏这一点。这位德鲁伊女巫收起了弓，然后向你微微点了点头。 谢谢。” “不客气。” “我知道现在离开可能显得有些无礼，但希望你们不会介意我暂时离开一下。有些事情我需要独自考虑。” 哦，你们一点也不介意。事实上，恰恰相反——你们正是希望通过这样的提议来引发她的思考，也希望她的这些思考能带来好的结果。 赫希娅微微点了点头，然后转身离开了。你目送着她走到宫殿走廊的转角处，直到她完全消失在视线之外，才长叹一声。你认为自己当时做得没错……正如你所说，虽然不能期望立刻看到效果，但至少你可以开始努力修复你们之间的隔阂；即使赫希娅可能无法完全接受非苍白精灵的人，至少她应该会尊重你。这也是你所能期望的全部了。

rows.original: [hethia.isHostile |Hethia sniffs at the proposition. "Well! I'd heard [pc.race]s were lustful, but for you to be this direct is something else altogether. Don't you have anything against fraternising with the enemy?" But she's not an enemy, that's the entire point of this. Even if this devolves into a hatefuck... you still want to at least have some chance at turning this entire situation around. Besides, there's nothing against being direct amongst the pale elves, is there? "No, not in the least — in fact, it's quite the opposite. Here, life can be unpredictably short for all kinds of reasons; if you care for someone, you speak up and let said someone know about it. You might not get another chance tomorrow, after all. Consider the poor regent's parents, both of them taken from her in unforeseen circumstances. Seize the day, as it were — but when it's coming from someone like you, who wouldn't know this..." You sigh. Does she mind you getting some of her time, then? "Hmph, I don't mind. I'd certainly like to fight you, but we already know the outcome of that. A little competition in another form isn't a challenge I'm going to back down from — I'm going to show you how exactly I turned that big dumb brute of a wolf-man into personal doggy dildo." Now that's the spirit! Her place, then? [party.has etheryn |"Um, don't mind me, then," Ryn says quietly as she begins to slip away. "Schmoozing with the lead negotiator of the other side certainly is a valid tactic towards gaining an advantage in the ensuing talks..." ] Hethia sniffs imperiously. "I suppose it'll be something to do while waiting for the next round of talks and negotiations. Come on — the chambers the regent has provided me and my delegation with are more than sufficient for the task." [party.hasCompanions |With [party.compNames] departed |Taking Hethia's hand ], it falls to you to lead the druidess through the alabaster palace corridors and up to the lavish quarters she's been assigned. No doubt formerly the abode of some elf courtier or the other who's been dealt with in the wake of Kasyrra's actions here in the city, it oozes class that Hethia mostly ignores as she shuts the door behind the both of you and plops down on the bed with an exhausted sigh, folding her arms and glaring up at you with all the defiance she can muster. "I'll admit, I've been looking forward to a rematch ever since our tussle in that logging camp. I'm so gracious, I'll even let you choose the battlefield... not that it'll do you much good, Champion of Winter." |A glimmer of a smile appears on Hethia's lips. "Oh? That's quite the forward proposition you have there." Why, is it some kind of social faux pas amongst the pale elves? "No, not in the least — in fact, it's quite the opposite. Here, life can be unpredictably short for all kinds of reasons; if you care for someone, you speak up and let said someone know about it. You might not get another chance tomorrow, after all. Consider the poor regent's parents, both of them taken from her in unforeseen circumstances. Seize the day, as it were, wouldn't you agree?" Well, of course you do, or else you wouldn't be asking her for some of her time. [party.has etheryn |"Um, don't mind me, then," Ryn says quietly as she begins to slip away. "Schmoozing with the lead negotiator of the other side certainly is a valid tactic towards gaining an advantage in the ensuing talks..." ] Hethia just sniggers at that and allows you to take her by the hand. "Well, time we do have. We are in between talks, after all; I suppose I cannot be blamed for indulging in some of the pleasures my sun-kissed siblings are supposed to have fallen into." Oh, and druidic orgies in the cover of the woods aren't a thing? She tsks. "More wyld elf nonsense made up for gullible and impressionable minds. Come on — the chambers the regent has provided me and my delegation with are more than sufficient for the task." [party.hasCompanions |With [party.compNames] departed |Taking Hethia's hand ], it falls to you to lead the druidess through the alabaster palace corridors and up to the lavish quarters she's been assigned. No doubt formerly the abode of some elf courtier or the other who's been dealt with in the wake of Kasyrra's actions here in the city, it oozes class that Hethia mostly ignores as she shuts the door behind the both of you and plops down on the bed with an exhausted sigh. "I don't think I'll ever get used to this kind of comfort," she admits with a rueful smile. "So, Champion of Winter, what were you expecting of a frigid bitch like me?" ]
rows.translation: [hethia.isHostile |赫希娅对这个提议嗤之以鼻：“哼！我早听说过了 [pc.race]他们确实充满了欲望，但你能如此直率，这确实另有一番意味。你难道不反对与敌人交好吗？ 不过她 不是 敌人，这才是整个事情的关键所在。即使这种情况最终演变成一场激烈的仇恨冲突……你至少还是希望自己能够有机会扭转整个局面。更何况，在苍白精灵族中，直接表达自己的想法并没有什么不妥吧？ 不，完全不是这样——事实上，情况恰恰相反。在这里，由于各种各样的原因，生命可能会在短时间内终结；如果你关心某个人，你就应该把这种感情说出来，让那个人知道。毕竟，你可能明天就没有机会再这么做了。 想想那位可怜的摄政王的父母吧，他们都是在一些意想不到的情况下离她而去的。可以说是，要珍惜眼前的每一刻吧——不过，当这种劝告来自像你这样的人时，谁又会觉得这话有什么不妥呢…… 你叹了口气。那么，她应该不会介意你占用她的一些时间吧？ 哼，我并不介意。我当然很乐意和你战斗，但我们早就知道结果会怎样了。以另一种形式进行一点竞争，对我来说并不是什么我会退缩的挑战——我会让你亲眼看到，我是如何把那个庞大的、愚蠢的狼人变成我的私人‘宠物玩具’的。太好了，正是这种精神！那么，她的地方在哪里呢？ [party.has etheryn |嗯，那我就不打扰你们了，”莱恩轻声说道，然后开始慢慢离开。“与对方的首席谈判代表攀谈交流，确实是一种在后续谈判中取得优势的有效策略…… ] 赫希娅傲慢地哼了一声：“我想，在等待下一轮谈判的过程中，这应该也是可以打发时间的事情吧。来吧——摄政王为我们我和我的代表团准备的房间，完全足够用来完成这项任务了。 [party.hasCompanions |借助 [party.compNames] 已离世 |牵着赫希娅的手 ]现在，由你来带领这位德鲁伊女祭司穿过那些白色大理石制成的宫殿走廊，前往她被安排居住的豪华房间。毫无疑问，这里曾经是某个精灵朝臣的居所，而那些精灵在卡希拉在这座城市里采取行动之后，都遭到了相应的惩罚。这个房间充满了高贵的气质，但赫希娅却几乎对此视而不见。当你们俩关上门后，她疲惫地坐在床上，双臂交叉，用尽全力表现出自己的反抗之情，直直地盯着你看。 我得承认，自从我们在那个伐木营地那次较量之后，我就一直期待着能与你再战一次。我真是大度，甚至允许你来选择战场……不过，对于你这个‘冬之冠军’来说，这应该也没什么意义吧。 |赫希娅的嘴角浮现出一丝微笑：“哦？你提出的这个想法还真是相当大胆啊。” “难道在这些苍白精灵中，这种想法算是某种社交禁忌吗？” “不，并不是这样的——事实上，恰恰相反。 在这里，由于种种原因，生命可能会在毫无征兆的情况下突然终结；如果你关心某个人，那就勇敢地说出来，让那个人知道你的感受。毕竟，明天你可能就没有机会再这么做了。想想那位可怜的摄政王的父母吧，他们都是在毫无预兆的情况下失去了自己的孩子。 抓紧当下，不是吗？” “嗯，当然啦，否则你也不会向她请求一些时间吧。 [party.has etheryn |嗯，那我就不打扰你们了，”瑞恩轻声说道，然后开始慢慢离开。“与对方的首席谈判代表攀谈交流，确实是一种在后续谈判中取得优势的有效策略…… ] 赫希娅只是轻笑了一声，然后让你牵她的手。“好吧，我们现在确实有时间。我们 是 在各种会议间隙，毕竟；我想，我享受那些那些被阳光亲吻过的兄弟姐妹们应该会体验到的乐趣，这也不能怪我吧。 哦，对了，那些在树林里举行的德鲁伊仪式，应该也不是真的存在吧？ 她轻哼了一声：“又是一些为那些容易轻信他人、容易受影响的人编造出来的野精灵胡言乱语罢了。拜托——摄政王为我们和我的代表团准备的房间，已经足够我们完成这项任务了。 [party.hasCompanions |借助 [party.compNames] 已离世 |牵着赫希娅的手 ]现在，由你来带领这位德鲁伊女祭司穿过那些白色大理石制成的宫殿走廊，前往她被安排居住的豪华房间。毫无疑问，这里曾经是某个精灵朝臣的居所，而那些精灵在卡希拉在这座城市里采取行动之后，都遭到了相应的惩罚。这个房间充满了高贵的气质，但赫希娅大多时候并没有注意到这些，她关上门后，疲惫地坐在床上叹了口气。 我想我永远都不会习惯这种舒适吧，”她带着一丝无奈的微笑说道，“那么，冬之冠军，你究竟期待一个像我这样冰冷无情的女人做出什么反应呢？ ]

rows.original:
"Just so to be clear, I've never actually been there or seen anything for myself," Hethia says. "We're warned against getting too close to any of the infested temples for fear of bringing back the infection, so everything I know is second-hand at best."
    
    You get it — it's just like how Ryn only knows so much history from books and nowhere else.
    
    "Harsh, but apt. Anyway, Xadaron Temple was the greatest and most lavish of the druidic temples when the boer'alvar were still beholden to the Old Wyld, mostly because it was the domain of the Xadaron lineage, which had held the position of archdruid for about ten generations. The way things worked, each temple was run by a family inasmuch as a Belharan noble might run a barony — a small fiefdom of a temple and surrounding village, with considerable autonomy at the cost of taxes to the crown and billeting or garrisoning outriders."
    
    Sounds about right, given the conversation you had earlier.
    
    "If you couldn't live in a great city like Dracia or Njorhaalt, then being in a temple village was the next best thing, perhaps even better. You had to be a little more observant than most, living so close to a temple, but most people found that okay because it meant plenty of excuses to take off work and have fun, accompanied by the best mirrorwine. Of course, I'm sure that our own tales paint us in a better light than the Lumians' do, but that's only to be expected."
    
    Ahem. Moving back to Xadaron Temple, if she might...
    
    "Oh, right. It was supposed to be three stories high, built with the wyld tree it housed as the central supporting pillar. That's right — the greatest of the temples each housed one of the half-dozen wyld trees that we worship — or worshipped, now — and Xadaron Temple was home to the greatest and most ancient of them all.
    
    "And to speak to the adventurer in you, Champion... I'm not sure how much can have survived both time and the rampantly growing fungus, but my predecessors had no shortage of valuables. Winemaking, fabric weaving, nectar collection, and apothecary were all major druidic professions — we'd like to have any major relics you find returned, and you'll be compensated, of course. That being said, everything else you find is yours to keep; by necessity, we've embraced asceticism in the last couple of centuries."
    
    All right, you get the picture. So, grand temple — flower farms, vineyards, wine cellar, hospital, maybe? Then of course, then main reason it's called a temple — no doubt rooms for worship and all that. Is there any chance she could give you a map or something of the place? A floor plan?
    
    A rueful smile. "I'm afraid not. Everyone who's personally seen Xadaron Temple with their own eyes is now dead, be it from old age or not returning from being sent to investigate. Your party will be on your own."
    
    You see. Now, is there something more you need to ask Hethia...?

只是为了让大家清楚，我其实从未真正去过那里，也没有亲眼看到过任何东西，”赫希娅说道。“我们被警告过不要过于接近那些被感染的寺庙，因为担心会带来感染，所以我所知道的一切，充其量也只是道听途说而已。
    
    你明白的——这就像Ryn只是从书本中了解了一些历史知识，其他渠道并没有让她了解到更多内容。

“虽然严厉，但确实很贴切。总之，在boer'alvar还效忠于旧日荒野的时候，Xadaron神庙无疑是所有德鲁伊神庙中最宏伟、最奢华的，这主要是因为它属于Xadaron家族的领地，而这个家族已经连续十代担任大德鲁伊一职。 按照当时的运作方式，每一座寺庙都由某个家族来管理，就如同贝拉兰的贵族管理着自己的小领地一样——这些家族负责管理寺庙及其周边的村庄，拥有相当大的自治权，但为此他们必须向王室缴纳赋税，并且还要为王室的骑兵提供住宿或驻防支持。"
    
    考虑到你之前的谈话，这样想倒也挺合理的。

“如果不能生活在像德拉西亚或尼约哈尔特这样的繁华城市里，那么住在寺庙所在的村庄里也算是次优的选择，甚至可能更好。住在离寺庙这么近的地方，你确实需要比大多数人更加留心观察周围的环境，但大多数人其实都觉得这样挺好的，因为这给了他们很多借口可以请假出去玩，还能享受到最上等的镜酒。 当然，我相信我们自己讲述的故事会让我们显得比卢米安人的描述更加美好，但这也是意料之中的事。
    
    咳，回到萨达隆神庙的话题上来，如果她允许的话……

“哦，对了。那座神庙本来应该有三层高，它的主体结构就是以那棵被用来作为支撑的野生树木建造的。没错——所有的神庙中，每一座都供奉着我们崇拜的六棵野生树木中的一棵；而萨达隆神庙，则供奉着其中最伟大、最古老的那一棵。
    
    对于你内心那个热爱冒险的人来说，冠军……我不确定有多少物品能够同时经受住时间的考验以及那些肆意蔓延的真菌的侵蚀，但我的前辈们确实收集到了许多珍贵的财物。酿酒、织布、采集花蜜以及制药都是德鲁伊的重要职业——我们希望你能将你发现的任何重要遗物归还给我们，当然，你也会因此得到相应的报酬。至于你找到的其他东西，那就全部归你所有吧；在过去的几个世纪里，我们出于必要，选择了过简朴的生活。
    
    明白了，你应该懂我的意思了。那么，这座宏伟的寺庙里应该有花田、葡萄园、酒窖，甚至还有医院吧？当然，它被称为“寺庙”的主要原因，肯定是里面设有用于祭祀的场所等等。她有没有可能给你提供这个地方的地图或者平面图呢？
    
    他露出了一丝懊悔的笑容：“恐怕不行。所有亲眼见过萨达隆神庙的人，现在都已经去世了——要么是因为年老，要么是在执行调查任务后再也没有回来。你们的队伍将只能独自面对这一切了。”

你看，现在还有什么问题需要向赫希娅询问吗……？

rows.original: Hethia raises an eyebrow. "After some discussion with Elthara and several valkyries, we agree that the infestation is unlikely to be able to affect anyone who doesn't possess druidic powers, since it feeds off that. Whatever hold it might have on you and yours, Elthara should be able to treat... in short, you should be impervious to infection. You're still interested?" Morbid curiosity, maybe? Besides, even if the fungus isn't able to affect you, that's not to say that whatever's left in the temple won't be able to hurt you in other ways. "All right, I'll indulge you. As I said, the infection fed upon our particular brand of power to proliferate — attempts to cure it with remedies or spells merely accelerated the disease's progression. The first signs of infestation would be discolored blotches on the skin, alongside an elevated libido. As the infestation progressed, the blotches would break out into fungal growths, while the victim quickly lost all sense... having consumed the outside, the infestation would progress inward, filling the lungs with spores and causing rampant, uncontrolled growth in the body. Hermaphroditism was the most common result, followed by extra fingers and toes, tumors, all kinds of disfigurements and open sores as skin and flesh could not contain the twisted powers running amok on the body. At the end of it all, only death awaited, the victim barely recognizable as an elf any more." That's rather detailed and graphic, although you're not surprised that description has been preserved so well. "It may sound rather fantastic, but it's not. We made it a point to accurately record the cause of our downfall. In the earlier stages of infestation, the afflicted would seek to force themselves upon others, presumably driven by the fungus to spread its spores. The elven druids weren't the only ones afflicted, either — other creatures like dryads who served the wyld, or the trees themselves were also consumed by the infection, although it had differing effects on them. "You can see why we've been very careful all this time to not risk spreading whatever may remain to our last holdouts." They did send people to investigate the temples, though... "With what we felt were adequate protections, that were clearly inadequate since they never returned. At this point, like it or not, the Lumian boer'alvar are the only chance of actually finding out what's been going on all these years. No doubt that must stick in Mie's craw quite a bit." So, that's all there is to this fungal infection, then? Turns you horny, causes your body to grow out of control and die like a big cancer? "Might be. Might not be. Who knows what might have happened these last two centuries, since the temples were condemned? Maybe the Wraiths and their servants had some ultimate purpose behind this weapon that we never got to record because we fled too early, maybe there's something more horrible inside those ancient walls. I don't know... none of us do, which is part of what this investigation is supposed to achieve. But yes, I've just given you the summarized version of what we know about this thing." You see. Now, is there something more you need to ask Hethia...?
rows.translation: 赫希娅挑了挑眉毛：“经过与埃尔萨拉以及几位女武神的讨论，我们认为这种寄生虫不太可能影响到那些没有德鲁伊能力的人，因为这种寄生虫正是以这些能力为食的。无论它对你和你的同伴们产生了怎样的影响，埃尔萨拉应该能够加以治疗……简而言之，你们应该不会受到这种感染的威胁。你还是有兴趣继续吗？ 也许是病态的好奇心在作祟吧？更何况，即使这种真菌无法对你造成伤害，也不代表寺庙里剩下的那些东西不会以其他方式伤害你。 “好吧，我就满足你的好奇心吧。正如我所说，这种感染正是依靠我们特有的力量才能不断扩散的——用各种药物或法术试图治愈它，只会加速病情的发展罢了。 感染的最初迹象会是皮肤上出现变色斑块，同时性欲也会增强。随着感染的发展，这些斑块会逐渐发展成真菌性病变，而感染者也会迅速失去意识。当这些寄生虫侵蚀了身体外部之后，它们会继续向内部蔓延，使肺部充满孢子，并导致身体内部出现失控性的生长。最常见的结果是出现两性特征，其次是多指或多趾、肿瘤，以及各种畸形和开放性溃疡——因为皮肤和肉体已经无法容纳那些在体内肆意肆虐的异常力量了。 最终，等待受害者的只有死亡，而那个受害者已经几乎无法被认出是精灵了。 这个描述听起来确实有些夸张，但事实并非如此。我们特意认真记录下了导致我们失败的原因。 在感染初期，受影响生物会试图强迫其他生物与自己发生接触，这很可能是真菌为了传播孢子而驱使它们这样做的。受到感染的不仅仅是精灵德鲁伊——那些服务于自然界的生物，比如树精，甚至树木本身也会被这种感染侵袭，只不过这种感染对它们的影响各不相同。 你们应该能理解，为什么我们一直以来都如此谨慎，生怕将自己手中仅存的资源也浪费掉，从而影响到那些还在坚持抵抗的人。 做了 我们本来以为采取了足够的保护措施，但显然这些措施并不够，因为他们再也没有回来。如今，不管我们愿不愿意，卢米安的布尔阿尔瓦人才是真正能够查明这些年来究竟发生了什么的唯一希望。 毫无疑问，这件事肯定让米感到非常恼火。” 那么，这种真菌感染就只是会导致这些症状吗？会让人变得欲火中烧，让身体失控生长，最后像患了严重的癌症一样死去吗？ “也可能是这样的。 未必如此。谁知道在过去的两个世纪里，自从那些神庙被诅咒之后，究竟发生了什么呢？也许那些幽灵及其仆从制造这种武器背后有着某种我们永远无法了解的终极目的，只是因为我们太早逃走了，才没能记录下来；又或许，那些古老的墙壁里隐藏着更加恐怖的东西。 我不知道……我们所有人都不清楚，而这正是这次调查所要弄清楚的部分。不过，我刚才确实向你们总结了我们目前所掌握的关于这个事情的信息。 你看，现在还有没有什么问题你需要再问赫希娅呢？..?
rows.raw: " Hethia raises an eyebrow. "After some discussion with Elthara and several valkyries, we agree that the infestation is unlikely to be able to affect anyone who doesn't possess druidic powers, since it feeds off that. Whatever hold it might have on you and yours, Elthara should be able to treat... in short, you should be impervious to infection. You're still interested?" Morbid curiosity, maybe? Besides, even if the fungus isn't able to affect you, that's not to say that whatever's left in the temple won't be able to hurt you in other ways. "All right, I'll indulge you. As I said, the infection fed upon our particular brand of power to proliferate — attempts to cure it with remedies or spells merely accelerated the disease's progression. The first signs of infestation would be discolored blotches on the skin, alongside an elevated libido. As the infestation progressed, the blotches would break out into fungal growths, while the victim quickly lost all sense... having consumed the outside, the infestation would progress inward, filling the lungs with spores and causing rampant, uncontrolled growth in the body. Hermaphroditism was the most common result, followed by extra fingers and toes, tumors, all kinds of disfigurements and open sores as skin and flesh could not contain the twisted powers running amok on the body. At the end of it all, only death awaited, the victim barely recognizable as an elf any more." That's rather detailed and graphic, although you're not surprised that description has been preserved so well. "It may sound rather fantastic, but it's not. We made it a point to accurately record the cause of our downfall. In the earlier stages of infestation, the afflicted would seek to force themselves upon others, presumably driven by the fungus to spread its spores. The elven druids weren't the only ones afflicted, either — other creatures like dryads who served the wyld, or the trees themselves were also consumed by the infection, although it had differing effects on them. "You can see why we've been very careful all this time to not risk spreading whatever may remain to our last holdouts." They did send people to investigate the temples, though... "With what we felt were adequate protections, that were clearly inadequate since they never returned. At this point, like it or not, the Lumian boer'alvar are the only chance of actually finding out what's been going on all these years. No doubt that must stick in Mie's craw quite a bit." So, that's all there is to this fungal infection, then? Turns you horny, causes your body to grow out of control and die like a big cancer? "Might be. Might not be. Who knows what might have happened these last two centuries, since the temples were condemned? Maybe the Wraiths and their servants had some ultimate purpose behind this weapon that we never got to record because we fled too early, maybe there's something more horrible inside those ancient walls. I don't know... none of us do, which is part of what this investigation is supposed to achieve. But yes, I've just given you the summarized version of what we know about this thing." You see. Now, is there something more you need to ask Hethia...? "

rows.original: "I'd have said the fungal infection, but you should be good with that; Elthara should be able to alleviate the worst of the ill effects. Anything else that it's able to do to you should be curable with common remedies; I suggest that you bring plenty just in case. "It's common knowledge that violent, traumatic or otherwise emotion-filled deaths often give rise to lingering spirits. Given how the druids must've been in equal parts unbearable pain and lust by the time they succumbed to the disease, I wouldn't be surprised if you had to deal with any number of the specters that would've resulted. Elthara and the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] can help you with that, but you wouldn't want to leave them to do all the work, right?" No, you guess you can't let Elthara and Ryn garner all the glory for themselves. Is there anything else you should take note of? "Elven druids aside, the major temples also housed many other wyld kin — elementals, faeries, dryads and their ilk. The histories mostly focus on the elves, but they were afflicted by the fungal infection as well; what transformations in body and mind they may have undergone as a result of the disease are not recorded. Please be careful. "And finally, there's the matter of the wyld tree the temple was built around." Their... well, god wouldn't be the right word for it, not in the way that the Seven are to most peoples. Patron, then? "Ever since we fled our temples in the eastern Frostwood, those wyld trees have fallen silent to us. The assumption all these years is that they perished in much the same manner that the druids did, but now that the chance to investigate has come up I'm wondering if some other fate might have befallen them." Hethia shakes her head. "Be careful. Even if it is deceased, a corpse that mighty still possess much potential for danger. "All this aside... well, you're the adventurer here. I'm sure you've all kinds of ropes, tools, six-foot poles, that kind of stuff. That's about the extent of the advice I'm able to give you, I'm afraid." Nevertheless, it's appreciated. Now, is there anything about this trip that you'd like to discuss with Hethia?

rows.original: Are you sure that you're prepared? Once you set off, you won't be able to backtrack until the adventure's done with.
rows.translation: 你确定自己已经做好了准备吗？一旦开始行动，除非冒险结束，否则你就无法回头了。
rows.raw: "\n    Are you sure that you're prepared? Once you set off, you won't be able to backtrack until the adventure's done with.\n    "

rows.original: [var0 |Hethia eyes you. "Oh, you're ready to set off? One problem, though — if you bring both your current companions, Elthara and the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ], that'll be too many people. Once you've dismissed your companion with a hearty invitation to have the run of the palace while you're away, Hethia gives you a nod.
                   
                   "Well, no time like the present. I'll get Elthara and the [etheryn.crowned|queen|princess-regent], then have everyone meet up at the kennels."

当你热情地邀请你的同伴在你离开期间自由游览宫殿后，赫希娅向你点了点头。

“嗯，现在正是最好的时机。我去把埃尔萨拉和 [etheryn.crowned|女王|摄政公主]那么，就让大家在犬舍那里集合吧。

rows.original: You've made your preparations, there's no reason to put it off any longer.
rows.translation: 你已经做好了所有的准备，没有理由再拖延下去了。
rows.raw: "You've made your preparations, there's no reason to put it off any longer."

rows.original:
It's probably for the best — you're heading into unknown territory and should cover all your bases. It's not like the talks are moving at any pace other than glacial, anyway...
        
        Now, is there something else you wanted to ask Hethia about the temple?
rows.translation:
这或许反而是件好事——你即将进入一个未知的领域，因此有必要做好万全的准备。反正这些谈判的进展速度也慢得像冰川移动一样……

那么，关于那座寺庙，还有其他你想问赫希娅的事情吗？
rows.raw:
"
        It's probably for the best — you're heading into unknown territory and should cover all your bases. It's not like the talks are moving at any pace other than glacial, anyway...
        
        Now, is there something else you wanted to ask Hethia about the temple?
        "

rows.original: Maybe you still need to prepare more.
rows.translation: 也许你还需要再做更多的准备。
rows.raw: "Maybe you still need to prepare more."

rows.translation: 让那位爱龙之人安静下来吧……

rows.original:
You enter Mary's shop, looking at the various shelves of alchemical ingredients, the tables where various alchemical concoctions and the tools to make them are displayed, and the exotic decorations everywhere else — like those strange glass orbs in nets attached to the ceiling. Overall, it feels like a shop made by someone with plenty of means and experience, and it almost makes you want to loiter and window shop for hours on end.
    
    So much so that [party.som
        |you do take your time along the aisles while you head for the counter
        |[companion.name] goes off to enjoy it by [comp1.mf
            |him
            |her
        ]self
        |both of your companions go off to enjoy it on their own
    ]. The shop is pretty large and with little to no customers, so you end up drinking in the atmosphere alone before you meet with the shop's [kesuk.isBull
        |cute dommy bull, who grins and gives your ass a friendly spank, then rubs it as he
        |poster-boy who blushes and waves at you, and
    ] walks with you to the counter where the mino-gal smiles at you.
    
    "My, if it isn't our favorite client! What can we do for you, sweetie?" Mary grins at you. The minotaur's head is resting in her hands as she leans over the counter, her generous bust squished against the surface. It's very distracting cleavage, and her grin shows she knows it.
    
    [kesuk.isBull
        |Kesuk doesn't say anything but just gives you a friendly grin, giving a small wave as he stands nearby. The mino boy looks cute as always, though he does stand with a lot more confidence than before. One hand on his hip, with the kind of pose and smile that says he's very much aware you're staring at his bulge and ass, and he enjoys the attention.
        |Kesuk doesn't say anything but just smiles shyly at you, giving a small nod as he stands nearby. The mino boy looks as cute as always, [silly
            |cutely doing his job of standing around the shop looking cute and wriggling cutely like the cute poster boy he is
            |doing his job as poster boy to offer a pretty face and assistance to clients that come in
        ].
    ]
rows.translation:
你走进玛丽的商店，看着那些摆满各种炼金材料的架子，那些陈列着各种炼金药剂以及制作这些药剂所需工具的桌子，还有那些随处可见的奇特装饰品——比如那些挂在天花板上的、用网状结构固定的奇怪玻璃球体。总体来说，这个商店给人的感觉就像是某个财力雄厚且经验丰富的人精心打造出来的，甚至会让你忍不住想在这里闲逛上几个小时，仔细欣赏这些陈列品。

真的，简直让人 [party.som
        |在走向收银台的过程中，你可以慢慢地在过道里走。
        |[companion.name] 去享受它吧 [comp1.mf
            |他
            |她
        ]自己
        |你的两位同伴都各自去享受乐趣了。
    ]这家商店相当大，但几乎没有任何顾客，因此你在与店主见面之前，只能独自在这种氛围中喝酒。 [kesuk.isBull
        |可爱的“霸道主人”啊，他会微笑着友好地拍打你的屁股，然后还会揉搓着它……
        |那个会脸红、还会向你挥手致意的形象代言人……
    ] 它陪你走到柜台前，那里的米诺牛女孩正对你微笑。

“哎呀，这不是我们最喜欢的顾客吗？亲爱的，我们能为您做些什么呢？”玛丽对你笑着说。她把米诺牛的头放在手部上，身体探过柜台，她那丰满的上半身紧紧贴在柜台上。这样的身材实在非常吸引人的注意，而她的笑容也表明她很清楚这一点。
    
    [kesuk.isBull
        |凯苏克什么也没说，只是友好地笑了笑，站在旁边还轻轻挥了挥手。这个米诺男孩看起来还是像以前一样可爱，不过这次他的姿态显得更加自信了——他一只手叉腰，那副样子和笑容明显在表明，他很清楚你在盯着他的凸起部位看，而且他也很享受这种关注。
        |克苏克什么也没说，只是害羞地对你笑了笑，站在旁边微微点了点头。这个米诺男孩看起来还是像以前一样可爱。 [silly
            |他正以自己那可爱的形象站在商店里，扭动着身体，表现得格外惹人喜爱，完全就是个十足的“可爱宣传代言人”。
            |他充当着“形象代言人”的角色，为前来咨询的客户提供漂亮的外表以及帮助。
        ].
    ]

rows.original: You figure you might as well see what this new building is about, so you go in, looking around without bothering to hide your curiosity. Though the building itself doesn't look relatively new, everything inside does. The smell of fresh wood and freshly unpacked things greets you when you enter, and parts of the shop are still cluttered with boxes. You did solve the city's... royal problems, so it shouldn't be a surprise that someone finally felt comfortable enough to open a new shop now. It's filled with a lot of half-opened boxes, though you spot a number of bags of... ingredients? You can see some regular camping supplies here and there too. Is this shop meant for travelers, or did they arrive after a long trip and are planning to sell their excess supplies? You could probably just ask, surely the owner isn't far from their own open shop... Yes, your guess is proved correct when you navigate through the relatively wide but cluttered shop and someone calls out to you. A rather big minotaur woman hurries over to you, emerging from some backroom while brushing wood chips off her shoulder. She has an impressive figure, and stands proud and straight despite the massive G-cups hanging off her front, which threaten to spill out of her white frilly top. She's a northern minotaur, and she's sporting a cute black snout and a black fur coat that covers her entire body, with a big white patch that stretches down from her chin. And you notice her short-ish curly hair bounces just as much as her cleavage as she clops up to you. "Yes, yes, I'm coming! I do apologize for the wait, unpacking everything took much longer than I thought... my!" she pauses when she sees you properly, looking you[party.isJustPC | |r party ] up and down and smiling brightly. "You don't look like the delivery I was waiting for, and you certainly [pc.ra borealelf |look more adventurous than the locals. |don't look like a local. [party.has Ryn |Well, apart from one of you obviously." She grins at Ryn. " ] ] Welcome! Sorry for staring, I'm a fresh arrival myself and I get my fair share of curious glances in the street too. I'm Marigold, but everyone calls me Mary." You laugh and tell her there's no problem, giving her your name[party.isJustPC | |s ] in turn. You can understand the feeling, besides, she looks pretty far from home. Considering her appearance, she's from the Far North, isn't she? "You're correct! I braved the elements and risked my life, fighting countless bandits and monsters on my way..." she says ominously, before bursting with laughter and slapping her belly. "Hah! I wish. No, it was a boringly uneventful if exhausting trip. Worst part was that on our last stop, we learned the city was occupied by a tyrant! We obviously couldn't have gotten in, so we were looking into some other location we could move the shop to, when some hero just went and kicked her out! Very kind of them. That's what a good neighbor does, that is." You smile at her bombastic nature, wondering how she might react knowing she was talking to that same hero. But even if you wanted to brag, you get the feeling she wouldn't believe you in this situation. Instead, you wonder what she came here to sell? The sign was uh. Not exactly helpful. "Oh, yes, I've yet to get around to that! Well, I don't mind telling you, [pc.mf |mister |miss ], but I am in the middle of preparing everything, and I didn't put the open sign out, naughty [pc.mf |boy |girl ]! So if you want to stay, help me unpack this, will you?" she grins, suddenly shoving a box in your arms and not giving you an option to say no[party.isJustPC | before she gives your companion[party.oneCompanion | |s ] something else to do ]. Admittedly you did enter uninvited, so it's fair enough. You put the box down on a table she gestures you towards, and begin unpacking... packs of dried herbs, mushrooms of various colors, vials of gooey liquids, and far weirder things. Are those alchemical ingredients? "Correct! I came here to open up my shop of alchemical marvels!" Oh? You have to admit, you're curious about what alchemy is like in the Far North. "Well, the only way to know would be going there the one time of year it opens up, so good luck!" she says with a hearty laugh, rummaging through a box full of wood chips and pulling out a set of glass bottles she puts on a shelf. "Not to mention it's impossible to build a shop there. Which is precisely why there was a fortune to be made by simply bringing goods from afar." Aah, it does make sense, supply and demand and all that. So she sells ingredients and potions and such? "Oh, mostly ingredients, and some basic supplies as well. I sold potions up north until I had the funds to start a proper shop down south, but then I found out that my clients always wanted very specific results. I just gave up and started selling ingredients and alchemist kits! It worked far better than I expected." You wonder where in the south that shop was, exactly. Before you can ask that question however, another person comes out of the back room. A much smaller and boyish minotaur this time. His face is all but human, with pale skin and a cute button nose, the only hints of his race being the tiny nubby horns that peek out of his messy black hair, as well as the cute black bovine ears. Your eyes slide down, noting he's incredibly slender and soft looking, and though your eyes stop at his impressive ass you do confirm that he has hooved legs as well. Come to think of it, he's wearing black pants and the same kind of top as Mary, though it looks quite different on him. And she's... wearing the same pants. They wear matching outfits? Cute. "Mo- um, Mary, I can't find the... oh, hello!" he yelps when he notices you, fidgeting on the spot. "Er-" "Don't worry sweetheart, [pc.heShe]'s just a very helpful visitor!" the woman laughs. "Speaking of, hand me that box there will you? Thank you. This is my most wonderful and cute husband, Kesuk," she says proudly, which makes the boy blush up a storm. "As well as my poster boy." A pleasure. But wait, husband? You don't want to be rude, but you kinda thought he was her son. "Well, he is young enough to be my son. But we love each other too much to care, and if you have a problem with that, the exit is right there," she tells you with a bright smile. Oh, you're not judging or anything, if they're both happy and in love that's what matters. But he did almost call her mom. "No, he almost called me 'mommy', because that's what he calls me when we're alone," the cow mommy explains casually, which makes the boy blush even harder somehow. He had rather pale skin when you first saw him, but now he's more red than white. Though he's also stifling a smile. "I mean, wouldn't you call me mommy too if you had the chance?" With a laugh, you tell her this might be a bit forward, though you have to admit she does seem like a very fun mom. "Such an honest [pc.mf |boy |girl ]! I'd hug you for that, but we do need to get this done, and I wouldn't want to make my favorite cutie jealous," she chuckles. The favorite boy in question did look bothered when you looked, but relieved when she relented. You start to focus on unpacking, though you figure you could return the favor and talk a bit about yourself. You still think they wouldn't believe you if you said everything, so you mostly tell them what you did before you came here and started your journey, though you do regale them with a few of your adventures. They coo and ahh and joke with you, and soon enough the atmosphere is very much pleasant and friendly. Even the boy, despite being such a scaredy cat, ends up coming close to you at some point, asking you for help putting things up on the higher shelves [pc.heightRange 0 60 |as a fellow shorty |since you're taller ]. He's a bit clumsy, but he does try his best. By the end, most boxes in the shop have been opened and emptied, and you feel satisfied. Though you did not exactly plan to do this when you entered this shop, in the end you feel like you did something good and earned two friends, so it's all good in the end. "Now, while I would love to offer you some tea as thanks, I'm afraid there's still more boxes in the back!" Mary laughs loudly. "But I won't ask [party.isJustPC |a guest |guests ] to help anymore than this, you already did so much! Thank you very much cutie[party.isJustPC | |s ]. Come back again tomorrow, and everything should be nice and ready. I'll serve you the best tea this side of the mountain!" "Th-Thanks again, [pc.mf |mister |miss ] [pc.name]," Kesuk tells you with a timid smile. "You helped out a lot, and um, you were nice. I hope we'll see you soon!" Adorable. Well, if they insist, you won't overstay your welcome, and your arms are already feeling sore anyway. You still wave goodbye to them as you traverse the far less cluttered room[party.isJustPC | with your companion[party.oneCompanion | |s ] ] and emerge back into the street, welcoming the refreshing air.
rows.translation: 你心想，反正也好看看这座新建筑里到底有什么，于是便走了进去，四处打量着，丝毫没有掩饰自己的好奇心。虽然这座建筑本身看起来并不算很新，但里面的所有东西却都显得很新。当你走进去时，一股新鲜木材和刚拆开的物品散发出的气味迎面扑来，商店的某些区域里仍然堆满了箱子。 你确实解决了这座城市里那些……与皇室相关的问题，所以现在终于有人愿意开新店了，这也并不奇怪。店里堆满了许多半打开的箱子，不过你也看到了几袋东西。这些商品都是用来露营的吗？在这里和那里，你也能够看到一些常见的露营用品。这家商店是专门为旅行者准备的，还是说有些人在长途旅行之后来到这里，打算把多余的用品卖掉呢？你直接问一下不就知道了吗？店主应该就在附近吧，他们的店铺应该也是敞开的吧。…是的，当你穿梭于这个虽然空间宽敞但却杂乱无章的商店里时，果然有人叫住了你，这说明你的猜测是正确的。 一位身材高大的女弥诺陶洛斯匆匆走向你，她从某个幕后区域走出来，同时正拍掉肩上的木屑。她拥有令人印象深刻的体态，尽管前胸那巨大的G罩杯几乎要从她那白色蕾丝上衣中凸出来，但她依然挺拔地站立着，显得非常自信。 她是一头北方弥诺陶洛斯，拥有一张可爱的黑色鼻子，全身覆盖着黑色的毛皮，只有下巴下方有一块巨大的白色斑块。当你靠近她时，你会注意到她那略带卷曲的短发，以及她那引人注目的胸部，在她走动时都会随着步伐一起晃动。 是的，是的，我马上就来！真的很抱歉让大家等待了，整理这些东西所花的时间比我预想的要长得多……哎呀！”当她终于看清你的样子时，她停住了说话，仔细地打量着你。[party.isJustPC | |派对 ] 上上下下，笑容满面。“你看起来完全不像我一直在等待的那个人，当然 [pc.ra borealelf |看起来比当地人更喜欢冒险。 |看起来不像是本地人。 [party.has Ryn |嗯，除了你们当中的某个人之外。”她对着瑞恩笑了笑。 ] ] 欢迎！不好意思，我刚才盯着你看，其实我也是刚来到这里的人，所以在街上也会经常收到别人好奇的目光。我叫玛里戈尔德，不过大家都叫我玛丽。 你笑着告诉她没关系，然后也告诉了她自己的名字。[party.isJustPC | |s ] 反过来想，你也能理解这种感受。而且，她看起来离家乡应该很远。从她的外貌来看，她应该来自遥远的北方，对吧？ “你说得对！我冒着严寒，冒着生命危险，在路上与无数强盗和怪物进行了斗争。……”她阴森森地说道，随即爆发出一阵笑声，还拍打着自己的肚子。“哈！我倒是希望会发生点什么呢。不，那其实是一次无聊又平淡无奇，但却非常累人的旅行。最糟糕的是，在我们的最后一站，我们发现那座城市被一个暴君占领了！ 我们显然无法进入那里，所以正在考虑把店铺搬到其他地方去，这时某个“英雄”突然出现，把她赶了出去！他们真是太好了。这才是真正的好邻居该做的啊。 你对她那夸夸其谈的作风报以微笑，心里却在想：如果她知道自己正在和那位英雄交谈，会作何反应呢？不过，就算你想炫耀些什么，你也觉得在这种情况下她根本不会相信你。相反，你更想知道她来这里究竟想卖什么。 那个标志啊，其实没什么帮助。 “哦，对，我还没来得及处理那件事呢！不过，我并不介意告诉你们 [pc.mf |先生 |错过 ]但是，我 是 就在我准备所有东西的时候，却忘了挂上“营业中”的标志，真糟糕。 [pc.mf |男孩 |女孩 ]所以，如果你想留下来的话，就帮我把这些东西拆开吧，好吗？”她笑着说，突然把一个箱子塞到你的怀里，根本不给你拒绝的机会。[party.isJustPC | 在她把你的同伴交出来之前[party.oneCompanion | |s ] 还有其他事情要做 ]诚然，你确实是未经邀请就进来了，所以这也情有可原。你把那些包裹放在她指给你的桌子上，然后开始拆开包装……一包包干草药、五颜六色的蘑菇、装着黏稠液体的小瓶子，还有许多更加奇怪的东西。那些难道都是炼金术所需的材料吗？ 没错！我来这里就是为了开一家出售炼金奇物的商店！” 哦？你得承认，你肯定很好奇远北地区的炼金术是怎样的吧。 “嗯，唯一能了解真相的方法就是在那一年中唯一一次有机会去那里的时候亲自去看看，祝你好运吧！她哈哈大笑着，从装满木屑的箱子里翻找出一套玻璃瓶，然后把它们放在架子上。“更不用说在那个地方根本不可能开一家商店。正因为如此，从远处运来商品才有可能带来丰厚的利润。" 啊，确实有道理，供求关系嘛。所以她是卖食材和药剂之类的东西吗？ “哦，主要是食材，还有一些基本的用品。我在北方卖药剂，直到有足够的资金在南方开一家正规的店铺，但后来我发现，我的顾客总是希望得到非常具体的效果。于是我就放弃了，开始卖食材和炼金术套装！结果效果比我预想的要好得多。 你不禁想知道，那家商店到底位于南方的哪个地方。然而，还没等你问出这个问题，另一个人从后面的房间走了出来——这一次，出现的是一个体型小得多、看起来更像男孩的弥诺陶洛斯。他的脸几乎完全像人类的脸，皮肤苍白，鼻子圆润可爱，唯一能显示出他种族特征的地方，就是那些从他凌乱的黑色头发中露出来的小角，以及那对可爱的黑色牛耳。 你的目光向下移，注意到他身材极其纤细，看起来十分柔软；虽然你的视线最终停留在他那引人注目的臀部上，但你还是确认了他确实长着蹄子。 仔细想想，他穿着和玛丽一样的黑色裤子和上衣，只不过穿在他身上看起来有点不一样。而她……也穿着同样的裤子。他们穿了一模一样的衣服？真可爱。 “喂，玛丽，我找不到那个……哦，你好！”当他注意到你时，他慌忙地叫道，然后在原地手足无措地站着。“呃—— 别担心，亲爱的 [pc.heShe]他真是个非常乐于助人的访客呢！”那位女士笑着说，“说起来，能把那边的那个盒子递给我吗？谢谢。这是我最棒、最可爱的丈夫，凯苏克，”她自豪地说道，这让男孩的脸一下子红得像熟透的苹果。“他也是我的形象代言人呢。” 真是太荣幸了。不过等等，丈夫？你该不会是搞错了吧，你之前不觉得他是她的儿子吗？ “嗯，他 是 他年纪小得都可以当我儿子了。但我们太相爱了，所以根本不在意这些。如果你对此有意见，那么离开就是最好的选择。”她微笑着对你说。 “哦，我并不是在评判什么，只要他们俩都开心、都相爱，那就最重要了。 但他差点就叫她“妈妈”了。 “没有，他差点就叫我‘妈咪’了，因为在我们单独在一起的时候，他就是这么叫我的，”这位奶牛妈妈若无其事地解释道，这让男孩的脸变得更加红了。刚开始见到他的时候，他的皮肤还挺白的，但现在他的脸已经红得几乎发紫了。 虽然他也在强忍着笑意。“我的意思是，难道不会 你 如果有机会的话，也叫我妈妈吧？” 你笑着告诉她，这样可能有点太直接了，不过你不得不承认，她确实看起来像是个非常有趣的妈妈。 “真是个诚实的人 [pc.mf |男孩 |女孩 ]真想为此抱抱你，但我们确实得完成这件事，而且我也不想让我最喜欢的宝贝吃醋哦，”她笑着说。说到这个“最喜欢的男孩”，当你看向他的时候，他确实看起来有些不高兴，但当她让步后，他又显得松了一口气。 你开始专心地回答他们的问题，不过你也想着可以反过来也问问他们一些关于他们自己的事情。你仍然觉得，如果把所有的事情都告诉他们，他们可能也不会相信你，所以你主要讲述了来这里之前自己的经历以及开始这段旅程的经过，不过也偶尔会给他们讲讲自己遇到的一些冒险经历。 它们会发出轻柔的叫声，还会和你开玩笑，很快，氛围就会变得非常愉快和友好。就连那个原本非常胆小的男孩，最终也会靠近你，向你求助，让你帮忙把东西放到较高的架子上。 [pc.heightRange 0 60 |作为一个身材矮小的人…… |既然你个子更高…… ]他虽然有点笨手笨脚，但确实一直在尽力。 最后，店里的大多数盒子都被打开并清空了，你感到很满足。虽然当初进入这家店时你并没有打算这么做，但现在你觉得自己做了一件好事，还交到了两个朋友，所以一切都是值得的。 “现在，虽然我很想请你们喝点茶表示感谢，但恐怕后面还有更多的盒子没处理呢！”玛丽大声笑道，“不过我不会强迫你们的 [party.isJustPC |一位客人 |客人 ] 你能做的已经够多了，再帮忙的话就过分了！真的非常感谢你，亲爱的！[party.isJustPC | |s ]明天再回来吧，到那时一切都应该准备妥当了。我会为你提供这座山这边最好的茶叶！” “再、再谢谢您！ [pc.mf |先生 |错过 ] [pc.name]凯苏克带着一丝羞涩的微笑对你说：‘你帮了我们大忙，而且你人也很友善。希望我们能很快再见到你！’” 真是太可爱了。好吧，如果他们坚持邀请的话，你也不会拒绝他们的好意；而且你的手臂也已经开始感到酸痛了。在穿过这个整洁得多的房间时，你还是向他们挥了挥手道别。[party.isJustPC | 和你的同伴一起[party.oneCompanion | |s ] ] 重新走到街上，呼吸着清新的空气，感觉真是太惬意了。

Are those alchemical ingredients? "Correct! I came here to open up my shop of alchemical marvels!" Oh? You have to admit, you're curious about what alchemy is like in the Far North. "Well, the only way to know would be going there the one time of year it opens up, so good luck!" she says with a hearty laugh, rummaging through a box full of wood chips and pulling out a set of glass bottles she puts on a shelf. "Not to mention it's impossible to build a shop there. Which is precisely why there was a fortune to be made by simply bringing goods from afar." Aah, it does make sense, supply and demand and all that. So she sells ingredients and potions and such? "Oh, mostly ingredients, and some basic supplies as well. I sold potions up north until I had the funds to start a proper shop down south, but then I found out that my clients always wanted very specific results. I just gave up and started selling ingredients and alchemist kits! It worked far better than I expected." You wonder where in the south that shop was, exactly. Before you can ask that question however, another person comes out of the back room. A much smaller and boyish minotaur this time. His face is all but human, with pale skin and a cute button nose, the only hints of his race being the tiny nubby horns that peek out of his messy black hair, as well as the cute black bovine ears. Your eyes slide down, noting he's incredibly slender and soft looking, and though your eyes stop at his impressive ass you do confirm that he has hooved legs as well. Come to think of it, he's wearing black pants and the same kind of top as Mary, though it looks quite different on him. And she's... wearing the same pants. They wear matching outfits? Cute. "Mo- um, Mary, I can't find the... oh, hello!" he yelps when he notices you, fidgeting on the spot. "Er-" "Don't worry sweetheart, [pc.heShe]'s just a very helpful visitor!" the woman laughs. "Speaking of, hand me that box there will you? Thank you. This is my most wonderful and cute husband, Kesuk," she says proudly, which makes the boy blush up a storm. "As well as my poster boy." A pleasure. But wait, husband? You don't want to be rude, but you kinda thought he was her son. "Well, he is young enough to be my son. But we love each other too much to care, and if you have a problem with that, the exit is right there," she tells you with a bright smile. Oh, you're not judging or anything, if they're both happy and in love that's what matters. But he did almost call her mom. "No, he almost called me 'mommy', because that's what he calls me when we're alone," the cow mommy explains casually, which makes the boy blush even harder somehow. He had rather pale skin when you first saw him, but now he's more red than white. Though he's also stifling a smile. "I mean, wouldn't you call me mommy too if you had the chance?" With a laugh, you tell her this might be a bit forward, though you have to admit she does seem like a very fun mom. "Such an honest [pc.mf |boy |girl ]! I'd hug you for that, but we do need to get this done, and I wouldn't want to make my favorite cutie jealous," she chuckles. The favorite boy in question did look bothered when you looked, but relieved when she relented. You start to focus on unpacking, though you figure you could return the favor and talk a bit about yourself. You still think they wouldn't believe you if you said everything, so you mostly tell them what you did before you came here and started your journey, though you do regale them with a few of your adventures. They coo and ahh and joke with you, and soon enough the atmosphere is very much pleasant and friendly. Even the boy, despite being such a scaredy cat, ends up coming close to you at some point, asking you for help putting things up on the higher shelves [pc.heightRange 0 60 |as a fellow shorty |since you're taller ]. He's a bit clumsy, but he does try his best. By the end, most boxes in the shop have been opened and emptied, and you feel satisfied. Though you did not exactly plan to do this when you entered this shop, in the end you feel like you did something good and earned two friends, so it's all good in the end. "Now, while I would love to offer you some tea as thanks, I'm afraid there's still more boxes in the back!" Mary laughs loudly. "But I won't ask [party.isJustPC |a guest |guests ] to help anymore than this, you already did so much! Thank you very much cutie[party.isJustPC | |s ]. Come back again tomorrow, and everything should be nice and ready. I'll serve you the best tea this side of the mountain!" "Th-Thanks again, [pc.mf |mister |miss ] [pc.name]," Kesuk tells you with a timid smile. "You helped out a lot, and um, you were nice. I hope we'll see you soon!" Adorable. Well, if they insist, you won't overstay your welcome, and your arms are already feeling sore anyway. You still wave goodbye to them as you traverse the far less cluttered room[party.isJustPC | with your companion[party.oneCompanion | |s ] ] and emerge back into the street, welcoming the refreshing air. "

rows.original: Well, they did promise you a cup of tea, didn't they? Besides, it looks like they can afford a little break. "Oh? And what's that supposed to mean, mh? That our shop is unpopular and empty so it doesn't matter if we close it anyway?" Er. Well no, you just mean... every business has its less busy hours and uh... You're cut off when Mary bursts out laughing. "Because you're right! The citizens of this newly opened city are still a little wary of a foreigner's shop, apparently. We do get a few clients now and then, but mostly window shoppers. It takes time for ice elves to warm up to someone, eh? So yes, it really doesn't matter if we close shop for the day if we feel like it!" She grins at Kesuk who smiles back, before he runs up to the front of the shop and flips the sign around and locks the door. With the shop closed up for now, Mary steps out from behind the counter and tells you to follow as she enters the door at the back. She leads you through a richly-decorated corridor before you arrive at a very cozy-looking kitchen. It's fairly big, though so full of large furniture it's almost hard to move around, and yet it just feels comfortable. Every piece of furniture is covered in quilts, antimacassars, slipcovers, carpets, upholstery and small fancy pillows to the point you can't even see any wood. And while the armchairs look soft, they feel so much more than that. You sink into one of them as your hosts dig around cupboards for cups, tea and snacks, and then boil some water while you wait patiently and very comfortably. They put the kettle to heat up next to the hearth, which is no doubt partially to blame for part of this very warm atmosphere. But not nearly as much as the smiles of your hosts, and the way Mary unabashedly flirts and gropes her husband who blushes and half-heartedly complains while pushing back into her. Eventually, the tea is done and the couple sit down on the other two chairs, finally settling down. And in the silence that follows as you all wait for the tea to finish brewing, you start to wonder. She mentioned she didn't care about having clients, but then... Well, how does her business stay afloat? Mary laughs quite loudly, and she has to calm herself down before pouring three cups of tea for you, Kesuk and herself. You notice she put three sugars in Kesuk's cup, one in hers, and put the sugarbox next to you for you to put as many as you like. "Well, it's a fair question," Mary admits. "I told you that I started my business by selling potions to the Far North, where that sort of thing isn't common, yes?" Right, she did. It makes sense, while there might be some people afraid of the stuff out of ignorance, novelty always sells. "Precisely. But in order to get both the idea and the merchandise, we had to travel out of the Far North, since there's none of that there. And I have my Kessy sweetie to thank for that!" she grins, and you turn to Kesuk who sinks in his chair in embarrassment. "I- I didn't do much, I just wanted to travel... You're the one who took care of everything, Mary." "I never would have thought to travel without you! And don't sell yourself short, you're a better traveler than I am!" You smile at the cute couple's antics, and finally try a sip of the tea... Huh. It's not bad but, well, you can't quite grasp what it even is. The best way to put it is that it tastes like how the smell of a flower would taste, and you don't even know what flower exactly. "Oh yes!" Mary says, noticing your face. "My cute husband's own brew, made of discrete flowers that grow in the snow unnoticed by most. It's strange, but you'll be addicted before you know it, he's so talented! But enough making my husband squirm, not that it ever gets old. The point is, on our way we traveled to a few places and realized each place had its own alchemical specialty that others didn't know about, especially not our homeland. So I figured I could make a fortune by buying from one place and carrying the goods to homesteads only locals know how to look for." "It did work a lot better than we expected," Kesuk notes. "I mean, Mary was already kind of well-off in the first place, but it really took off with that venture." "Mhm! And then we started opening shops outside of the Far North, to give us locations to import ingredients and tools more easily. And this shop is the latest one! It doesn't matter if it doesn't sell much, because its purpose is to give us a place to purchase from and sell elsewhere!" Huh. You look at the minotaurs, one puffing her generous chest proudly, the other looking at the former lovingly, and find yourself impressed. She might be underselling it, but traveling back and forth with sensitive ingredients in such a harsh environment can't be easy. "It's not, and it's why we don't do it anymore!" she laughs. "Now that we're really rich, we just hire people to do the trip for us. Now all we do ourselves is looking for new potential locations, buying or building a shop and settling in before going for the next. When we feel like it!" she laughs again, and you can't help but join in. You spend the next few hours with the lovely couple, chatting about everything and nothing, enjoying the peculiar but awfully tasty tea. You talk about your respective homelands, about what you got up to recently, about what's happening in the city, and a plethora of little jokes and inconsequential little things. You laugh, drink and snack with them, not seeing the time go by. Spending time with them feels very warm and comfortable, and seeing their happy smiles it's clear the feeling is mutual. Before you know it, the kettle is empty and you have to admit you've been here maybe longer than you should have. You get up and thank the sweet couple for the pleasant tea time, before making your way back outside. Mary gives you a hearty pat on the butt as you leave, laughing and waving you goodbye while you wave back.
rows.translation: 嗯，他们确实答应过给你泡杯茶，对吧？而且，看起来他们也有能力稍微休息一下。 “哦？那这又是什么意思呢？难道是说我们的店不受欢迎，所以关店也没关系吗？” 呃，不是这样的，你只是想说……每个店铺都会有生意不那么繁忙的时段而已…… 就在这时，玛丽突然大笑起来，打断了他的话。“因为你说得对！显然，这个新开张的城市里的居民们还是对外国人的店铺有点警惕。我们偶尔也会遇到一些顾客，但大多数都只是随便看看而已。冰精灵们需要一些时间来适应别人，对吧？所以，如果我们想今天不营业的话，其实也没关系啊！ 她对着凯苏克笑了笑，凯苏克也回以微笑，然后跑上前去把店里的招牌翻过来，锁上了门。既然店铺暂时关了，玛丽就从柜台后面走出来，让你跟着她从后门进去。 她引领你穿过一条装饰华丽的走廊，最终来到一间看起来非常舒适的厨房。厨房面积相当大，但由于摆满了大型家具，几乎让人难以活动，但就是这种布置让人感到非常惬意。每一件家具上都覆盖着被子、防污罩、桌布、地毯、软垫以及各种精美的小枕头，以至于根本看不到任何木质材料。那些扶手椅看起来虽然柔软，但实际上触感远比看上去要结实得多。 你坐下来休息，而主人们则忙着在橱柜里翻找杯子、茶叶和零食，然后烧水。你耐心地等待着，感觉非常舒适。他们把水壶放在壁炉旁加热，这无疑也为营造这种温馨的氛围贡献了一份力量。但比起这些，更重要的是主人们的笑容，以及玛丽毫不掩饰地调情、逗弄她丈夫的样子——她的丈夫虽然脸红着，半心半意地抱怨着，却还是忍不住回应她的举动。 终于，茶泡好了，这对夫妇坐在另外两把椅子上，终于安顿下来。在接下来的寂静中，当大家都在等待茶完全泡好时，你开始思考起来：她说过自己并不在意是否有客户，但那么……她的生意究竟是如何维持下去的呢？ 玛丽笑得相当大声，她不得不先让自己平静下来，才能为您、凯苏克和自己倒三杯茶。您注意到她在凯苏克的茶杯里放了三块糖，在自己的茶杯里放了一块，而糖盒则放在您旁边，让您可以根据自己的喜好添加糖分。 “嗯，这确实是个合理的问题，”玛丽承认道，“我之前就告诉过您，我是通过向远北地区销售药剂来开始我的事业的，因为在那些地方，这类东西并不常见，对吧？ 没错，她确实这么做了。这确实很有道理——虽然可能会有一些人因为无知而害怕那些东西，但新奇感总是能够吸引人们的注意的。 “正是这样。不过，为了做到这一点 获得 无论是这个想法还是这些商品，我们都不得不前往遥远的北方去获取，因为那里根本没有什么这些资源。而这一切，都要归功于我的凯西甜心！”她笑着说，这时你转头看向凯苏克，发现他正尴尬地坐在椅子上。 “我……我其实没做什么，我只是想一起去旅行而已……真正负责安排一切的人是你，玛丽。” “如果没有你，这一切根本不可能实现。 思考 没有你，我就无法开始这段旅程！而且千万不要低估自己，你其实比我更会旅行呢！” 你看着这对可爱情侣的滑稽举动，笑了笑，终于试着喝了一口茶……嗯，味道还不错，不过说实话，你实在搞不清楚这到底是什么味道。用最简单的说法，就是这种味道有点像花的香气，只不过你完全不知道这是哪种花的味道。 哦，对了！”玛丽看到你的表情后说道，“这是我可爱丈夫自己酿制的花酒，这些花生长在雪中，几乎没人注意到它们的存在。虽然有点奇怪，但你会不知不觉就上瘾的——他真的太有天赋了！不过，别再让我丈夫感到尴尬了，其实他从来都不嫌这样做烦人。 关键在于，我们在旅途中去了好几个地方，发现每个地方都有自己独特的炼金术特色，而这些是其他地方所不知道的，尤其是我们的故乡。因此，我想到可以通过从一个地方购买这些商品，然后把它们带到只有当地人才知道如何寻找的定居点去售卖，从而赚一大笔钱。" 它的效果确实比我们预期的要好得多，”Kesuk说道，“我的意思是，Mary本来就相当富裕，但那次投资确实让她的事业取得了更大的发展。” “嗯！后来我们开始在远北地区以外的地方开设分店，这样就能更方便地进口各种原材料和工具了。而这家分店就是最新的一个！即使它的销量不是很高，也没关系，因为它的作用就是为我们提供一个采购和销售的基地罢了！ 哈，你看那些弥诺陶洛斯，一个骄傲地挺着它那丰满的胸膛，另一个则充满爱意地注视着前者，你不禁会感到赞叹。她可能说得有点轻描淡写，但在如此恶劣的环境中，不断往返运送那些易碎、敏感的原料，肯定不是一件容易的事。 不是这样的，这就是我们不再自己亲自去的原因！”她笑着说，“现在我们真的有钱了，就雇人去替我们完成这些旅行。我们现在要做的就是寻找新的潜在地点，购买或建造店铺，安顿下来，然后再开始下一次旅行。当然，这一切都是在我们想做的时候才去做的！”她又笑了起来，你也不由得跟着笑了起来。 接下来的几个小时，你和这对可爱的夫妇一起度过了，聊着各种各样的话题，也聊些无关紧要的事情，同时品尝着那种独特而美味的茶。你们谈论着各自的故乡，最近都做了些什么，城里正在发生些什么，还有许多琐碎的笑话和一些无关紧要的小事情。 你和他们一起欢笑、喝茶、吃点心，不知不觉中时间就过去了。与他们共度时光让人感到无比温暖舒适，看到他们开心的笑容，你也明白这种感觉是相互的。转眼间，水壶已经空了，你不得不承认自己在这里待的时间可能比原本计划的要长。你起身，感谢这对可爱的夫妇让你们度过了如此愉快的茶歇时光，然后便走出了房间。当你离开时，玛丽笑着拍了拍你的屁股，还挥手和你道别，你也同样回了挥手。
rows.raw: " Well, they did promise you a cup of tea, didn't they? Besides, it looks like they can afford a little break. "Oh? And what's that supposed to mean, mh? That our shop is unpopular and empty so it doesn't matter if we close it anyway?" Er. Well no, you just mean... every business has its less busy hours and uh... You're cut off when Mary bursts out laughing. "Because you're right! The citizens of this newly opened city are still a little wary of a foreigner's shop, apparently. We do get a few clients now and then, but mostly window shoppers. It takes time for ice elves to warm up to someone, eh? So yes, it really doesn't matter if we close shop for the day if we feel like it!" She grins at Kesuk who smiles back, before he runs up to the front of the shop and flips the sign around and locks the door. With the shop closed up for now, Mary steps out from behind the counter and tells you to follow as she enters the door at the back. She leads you through a richly-decorated corridor before you arrive at a very cozy-looking kitchen. It's fairly big, though so full of large furniture it's almost hard to move around, and yet it just feels comfortable. Every piece of furniture is covered in quilts, antimacassars, slipcovers, carpets, upholstery and small fancy pillows to the point you can't even see any wood. And while the armchairs look soft, they feel so much more than that. You sink into one of them as your hosts dig around cupboards for cups, tea and snacks, and then boil some water while you wait patiently and very comfortably. They put the kettle to heat up next to the hearth, which is no doubt partially to blame for part of this very warm atmosphere. But not nearly as much as the smiles of your hosts, and the way Mary unabashedly flirts and gropes her husband who blushes and half-heartedly complains while pushing back into her. Eventually, the tea is done and the couple sit down on the other two chairs, finally settling down. And in the silence that follows as you all wait for the tea to finish brewing, you start to wonder. She mentioned she didn't care about having clients, but then... Well, how does her business stay afloat? Mary laughs quite loudly, and she has to calm herself down before pouring three cups of tea for you, Kesuk and herself. You notice she put three sugars in Kesuk's cup, one in hers, and put the sugarbox next to you for you to put as many as you like. "Well, it's a fair question," Mary admits. "I told you that I started my business by selling potions to the Far North, where that sort of thing isn't common, yes?" Right, she did. It makes sense, while there might be some people afraid of the stuff out of ignorance, novelty always sells. "Precisely. But in order to get both the idea and the merchandise, we had to travel out of the Far North, since there's none of that there. And I have my Kessy sweetie to thank for that!" she grins, and you turn to Kesuk who sinks in his chair in embarrassment. "I- I didn't do much, I just wanted to travel... You're the one who took care of everything, Mary." "I never would have thought to travel without you! And don't sell yourself short, you're a better traveler than I am!" You smile at the cute couple's antics, and finally try a sip of the tea... Huh. It's not bad but, well, you can't quite grasp what it even is. The best way to put it is that it tastes like how the smell of a flower would taste, and you don't even know what flower exactly. "Oh yes!" Mary says, noticing your face. "My cute husband's own brew, made of discrete flowers that grow in the snow unnoticed by most. It's strange, but you'll be addicted before you know it, he's so talented! But enough making my husband squirm, not that it ever gets old. The point is, on our way we traveled to a few places and realized each place had its own alchemical specialty that others didn't know about, especially not our homeland. So I figured I could make a fortune by buying from one place and carrying the goods to homesteads only locals know how to look for." "It did work a lot better than we expected," Kesuk notes. "I mean, Mary was already kind of well-off in the first place, but it really took off with that venture." "Mhm! And then we started opening shops outside of the Far North, to give us locations to import ingredients and tools more easily. And this shop is the latest one! It doesn't matter if it doesn't sell much, because its purpose is to give us a place to purchase from and sell elsewhere!" Huh. You look at the minotaurs, one puffing her generous chest proudly, the other looking at the former lovingly, and find yourself impressed. She might be underselling it, but traveling back and forth with sensitive ingredients in such a harsh environment can't be easy. "It's not, and it's why we don't do it anymore!" she laughs. "Now that we're really rich, we just hire people to do the trip for us. Now all we do ourselves is looking for new potential locations, buying or building a shop and settling in before going for the next. When we feel like it!" she laughs again, and you can't help but join in. You spend the next few hours with the lovely couple, chatting about everything and nothing, enjoying the peculiar but awfully tasty tea. You talk about your respective homelands, about what you got up to recently, about what's happening in the city, and a plethora of little jokes and inconsequential little things. You laugh, drink and snack with them, not seeing the time go by. Spending time with them feels very warm and comfortable, and seeing their happy smiles it's clear the feeling is mutual. Before you know it, the kettle is empty and you have to admit you've been here maybe longer than you should have. You get up and thank the sweet couple for the pleasant tea time, before making your way back outside. Mary gives you a hearty pat on the butt as you leave, laughing and waving you goodbye while you wave back. "

rows.original: You really do like spending time with this cute couple. Though part of you wonders. Are you hoping for a bit more than just friendship from the gorgeous cow and her husband?
rows.translation: 你确实很喜欢和这一对可爱的情侣一起度过时光。不过，你心里也在想：对于这位迷人的女孩和她的丈夫来说，你期待的是否不仅仅是友谊而已呢？

rows.original: How about a little tea break? You'd like to get to taste their unique brew again. Mary chuckles, and she waves at Kesuk to go close the shop for now. With the shop closed up, Mary steps out from behind the counter and tells you to follow as she enters the door at the back. She leads you through a richly-decorated corridor before you arrive at a very cozy-looking kitchen. It's fairly big, though so full of large furniture it's almost hard to move around, and yet it just feels comfortable. Every piece of furniture is covered in quilts, antimacassars, slipcovers, carpets, upholstery and small fancy pillows to the point you can't even see any wood. And while the armchairs look soft, they feel so much more than that. You sink into one of them as your hosts dig around cupboards for cups, tea and snacks, and then boil some water while you wait patiently and very comfortably. They put the kettle to heat up next to the hearth, which is no doubt partially to blame for part of this very warm atmosphere. But not nearly as much as the smiles of your hosts, and the way Mary unabashedly flirts and gropes her husband who blushes and half-heartedly complains while pushing back into her. Once again, you watch as she pours three cups and... instead of giving you the sugarbox for you to put it in, you watch her put just as many sugars as you put in last time. Aw, she remembered? How very sweet and considerate of her. You accept the warm cup gratefully, and the warmth reminds you of something you were wondering about. Out of curiosity, why did they want to travel out of the Far North? They mentioned they just wanted to travel before starting this business venture, was it just to get out of the cold? "Well, that's part of it but..." Mary trails off, looking unsure of herself for once, maybe even for the first time since you met her. She seems conflicted, but Kesuk ends up cutting in. "It's okay Mary, I trust [pc.name]. The cold was part of the reason, but the main reason was me. I never... I never felt like I fit in, back there." He sighs and continues, staring into his cup. "I've always been very small. Minotaur men up north are smaller than the southern ones around here, but even then I'm particularly small. In- In many ways. And well, up there men usually compete for the affection of the women, to be one of their many husbands, so men compete a lot with each other. I've never been good with competition, and I was weak, so I usually ended up bullied out of the way." His voice sounds so dull and resigned, you want to hug him there and then, but with the chairs you're in you can only put a comforting hand on his shoulder. And you see that Mary put a loving hand on his own, muttering, "Even though Kessy's always been such a sweetie. Not a single mean bone in his body, always there to help, even for people that were mean to him." Kesuk smiles at her, then at you, silently thanking you for the gesture. "Though I can understand wanting to bully such an adorable boy," she adds, making Kesuk laugh and say a playfully scolding, "Mary!" "What, it's true! You're just so cute, how can anyone resist teasing you and making you blush, squirm and whine in that adorable way of yours?" she smiles, making him blush, squirm and whine in an adorable way. "A-Anyway!" he coughs, trying to get the conversation back on track. "Things weren't going great for me. But thankfully, Mary saved me." She chuckles at that. "That's a fancy way of saying your mother convinced me to hire you as an apprentice after you turned 18. And even then, it took me a bit to realize just what a gentle sweetheart you are. And then it took me much longer to admit to myself I fell in love with a boy half my age. And then it took me far longer to give in and act on it, especially since I didn't want to take advantage of you and I wasn't even sure if I should." Kesuk giggles, holding her hand. "I had no such issue. I knew I fell in love the moment I saw her, and I just spent the rest of the time thinking I wasn't worthy of her, that she'd never pick me, that I was too young for her, that I could never confess my feelings... until I did. And she told me she loved me too. I don't think I ever cried as much as during that day." The two share a long, loving look which you're almost envious of. Though he ends up looking down into his cup again. "But even then, I only felt like I fit in with her. Especially since the other guys got pretty jealous of me, who got to marry one of the most gorgeous women around, as well as one from a known trading family — not that I cared about that. But it did make them try even harder to flirt with her, and made me feel pretty scared she'd find someone better than me, and forget about me." "Not that it'd ever happen! But it didn't help that I've always been a flirty gal, always liked making boys and girls blush up a storm. And it was oh so difficult for me!" she cries out theatrically, one dramatic hand against her forehead. "To not be able to flirt and tease every client that enters my shop anymore, lest I hurt my sweetie!" Kesuk laughs at her antics, but you have to ask, isn't she flirty already? Just, you know, showing off her cleavage and patting butts and all that. "You think that's flirting?" the minoboi asks, giggling a bit. "That's her holding back a lot! I'm, well, I'm sure she could show you if you'd like." The big cow grins at that, getting out of her chair and walking around the table. "Oh? Well if I'm allowed," she says sultrily, kissing the top of her husband's head on the way before she slides a hand up your arm and lands on your shoulder. "Why hello my good customer," she says in a clearly fake customer voice. "I see you're interested in my goods, mh?" She moves behind you, not-so-subtly brushing the side of your face with her chest. "This product is one of our most popular," she continues, mostly just giving you a regular if sultry run down of some product she sells. But more remarkably, she rubs your shoulders, she presses her chest against the back of your head, she casually rubs a finger against your chin, whispers casually in your ears... This really is flirting on another level. And it's working very well at that. You can't deny that her touch, despite being technically not outright lewd, is making you feel warm and bothered, and soon enough your [pc.cock] is straining against your clothes. [pc.hasRealCock | |How... Did you accidentally activate your magicock ]? Regardless, you're very clearly pitching a tent, and Kesuk is the first to notice. "Oh! Um, perhaps you should, uh, slow down a bit Mary," he gulps, clearly staring at your crotch. She follows his gaze and gasps. "Oh! Why, it seems I haven't lost my touch! I'm used to teasing Kesuk 'til he pops as soon as we're alone of course, but this is.. It's been a while since I got someone else to react like that!" She clears her throat and shakes her head. "Oh, but I should stop. Sorry about leaving you like this, [pc.name], but I can't really..." "I-I don't mind!" Kesuk blurts out. Both you and Mary stare at him, and he buries himself so far into his chair he almost ends up hidden in the pillows. "I mean... it's our fault, especially mine since I told you to do so... I mean, if you wanted to jerk [pc.name] a little just to help, I wouldn't mind..." "Really? Well, how about it [pc.mf |mister |miss ]?" Mary grins at you. "Want a little handy from this old lady?" Well, you didn't really expect this. You suppose you could, though it'd be while her husband watches... which might be a perk, in a way.

嗯，这也是原因之一，但是……”玛丽的话说到这里戛然而止，她看起来有些犹豫不决，或许这是你认识她以来，她第一次表现出这样的神情。她似乎内心很矛盾，但最终凯苏克打断了她。 “没关系，玛丽，我相信你。 rows.original:
You approach the statue of the elven warrior-maiden, drawing forth your waystone charm and holding it up towards her gem-set crown. The moment you hold up the charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.

        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and the wind howls through the city square. The gemstone in the statue's crown shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. The idol is awakened once more...
        
        Several startled elves stare at you, backing away slowly. 
        
        [party.has etheryn|"D-don't mind us!" Etheryn squeaks, putting up her hands. "Just... just fixing it!"]

你走向那位精灵战士少女的雕像，取出你的路石护符，将其举向她那镶嵌着宝石的王冠。就在你举起护身符的那一刻，你感觉到空气中弥漫着一种紧张的气氛，整个空间仿佛都被强大的能量所充斥。 你咬紧牙关，向前走去，强迫自己朝着那座古老的雕像走去。

就在这时，突然间，那种压迫感消失了，狂风在城镇广场上呼啸而过。雕像头顶上的宝石开始闪烁，内部仿佛蕴含着轻型芒，正在脉动般地发轻型。..它醒来了！你露出笑容，将那枚护身符握在拳头中，看着轻型芒渐渐消失。那个神像又一次被唤醒了……

几个惊慌的精灵盯着你，缓缓后退着。 
        
        [party.has etheryn|别、别管我们！”艾瑟琳惊慌地叫道，同时举起了双手。“我们只是在……只是在修理它而已！]

rows.original: You throw open the bar and pull the castle's heavy wooden doors open, a monumental effort considering their sheer size. When they've shuddered into position, you find a company of brawny elven warrior-women standing in the courtyard, staring up at you with mild surprise. [etheryn.lowConfidence|"H-hi, ladies," Etheryn chirps nervously from behind you|"Ladies," Etheryn comments from behind you]. "It's just me. Stand down." The guards give a collective shrug and turn their attentions back to the city streets. Oh, well, that's easy then. At least, it seems like it, until you take a step out. The guards whirl around, crossing their spears over the palace steps. "None may enter. None may leave. By the queen's decree." [flags.WC_QUEEN_DEF |Telling them you just beat the daylights out of their queen probably isn't a smart play, considering there's several dozen warriors facing you down. Not until you can prove what their queen has become in front of everyone... |"By the queen's decree," Ryn murmurs, touching your shoulder. "We should... we have to find my sister." Yeah. And when you do, you'll have to prove to the whole city what's happened here. There's no getting out of here until Alissa is dealt with. ]
